story: With the Yellow Turbans in arms, Liu Yan, governor of You province, posts a call for volunteers. In Zhuo county a man of twenty-eight, Liu Bei, reads the notice and sighs. A voice booms behind him: why sigh, when a real man should be serving his country? It is Zhang Fei, a wine-seller and pig-butcher with a panther's head and round eyes. Over wine at a village inn they see a red-faced, long-bearded giant come in pushing a cart and calling for wine so he can hurry off to enlist: Guan Yu of Xieliang, on the run for five or six years since he killed a local bully.

The three talk until they are of one mind. Next day, in the peach garden behind Zhang Fei's farm, they offer a black ox and a white horse, burn incense and swear to stand together, help the distressed, serve the state and give peace to the people: not born on the same day, they will die on the same day. Liu Bei is the eldest, Guan Yu the second, Zhang Fei the youngest. They gather three hundred young men of the district, and two merchants from Zhongshan, Zhang Shiping and Su Shuang, give them horses, money and steel, from which they forge Liu Bei's double swords, Guan Yu's Green Dragon blade and Zhang Fei's eighteen-foot spear.

Historically: Guan Yu's biography in the Records of the Three Kingdoms says that when Liu Bei raised followers in his home district, Guan Yu and Zhang Fei were his guards; the three 'slept in the same bed and were as close as brothers', and in company the two stood beside him all day. Zhang Fei's biography adds that Guan Yu was a few years older and Zhang Fei treated him as an elder brother. The merchants are real: Liu Bei's biography says their money let him raise his band. But Zhang Fei the butcher and the oath in the garden are nowhere in the histories; the story had taken shape by the Yuan-dynasty Pinghua tales of the Three Kingdoms.
story_zh: 黄巾大起，幽州太守刘焉出榜招募义兵。榜文贴到涿县，二十八岁的刘备看罢慨然长叹，身后一人厉声道：“大丈夫不与国家出力，何故长叹？”此人豹头环眼、燕颔虎须，是卖酒屠猪的张飞。两人同到村店饮酒，又见一个红脸长髯的大汉推车进来，催店家快上酒，好赶去投军，他便是河东解良人关羽，因杀了倚势凌人的本地豪强，已在江湖上逃难五六年。
三人越谈越投机。次日在张飞庄后的桃园里，备下乌牛白马，焚香再拜，立誓同心协力、救困扶危，上报国家、下安黎庶，“不求同年同月同日生，只愿同年同月同日死”。刘备为兄，关羽次之，张飞为弟。他们聚起乡中勇士三百余人，又得中山大商张世平、苏双赠送良马、金银和镔铁，打造了双股剑、青龙偃月刀和丈八点钢矛，从此踏上征程。
史实：《三国志·关羽传》说，刘备在乡里聚众，关羽、张飞为他抵御外侮；三人“寝则同床，恩若兄弟”，在大庭广众之中，关、张则整日侍立在刘备身旁。《张飞传》说关羽年长几岁，张飞以兄长之礼待他。中山商人张世平、苏双出资助刘备募兵，见于《先主传》，确有其人。张飞屠户出身与桃园盟誓都不见于史书，结义故事在元代《三国志平话》中已经成形。
ch001-peach-garden.why: The oath is the bond on which the whole novel turns: the brothers' loyalty to one another, and its price, drive the story to the end.
ch001-peach-garden.why_zh: 桃园之誓是全书情义的根本，三兄弟此后的成败生死都由此展开。

quote.zh: 不求同年同月同日生，只愿同年同月同日死
quote.en: We do not ask to be born on the same day of the same year; we ask only to die on the same day of the same year.

people.name: Guan Yu
people.role: Second brother, a fugitive from Xieliang
people.role_zh: 结义二弟，亡命的解良人

people.name: Zhang Fei
people.role: Youngest brother, host of the oath

story: The novel opens with its famous line that the empire, long divided, must unite, and long united, must divide; then it tells how emperors Huan and Ling trusted their eunuchs while government rotted and omens multiplied. In Julu a failed scholar named Zhang Jiao, gathering herbs in the mountains, meets a green-eyed old man with a boy's face and a goosefoot staff who calls himself the Immortal of Nanhua. He gives Zhang Jiao three scrolls, the Essential Arts of Great Peace, and tells him to spread their teaching and save the world. Zhang Jiao studies day and night until he can call up wind and rain.

In the first month of 184 an epidemic breaks out; Zhang Jiao hands out charmed water to the sick and calls himself the Great Worthy Teacher. His following grows until he organizes it into thirty-six districts of six thousand to ten thousand men, each under a commander, and has the characters jiazi chalked on gates everywhere. A rising inside and outside the capital is planned, but his disciple Tang Zhou betrays it and the agent Ma Yuanyi is caught and beheaded. Zhang Jiao rises at once as General of Heaven, with his brothers Zhang Bao and Zhang Liang as Generals of Earth and of Man; four or five hundred thousand men put on yellow turbans, and government troops scatter before them.

This is close to the histories. The Book of the Later Han (biography of Huangfu Song) says Zhang Jiao healed with charmed water and spells, that in ten-odd years his followers spread across eight provinces, and that the rising, set for the fifth day of the third month, was brought forward when Tang Zhou informed. The Immortal and his scrolls are the novel's. Huangfu Song, Zhu Jun and Lu Zhi crushed the main armies within the year and Zhang Jiao died of illness; but remnants fought on for twenty years, and the provincial governors who raised troops against them became the warlords who broke the Han apart.
story_zh: 小说开篇先说“天下大势，分久必合，合久必分”，再说桓、灵二帝宠信宦官，朝政日坏，灾异屡见。巨鹿郡有个不第秀才张角，入山采药，遇见一位碧眼童颜、手执藜杖的老人，自称南华老仙，传给他天书三卷，名为《太平要术》，嘱他代天宣化、普救世人。张角昼夜攻习，能呼风唤雨，号称“太平道人”。
中平元年正月疫气流行，张角散施符水为人治病，自称“大贤良师”。信徒越聚越多，他设三十六方，大方万余人、小方六七千，各立渠帅，又让人用白土在各家门上写“甲子”二字。本来约好里应外合，弟子唐周告密，内应马元义被擒斩首，张角便连夜起兵，自称天公将军，弟弟张宝、张梁称地公、人公将军，四五十万人头裹黄巾，官军望风而靡。
这段与史书大体相合。《后汉书·皇甫嵩传》载，张角奉事黄老，以符水咒语治病，十余年间信徒遍及青、徐、幽、冀、荆、扬、兖、豫八州；起事原定三月五日内外俱起，因唐周告密而提前。南华老仙授书则是小说附会。朝廷派皇甫嵩、朱儁、卢植等分路征讨，当年便击溃主力，张角病死；但余部此起彼伏二十余年，州郡借讨贼拥兵自重，汉朝由此走向分裂。
ch001-yellow-turbans.why: The rising cracks the Han's hold on the provinces and gives the warlords, and the novel's heroes, their start.
ch001-yellow-turbans.why_zh: 黄巾起义动摇了汉朝的统治，群雄由此登场，小说的故事也由此展开。

quote.zh: 苍天已死，黄天当立；岁在甲子，天下大吉
quote.en: The blue heaven is dead, the yellow heaven shall rise; in the jiazi year, great fortune under heaven.

people.name: Zhang Jiao
people.role: Leader of the Way of Great Peace, General of Heaven

story: After their first victories the brothers join Liu Bei's old teacher Lu Zhi, who gives them a thousand government troops and sends them to help Huangfu Song and Zhu Jun in Yingchuan. There Zhang Liang and Zhang Bao, beaten, have fallen back to Changshe and camped among the long grass. 'They have camped in grass,' Huangfu Song tells Zhu Jun, 'so we use fire.' Each soldier is given a bundle of straw and sent to lie in wait. That night a strong wind rises; after the second watch the fires are lit together, the flames leap to the sky, and the rebels flee without saddling their horses or putting on their armor.

At dawn, as the two Zhangs cut their way out, a troop under red banners blocks the road. At its head rides a man seven feet tall with narrow eyes and a long beard: Cao Cao, Commandant of Cavalry. The novel pauses to introduce him: childhood name A Man, fond of hunting, song and dance, full of schemes and quick shifts; the famous judge of men Xu Shao told him he would be an able minister in an age of order and a cunning hero in an age of chaos, and Cao Cao was delighted. His men kill ten thousand and take banners, drums and horses. Liu Bei arrives after the fighting is over.

Changshe is in Huangfu Song's biography in the Book of the Later Han: the rebel commander Bo Cai besieged him there; short of men, Huangfu Song waited for a strong wind, had his soldiers carry torches onto the walls and sent picked men out through the siege lines to start fires and raise a shout, the walls answering with torches, and the rebels broke. Cao Cao, Commandant of Cavalry, happened to arrive, and with Zhu Jun they won a great victory. So the enemy was Bo Cai, not Zhang Liang and Zhang Bao. Xu Shao's verdict appears in the Book of the Later Han as 'a villain in times of peace, a hero in times of chaos'; the novel uses the version in Sun Sheng's Yitong zayu.
story_zh: 刘备兄弟初战告捷，又赶到广宗投奔师父卢植。卢植拨给他一千官军，让他去颍川帮皇甫嵩、朱儁。此时张梁、张宝在颍川失利，退入长社，依草结营。皇甫嵩对朱儁说：“贼依草结营，当用火攻。”便令军士每人束草一把，暗中埋伏。当夜大风忽起，二更以后一齐纵火，火焰张天，黄巾军马不及鞍、人不及甲，四散奔逃。
杀到天明，张梁、张宝夺路而走，迎面一彪人马尽打红旗，截住去路。为首一将身长七尺、细眼长髯，正是骑都尉曹操。小说在这里交代他的来历：小字阿瞒，好游猎、喜歌舞，有权谋、多机变；名士许劭评他“治世之能臣，乱世之奸雄”，他听了大喜。曹操截杀一阵，斩首万余，夺得旗幡金鼓马匹极多。刘备赶到时，仗已经打完了。
长社之战见于《后汉书·皇甫嵩传》：黄巾渠帅波才围皇甫嵩于长社，嵩兵少，趁大风令军士束苣登城，派精兵潜出围外纵火呐喊，城上举火相应，黄巾惊乱奔走；适逢骑都尉曹操领兵赶到，与皇甫嵩、朱儁合兵大破之，斩首数万。可见当时的对手是波才，并非张梁、张宝。许劭的评语，《后汉书》作“清平之奸贼，乱世之英雄”，小说用的是孙盛《异同杂语》的说法。
ch001-changshe.why: Cao Cao enters the story at the head of a victorious army, labeled from the start as the cunning hero of a chaotic age.
ch001-changshe.why_zh: 曹操以胜利者的姿态登场，“乱世之奸雄”的评语也从此成为他在全书中的底色。

quote.zh: 子治世之能臣，乱世之奸雄也
quote.en: In an age of order you would be an able minister; in an age of chaos, a cunning hero.

people.name: Cao Cao
people.role: Commandant of Cavalry who cuts off the retreat

people.name: Liu Bei
people.role: Sent to help, arrives too late

story: When the Yellow Turbans are put down, Liu Bei's services go unrewarded until at last he is made sheriff of Anxi in Zhongshan. In four months he does not take so much as a hair from the people, and they love him for it. Then an edict orders a purge of officials who won their posts in the war, and an inspector arrives to review the county. Liu Bei goes out to greet him; the inspector, still in the saddle, answers with a flick of his whip, and at the post-house accuses Liu Bei of faking imperial kinship and padding his record. A clerk explains that the man wants a bribe. 'I have not taken a hair from the people,' says Liu Bei. 'Where would I find money for him?'

Next day the inspector seizes the county clerk to make him accuse the sheriff of oppressing the people, and Liu Bei is turned away at the door again and again. Zhang Fei, who has been drinking to his anger, rides past the post-house and finds fifty or sixty old people weeping at the gate. When he hears why, he storms in, drags the inspector out by the hair to the county office, ties him to the hitching post and thrashes him with willow switches until a dozen have snapped. 'Brambles are no roost for a phoenix,' Guan Yu tells Liu Bei. Liu Bei hangs his seal of office round the inspector's neck, gives him a tongue-lashing, and the three leave to take refuge with Liu Hui in Dai.

Historically: it was Liu Bei himself. Liu Bei's biography in the Records of the Three Kingdoms says that when the inspector came on business and would not see him, he forced his way in, tied the man up, gave him two hundred strokes, hung his own seal cord round his neck and fled. The Dianlue, quoted in Pei Songzhi's notes, gives more: Liu Bei expected to be purged; the inspector pleaded illness; Liu Bei burst into the post-house with his men claiming secret orders from the governor, tied the inspector to a tree at the county border and flogged him a hundred-odd times, letting him go only when he begged for his life.
story_zh: 黄巾平定后，刘备的战功迟迟得不到封赏，后来才被授为中山府安喜县尉。他到任四个月，与民秋毫无犯，百姓都很感念。不久朝廷降诏，要淘汰因军功做官的人，督邮奉命来县里查察。刘备出城迎接，督邮坐在马上只用鞭子一指；到了馆驿，又斥他“诈称皇亲，虚报功绩”。县吏私下提醒，督邮是想要贿赂，刘备说：“我与民秋毫无犯，那得财物与他？”
第二天，督邮把县吏抓去，逼他诬告县尉害民，刘备几次求见都被挡回。张飞喝了几杯闷酒，路过馆驿，见五六十个老人在门前痛哭，问明缘由，大怒闯入，揪住督邮的头发拖到县衙前，绑在拴马桩上，折下柳条痛打，一连打断十几根。关羽劝刘备：“枳棘丛中，非栖鸾凤之所。”刘备便把官印挂在督邮脖子上，斥责一番，三人弃官而去，投奔代州刘恢。
史实：鞭打督邮的其实是刘备本人。《三国志·先主传》载，督邮因公事到县，刘备求见不得，便直闯进去把他绑了，杖打二百，解下自己的印绶系在他脖子上，弃官亡命。裴注引《典略》说得更细：朝廷下诏淘汰军功出身的官吏，刘备料定自己在裁撤之列，督邮又托病不见，他便带吏卒冲进传舍，谎称奉太守密令拿人，把督邮绑到县界的树上鞭打一百多下，督邮苦苦哀求才放了他。
ch002-whipping-the-inspector.why: The scene fixes Zhang Fei's fiery temper and Liu Bei's mildness in readers' minds, at the cost of the historical Liu Bei's own violence.
ch002-whipping-the-inspector.why_zh: 这一回奠定了张飞刚烈、刘备宽厚的形象，代价是抹去了历史上刘备本人火爆的一面。

quote.zh: 枳棘丛中，非栖鸾凤之所
quote.en: A thicket of thorns is no place for a phoenix to roost.

story: In 189, as Emperor Ling lies dying, the eunuch Jian Shuo plots to kill the regent He Jin and put Prince Liu Xie on the throne, but He Jin is warned. When the emperor dies, He Jin enthrones his nephew Liu Bian, Jian Shuo is killed, and He Jin resolves to wipe out the Ten Regular Attendants. The empress dowager, swayed by her mother and her brother He Miao, protects the eunuchs, so He Jin decides to summon armies from the provinces to force her hand. His secretary Chen Lin warns that this is 'covering your eyes to catch sparrows'; Cao Cao says a single jailer would be enough, so why call in outside armies? He Jin accuses him of selfish motives, and Cao Cao withdraws saying that the man who will throw the realm into chaos is He Jin.

He Jin sends secret summonses to Dong Zhuo, governor of Xiliang, and others. The eunuchs learn of it, hide armed men inside the Jiade Gate of the Changle Palace, and coax the empress dowager into calling He Jin to the palace. Chen Lin and Cao Cao beg him not to go; he laughs at their childishness: he holds the realm, what can the eunuchs do to him? He goes in alone. Zhang Rang berates him to his face as a butcher's boy, the ambush springs, and he is cut in two. When his head is flung over the wall, Yuan Shao cries that the eunuchs have murdered a minister of state, and with Cao Cao and others he forces the gates and kills every eunuch in sight, even beardless men who are not eunuchs at all.

This is essentially history. The Book of the Later Han says He Jin was killed by Zhang Rang, Duan Gui and others before the Jiade Hall in the eighth month of 189. Cao Cao's advice to punish only the ringleaders, 'one jailer is enough', comes from the Book of Wei quoted in Pei Songzhi's notes, and Chen Lin's sparrow warning is in the Records of the Three Kingdoms. Yuan Shao shut the palace gates and killed more than two thousand eunuchs; some men died for lacking a beard, and others saved themselves only by stripping to prove it. The armies had been summoned, Dong Zhuo came, and the Han court passed into the hands of warlords.
story_zh: 中平六年灵帝病重，宦官蹇硕想先除掉大将军何进，好立皇子刘协，被何进识破。灵帝死后，何进拥立外甥刘辩即位，蹇硕被杀，何进又想把十常侍一网打尽。何太后听了母亲和弟弟何苗的话，执意庇护宦官，何进便要召外地兵马进京相逼。主簿陈琳劝他这是“掩目而捕燕雀”，曹操也说只需交给一个狱吏就够了，何必召外兵？何进怒斥他存有私心，曹操退下说：“乱天下者，必进也。”
何进不听，发密诏召西凉刺史董卓等进京。宦官得知后，在长乐宫嘉德门内埋伏刀斧手，哄太后下诏宣何进入宫。陈琳、曹操都劝他别去，何进笑道：“此小儿之见也。吾掌天下之权，十常侍敢待如何？”他独自入宫，张让当面骂他本是“屠沽小辈”，伏兵齐出，把他砍为两段。宦官把首级从墙头掷出，袁绍大呼“阉官谋杀大臣”，与曹操等斩关入宫，见宦官便杀，连没有胡须的人也被误杀。
这段基本据史。《后汉书·何进传》载，何进于中平六年八月被张让、段珪等杀于嘉德殿前。曹操劝何进只诛元凶、“一狱吏足矣”的话，出自裴注引《魏书》；陈琳“掩目捕雀”的谏言也见于《三国志》。袁绍关闭宫门捕杀宦官二千余人，有人因没有胡须被误杀，有的只好脱衣自证才得免死。外兵既召，董卓进京，东汉朝廷从此落入军阀手中。
ch002-he-jin.why: Summoning the frontier armies to settle a palace feud opens the capital to Dong Zhuo and starts the Han's collapse.
ch002-he-jin.why_zh: 为一场宫廷争斗召外兵进京，引来了董卓，东汉的崩溃由此开始。

story: Master of the capital, Dong Zhuo holds a banquet in the Wenming Garden and proposes to depose the emperor. Ding Yuan, governor of Jing province, pushes back his table and denounces him; Dong Zhuo draws his sword, then sees standing behind Ding Yuan a magnificent young man with a halberd, glaring at him: Ding Yuan's adopted son Lü Bu. Next day Lü Bu charges out at the head of Ding Yuan's troops and routs Dong Zhuo, who sighs that with such a man the empire would be his for the taking. Li Su, a palace guard commander from Lü Bu's home district, says he knows Lü Bu: brave but brainless, quick to forget loyalty when he sees a profit. With his three-inch tongue he will bring him over.

Li Su asks Dong Zhuo for Red Hare, a horse that runs a thousand li a day, and takes along a thousand taels of gold, dozens of pearls and a jade belt. The horse is red as burning coal from head to tail without a single stray hair, and Lü Bu is overjoyed. Li Su praises his talents and reminds him that a good bird chooses the tree it nests in. In the second watch that night Lü Bu walks into Ding Yuan's tent, where his master is reading by candlelight, shouts that a true man will be no one's son, and cuts off his head. Next morning he takes the head to Dong Zhuo, bows to him as his adoptive father, and is rewarded with golden armor, a brocade robe and a string of titles.

Historically: Lü Bu's biography in the Records of the Three Kingdoms says he was the trusted registrar of Ding Yuan, inspector of Bing province, not his son; Ding Yuan came to the capital and became Bearer of the Golden Mace. Dong Zhuo wanted his troops and induced Lü Bu to kill him; Lü Bu brought the head, was made Commandant of Cavalry and swore to be Dong Zhuo's son. Red Hare was indeed his horse ('Lü Bu had a fine horse called Red Hare'), and the Cao Man zhuan in Pei Songzhi's notes records the saying 'Lü Bu among men, Red Hare among horses'. But Li Su's mission and the gift of the horse appear in no history.
story_zh: 董卓进京后，在温明园大宴百官，提出废立皇帝。荆州刺史丁原推案而起，当面斥责，董卓拔剑要杀他，却见丁原身后站着一人，器宇轩昂，手执方天画戟，怒目而视，正是丁原的义子吕布。次日丁原引兵搦战，吕布纵马挺戟冲杀，董卓大败，叹道：“吾若得此人，何虑天下哉！”虎贲中郎将李肃说，自己与吕布同乡，知他勇而无谋、见利忘义，愿凭三寸不烂之舌说他来降。
李肃向董卓讨了日行千里的赤兔马，又带上黄金一千两、明珠数十颗、玉带一条。那马浑身上下火炭般赤，无半根杂毛，吕布一见大喜。李肃又劝他“良禽择木而栖，贤臣择主而事”。当夜二更，吕布提刀闯进丁原帐中，丁原正秉烛观书，吕布喝道：“吾堂堂丈夫，安肯为汝子乎！”一刀砍下丁原首级。次日他提头去见董卓，拜为义父，董卓赐他金甲锦袍，封为骑都尉、中郎将、都亭侯。
史实：《三国志·吕布传》载，吕布本是并州刺史丁原手下的主簿，深受亲信，二人并非父子；丁原率兵入京，任执金吾。董卓想吞并丁原的人马，诱使吕布杀了丁原，吕布提着首级投奔董卓，被任为骑都尉，与董卓“誓为父子”。赤兔确是吕布坐骑，《吕布传》说“布有良马曰赤兔”，裴注引《曹瞒传》记时人语“人中有吕布，马中有赤兔”。李肃说降、董卓赠马，史书都没有记载。
ch003-red-hare.why: Lü Bu's first betrayal gives Dong Zhuo the strongest warrior in the capital and brands Lü Bu as a man who sells his loyalty for gain.
ch003-red-hare.why_zh: 吕布第一次背主，使董卓得到京师第一猛将，“见利忘义”也从此成为吕布的标签。

quote.zh: 良禽择木而栖，贤臣择主而事
quote.en: A good bird picks the tree it nests in; a wise servant picks the master he serves.

people.name: Lü Bu
people.role: Kills Ding Yuan for Red Hare

story: In the chaos after He Jin's death, the eunuchs Zhang Rang and Duan Gui seize the boy emperor and his brother, the Prince of Chenliu, and flee through smoke and fire toward Beimang Hill. In the second watch the official Min Gong catches up with them, and Zhang Rang, cornered, throws himself into the river. The two boys hide in the grass by the bank until the soldiers have passed, cold and hungry, clinging to each other and weeping without daring to make a sound. 'We cannot stay here,' says the prince, 'we must find a way out.' They tie their clothes together and scramble up the bank into a darkness full of thorns, until a swarm of fireflies gathers and lights the way before the emperor.

'Heaven is helping us,' says the prince. Following the fireflies they reach a road, walk until their feet give out in the fifth watch, and lie down by a haystack, where a farmer, Cui Yi, takes them in. Min Gong finds them there and the ministers follow. On the way back an army appears with banners that blot out the sun; the emperor is too frightened to speak, but the prince rides forward and demands who comes. Dong Zhuo says he has come to protect the emperor. 'Then the Son of Heaven is here,' says the prince, 'why do you not dismount?' Dong Zhuo hastily gets down and bows by the roadside. The prince speaks well all the way back, and Dong Zhuo begins to think of putting him on the throne.

Historically: He Jin's biography in the Book of the Later Han says Zhang Rang and the others fled with the emperor by night to the Yellow River crossing at Xiaopingjin; when Lu Zhi and Min Gong caught up, the eunuchs kowtowed in farewell and drowned themselves. Min Gong then helped the emperor and the prince 'walk south by night following the light of fireflies' until they found a farmer's open cart, and next day the ministers and Dong Zhuo met them below Beimang. So the fireflies come from the history itself. The Xiandi ji in Pei Songzhi's notes adds that the emperor could not answer Dong Zhuo, while the prince told the whole story of the troubles without a slip, and that this gave Dong Zhuo the idea of changing emperors.
story_zh: 何进死后宫中大乱，张让、段珪劫持少帝和陈留王，冒烟突火连夜逃往北邙山。二更时分，河南中部掾吏闵贡带兵追来，张让走投无路，投河而死。兄弟二人藏在河边乱草丛里，等追兵过去，饥寒交迫，相抱而哭又不敢出声。陈留王说：“此间不可久恋，须别寻活路。”两人用衣服连结在一起爬上河岸，满地荆棘，黑夜里不见道路，忽然有千百成群的流萤飞来，光芒照在少帝面前。
陈留王说：“此天助我兄弟也！”二人随着萤光走上大路，到五更脚痛难行，在草堆旁躺下，被庄主崔毅收留。闵贡寻到庄上，百官也陆续赶来。回宫途中，忽见一彪人马旌旗蔽日而来，少帝吓得说不出话，陈留王却勒马上前喝问来者。董卓答称来保驾，陈留王便说：“既来保驾，天子在此，何不下马？”董卓慌忙下马拜于道左。一路上陈留王应对自如，董卓暗暗称奇，从此有了废立之意。
史实：《后汉书·何进传》载，张让等劫帝出谷门，夜奔黄河渡口小平津，尚书卢植、河南中部掾闵贡追到，张让等向少帝叩头辞别，投河而死。闵贡扶着少帝和陈留王“夜步逐萤光南行”，找到民家的露车，次日公卿与董卓在北邙阪下迎驾。可见萤火引路本出自史书。裴注引《献帝纪》说，董卓与少帝说话，少帝答不上来；与陈留王说，陈留王把祸乱始末讲得毫无遗漏，董卓大喜，便起了废立之心。
ch003-beimang.why: The prince's composure on the road decides Dong Zhuo to depose one emperor and set up another, the future Emperor Xian.
ch003-beimang.why_zh: 陈留王在迎驾路上的从容应对，让董卓起了废立之心，日后的汉献帝由此登场。

quote.zh: 汝来保驾耶，汝来劫驾耶？
quote.en: Have you come to protect His Majesty, or to seize him?

people.name: Liu Xie
people.role: Prince of Chenliu, the future Emperor Xian
people.role_zh: 陈留王，即后来的汉献帝

people.name: Dong Zhuo
people.role: Meets the emperor with his army

story: Dong Zhuo's first attempt, in the Wenming Garden, failed when Ding Yuan and Lu Zhi spoke against him. With Lü Bu at his side he calls the officials together again and, hand on sword, announces that like Yi Yin and Huo Guang of old he will demote the emperor to Prince of Hongnong and enthrone the Prince of Chenliu; whoever objects will be beheaded. The ministers cower; only Yuan Shao, commander of the central army, stands up to him. 'Do you think my sword is not sharp?' says Dong Zhuo. Yuan Shao draws his own: if Dong Zhuo's sword is sharp, his has never been blunt. Then he hangs his insignia on the east gate and leaves for Ji province.

On the first day of the ninth month Dong Zhuo seats the boy emperor in the Jiade Hall and has Li Ru read the decree deposing him; the empress dowager is deposed with him. The minister Ding Guan strikes at Dong Zhuo with his ivory tablet, cursing him as a traitor, and is dragged out and killed. The nine-year-old Prince of Chenliu takes the throne as Emperor Xian. Dong Zhuo makes himself chancellor, free to come to court unhurried, wear sword and shoes in the hall and be announced without his name. The deposed emperor, his mother and his consort Lady Tang are shut up in the Yong'an Palace; when Dong Zhuo hears of a bitter poem the young man has written, he sends Li Ru with soldiers to force poison on him, throw the empress dowager from a tower and strangle Lady Tang.

The deposition is well recorded. In the ninth month of 189 Dong Zhuo made the empress dowager issue the edict demoting the emperor and enthroning Liu Xie, and soon poisoned her. Yuan Shao's defiance is told in the Xiandi chunqiu in Pei Songzhi's notes, where he says 'Dong Zhuo is not the only strong man in the world' and leaves with his sword held level. Dong Zhuo had the deposed emperor poisoned only in the first month of 190, after the eastern lords rose. The Book of the Later Han records the farewell song he sang with Lady Tang; she was not killed, but went home to Yingchuan and refused ever to remarry.
story_zh: 董卓第一次在温明园提出废立，丁原、卢植先后反对，没能成事。收服吕布后，他再次大会百官，按剑宣布要依伊尹、霍光的旧例，废少帝为弘农王，立陈留王为帝，“有不从者斩”。群臣惶恐，只有中军校尉袁绍挺身反对。董卓喝问：“汝视我之剑不利否？”袁绍也拔剑相向：“汝剑利，吾剑未尝不利！”随后辞别百官，把符节挂在东门，投奔冀州去了。
九月初一，董卓请少帝升嘉德殿，命李儒宣读策文，废少帝为弘农王，何太后也一并被废。尚书丁管用象简击打董卓，大骂贼臣，被拖出去杀了。九岁的陈留王即位，就是汉献帝。董卓自任相国，赞拜不名，入朝不趋，剑履上殿。废帝与何太后、唐妃被软禁在永安宫，废帝作诗抒发怨恨，董卓得知，派李儒带武士逼他饮下鸩酒，何太后被推下高楼，唐妃被绞死。
废立之事在史书中记载分明。189年九月，董卓逼何太后下诏，废少帝为弘农王，立陈留王刘协，随后鸩杀何太后。袁绍当面顶撞董卓一事见裴注引《献帝春秋》，袁绍说的是“天下健者，岂惟董公”，横刀长揖而去。次年正月关东起兵，董卓才命李儒毒死弘农王。《后汉书·皇后纪》记他临死与唐姬诀别作歌；唐姬并未被杀，后来回到颍川，誓不再嫁。
ch004-dethrones-emperor.why: By making and unmaking emperors, Dong Zhuo shows the Han throne is now the warlords' plaything and provokes the eastern revolt.
ch004-dethrones-emperor.why_zh: 董卓擅行废立，表明汉家天子已成军阀手中的傀儡，也直接激起了关东诸侯的讨伐。

quote.zh: 汝剑利，吾剑未尝不利！
quote.en: If your sword is sharp, mine has never been blunt!

story: At a birthday banquet the minister Wang Yun weeps over the state of the Han and all his guests weep with him. Cao Cao claps his hands and laughs: if the whole court weeps from night till dawn and dawn till night, will that weep Dong Zhuo to death? He borrows Wang Yun's jeweled dagger and goes to Dong Zhuo's residence. Dong Zhuo sends Lü Bu to pick out a good horse for him, and once Lü Bu has gone the fat tyrant lies down facing the wall. As Cao Cao draws the blade Dong Zhuo sees it in a mirror and turns; Lü Bu is back with the horse; Cao Cao drops to his knees and presents the dagger as a gift, then rides off to try the horse and out through the east gate.

Guards seize him at Zhongmou, but the magistrate, Chen Gong, recognizes him, questions him in the night, and is so moved by his ambition ('what do sparrows know of the swan's aims?') that he leaves his post and flees with him. At Chenggao they stay with Lü Boshe, sworn brother of Cao Cao's father. While their host is out buying wine, Cao Cao hears knives being sharpened and someone saying 'tie it up and kill it', and they kill the household, eight people, before finding a pig trussed in the kitchen. Fleeing, they meet Lü Boshe coming home with the wine, and Cao Cao kills him too: better that he wrong the world than the world wrong him. Chen Gong says nothing, and leaves him that night.

Historically: the dagger is invented. Cao Cao's annals in the Records of the Three Kingdoms say that he went east under a false name, was taken at Zhongmou by a suspicious village head and handed to the county, and was released when someone who secretly knew him spoke for him; the Shiyu in Pei Songzhi's notes says this was a county officer, not Chen Gong. On Lü Boshe the three sources in the notes disagree: the Book of Wei says Lü's sons and guests tried to rob Cao Cao of his horse and goods and he killed them; the Shiyu says he suspected a plot and killed eight people in the night; Sun Sheng's Zaji says he took the clatter of dishes for a plot and afterwards said sadly, 'Better I wrong others than others wrong me.'
story_zh: 司徒王允借寿宴召集旧臣，席间掩面痛哭，众官也都哭起来。曹操抚掌大笑：“满朝公卿，夜哭到明，明哭到夜，还能哭死董卓否？”他借来王允的七宝刀入相府行刺。董卓让吕布去挑一匹好马送他，吕布一走，肥胖的董卓侧身向里躺下。曹操刚拔出刀，董卓从衣镜里看见，回身喝问，恰好吕布牵马回来，曹操急忙跪下说要献刀，随即借口试马逃出东门。
曹操在中牟被守关军士拿住，县令陈宫认出了他，夜里提审，听他说“燕雀安知鸿鹄志哉”，竟弃官随他同逃。在成皋，二人投宿曹父的结义兄弟吕伯奢家，伯奢出门买酒，曹操听见庄后磨刀声和“缚而杀之”的话，便杀了一家八口，到厨下才见一头待宰的猪。出逃路上遇见买酒归来的吕伯奢，曹操索性把他也杀了，说出“宁教我负天下人，休教天下人负我”。陈宫默然，当夜离他而去。
史实：献刀行刺是小说虚构。《三国志·武帝纪》载，曹操改名换姓东归，过中牟时被亭长怀疑，押到县里，裴注引《世语》说是县里的功曹暗中认出他，劝县令放了他，与陈宫无关。杀吕伯奢家一事，裴注引三书各不相同：《魏书》说吕家子弟与宾客要劫他的马匹财物，被他亲手杀死；《世语》说他疑心对方图谋自己，夜杀八人；孙盛《杂记》说他听到食器声而起疑，事后凄然说“宁我负人，毋人负我”。
ch004-cao-cao-flees.why: The line becomes the motto of the novel's Cao Cao, and Chen Gong's revulsion at it foreshadows his later turn against him.
ch004-cao-cao-flees.why_zh: 这句话成了小说中曹操的人生信条，陈宫由此看透曹操，为日后背曹投吕埋下伏笔。

quote.zh: 宁教我负天下人，休教天下人负我
quote.en: Better that I wrong the whole world than let the world wrong me.

people.name: Lü Boshe
people.role: Sworn brother of Cao Cao's father

story: Back in Chenliu, Cao Cao is financed by the wealthy Wei Hong, raises troops under a banner reading 'Loyalty and Righteousness', and is joined by Yue Jin, Li Dian, Xiahou Dun, Xiahou Yuan, Cao Ren and Cao Hong. He sends out a forged imperial summons calling the lords to march against Dong Zhuo. Seventeen answer, among them Yuan Shu of Nanyang, Han Fu of Ji province, Kong Rong of Beihai, Tao Qian of Xuzhou, Ma Teng of Xiliang, Gongsun Zan of Beiping, Sun Jian of Changsha and Yuan Shao of Bohai; with Cao Cao they make eighteen. Gongsun Zan brings Liu Bei and his brothers along from Pingyuan.

The lords build a three-tiered altar ringed with banners of the five directions, and at Cao Cao's suggestion choose Yuan Shao, whose family has produced the empire's highest ministers for four generations, as their leader. Yuan Shao mounts the altar, smears his lips with blood and reads the oath in a voice that brings tears to every eye. He puts his brother Yuan Shu in charge of supplies, and Sun Jian volunteers to lead the van against the Sishui Pass. But Yuan Shu, warned that Sun Jian would be uncontrollable once he took Luoyang, holds back the grain; Sun Jian's hungry army is routed in a night attack by Dong Zhuo's general Hua Xiong, and his officer Zu Mao, wearing Sun Jian's red headcloth to draw off the pursuit, is cut down.

Historically: in the first month of 190 Yuan Shu, Han Fu, Kong Zhou, Liu Dai, Wang Kuang, Yuan Shao, Zhang Miao, Qiao Mao, Yuan Yi and Bao Xin rose together and made Yuan Shao their leader, with Cao Cao as acting general; Tao Qian, Ma Teng and Gongsun Zan were not among them. Their armies camped apart at Suanzao, Henei, Luyang, Yingchuan and Ye and never joined. The call to arms was forged not by Cao Cao but by Qiao Mao, governor of Dong, who faked letters from the three dukes in the capital. At Suanzao the oath was read by Zang Hong, an officer of Zhang Chao, and the novel's stirring oath for Yuan Shao is borrowed from Zang Hong's biography in the Records of the Three Kingdoms.
story_zh: 曹操逃回陈留，得到孝廉卫弘倾家资助，竖起“忠义”大旗招兵，乐进、李典、夏侯惇、夏侯渊、曹仁、曹洪先后来投。他又发出矫诏，号召各镇诸侯共讨董卓。南阳袁术、冀州韩馥、北海孔融、徐州陶谦、西凉马腾、北平公孙瓒、长沙孙坚、渤海袁绍等十七镇纷纷响应，连曹操共十八路，各引兵马前来。公孙瓒路过平原，把刘备兄弟也带上了。
诸侯会齐后筑起三层高台，遍列五方旗帜，曹操提议推举四世三公之后的袁绍为盟主。袁绍整衣佩剑登坛，焚香歃血，宣读盟誓，辞气慷慨，众人无不落泪。袁绍命弟弟袁术总督粮草，长沙太守孙坚自请为前部，直取汜水关。袁术听信谗言，怕孙坚破了洛阳难以控制，扣住粮草不发，孙坚军中缺粮自乱，被董卓部将华雄夜袭大败，部将祖茂戴上孙坚的赤帻引开追兵，被华雄斩杀。
史实：190年正月，袁术、韩馥、孔伷、刘岱、王匡、袁绍、张邈、桥瑁、袁遗、鲍信同时起兵，推袁绍为盟主，曹操行奋武将军，陶谦、马腾、公孙瓒等并未参加。各军分屯酸枣、河内、鲁阳、颍川和邺，从未合兵一处。发假文书号召起兵的也不是曹操，而是东郡太守桥瑁，他伪造了京师三公的书信。酸枣会盟时登坛读誓的是张超部下的臧洪，小说里袁绍那段慷慨誓词正是借自《三国志·臧洪传》。
ch005-eastern-alliance.why: The coalition is the first gathering of the warlords who will carve up the empire, and its quarrels show why it achieved nothing.
ch005-eastern-alliance.why_zh: 讨董联军是日后割据天下的群雄第一次聚首，而它的各怀私心也预示了必然的瓦解。

story: Fresh from beating Sun Jian, Hua Xiong rides up to the allied camp with Sun Jian's red headcloth on a pole. Yuan Shu's officer Yu She goes out and is killed within three bouts; Pan Feng, the great axeman Han Fu has boasted of, is cut down with one stroke. As the lords stare at one another, Yuan Shao sighs that his own champions Yan Liang and Wen Chou are not there. Before he has finished, a voice from behind Liu Bei offers to go and fetch Hua Xiong's head. The speaker is nine feet tall, with a two-foot beard, phoenix eyes, silkworm brows and a face the color of a ripe date: Guan Yu.

When Yuan Shu hears the man is only a mounted archer, he orders him thrown out. Cao Cao intervenes: a man who talks so big must have the courage to match, and with his bearing, how would Hua Xiong know he is an archer? Guan Yu stakes his head on the outcome. Cao Cao has a cup of hot wine poured for him; 'Pour it and leave it,' says Guan Yu, 'I'll be right back,' and rides off with his blade. The lords hear drums and shouting outside the pass as if heaven and earth were falling in; before their scouts can go, harness bells jingle, Guan Yu rides in and throws Hua Xiong's head on the ground, and the wine is still warm.

Historically: Sun Jian's biography in the Records of the Three Kingdoms says that when Dong Zhuo's army attacked him east of Liang, he broke out with a few dozen riders and gave the red headcloth he always wore to his officer Zu Mao; Zu Mao hung it on a charred post among the graves and hid in the grass, and the enemy horsemen circled the post several times before they saw what it was. Zu Mao survived. Sun Jian rallied his men, fought again at Yangren, routed Dong Zhuo's army and beheaded its commander Hua Xiong. Hua Xiong was Sun Jian's kill; Guan Yu had nothing to do with it, and the warm wine is pure fiction.
story_zh: 华雄打败孙坚后，挑着孙坚的赤帻到联军寨前搦战。袁术部将俞涉出马，不到三合被斩；韩馥夸口的上将潘凤提大斧迎战，也被一刀砍死。众诸侯大惊失色，袁绍叹道：“可惜吾上将颜良、文丑未至！得一人在此，何惧华雄！”话音未落，刘备身后一人高声道：“小将愿往斩华雄头，献于帐下！”此人身长九尺，髯长二尺，丹凤眼，卧蚕眉，面如重枣，正是关羽。
袁术听说他只是个马弓手，喝令把他打出去。曹操劝道，此人既出大言，必有勇略，况且“仪表不俗，华雄安知他是弓手？”关羽说若不胜，甘愿斩首。曹操命人斟一杯热酒给他壮行，关羽说：“酒且斟下，某去便来。”提刀上马而去。众诸侯只听关外鼓声大震、喊声大举，如天摧地塌，正要派人打探，鸾铃响处，关羽已提着华雄的头掷于地上，那杯酒还是温的。
史实：《三国志·孙坚传》载，孙坚在梁县以东被董卓军大举进攻，带数十骑突围，把常戴的红色头巾交给亲将祖茂戴上引开追兵；祖茂把头巾挂在坟间一根烧焦的木柱上，自己伏在草中，敌骑围了几重才发现是柱子，祖茂并没有死。孙坚收集散兵再战于阳人，大破董卓军，斩其都督华雄。斩华雄的是孙坚，关羽与此毫无关系，“温酒斩华雄”完全出于小说。
ch005-hua-xiong.why: The scene turns an unknown archer into the novel's god of war in a single stroke, and takes the credit from Sun Jian.
ch005-hua-xiong.why_zh: 这一回让无名的马弓手关羽一战成名，也把孙坚的战功移到了关羽名下。

quote.zh: 酒且斟下，某去便来
quote.en: Pour the wine and leave it; I'll be back directly.

people.name: Guan Yu
people.role: Mounted archer who kills Hua Xiong

people.name: Cao Cao
people.role: Pours the wine and backs Guan Yu

story: After Hua Xiong's death Dong Zhuo kills the whole family of Yuan Shao's uncle, the Grand Tutor Yuan Wei, and leads his main army to the Hulao Pass, with Lü Bu camped before it with thirty thousand men. Lü Bu wears a three-pronged purple-gold crown, a robe of embroidered flowers and linked-ring armor; he carries his halberd and rides Red Hare, and the novel repeats the saying 'Lü Bu among men, Red Hare among horses.' Fang Yue falls in under five bouts, Mu Shun at the first thrust, and Wu Anguo with his iron hammer loses his wrist after ten. The lords are terrified.

Lü Bu comes out again; Gongsun Zan lasts a few bouts and flees, and Red Hare is running him down when a rider with round staring eyes and bristling whiskers charges in with an eighteen-foot spear: 'Halt, slave of three surnames! Zhang Fei of Yan is here!' They fight fifty bouts without result. Guan Yu joins with his Green Dragon blade, and thirty bouts later Lü Bu still stands; Liu Bei rides in with his double swords, and the three circle Lü Bu like figures on a revolving lantern while the watching armies gape. At last Lü Bu feints at Liu Bei's face, breaks through and gallops back to the pass trailing his halberd.

Historically: there was no such fight. The man who actually beat Lü Bu in this campaign was Sun Jian: according to his biography and the Yingxiong ji in Pei Songzhi's notes, Dong Zhuo's army at Yangren fell into panic because its commander Hu Zhen and the cavalry chief Lü Bu were at odds, and Sun Jian routed it; later, closing on Luoyang, he beat Lü Bu again under the walls. As for Liu Bei, only the Yingxiong ji says vaguely that he too 'raised troops to join the campaign against Dong Zhuo'; no deed of his is recorded and he was nowhere near the front. Hulao and Sishui were one pass at Chenggao, which the novel turns into two.
story_zh: 华雄死后，董卓杀了袁绍的叔父太傅袁隗满门，亲率大军屯驻虎牢关，命吕布领三万人在关前扎寨。吕布头戴三叉束发紫金冠，身披百花袍、连环铠，手持画戟，坐下嘶风赤兔马，真是“人中吕布，马中赤兔”。王匡部将方悦不到五合被刺，张杨部将穆顺一戟落马，孔融部将武安国使铁锤，战到十余合被砍断手腕，诸侯无不胆寒。
吕布再来搦战，公孙瓒迎战几合便败走，吕布纵赤兔马追上，眼看就要刺中，只见一将圆睁环眼、倒竖虎须，挺丈八蛇矛飞马大叫：“三姓家奴休走！燕人张飞在此！”二人连斗五十余合不分胜负。关羽舞青龙刀来夹攻，三十合仍拿不下吕布；刘备掣双股剑也加入，三人围住吕布转灯般厮杀，八路人马都看呆了。吕布招架不住，虚刺刘备一戟，荡开阵角，倒拖画戟逃回关上。
史实：三英战吕布于史无据。这次讨董，真正击败吕布的是孙坚：据《孙坚传》及裴注引《英雄记》，阳人一战董卓军因大督护胡轸与骑督吕布不和而自相惊扰，被孙坚大破；后来孙坚进逼洛阳，又在城下击败吕布。至于刘备，只有裴注引《英雄记》含糊说他也“起军从讨董卓”，并无任何战绩，更谈不上在联军前线。虎牢关与汜水关本是成皋的同一座关隘，小说却当成两关来写。
ch005-three-heroes-vs-lu-bu.why: The fight is the novel's showcase of Lü Bu's prowess, so great that it takes all three brothers to drive him off, and it makes their name before the lords.
ch005-three-heroes-vs-lu-bu.why_zh: 这一战极写吕布之勇，要三兄弟合力才能将他击退，也让刘关张在诸侯面前崭露头角。

quote.zh: 三姓家奴休走！燕人张飞在此！
quote.en: Halt, slave of three surnames! Zhang Fei of Yan is here!

story: After the defeat at Hulao, Li Ru proposes moving the capital west to Chang'an and cites a street rhyme: 'A Han in the west, a Han in the east; when the deer runs into Chang'an, the trouble will cease.' The Han founder, he explains, reigned from Chang'an in the west and his line ran for twelve emperors; Guangwu reigned from Luoyang in the east and his line has now run for twelve too; the cycle points back to Chang'an. The ministers Yang Biao, Huang Wan and Xun Shuang object and are dismissed; when Zhou Bi and Wu Qiong protest, Dong Zhuo has them beheaded.

On Li Ru's advice he brands the rich families of Luoyang as rebels, beheads them and seizes their property. Li Jue and Guo Si drive millions of people west, a company of soldiers between every company of civilians; countless people die in the ditches, the soldiers rape and plunder along the road, and the wailing shakes heaven and earth. Before leaving Dong Zhuo has fires set at every gate; houses, temples and government halls burn, the flames of the southern and northern palaces join, and the Changle Palace is reduced to ash. Lü Bu is sent to dig up the tombs of emperors and empresses, the soldiers loot the graves of officials and commoners, and the treasure fills thousands of carts.

This matches the histories. Dong Zhuo's biography in the Book of the Later Han says that in the second month of 190 he moved the emperor west and drove several million people of Luoyang into the passes, horse and foot herding them along, trampling, starving and robbing, until the road was lined with corpses. He burned the palaces, temples, offices and homes so that 'within two hundred li nothing was left', and had Lü Bu open the imperial tombs and the graves of officials for their treasure. Dong Zhuo himself stayed on for a time in the Bigui Park outside the city. Years later Cao Zhi passed by and wrote: 'How desolate is Luoyang, its palaces all burned; the walls are broken down, and brambles reach the sky.'
story_zh: 虎牢关失利后，董卓与众人商议，李儒献计迁都长安，引街头童谣为证：“西头一个汉，东头一个汉。鹿走入长安，方可无斯难。”他解释说，高祖在西都长安传了十二帝，光武在东都洛阳也传了十二帝，天运循环，该回长安了。司徒杨彪、太尉黄琬、司空荀爽相继劝阻，都被罢官；尚书周毖、城门校尉伍琼也来进谏，董卓竟把二人斩了。
董卓又听李儒之计，把洛阳富户诬为反臣逆党，斩首抄家。李傕、郭汜驱赶数百万百姓西行，一队百姓夹一队军士，死于沟壑者不计其数，士兵沿路奸淫抢掠，哭声震天动地。临行前，董卓下令各门放火，焚烧民房，宗庙宫府也一齐烧起，南北两宫火焰相接，长乐宫庭尽为焦土。他又派吕布发掘先皇和后妃的陵墓，军士乘机挖掘官民坟冢，金珠缎匹装了几千辆车。
这段与史书相符。《后汉书·董卓传》载，初平元年二月董卓挟献帝西迁，驱赶洛阳数百万人入关，步骑驱赶，互相践踏，饥饿抢掠，积尸满路；他焚烧宫庙、官府和民居，“二百里内无复孑遗”，又命吕布发掘帝陵及公卿冢墓，搜取珍宝。董卓本人一度留屯城外的毕圭苑。后来曹植路过，写下“洛阳何寂寞，宫室尽烧焚。垣墙皆顿擗，荆棘上参天”的诗句。
ch006-burns-luoyang.why: The burning of Luoyang destroys the Han capital and leaves the court a wandering prize in the warlords' hands.
ch006-burns-luoyang.why_zh: 洛阳焚毁使东汉都城化为废墟，朝廷从此颠沛流离，再也摆脱不了军阀的控制。

quote.zh: 西头一个汉，东头一个汉。鹿走入长安，方可无斯难
quote.en: A Han in the west, a Han in the east; only when the deer runs into Chang'an will this trouble cease.

people.name: Dong Zhuo
people.role: Orders the move and the burning

story: Short of grain in Henei, Yuan Shao follows Pang Ji's plan: he secretly invites Gongsun Zan to attack Ji province with him, then frightens its timid governor Han Fu into handing the province over. When Gongsun Zan sends his brother Gongsun Yue to claim half, Yuan Shao has men disguised as Dong Zhuo's troops shoot him down on the road. Gongsun Zan marches south in fury and the armies meet at the Pan River. From the bridge Gongsun Zan curses Yuan Shao as a traitor; Yuan Shao's champion Wen Chou charges, beats him in ten-odd bouts, spears one of the four officers who come to his aid, and chases Gongsun Zan into the hills.

Gongsun Zan loses his bow, then his helmet, and rides on with his hair flying until his horse stumbles and throws him down a slope. As Wen Chou raises his spear, a young officer rides out from the side of the slope and goes straight for him. They fight fifty or sixty bouts without result until Gongsun Zan's men arrive and Wen Chou withdraws. The young man introduces himself, Zhao Yun, courtesy name Zilong, of Zhending in Changshan, once Yuan Shao's man, who left him because Yuan Shao cared nothing for the emperor or the people. In the next day's battle Zhao Yun spears Yuan Shao's general Qu Yi, and Liu Bei and his brothers arrive to help; Liu Bei and Zhao Yun take to each other at once.

Historically: the battle was fought at Jieqiao. According to the Yingxiong ji in Pei Songzhi's notes, Yuan Shao put Qu Yi's eight hundred picked men in front with a thousand crossbows on their flanks. Gongsun Zan, scorning so small a force, sent his cavalry at them; Qu Yi's men crouched under their shields until the horsemen were a few dozen paces away, then sprang up as the crossbows loosed together, killed Gongsun Zan's appointed governor Yan Gang, and broke the White Horse cavalry. Zhao Yun did bring volunteers from Changshan to Gongsun Zan and met Liu Bei there, but the rescue and the killing of Qu Yi are the novel's; Qu Yi was later put to death by Yuan Shao for his arrogance.
story_zh: 袁绍屯兵河内缺粮，听逢纪之计，一面暗约公孙瓒夹攻冀州，一面派人恐吓冀州牧韩馥，胆小的韩馥竟把冀州拱手相让。公孙瓒派弟弟公孙越来分地盘，袁绍派人假扮董卓的兵马，在半路把他乱箭射死。公孙瓒大怒，起兵南下，两军在磐河相遇。公孙瓒立马桥上大骂袁绍背义，袁绍部将文丑拍马上桥，公孙瓒战了十余合便抵挡不住，手下四员健将上前迎战，一将被刺落马，公孙瓒望山谷而逃。
文丑紧追不舍，公孙瓒弓箭落地、头盔坠落，披发奔逃，马失前蹄翻下坡来。文丑挺枪正要刺下，草坡左侧忽然转出一个少年将军，挺枪直取文丑，二人大战五六十合不分胜负，公孙瓒救兵赶到，文丑才拨马退去。少年自称“常山真定人也，姓赵，名云，字子龙”，本是袁绍部下，见袁绍无忠君救民之心，特来相投。次日交战，赵云刺死麴义，刘备兄弟也赶来相助，与赵云一见如故。
史实：此战发生在界桥。据裴注引《英雄记》，袁绍以麴义的八百先登死士为前锋、强弩千张夹护；公孙瓒轻敌，纵骑冲击，麴义的兵士伏在盾下不动，等敌骑近到数十步才一齐跃起，强弩齐发，斩杀公孙瓒所署冀州刺史严纲，白马义从大败。赵云确曾率常山义从投奔公孙瓒，并在那里结识刘备，但救公孙瓒、斩麴义都是小说的笔墨；麴义后来因骄横被袁绍所杀。
ch007-jieqiao.why: The battle brings Zhao Yun into the story, and his first meeting with Liu Bei begins one of the novel's most loyal partnerships.
ch007-jieqiao.why_zh: 这一战引出了赵云，他与刘备的初次相识，开启了全书最忠诚的君臣情谊之一。

quote.zh: 某乃常山真定人也，姓赵，名云，字子龙
quote.en: I am a man of Zhending in Changshan; my surname is Zhao, my name Yun, my courtesy name Zilong.

story: Sun Jian, who found the imperial seal in Luoyang, was attacked by Liu Biao on his way home and has hated him ever since. Now Yuan Shu, at odds with Yuan Shao, writes urging him to attack Liu Biao. Sun Jian marches; one day a gale snaps the staff of his headquarters banner, and Han Dang begs him to turn back at so bad an omen, but Sun Jian will not abandon a winning campaign over a broken flagpole. He beats Liu Biao's general Huang Zu at Fancheng and lays siege to Xiangyang.

On Kuai Liang's advice Liu Biao sends his officer Lü Gong out of the city with five hundred men to lie in ambush on Xian Hill. Sun Jian, hearing that troops have slipped out, gives chase with only thirty-odd riders. Below the hill rocks crash down and arrows pour from the woods; struck by stones and arrows, Sun Jian dies there with his horse, at thirty-seven. Huang Gai captures Huang Zu, Huan Jie goes into the city to trade the prisoner for Sun Jian's body, and Sun Ce carries his father home to be buried at Qu'e.

Sun Jian's death is history. His biography in the Records of the Three Kingdoms says Liu Biao sent Huang Zu against him between Fan and Deng; Sun Jian beat him, crossed the Han River and besieged Xiangyang, and riding alone over Xian Hill was shot by Huang Zu's soldiers. The sources in Pei Songzhi's notes differ: the Yingxiong ji says Liu Biao's officer Lü Gong came at him along the hill and a falling rock struck his head; the Dianlue says Huang Zu fled into the hills and Sun Jian, pursuing by night, was shot by men hidden in the bamboo. The novel uses both the rocks and the arrows. His eldest son Sun Ce was only seventeen; he would go on to conquer the lands south of the Yangzi and found the house of Wu.
story_zh: 孙坚在洛阳得到传国玉玺后回江东，途中被刘表截击，从此结怨。袁术与袁绍不和，便写信约孙坚攻打刘表。孙坚兴兵出发，一日狂风大作，把中军帅字旗的旗杆吹折，韩当说这不是吉兆，劝他暂且班师，孙坚说自己屡战屡胜，岂可因风折旗杆就罢兵。他在樊城打败刘表部将黄祖，进围襄阳。
刘表依蒯良之计，派部将吕公带五百人突围出城，到岘山埋伏。孙坚听说有人马出城，只带三十余骑追赶，追到岘山下，山上石块乱下，林中乱箭齐发，孙坚身中石、箭，脑浆迸流，人马都死在岘山之中，年仅三十七岁。随后黄盖生擒黄祖，桓阶入城谈判，用黄祖换回孙坚的尸首，孙策扶柩回江东，葬于曲阿之原。
孙坚战死于史有据。《三国志·孙坚传》载，刘表派黄祖在樊、邓之间迎战，孙坚击破之，追渡汉水，围攻襄阳，单马行经岘山时被黄祖军士射杀。裴注所引各书说法不一：《英雄记》说刘表部将吕公沿山迎击，下石击中孙坚头部而死；《典略》说黄祖败走后藏入岘山，孙坚连夜追赶，被埋伏在竹林中的兵士暗箭射死。小说把落石、乱箭都写了进去。长子孙策当时年仅十七，后来平定江东，开创东吴基业。
ch007-sun-jian-dies.why: Sun Jian's early death leaves his young sons to build the Wu state, and makes Huang Zu the family's enemy for years to come.
ch007-sun-jian-dies.why_zh: 孙坚早逝，东吴基业落到孙策、孙权兄弟肩上，黄祖也从此成为孙氏的世仇。

people.name: Sun Ce
people.role: Eldest son, brings home the body

story: In Chang'an Dong Zhuo grows ever more savage, butchering prisoners at his feasts and having Zhang Wen killed at table, until every official fears for his life. One moonlit night the minister Wang Yun, too troubled to sleep, walks in his garden with his staff and hears someone sighing by the peony pavilion. It is Diao Chan, a singing girl brought up in his house since childhood, sixteen years old, beautiful and accomplished, whom he treats as his own daughter. She tells him she owes him everything and would die ten thousand deaths to serve him. Wang Yun strikes the ground with his staff: who would have thought the fate of the Han lies in her hands!

His plan is a chain of stratagems: promise her to Lü Bu, give her to Dong Zhuo, and let her set the two against each other. He sends Lü Bu a golden cap set with pearls, and when Lü Bu comes to thank him, Diao Chan pours the wine and Wang Yun promises her to him. A day later he invites Dong Zhuo, has her dance, and sends her to Dong Zhuo's mansion that night. When Lü Bu comes to demand an explanation, Wang Yun claims the Grand Tutor has taken her to arrange the wedding himself. From then on, whenever Diao Chan sees Lü Bu she weeps, points to her heart and then to Dong Zhuo, and Lü Bu is torn apart, until Dong Zhuo notices and has him thrown out.

Historically: Diao Chan appears in no history. Lü Bu's biography in the Records of the Three Kingdoms says Dong Zhuo often had Lü Bu guard his inner apartments, that Lü Bu was having an affair with one of Dong Zhuo's maids and lived in fear of discovery, and that Wang Yun, who had always cultivated this strong man from his own province, heard him complain that Dong Zhuo had nearly killed him and drew him into the plot he was hatching with Shisun Rui. 'But we are father and son!' said Lü Bu. 'Your surname is Lü,' said Wang Yun. 'You are not his flesh and blood.' Diao Chan's name and story were built up over time in the Yuan-dynasty Pinghua and in drama.
story_zh: 董卓在长安骄横日甚，宴席上当众残杀降卒，又当席杀了张温，百官人人自危。司徒王允回到府中坐立不安，夜深月明，拄杖到后园徘徊，忽听牡丹亭畔有人长吁短叹，原来是府中歌伎貂蝉。她自幼被选入府中学习歌舞，年方二八，色艺俱佳，王允待她如亲生女儿。貂蝉说受大人厚恩，若有用得着的地方，万死不辞。王允以杖击地说：“谁想汉天下却在汝手中耶！”
王允定下连环计：先把貂蝉许给吕布，再献给董卓，让她从中离间，使二人反目。他先派人送吕布一顶嵌着明珠的金冠，吕布上门道谢，王允让貂蝉出来敬酒，当面许婚；隔天又请董卓赴宴，让貂蝉歌舞，当夜便把她送进相府。吕布前来质问，王允推说太师要替他择吉日成亲。此后貂蝉在董卓身边，见到吕布便蹙眉流泪，以手指心，又指董卓，吕布心如刀割。董卓察觉，把他赶了出去。
史实：貂蝉其人不见于任何史书。《三国志·吕布传》载，董卓常让吕布守卫内阁，吕布与董卓的一名侍婢私通，怕事情败露，心中不安。王允因吕布是同州壮士，一向厚待他，吕布向王允诉说董卓几次差点杀他，王允便告诉他自己正与士孙瑞密谋诛卓，劝他作内应。吕布说：“奈如父子何！”王允说：“君自姓吕，本非骨肉。”貂蝉的名字和身世，是元代《三国志平话》和杂剧中逐渐编出来的。
ch008-diaochan.why: The chain of stratagems turns an unnamed maid of the histories into the novel's most famous woman and gives Dong Zhuo's fall a human cause.
ch008-diaochan.why_zh: 连环计把史书里一个无名侍婢化作全书最著名的女子，也为董卓之死写出了一段动人的前因。

quote.zh: 谁想汉天下却在汝手中耶！
quote.en: Who would have thought the fate of the Han lay in your hands!

story: When Dong Zhuo recovers and goes to court, Lü Bu follows with his halberd, then, seeing his master deep in talk with the emperor, slips out and rides to the mansion. Diao Chan tells him to wait in the Phoenix Pavilion in the back garden. She comes to him through the flowers, weeping that she was promised to him and has been defiled by the Grand Tutor; having seen him once more, she will die, and she climbs the railing to throw herself into the lotus pond. Lü Bu catches her: if he cannot make her his wife in this life, he is no hero. When he says he must go before the old man grows suspicious, she clutches his robe: if he is so afraid of the old villain, she will never see the light of day again.

At court Dong Zhuo misses Lü Bu, hurries home, finds Red Hare tied at the gate, and in the garden catches the two in each other's arms beneath the pavilion. At his roar Lü Bu runs; Dong Zhuo snatches up the halberd and gives chase, but is too fat to keep up and hurls it; Lü Bu knocks it aside. Dong Zhuo picks it up and runs on, and at the garden gate collides with Li Ru running in and goes sprawling. Li Ru reminds him how King Zhuang of Chu forgave an officer who grabbed at his concubine, and urges him to give Diao Chan to Lü Bu. Dong Zhuo agrees, until Diao Chan's tears change his mind. Li Ru walks out and sighs to heaven that they will all die at a woman's hands.

Historically: Lü Bu's biography in the Records of the Three Kingdoms says Dong Zhuo was violent and narrow-minded and never thought before he lost his temper; once, over some small thing, he snatched up a hand halberd and threw it at Lü Bu, who dodged nimbly and turned to apologize, and Dong Zhuo calmed down. But from then on Lü Bu secretly resented him, and with his affair with the maid weighing on him, he was ready to listen to Wang Yun. The thrown halberd is real, though it was a small hand halberd, not Lü Bu's great one, and the quarrel was a trifle; the Phoenix Pavilion and Diao Chan are the novel's.
story_zh: 董卓病愈入朝，吕布执戟随行，见董卓与献帝说话，便提戟出了内门，上马直奔相府。貂蝉让他到后园凤仪亭等候，不久分花拂柳而来，哭诉自己本已许给将军，却被太师污辱，今日见将军一面，情愿一死，说罢攀住曲栏要跳荷花池。吕布慌忙抱住，说：“我今生不能以汝为妻，非世之英雄也！”他担心董卓起疑要走，貂蝉又扯住他的衣服，说他如此惧怕老贼，自己再无见天日之期了。
董卓在殿上不见吕布，心中生疑，急忙回府，见赤兔马拴在门前，进后园正撞见二人在凤仪亭下偎依。董卓大喝一声，吕布转身就跑，董卓抢过画戟追赶，他太胖赶不上，便把戟掷去，吕布一拳打落，董卓拾起再追，追出园门时与奔进来的李儒撞个满怀，跌倒在地。李儒用楚庄王“绝缨”的典故劝他把貂蝉赐给吕布，董卓答应了，却被貂蝉一番哭闹又改了主意。李儒出来仰天长叹：“吾等皆死于妇人之手矣！”
史实：《三国志·吕布传》载，董卓性情刚暴褊狭，一时发怒便不顾后果，曾因一点小事不如意，拔出手戟向吕布掷去，吕布身手敏捷躲开了，回头向董卓赔礼，董卓的气也就消了。但吕布从此暗中怨恨董卓，又因与侍婢私通而心怀不安，终被王允说动。掷戟确有其事，掷的是随身的短手戟，并非吕布的画戟，起因也只是小事；凤仪亭和貂蝉都出自小说。
ch008-phoenix-pavilion.why: The thrown halberd breaks the bond between Dong Zhuo and his bodyguard, the man who will soon kill him.
ch008-phoenix-pavilion.why_zh: 一戟掷出，董卓与贴身护卫吕布恩断义绝，杀身之祸由此种下。

quote.zh: 吾等皆死于妇人之手矣！
quote.en: We shall all die at the hands of a woman!

story: Wang Yun, Lü Bu and Shisun Rui lay their plan. Li Su, bitter at being passed over for promotion, takes an edict to Mei and tells Dong Zhuo that the emperor, now recovered, wishes to abdicate to him in the Weiyang Hall. Delighted, Dong Zhuo takes leave of his mother, who is over ninety, and sets out. On the road a wheel of his carriage breaks; on horseback his bridle snaps; a gale whips up dust that blots out the sky; Li Su explains each as a happy omen. That night children are heard singing of 'grass of a thousand li', green, green, that 'shall not live', a riddle on the characters of Dong Zhuo's name. Next day a Daoist appears carrying a pole hung with cloth marked at each end with a square, the two squares making the character Lü.

At the north gate of the palace his troops are stopped and only the twenty-odd men pushing his carriage go in. Wang Yun and others stand at the hall doors holding swords. Dong Zhuo asks in alarm what the swords are for, and Wang Yun shouts for the guards to seize the traitor. A hundred men rush at him with halberds and lances, but his armor turns the points; wounded in the arm, he falls from his carriage crying, 'Where is my son Fengxian?' Lü Bu steps out from behind the carriage: 'By imperial order, death to the traitor!' and drives his halberd through Dong Zhuo's throat. The corpse is left in the street, and because it is so fat the guards light a wick in its navel, and the fat runs over the ground.

The histories record it plainly. Dong Zhuo's biography in the Records of the Three Kingdoms says that in the fourth month of 192, when the emperor had recovered and held court in the Weiyang Hall, Lü Bu had Li Su, a man of his own commandery, and a dozen men disguised as guards wait at the side gate; when Dong Zhuo arrived Li Su struck at him, Dong Zhuo cried out for Lü Bu, and Lü Bu said 'There is an edict' and killed him; his clan was wiped out. The Book of the Later Han says soldiers and people celebrated, and the guards set a fire in his navel that burned till dawn for days on end. His fortress at Mei held twenty or thirty thousand catties of gold, eighty or ninety thousand of silver, and silks and curiosities piled like hills.
story_zh: 王允与吕布、士孙瑞定计，派因不得升迁而怀恨的李肃带着诏书去郿坞，谎称天子病愈，要在未央殿禅位给太师。董卓大喜，辞别九十多岁的老母启程。途中车轮折断，换马又挣断辔头，狂风蔽天，李肃都说成吉兆。夜里又听见小儿唱：“千里草，何青青！十日卜，不生！”——“千里草”是“董”，“十日卜”是“卓”。次日又见一个道人，长竿上缚着一丈布，两头各写一个“口”字，暗指“吕”字。
董卓到北掖门，军兵都被挡在门外，只有推车的二十余人随入。只见王允等人手执宝剑立在殿门，董卓惊问持剑何意，王允大呼：“反贼至此，武士何在？”百余名武士持戟挺槊一拥而上。董卓穿着内甲，刺不进去，只伤了手臂，跌下车来，大叫：“吾儿奉先何在？”吕布从车后闪出，喝道：“有诏讨贼！”一戟刺穿他的咽喉。董卓暴尸街头，因为太胖，守尸军士在他肚脐里点火为灯，膏油流了一地。
此事史书记载分明。《三国志·董卓传》载，初平三年四月献帝病愈，在未央殿大会群臣，吕布让同郡人骑都尉李肃等带亲兵十余人，假扮卫士守在掖门。董卓一到，李肃上前格击，董卓惊呼吕布，吕布说“有诏”，随即杀了他，夷灭三族。《后汉书》记长安士卒百姓欢呼庆贺，守尸吏在他肚脐里点火，光明达旦，接连几天。郿坞中抄出黄金二三万斤、白银八九万斤，锦绮珍玩堆积如山。
ch009-dong-zhuo-killed.why: Dong Zhuo's death ends the first tyranny of the age but not the chaos, since his generals soon take their revenge.
ch009-dong-zhuo-killed.why_zh: 董卓之死结束了乱世第一个权臣的统治，却没能结束动乱，他的部将很快就卷土重来。

quote.zh: 吾儿奉先何在？
quote.en: Where is my son Fengxian?

people.name: Li Su
people.role: Lures Dong Zhuo to the palace

story: After Dong Zhuo's death his generals Li Jue, Guo Si, Zhang Ji and Fan Chou flee west and send to Chang'an begging a pardon. Wang Yun refuses: Dong Zhuo's tyranny rested on these four, and even a general amnesty will not include them. As they prepare to scatter, their adviser Jia Xu warns that if they abandon their troops and run, any village head could tie them up; better to gather the men of the region, march on Chang'an and avenge Dong Zhuo: if they succeed they will hold the court, and if they fail there will be time enough to run. They spread a rumor that Wang Yun means to massacre the people of Liang province, raise more than a hundred thousand men and advance on Chang'an by four roads.

Li Su, sent out by Lü Bu, is beaten by Dong Zhuo's son-in-law Niu Fu, and Lü Bu beheads him for it, then drives back Li Jue himself. Jia Xu has a second plan: Li Jue and Guo Si take turns harassing Lü Bu while Zhang Ji and Fan Chou go straight for the undefended capital, where Li Meng and Wang Fang open the gates. Too late to save the city, Lü Bu rides up with a few hundred horsemen and begs Wang Yun to flee with him. Wang Yun refuses: if heaven protects the dynasty his wish is fulfilled; if not, he will die for it rather than save himself in the hour of danger. Lü Bu escapes through the pass to Yuan Shu. Li Jue and Guo Si surround the palace and demand Wang Yun; he steps forward and is killed with his whole family.

This is broadly history. Jia Xu's biography in the Records of the Three Kingdoms says Li Jue and the others meant to disband and slip home to Liang province, and Jia Xu told them: Chang'an is talking of killing every man from Liang; if you leave your troops and travel alone, one village head can tie you up; better to lead your men west, gather more on the way and attack Chang'an to avenge Lord Dong. So they turned back, took Chang'an, drove out Lü Bu and killed Wang Yun. Pei Songzhi was scathing: just when the arch-villain was dead and the realm might have recovered, he wrote, Jia Xu's words brought disaster back. For three years the emperor was in Li Jue's and Guo Si's hands.
story_zh: 董卓死后，他的部将李傕、郭汜、张济、樊稠逃到陕西，派人到长安上表求赦。王允说董卓的跋扈全靠这四人相助，即便大赦天下，也独不赦他们。四人商议各自逃命，谋士贾诩劝道：你们若丢下军队独自逃走，一个亭长就能把你们捆了；不如收集陕西人马杀进长安，为董卓报仇，事成就奉朝廷以正天下，不成再走也不迟。四人依计散布流言，说王允要洗荡西凉，很快聚起十余万人，分四路杀奔长安。
吕布的先锋李肃被董卓女婿牛辅打败，吕布怒斩李肃，又亲自击退李傕。贾诩再献一计：让李傕、郭汜轮番袭扰，拖住吕布，张济、樊稠则乘虚直取长安，城中李蒙、王方开门接应。吕布回救不及，只带数百骑来请王允一同出逃。王允说国家若得安定便是心愿，否则唯有以身殉国，绝不临难苟免。吕布只得出关投奔袁术。李傕、郭汜围住皇宫，逼献帝交出王允，王允挺身而出，当场被杀，全家老幼也都遇害。
这段大体据史。《三国志·贾诩传》载，李傕等本想解散部众各自逃回凉州，贾诩说，听说长安正商议要尽诛凉州人，诸君若弃众单行，一个亭长就能捆住你们，不如率众西进，沿途收兵，攻打长安为董公报仇。李傕等由此反攻，攻破长安，吕布战败出走，王允遇害。裴松之对此深为不满，批评元凶刚除、天下将安之际，正是贾诩这番话使祸乱重起。此后献帝落在李傕、郭汜手中达三年之久。
ch009-li-jue-guo-si.why: Jia Xu's advice revives Dong Zhuo's faction and throws the court and Chang'an into years of misery.
ch009-li-jue-guo-si.why_zh: 贾诩一计使董卓旧部死灰复燃，长安和朝廷从此陷入数年的苦难。

people.name: Wang Yun
people.role: Refuses the pardon and is killed

story: Established in Yan province, Cao Cao sends Ying Shao, governor of Taishan, to fetch his father Cao Song from Langya. Cao Song sets out with his brother Cao De and some forty members of the family, their carts loaded with wealth. In Xuzhou, Tao Qian, eager to win Cao Cao's friendship, comes out to meet them, feasts them for two days and sends his officer Zhang Kai with five hundred soldiers as escort. Caught by heavy rain between Hua and Fei, they shelter in an old temple. Zhang Kai, a former Yellow Turban, cannot resist the loot: at night his men kill Cao De, and Cao Song, trying to get a concubine over the back wall, finds her too fat to pass; the two hide in the privy and are killed there. Zhang Kai flees to Huainan with the treasure.

The news knocks Cao Cao to the ground in tears, and he swears to wash Xuzhou clean. Leaving Xun Yu and Cheng Yu with thirty thousand men to hold Juancheng, Fan and Dong'e, he marches with his whole army, Xiahou Dun, Yu Jin and Dian Wei leading the van, under orders to put the people of every captured city to the sword. Chen Gong comes to plead for Tao Qian; refused, he leaves to join Zhang Miao. Wherever the army goes it kills the people and digs up their graves. Tao Qian thinks of giving himself up for execution, but Mi Zhu sends for help to Kong Rong and Tian Kai, and Liu Bei marches to the rescue of Xuzhou.

The novel's own sources disagree. Cao Cao's annals in the Records of the Three Kingdoms say simply that Cao Song was 'killed by Tao Qian'; the Shiyu in Pei Songzhi's notes says Tao Qian secretly sent several thousand horsemen to seize him, that Cao De was killed at the gate, and that Cao Song died in the privy with a concubine too fat to get through the hole in the wall; Wei Zhao's Book of Wu blames Zhang Kai, the escort Tao Qian had provided, who killed for the loot. The novel blends the two. On the revenge every source agrees: the Book of the Later Han says Cao Cao's army massacred wherever it passed, killing hundreds of thousands of men and women, leaving not a dog or a chicken, until the Si River was choked and stopped flowing.
story_zh: 曹操在兖州站稳脚跟，派泰山太守应劭去琅琊接父亲曹嵩。曹嵩带着弟弟曹德和一家老小四十余人，车载财物前来。路过徐州，陶谦有心结交曹操，亲自出境迎接，大宴两日，又派都尉张闿领五百兵护送。走到华、费之间，大雨骤至，众人在一座古寺中歇宿。张闿本是黄巾余党，见财起意，夜里纵兵杀了曹德；曹嵩带着一个妾想翻墙逃走，妾太胖出不去，二人躲进厕所，也被杀死。张闿抢了财物逃往淮南。
曹操闻讯哭倒在地，发誓要洗荡徐州。他命荀彧、程昱领兵三万守鄄城、范县、东阿，自己尽起大军，以夏侯惇、于禁、典韦为先锋，下令攻下城池便将百姓尽行屠戮，以雪父仇。陈宫前来为陶谦说情，曹操不听，陈宫便去投奔张邈。曹军所到之处杀戮百姓、发掘坟墓。陶谦想自缚请死，糜竺请来孔融、田楷相救，刘备也领兵赶来援救徐州。
小说依据的史料本身就有分歧。《三国志·武帝纪》说曹嵩“为陶谦所害”，裴注引《世语》说是陶谦暗派几千骑兵去捉拿，曹德被杀于门中，曹嵩因爱妾肥胖钻不出墙洞，与她一起死在厕所里；韦昭《吴书》则说是陶谦派去护送的都尉张闿见财起意。小说把两说揉在了一起。对复仇的记载却众口一词：《后汉书·陶谦传》说曹军所过多所屠戮，杀男女数十万人，鸡犬无余，泗水为之不流。
ch010-xuzhou-massacre.why: The massacre stains Cao Cao's name, and the invasion draws Liu Bei into Xuzhou and gives Lü Bu his chance at Yan province.
ch010-xuzhou-massacre.why_zh: 徐州屠戮是曹操一生的污点，这场东征也把刘备引入徐州，又给了吕布偷袭兖州的机会。

people.name: Zhang Kai
people.role: Escort officer who kills him (in the novel)
people.role_zh: 护送途中行凶的都尉（小说）

story: While Cao Cao is in Xuzhou, Chen Gong persuades Zhang Miao to bring Lü Bu into Yan province, and most of its counties go over; only Juancheng, Fan and Dong'e hold out under Xun Yu and Cheng Yu. Cao Cao hurries back and storms Lü Bu's camp west of Puyang by night, but Lü Bu counterattacks and surrounds him. Dian Wei rides to the rescue with his twin iron halberds and tells his attendant to call him when the enemy are ten paces off. He waits until they are five paces away, then hurls his short halberds one after another, each bringing a rider down, until the enemy falls back and Cao Cao is saved.

Chen Gong has a second trick. The Tian family, rich men of Puyang, send Cao Cao a secret letter offering to betray the city: Lü Bu has gone to Liyang, and a white flag on the wall will be the signal. Cao Cao rides in himself, finds the streets empty before the government office, and knows he has been tricked as fires spring up at all four gates and the ambush falls on him. In the smoke he runs straight into Lü Bu, covers his face and gallops past; Lü Bu raps his helmet with the halberd and asks where Cao Cao is. The one ahead on the yellow horse, says Cao Cao, and Lü Bu rides after it. At the gate a burning beam comes down; Cao Cao pushes it off with his hands, burning his arm and beard, and Dian Wei and Xiahou Yuan get him out.

Puyang is history. Cao Cao's annals in the Records of the Three Kingdoms say Lü Bu's cavalry charged his Qingzhou troops first; his line broke, and riding out through the fire he fell from his horse and burned his left palm, escaping only when his officer Lou Yi helped him back into the saddle. The Xiandi chunqiu in Pei Songzhi's notes reads like the novel: the Tian family of Puyang played double agent, Cao Cao got into the city and burned the east gate to show he would not retreat, and when he was beaten one of Lü Bu's horsemen caught him without knowing him and asked where Cao Cao was; 'The one riding off on the yellow horse,' he said, and the rider let him go. Dian Wei's ten-paces courage is in his own biography too.
story_zh: 曹操东征徐州时，陈宫劝张邈迎吕布入兖州，兖州郡县大半落入吕布之手，只有荀彧、程昱保住鄄城、范县、东阿三城。曹操急忙回军，夜袭吕布在濮阳城西的营寨得手，却被吕布领兵反扑，四面受困。典韦手持双铁戟赶来救驾，吩咐随从：“贼来十步乃呼我！”敌兵逼近五步，他才将短戟连连飞掷，一戟一人坠马，杀退敌兵，救出曹操。
陈宫又设一计，让濮阳富户田氏密信诈降，谎称吕布已去黎阳，约定夜里以城上白旗为号献门。曹操亲自领兵入城，到州衙前不见一人，才知中计，四门火起，伏兵齐出。烟火中他正撞上吕布，以手遮脸加鞭驰过，吕布用戟敲他的头盔，问曹操何在，他指着前面说骑黄马的就是，吕布便去追黄马。曹操奔到城门，一根燃烧的梁木砸下，他用手推开，手臂和须发都被烧伤，幸得典韦、夏侯渊救出。
濮阳之战确有其事。《三国志·武帝纪》载，吕布出战，先以骑兵冲击曹操的青州兵，曹军阵乱，曹操驰马冲出火中，坠马烧伤左手掌，由司马楼异扶上马才得脱身。裴注引《献帝春秋》写得更像小说：濮阳大姓田氏作反间，曹操得以入城，烧掉东门以示决不后退，战败后被吕布骑兵捉住却没被认出，骑兵问曹操在哪里，他说“乘黄马走者是也”，骑兵便放了他去追黄马。典韦飞戟退敌之勇，也见于《典韦传》。
ch011-puyang.why: Puyang is Cao Cao's narrowest escape so far and opens his long duel with Lü Bu for Yan province.
ch011-puyang.why_zh: 濮阳一战是曹操起兵以来最险的一次死里逃生，也开启了他与吕布争夺兖州的长期拉锯。

story: Liu Bei comes to Xuzhou's rescue, and Tao Qian, taken with his bearing and his open manner, has Mi Zhu bring out the seals of the province on the spot and offers them to him. Liu Bei is aghast: he came out of duty; does Tao Qian suspect him of wanting to swallow the province? He refuses outright. When Lü Bu's seizure of Yan province forces Cao Cao to withdraw, Tao Qian gives a feast of thanks and offers again; again Liu Bei declines, and Tao Qian can only ask him to station his troops at Xiaopei to guard Xuzhou. Those are the first two offers.

Soon Tao Qian falls gravely ill and calls Liu Bei to his bedside: he may not last the day, and he begs Liu Bei, for the sake of the Han, to take the seals. Why not leave them to your sons? asks Liu Bei. Neither Tao Shang nor Tao Ying is fit for it, says the old man; he recommends Sun Qian as an aide, points to his heart and dies. The soldiers and people of Xuzhou crowd the gate weeping, saying they will never know peace unless Liu Bei governs them, Guan Yu and Zhang Fei press him too, and at last he accepts. Cao Cao, hearing of it, vows to kill Liu Bei and mutilate Tao Qian's corpse, until Xun Yu talks him out of it.

Historically: Liu Bei's biography in the Records of the Three Kingdoms says Tao Qian had already recommended him as inspector of Yu province and stationed him at Xiaopei. Dying, Tao Qian told his aide Mi Zhu that only Liu Bei could keep the province safe, and after his death Mi Zhu led the people of the province to welcome Liu Bei. That was the only offer. Liu Bei did hesitate, suggesting Yuan Shu at Shouchun instead, but Chen Deng said Yuan Shu was too arrogant to rule in hard times, and Kong Rong called Yuan Shu 'dry bones in a tomb' and warned that to refuse what heaven offers is to regret it forever; then Liu Bei accepted. The three offers are the novel's, though the reluctance is real.
story_zh: 刘备领兵来救徐州，陶谦见他仪表轩昂、言语豁达，当即命糜竺取来徐州牌印让给他。刘备大惊，说自己是为大义前来相助，“莫非疑刘备有吞并之心耶？”坚辞不受。后来曹操因吕布袭取兖州而退兵，陶谦大摆筵席答谢，又一次让州，刘备仍然推辞，陶谦只得请他带兵屯驻小沛，保护徐州。这就是一让、二让。
不久陶谦病重，派人请刘备到病榻前，说自己朝夕难保，恳请他以汉家城池为重，接受徐州牌印。刘备问他为何不传给两个儿子，陶谦说长子陶商、次子陶应都不堪重任，又举荐孙乾辅佐刘备，说罢以手指心而死。徐州军民拥到府前哭拜，说刘使君若不领此州，大家都不能安生；关羽、张飞也再三相劝，刘备这才接下徐州。曹操闻讯大怒，要先杀刘备、再戮陶谦之尸，被荀彧劝住。
史实：《三国志·先主传》载，陶谦先表刘备为豫州刺史，屯驻小沛。陶谦病重时对别驾麋竺说“非刘备不能安此州也”，死后麋竺率州人迎刘备，只有这一次。刘备不敢接受，推荐寿春的袁术；陈登说袁术骄豪，不是治乱之主，北海相孔融也说袁术不过是“冢中枯骨，何足介意”，“天与不取，悔不可追”，刘备这才领了徐州。三让是小说添出来的，史书中的推辞倒确有其事。
ch012-three-offers-of-xuzhou.why: Xuzhou gives Liu Bei his first province, and the novel's three offers make his modesty a lasting part of his image.
ch012-three-offers-of-xuzhou.why_zh: 徐州是刘备的第一块地盘，“三让”则把他的谦让写进了人们心中。

story: After the fire at Puyang Cao Cao turns the trick around: he spreads word that he has died of his burns, lures Lü Bu into an attack and ambushes him at Maling Hill. That year locusts strip the fields, a measure of grain costs fifty strings of cash, people eat one another, and both armies have to stop fighting. Cao Cao moves off to find food and, on Xun Yu's advice, first attacks the Yellow Turban remnants He Yi and Huang Shao in Runan and Yingchuan for their grain, winning the strongman Xu Chu on the way. Then, hearing that Lü Bu's garrison commanders Xue Lan and Li Feng have let their men out to plunder, he swoops back and retakes Yan province.

Lü Bu falls back on Dingtao and comes out to fight again. Cao Cao hides picked troops behind a long dike west of his camp and plants banners in the nearby woods as decoys. Lü Bu, sure enough, suspects an ambush in the woods and strikes at empty air, and the men behind the dike burst out and rout him. He abandons Dingtao, and all of Yan province falls to Cao Cao. With nowhere left to go, Lü Bu remembers Liu Bei in Xuzhou and his name for kindness, and leads what is left of his army east to seek refuge with him.

Cao Cao's annals in the Records of the Three Kingdoms say that in 194 drought and locusts struck Yan province, a measure of grain cost over five hundred thousand cash and people ate each other, so Cao Cao and Lü Bu broke off the war; Cao Cao even thought of sending his family to shelter with Yuan Shao until Cheng Yu talked him out of it. Next spring he attacked Dingtao, and in summer beheaded Xue Lan and Li Feng at Juye. The Book of Wei in Pei Songzhi's notes says most of his men were out harvesting wheat and fewer than a thousand were in camp; he put women on the ramparts, hid his troops behind a great dike, and when Lü Bu came close the ambush rose, horse and foot together, and broke the ten thousand men under Lü Bu and Chen Gong. Lü Bu fled by night and went east to Liu Bei.
story_zh: 濮阳火烧之后，曹操将计就计，诈称伤重身亡，诱吕布来攻，在马陵山设伏杀了吕布一阵。这一年蝗灾大起，一斛谷子值钱五十贯，百姓相食，两军只得各自罢兵。曹操移兵就食，又依荀彧之计先打汝南、颍川的黄巾余党何仪、黄劭，夺取粮草，途中收了猛将许褚。随后听说吕布留守兖州的薛兰、李封纵兵出城抢掠，曹操回军一举夺回兖州。
吕布退守定陶，不肯服输，整军再战。曹操在营西大堤后埋伏精兵，旁边树林里虚插旌旗作为疑兵。吕布果然疑心林中有伏，扑了个空，堤后伏兵齐出，吕布大败，只得弃了定陶，兖州一境尽归曹操。吕布走投无路，想起徐州的刘备素有仁名，便领着残兵东去投奔。
《三国志·武帝纪》载，兴平元年兖州旱蝗相继，一斛谷五十余万钱，人相食，曹操与吕布各自罢兵；曹操一度想把家眷送到袁绍处寄身，被程昱劝止。次年春曹操袭定陶，夏天在巨野斩薛兰、李封。裴注引《魏书》说，当时曹军大多出外割麦，营中不足千人，曹操让妇女登上营垒守望，把兵藏在大堤后面，等吕布逼近，伏兵齐出，步骑并进，大破吕布与陈宫的万余人马。吕布连夜逃走，东奔刘备。
ch012-dingtao.why: Victory restores Cao Cao's base in Yan province and sends Lü Bu east to become Liu Bei's problem in Xuzhou.
ch012-dingtao.why_zh: 定陶之胜让曹操重新稳住兖州根本，也把吕布赶向徐州，成了刘备的心腹之患。

story: Li Jue and Guo Si run the court and terrorize Chang'an. The minister Yang Biao and Zhu Jun devise a scheme to divide them: Yang Biao's wife visits Guo Si's wife and hints that her husband is having an affair with Li Jue's wife. Consumed by jealousy, Guo Si's wife poisons a dish that Li Jue has sent and feeds it to a dog, which dies on the spot; later, when Guo Si comes home drunk from Li Jue's house with a stomachache, she makes him drink dung water to vomit. Convinced Li Jue tried to poison him, Guo Si turns on his ally. Li Jue seizes the emperor and empress and burns the palace; Guo Si holds the ministers hostage; the two armies fight in the streets of Chang'an.

In Li Jue's camp the emperor goes short of food and clothes; when he asks for rice and meat for his attendants he is sent rotten meat and spoiled grain. Zhang Ji at last negotiates his departure east, but Li Jue and Guo Si join forces to pursue, and Yang Feng and Dong Cheng fight running battles while officials and palace women die in great numbers. Reaching the Yellow River at night with a single boat, they lower the emperor and empress down the high bank on lengths of silk, and men who scramble for the boat are cut down into the water. Across the river the emperor lives in a thatched hut and meets his ministers in a clearing fenced with thorns; back in Luoyang, among the ruins, officials go out to gather firewood, and many starve among the broken walls.

The histories make the journey no less wretched. The Zizhi tongjian says it was Guo Si's own wife who, fearing he fancied Li Jue's maids, faked poison with fermented beans, and that Guo Si, suspecting poison after a drunken evening, drank dung water as a cure; the novel turns this domestic quarrel into Yang Biao's stratagem. Dong Zhuo's biography in the Book of the Later Han says that after a heavy defeat in Hongnong the court crossed the Yellow River by night, the emperor let down the bank on silk, and the fingers of those who grabbed at the boat were hacked off into it; back in Luoyang the palaces were ashes, and officials below the rank of secretary went out to forage for wild grain, some starving to death among the walls.
story_zh: 李傕、郭汜把持朝政，横行长安。太尉杨彪与朱儁定下反间计：让杨彪夫人去郭汜府中，告诉郭妻她丈夫与李傕的妻子有私情。郭妻妒火中烧，李傕送来酒菜，她暗下毒药喂狗，狗当场死了；后来郭汜在李傕家喝醉回来腹痛，郭妻灌他粪汁催吐。郭汜认定李傕要毒死他，二人反目成仇。李傕劫走献帝和皇后，放火烧了宫殿；郭汜扣押公卿百官，两军在长安城中混战。
献帝在李傕营中缺衣少食，讨些米肉赏赐左右，送来的却是腐肉烂粮。后经张济调解，献帝才得东归，李傕、郭汜又联兵追来，杨奉、董承护驾苦战，百官宫人死伤无数。夜奔黄河边，只找到一条小船，众人用白绢把天子和皇后缒下高岸，争船的人被砍落水中。过河后天子住在茅屋里，在荆棘围起的空地上与大臣议事；回到洛阳，满目焦土，百官出城樵采，不少人饿死在断墙残壁之间。
献帝东归之苦，史书所记不比小说轻。据《资治通鉴》，是郭汜之妻怕丈夫与李傕家婢妾有染，用豆豉冒充毒药挑拨，郭汜醉后疑心中毒，喝粪汁解毒，二人由此相攻，小说把这段家事改成了杨彪的计谋。《后汉书·董卓传》载，献帝一行在弘农被追兵大败，夜里用绢把天子缒下河岸偷渡黄河，争船者手指被砍落船中；回到洛阳，宫室烧尽，尚书郎以下亲自出城采集野谷，有的饿死在断墙之间。
ch013-emperor-escapes-east.why: The flight reduces the Han emperor to a starving refugee, which is exactly what makes him a prize for whoever will take him in.
ch013-emperor-escapes-east.why_zh: 东归之路使汉天子沦为饥寒交迫的流亡者，也让他成了群雄争相奉迎的筹码。

story: Sun Ce, having pawned the imperial seal to Yuan Shu for three thousand men, crosses the Yangzi to attack Liu Yao, inspector of Yang province. Taishi Ci of Donglai is in Liu Yao's camp, but Liu Yao thinks him too young for a command. Sun Ce, who has dreamed that the Emperor Guangwu summoned him, insists on visiting Guangwu's temple on Shenting Ridge despite Zhang Zhao's warning, takes thirteen riders including Cheng Pu, Huang Gai and Han Dang, and after the sacrifice rides up the ridge to spy on Liu Yao's camp. Told of it, Taishi Ci shouts for any man with courage to follow him; no officer moves but one junior who rides out with him.

Taishi Ci charges down and fights Sun Ce fifty bouts without result, then feigns flight to draw him away onto the plain and fights fifty more. Each grabs the other's spear, both tumble from their saddles and wrestle on the ground until their robes are in shreds; Sun Ce snatches the short halberd from Taishi Ci's back, Taishi Ci snatches Sun Ce's helmet, and only when troops arrive from both sides do they part. Later, captured, Taishi Ci is untied by Sun Ce himself. He asks leave to go and gather Liu Yao's scattered men, promising to be back by noon next day; everyone says he will never return, but Sun Ce sets up a pole at the camp gate to watch its shadow, and at noon Taishi Ci rides in with more than a thousand men.

Taishi Ci's biography in the Records of the Three Kingdoms says that when Liu Yao was urged to make him a general, he replied that Xu Shao would laugh at him, and used him only as a scout. With a single rider Taishi Ci ran into Sun Ce's thirteen horsemen, Han Dang, Song Qian and Huang Gai among them, and fought Sun Ce face to face: Sun Ce stabbed his horse and seized the hand halberd at the back of his neck, Taishi Ci took Sun Ce's helmet. When Sun Ce later captured him, the Wuli in Pei Songzhi's notes says, he untied him and asked what he would have done had he caught him at Shenting; 'Hard to say,' said Taishi Ci, and Sun Ce laughed and gave him a command.
story_zh: 孙策用传国玉玺向袁术换来三千兵马，渡江攻打扬州刺史刘繇。东莱人太史慈此时正在刘繇营中，刘繇嫌他年轻，不肯用为大将。孙策说夜里梦见光武帝召见，听说神亭岭上有光武庙，执意前去祭拜，张昭劝阻也不听，带着程普、黄盖、韩当等十三骑上岭，祭罢又纵马到岭上窥探刘繇营寨。太史慈听报，大叫“有胆气者，都跟我来！”众将不动，只有一名小将随他出营。
太史慈冲到岭下，与孙策大战五十合不分胜负，又佯败引孙策到平川上再斗五十合，两人互相挟住对方的枪，一齐滚下马来，揪扭在一处，战袍扯得粉碎。孙策夺了太史慈背上的短戟，太史慈夺了孙策的头盔，直到两边救兵赶到才散开。后来太史慈兵败被擒，孙策亲自为他松绑。太史慈请命去收拢刘繇残部，约定次日正午回来，众人都说他一去不返，孙策竖竿看日影，正午时分他果然带着一千多人回营。
《三国志·太史慈传》载，有人劝刘繇用太史慈为大将，刘繇说：“我若用子义，许子将不当笑我邪？”只派他侦察敌情。太史慈只带一骑，恰遇孙策的十三骑，其中有韩当、宋谦、黄盖等人，他上前与孙策交手，孙策刺中他的马，夺下他颈后的手戟，他也夺得孙策的头盔。据裴注引《吴历》，孙策后来擒获太史慈，亲手解缚，问他当日在神亭若捉住了我会怎样，太史慈答“未可量也”，孙策大笑，委以重任。
ch015-taishi-ci.why: The duel wins Sun Ce a loyal general and shows the open-handed leadership that let him take the lands south of the Yangzi.
ch015-taishi-ci.why_zh: 一场酣斗为孙策换来一员忠勇大将，也显示了他赖以平定江东的豁达气度。

story: Back in Luoyang the emperor finds the palaces in ruins and no food. Yang Biao proposes summoning Cao Cao, whose armies are strong, to support the throne. Cao Cao's adviser Xun Yu urges him on: Duke Wen of Jin escorted King Xiang of Zhou home and the lords submitted to him; the Han founder mourned the Righteous Emperor and the realm turned to him; to receive the Son of Heaven now and follow the people's wishes is a plan for the ages, and if he hesitates others will be first. Delighted, Cao Cao marches, drives off Li Jue and Guo Si when they attack again, and is received by the emperor and given charge of the capital region and the secretariat.

The court official Dong Zhao advises him privately: Luoyang is past repair and hard to supply; move the emperor to Xu, which has walls, palaces, money and grain enough, and give out that it is to be nearer the grain at Luyang. On the road east Yang Feng and Han Xian try to block the way; Yang Feng's officer Xu Huang fights Xu Chu to a standstill, and Cao Cao, admiring him, sends Man Chong to win him over. At Xu Cao Cao builds palaces and sets up the ancestral temples and altars; the emperor makes him General-in-Chief and Marquis of Wuping, and rewards Xun Yu, Xun You, Guo Jia, Cheng Yu and others. From now on the business of the court goes first to Cao Cao and only then to the emperor.

Cao Cao's annals in the Records of the Three Kingdoms say he reached Luoyang in the eighth month of 196, that Dong Zhao and others urged him to make Xu the capital, and that in the ninth month the emperor's carriage went east through the Huanyuan pass; at Xu Cao Cao was made General-in-Chief and Marquis of Wuping, but when Yuan Shao resented ranking below him he gave the title to Yuan Shao and became Minister of Works instead. Years earlier Mao Jie had advised him to 'serve the Son of Heaven and command the disobedient', and Yuan Shao's adviser Ju Shou had urged his own master to take in the emperor, in vain. Cao Cao moved first, and the same year began military farming colonies around Xu, laying the foundation for his conquest of the north.
story_zh: 献帝回到洛阳，宫室残破，粮食断绝，杨彪奏请宣召兵强将盛的曹操入朝辅政。曹操接诏，荀彧劝他：昔日晋文公护送周襄王回朝而诸侯归服，汉高祖为义帝发丧而天下归心，如今奉天子以从众望，正是不世之略，若不早图，就会被别人抢先。曹操大喜，发兵勤王，打退了又来进犯的李傕、郭汜，入朝面圣，被授以司隶校尉、录尚书事。
议郎董昭私下对曹操说，洛阳残破难以修复，转运粮草又艰难，不如移驾许都，那里城郭宫室、钱粮民物都足够用，对外可说是为了就近鲁阳运粮。车驾东行途中，杨奉、韩暹领兵拦截，杨奉部将徐晃与许褚大战，曹操爱惜徐晃，派满宠劝降了他。到了许都，曹操盖宫室殿宇，立宗庙社稷，献帝封他为大将军、武平侯，荀彧、荀攸、郭嘉、程昱等各有封赏。从此朝廷大事先禀曹操，然后才奏天子。
《三国志·武帝纪》载，建安元年八月曹操到洛阳，董昭等劝他定都于许，九月车驾出轘辕东行，到许县后曹操拜大将军、封武平侯；不久袁绍耻居其下，曹操便把大将军让给袁绍，自任司空、行车骑将军。早在几年前，谋士毛玠就劝曹操“奉天子以令不臣”；袁绍的谋士沮授也劝过袁绍迎奉天子，袁绍没有听从。曹操抢先一步，从此以汉室名义号令四方，同年又在许下推行屯田，奠定了统一北方的根基。
ch014-emperor-to-xu.why: Holding the emperor lets Cao Cao speak in the Han's name, the political edge that carries him to mastery of the north.
ch014-emperor-to-xu.why_zh: 迎奉天子使曹操得以借汉室名义号令四方，这一政治优势是他统一北方的关键。

story_zh: 曹操用“驱虎吞狼”之计，假借天子诏命让刘备去讨伐袁术。刘备临行放心不下张飞，因为他好酒，酒后爱打骂士卒。张飞发誓戒酒，自请留守徐州。刘备一走，张飞便大宴众官，说今日喝个痛快，明日起一同戒酒，挨个劝酒。曹豹推说自己天戒不饮，张飞硬逼他喝了一杯。
张飞喝得大醉，再劝时曹豹不肯，张飞便要鞭打。曹豹求他看在女婿吕布的面上，张飞反倒更怒：“我打你，便是打吕布！”打了五十鞭。曹豹连夜写信给屯驻小沛的吕布。吕布听从陈宫劝说，带五百骑兵连夜赶来，曹豹打开城门迎入。张飞醉中迎战不敌，只带少数随从杀出，刘备的家眷全陷在城中。他赶到盱眙向刘备请罪，羞愧得拔剑要自刎，被刘备一把抱住。
史实：徐州的治所在下邳。《三国志·先主传》只说吕布乘虚袭取下邳，“下邳守将曹豹反，间迎布”。裴注引《英雄记》说得更细：张飞与下邳相曹豹争执，杀了曹豹，城中大乱，丹杨兵将领许耽派人去请吕布，吕布连夜进兵，天亮时丹杨兵开门迎入。袁术事先还写信许以粮米，怂恿吕布出兵。醉酒鞭打和“岳父”之说都是小说添的。
story: Cao Cao's scheme of 'setting the tiger to swallow the wolf' sends Liu Bei off, under an imperial order, to fight Yuan Shu. Before leaving, Liu Bei worries about Zhang Fei, who drinks and beats his men when drunk. Zhang Fei swears off wine and asks to hold Xuzhou. As soon as Liu Bei is gone he throws a feast, declaring one last bout before everyone gives up drinking, and presses cups on every officer. Cao Bao says heaven forbids him wine; Zhang Fei makes him drink anyway.

Later, very drunk, Zhang Fei presses him again; Cao Bao refuses, and Zhang Fei orders a flogging. Cao Bao begs to be spared for the sake of his son-in-law Lü Bu, which only makes it worse: 'Beating you is beating Lü Bu!' After fifty lashes Cao Bao writes that night to Lü Bu at Xiaopei. Urged on by Chen Gong, Lü Bu rides through the night with five hundred horsemen and Cao Bao opens the gate. Zhang Fei, still drunk, cuts his way out with a handful of men, leaving Liu Bei's family in the city. When he reaches Liu Bei at Xuyi he is so ashamed that he draws his sword to kill himself, and Liu Bei throws his arms round him.

Historically: Xiapi was the seat of Xu province. Liu Bei's biography in the Records says only that Lü Bu took Xiapi while it was undefended and that its commander Cao Bao 'rebelled and let him in'. The Yingxiong ji, quoted in Pei Songzhi's notes, gives more: Zhang Fei quarrelled with Cao Bao, chancellor of Xiapi, and killed him; in the confusion Xu Dan, an officer of the Danyang troops, sent for Lü Bu, who marched by night, and at daybreak the Danyang men opened the gate. Yuan Shu had also written to Lü Bu promising him grain if he moved. The drunken flogging and the father-in-law are the novel's.
ch014-lu-bu-takes-xuzhou.why: Losing Xuzhou cost Liu Bei his only base and turned him from Lü Bu's host into his dependent, the start of years of wandering among the warlords.
ch014-lu-bu-takes-xuzhou.why_zh: 刘备失去了徐州这块根据地，与吕布主客易位，从此在群雄之间颠沛流离。

quote.zh: 兄弟如手足，妻子如衣服
quote.en: Brothers are hands and feet; wives and children are clothes.

people.name: Cao Bao
people.role: flogged officer, Lü Bu's father-in-law in the novel
people.role_zh: 被鞭打的部将，小说中吕布的岳父

story_zh: 孙坚死后，长子孙策寄身袁术帐下，郁郁不得志。舅父吴景在江东被扬州刺史刘繇所逼，孙策便拿父亲留下的传国玉玺作抵押，向袁术借得兵马，渡江东进。途中少年好友周瑜前来相助，又举荐了张昭、张纮“二张”。孙策击败刘繇，在神亭岭与刘繇部将太史慈单骑恶斗，一个夺了对方背上的短戟，一个抢了对方的头盔。后来太史慈兵败归降。
孙策军纪严明，所到之处秋毫无犯，百姓欢悦，人称“小霸王”。他转攻吴郡的严白虎，严白虎派弟弟严舆来议和，想与他平分江东，被孙策当场斩杀。严白虎败逃会稽，投奔太守王朗。王朗不听虞翻劝阻，出兵相助，结果被孙策打得大败，弃城而逃。两年之间，江东诸郡尽归孙氏。
《三国志·孙策传》记载，孙策起初只从袁术那里得到千余兵马、几十匹战马，走到历阳时已聚众五六千人。神亭岭夺戟抢盔一事，《太史慈传》几乎原样记载。孙策打下的这片江东基业，后来成了弟弟孙权建立吴国的根本。
story: After Sun Jian's death his eldest son Sun Ce lives as a dependent of Yuan Shu, chafing. When his uncle Wu Jing is hard pressed in Jiangdong by Liu Yao, the inspector of Yangzhou, Sun Ce pawns the imperial jade seal his father left him to borrow troops from Yuan Shu, and crosses the Yangzi. On the way his boyhood friend Zhou Yu joins him and recommends the 'two Zhangs', Zhang Zhao and Zhang Hong. Sun Ce beats Liu Yao, and at Shenting ridge fights a wild duel with Liu Yao's officer Taishi Ci: one snatches the short halberd off the other's back, the other grabs his helmet. Taishi Ci later surrenders and joins him.

Sun Ce's troops keep strict discipline and take nothing from the people, who welcome them, and he becomes known as the Little Conqueror. He turns on Yan Baihu at Wu. Yan sends his brother Yan Yu to propose splitting Jiangdong between them, and Sun Ce kills him on the spot. Yan Baihu flees to Kuaiji and its governor Wang Lang, who ignores Yu Fan's advice and fights for him, only to be routed and flee. In two years the commanderies of Jiangdong are all in the Suns' hands.

Sun Ce's biography in the Records says he set out from Yuan Shu with only about a thousand men and a few dozen horses, and had five or six thousand by the time he reached Liyang. The tussle over halberd and helmet at Shenting is told almost word for word in the biography of Taishi Ci. The lands Sun Ce won became the base on which his brother Sun Quan would found the state of Wu.
ch015-sun-ce-east.why: The Jiangdong that Sun Ce conquered was the foundation of Wu, the third of the Three Kingdoms.
ch015-sun-ce-east.why_zh: 孙策打下的江东基业，是日后三国鼎立中东吴的根本。

people.name: Taishi Ci
people.role: Liu Yao's officer, later Sun Ce's

people.name: Yuan Shu
people.role: lends the troops for the jade seal

story_zh: 袁术想除掉刘备，又怕吕布出手相救，便先送粮草给吕布，请他按兵不动，然后派大将纪灵领兵进攻小沛。刘备兵少，写信向吕布求救。吕布盘算：袁术若吞了小沛，就会联合泰山诸将来对付自己，不能坐视。他引兵来到小沛附近，分头请刘备和纪灵到营中赴宴。纪灵进帐见刘备也在座，大吃一惊，转身要走，被吕布一把拉了回来。
吕布说自己平生不好争斗，只爱为人劝和。他命人把画戟插在辕门外一百五十步远处，说：我一箭若射中戟上小枝，你们两家就罢兵；射不中，各自回营厮杀。纪灵心想这么远哪能射中，便答应了；刘备只盼他射中。吕布挽弓一发，正中小枝，帐上帐下齐声喝彩，纪灵只得收兵。不久张飞劫了吕布买来的马匹，吕布攻打小沛，刘备只好投奔许都的曹操。
《三国志·吕布传》的记载与小说几乎一样：吕布对纪灵等人说“玄德，布弟也”，又说自己“性不喜合斗，但喜解斗耳”，令门候在营门举起一支戟，一箭正中小支，诸将惊呼“将军天威也”，次日再次欢宴，然后各自罢兵。史书没有说一百五十步的距离，并记载纪灵所率是步骑三万。
story: Yuan Shu wants Liu Bei gone but fears Lü Bu will help him, so he first sends Lü Bu grain to keep him quiet, then sends his general Ji Ling to attack Xiaopei. Liu Bei, badly outnumbered, appeals to Lü Bu, who reckons that if Yuan Shu swallows Xiaopei he will join forces with the Taishan generals against him next, so he cannot stand by. He brings troops close to Xiaopei and invites Liu Bei and Ji Ling to a feast. When Ji Ling walks in and finds Liu Bei there, he turns to leave, and Lü Bu hauls him back.

Lü Bu says that all his life he has disliked fighting and liked only to stop fights. He has his painted halberd planted outside the camp gate a hundred and fifty paces off: if one arrow hits its small side blade, both sides go home; if he misses, they can go back and fight it out. Ji Ling, sure no one could hit it at that distance, agrees; Liu Bei only prays that he will. Lü Bu draws and looses, the arrow strikes the side blade, the whole camp roars, and Ji Ling has to withdraw. Soon after, though, Zhang Fei steals horses Lü Bu has bought, Lü Bu attacks Xiaopei, and Liu Bei has to take refuge with Cao Cao in Xudu.
