Lü Bu's biography in the Records tells it almost exactly so: Lü Bu tells Ji Ling and his officers that 'Xuande is my younger brother' and that 'by nature I do not like joining fights, only breaking them up'; he has a gate officer raise a halberd at the camp gate, hits the small blade with one shot, the officers cry 'General, your power is heaven's!', and after another feast the next day both armies leave. The Records gives no distance, and puts Ji Ling's force at thirty thousand foot and horse.
ch016-halberd-shot.why: One arrow saved Liu Bei for the moment and is the best remembered instance of Lü Bu playing the warlords off against each other.
ch016-halberd-shot.why_zh: 这一箭让刘备逃过一劫，是吕布在群雄夹缝中左右逢源、以武力调停的著名一幕。

quote.zh: 温侯神射世间稀，曾向辕门独解危
quote.en: Few in the world could shoot like the Marquis of Wen; at the camp gate he alone lifted the danger.

story_zh: 曹操南征宛城，张绣听从谋士贾诩的劝告，开城投降。曹操进城后连日饮宴，一晚醉后问侄子曹安民城中可有美女，曹安民说起张绣叔父张济的遗孀邹氏颇有姿色。曹操便把邹氏接到城外营中同住，叫典韦在帐外守卫。张绣得知，羞愤难当，与贾诩密谋反叛。
张绣部将胡车儿力大善走，设宴把典韦灌醉，偷走了他的双铁戟。当夜张绣放火劫营。典韦惊醒，手边没有兵器，夺过一口腰刀死守寨门，砍到刀口卷刃，又抓起两个敌兵当兵器挥舞，直到背后中枪，血流满地而死；死后半晌，仍无人敢从前门进去。曹操从后寨逃走，右臂中箭，坐骑也被射倒，长子曹昂把马让给父亲，自己死于乱箭，曹安民也被砍死。
《三国志》的记载相同：张绣怨恨曹操纳张济之妻，突袭曹营，曹昂、曹安民遇害，曹操也被流矢射中。裴注引《世语》说曹昂把马让给了父亲；《典韦传》记典韦在营门力战，伤重后瞋目大骂而死。曹操为他痛哭，后来每次路过他的葬地都要祭祀。两年后，张绣又在贾诩劝说下再次归降曹操。
story: Cao Cao marches south on Wancheng, and Zhang Xiu, on the advice of his strategist Jia Xu, opens the gates and surrenders. Cao Cao feasts in the city day after day. One night, drunk, he asks his nephew Cao Anmin whether there are any beautiful women in town, and hears of Lady Zou, widow of Zhang Xiu's uncle Zhang Ji. Cao Cao has her brought to his camp outside the walls and posts Dian Wei at the tent door. Zhang Xiu, burning with shame, plots revolt with Jia Xu.

Zhang Xiu's officer Hu Che'er, a giant of strength and a tireless walker, gets Dian Wei drunk and steals his pair of iron halberds. That night Zhang Xiu's men fire the camp and storm in. Dian Wei wakes with no weapon, snatches a soldier's sword and holds the gate until the blade is notched, then swings two enemy soldiers as clubs, until a spear in the back brings him down, roaring, in a pool of blood; long after he is dead no one dares come through that gate. Cao Cao flees from the rear with an arrow in his right arm. His horse is shot from under him, his eldest son Cao Ang gives him his own and dies under the arrows, and Cao Anmin is cut down.

The Records agrees: Zhang Xiu resented Cao Cao's taking Zhang Ji's widow and attacked by surprise, Cao Ang and Cao Anmin were killed and Cao Cao was hit by a stray arrow. The Shiyu, quoted by Pei Songzhi, says Cao Ang gave his father his horse; Dian Wei's biography has him fighting in the gateway until, badly wounded, he died glaring and cursing. Cao Cao wept for him and sacrificed to him whenever he passed his grave. Two years later, again on Jia Xu's advice, Zhang Xiu surrendered to Cao Cao a second time.
ch016-wancheng.why: Wancheng cost Cao Cao his eldest son and his fiercest bodyguard, one of the costliest lessons of his life.
ch016-wancheng.why_zh: 宛城之败让曹操失去了长子和最勇猛的护卫，是他一生中最惨痛的教训之一。

quote.zh: 吾折长子、爱侄，俱无深痛；独号泣典韦也
quote.en: I lost my eldest son and my dear nephew without deep grief; it is Dian Wei alone I weep for.

story_zh: 袁术据有淮南，地广粮多，手里又握着孙策抵押的传国玉玺，便动了称帝的念头。他对部下说，汉高祖不过是泗上一个亭长，尚能得天下；如今汉朝四百年气数已尽，袁家四世三公，正该应天顺人。主簿阎象劝他效法周文王，三分天下有其二仍事殷商。袁术不听，搬出谶语“代汉者，当涂高也”，说自己字公路，正应此谶。
于是袁术在寿春称帝，建号仲氏，设立百官，乘龙凤辇，祭祀天地，立冯方之女为皇后、儿子为太子。因吕布悔婚，又把他的使者韩胤押往许都斩首，袁术大怒，发七路大军攻打徐州，被吕布打得大败。曹操随即会合刘备、吕布、孙策南征，袁术渡淮而逃，寿春被攻破，宫室被付之一炬，袁术从此一蹶不振。
袁术于建安二年（197年）在寿春称帝。《后汉书》说他自称“仲家”，设置公卿，祭祀南北郊；他早年读过“代汉者当涂高”的谶语，便以为自己名字正应。称帝后荒淫奢侈，后宫数百人锦衣玉食，士卒却冻饿不堪，江淮之间人民相食，部众纷纷离散。两年后他走投无路，想喝一口蜜水都不可得，呕血而死。
story: Master of the wide, rich lands of Huainan and holding the imperial jade seal that Sun Ce pawned to him, Yuan Shu begins to dream of the throne. He tells his officers that the founder of the Han was only a village headman on the Si, yet won the empire; now after four hundred years the Han's fortune is spent, while the Yuan family has produced top ministers for four generations. His registrar Yan Xiang urges him to be like King Wen of Zhou, who held two thirds of the realm yet still served the Shang. Yuan Shu brushes him aside and cites the prophecy 'He who replaces the Han is Tu Gao': his courtesy name, Gonglu, means 'public road', and tu means road.

So at Shouchun Yuan Shu proclaims himself emperor of the Zhong, appoints a full court, rides a dragon-and-phoenix carriage, sacrifices to Heaven and Earth, and makes a daughter of Feng Fang empress and his son crown prince. Furious that Lü Bu has broken off a marriage between their children and sent his envoy Han Yin to Xudu to be executed, he sends seven armies against Xuzhou, and Lü Bu routs them. Cao Cao then joins with Liu Bei, Lü Bu and Sun Ce to march on him; Yuan Shu flees across the Huai, Shouchun falls and his palaces are burned. He never recovers.

Yuan Shu proclaimed himself emperor at Shouchun in 197. The Book of the Later Han says he called his dynasty Zhongjia, appointed ministers and sacrificed at the southern and northern altars; he had read the 'Tu Gao' prophecy as a young man and believed his names fulfilled it. His court grew ever more extravagant, hundreds of palace women in silks while his soldiers froze and starved, and between the Yangzi and the Huai people were reduced to eating one another. His followers drifted away, and two years later he died vomiting blood, unable even to get a drink of honey water.
ch017-yuan-shu-emperor.why: Yuan Shu was the first warlord to claim the throne openly, and the way every other lord turned on him showed how much the Han's name still counted.
ch017-yuan-shu-emperor.why_zh: 袁术是汉末第一个公开称帝的诸侯，此举让他成了众矢之的，也显示出汉室名分在人心中的分量。

quote.zh: 代汉者，当涂高也
quote.en: He who replaces the Han is the one high on the road.

story_zh: 下邳被困日久，侯成盗走赤兔献给曹操，宋宪、魏续趁吕布打盹将他捆住，开城投降。吕布被押上白门楼，叫嚷绳子绑得太紧，曹操说：“缚虎不得不急。”高顺一言不发，被推出斩首。陈宫被押上来，曹操问他老母妻儿怎么办，陈宫答：以孝治天下者不害人之亲，施仁政者不绝人之祀，存亡全在明公。说罢径自下楼受刑，曹操流泪相送，下令赡养他的家人。
趁曹操送陈宫下楼，吕布对座上的刘备说：您是座上客，我是阶下囚，何不替我说句话？曹操回来，吕布又说：明公所忧不过吕布，我已降服，您做大将，我为副手，天下不难平定。曹操问刘备，刘备说：“公不见丁建阳、董卓之事乎？”吕布瞪着刘备，骂他最不讲信义。曹操下令将吕布缢死后枭首。张辽被押上来大骂曹操，经刘备、关羽求情得免一死，归顺曹操。
《三国志·吕布传》的记载大体相同，只是细节略有出入：被侯成、宋宪、魏续捆绑献降的是陈宫，吕布与部下登上白门楼，见围困已急，才下楼投降。吕布对曹操说“令布将骑，明公将步，天下不足定也”，刘备一句话就让曹操打消了念头。裴注引《典略》说，陈宫死后，曹操赡养他的母亲直到终老，还为他的女儿操办了婚事。
story: After the long siege of Xiapi, Lü Bu's officer Hou Cheng steals Red Hare and takes it to Cao Cao, and Song Xian and Wei Xu tie up Lü Bu as he dozes and open the gates. Brought up the White Gate Tower, Lü Bu complains the ropes are too tight; Cao Cao answers, 'A tiger must be bound tight.' Gao Shun says nothing and is led out to be beheaded. Then comes Chen Gong. Asked what will become of his old mother, wife and children, he replies that one who rules by filial piety does not harm a man's parents and one who governs with benevolence does not cut off a man's line: their fate is in Cao Cao's hands. He walks down to his death; Cao Cao, in tears, orders his family cared for.

While Cao Cao is downstairs seeing Chen Gong off, Lü Bu says to Liu Bei, who is seated: you are the guest on the dais and I the prisoner below the steps, will you not say a word for me? When Cao Cao returns, Lü Bu offers himself: all you fear is me, and I submit; you be the commander and I your second, and the empire will be easy to settle. Cao Cao turns to Liu Bei, who says: 'Have you not seen what happened to Ding Yuan and Dong Zhuo?' Lü Bu glares at him and calls him the most faithless of men. Cao Cao has Lü Bu strangled and his head displayed. Zhang Liao, brought up next, curses Cao Cao, but is spared at the pleas of Liu Bei and Guan Yu and goes over to Cao Cao.

Lü Bu's biography in the Records tells much the same story, with one difference: it was Chen Gong whom Hou Cheng, Song Xian and Wei Xu tied up before surrendering, and Lü Bu, who had gone up the White Gate Tower with his men, came down and gave himself up as the siege closed in. He told Cao Cao, 'Let me lead the cavalry and you the infantry, and the empire will be no trouble to settle', and Liu Bei's one remark was enough to change Cao Cao's mind. The Dianlüe, cited by Pei Songzhi, adds that Cao Cao supported Chen Gong's mother for the rest of her life and arranged his daughter's marriage.
ch019-white-gate-tower.why: The death of the age's most feared fighter removed Cao Cao's most dangerous neighbour and gave him Xuzhou.
ch019-white-gate-tower.why_zh: 一代猛将吕布就此身死，曹操除去心腹之患，徐州落入其手。

quote.zh: 缚虎不得不急
quote.en: A tiger must be bound tight.

story_zh: 吕布连吃败仗，退守下邳。陈宫献计：趁曹军远来，由吕布领兵屯驻城外，陈宫守城，互为犄角。吕布本已答应，回去却被妻子严氏哭着劝阻，怕他一走城中生变、自己无依无靠，于是作罢，终日与妻妾饮酒。他派人向袁术求救，袁术要他先送女儿过去才肯发兵；吕布把女儿绑在背上突围，被关羽、张飞拦了回去。
下邳久攻不下，曹操想要退兵。郭嘉、荀攸劝他说吕布屡败、锐气已失，正该急攻，并献计决开沂水、泗水灌城。吕布却说自己有赤兔马，渡水如履平地，照旧饮酒作乐，直到在镜中看见自己形容憔悴，才下令全城禁酒。部将侯成追回失马后酿酒庆贺，被打了五十背花，怀恨在心，盗走赤兔献给曹操，宋宪、魏续随即缚了吕布出降。
《三国志·武帝纪》记载，建安三年（198年）冬，曹操进军下邳，吕布屡战屡败，退守城中。《荀攸传》说荀攸与郭嘉劝曹操不要退兵，于是引沂水、泗水灌城，一个多月后，宋宪、魏续等人捉住陈宫，举城投降。陈宫劝吕布出城屯兵、严氏哭劝阻止一节，见于裴注所引《魏氏春秋》。
story: Beaten again and again, Lü Bu falls back into Xiapi. Chen Gong proposes that, while Cao Cao's army is far from home, Lü Bu camp outside the walls with troops and Chen Gong hold the city, each supporting the other. Lü Bu agrees, but his wife Lady Yan begs him in tears not to go, afraid of what will happen in the city and to her once he is gone, and he gives it up, spending his days drinking with his wives. He asks Yuan Shu for help; Yuan Shu wants his daughter sent first, and when Lü Bu tries to break out with the girl strapped to his back, Guan Yu and Zhang Fei drive him back.

The city holds, and Cao Cao thinks of withdrawing. Guo Jia and Xun You tell him that Lü Bu's spirit is broken by defeat and now is the time to press, and propose breaking the banks of the Yi and Si rivers to flood the city. Lü Bu shrugs it off, saying his Red Hare crosses water as if it were flat ground, and goes on drinking, until he sees his haggard face in a mirror and bans wine throughout the city. When his officer Hou Cheng brews wine to celebrate recovering some stolen horses, Lü Bu has him given fifty strokes. Hou Cheng steals Red Hare and takes it to Cao Cao, and Song Xian and Wei Xu bind Lü Bu and surrender.

The annals of Cao Cao in the Records say that in the winter of 198 Cao Cao advanced on Xiapi and Lü Bu, beaten in every battle, shut himself up inside. Xun You's biography says he and Guo Jia talked Cao Cao out of retreating; the Yi and Si were turned on the city, and after a little over a month Song Xian, Wei Xu and others seized Chen Gong and surrendered the city. Chen Gong's plan for a camp outside the walls, and Lady Yan's tearful objection, are in the Weishi chunqiu quoted by Pei Songzhi.
ch019-flooding-xiapi.why: The flood left Lü Bu trapped in a doomed city and let Cao Cao destroy his most troublesome rival in the east.
ch019-flooding-xiapi.why_zh: 水淹下邳让吕布困死孤城，曹操由此消灭了东方最难缠的对手。

people.name: Chen Gong
people.role: urges a camp outside the walls

story_zh: 曹操请献帝到许田打猎。献帝连射一头大鹿三箭不中，曹操借过天子的宝雕弓、金鈚箭，一箭射倒。群臣见了金箭，以为是天子射中，齐呼万岁，曹操却纵马挡在天子面前接受欢呼。关羽大怒，提刀要斩曹操，被刘备用眼色止住。献帝回宫向伏皇后哭诉，皇后之父伏完推荐了国舅董承。
献帝咬破手指写下血诏，由伏皇后缝进玉带的紫锦衬里，再召董承到功臣阁，赐他锦袍玉带，嘱咐他回去细看。出宫时偏遇曹操，曹操拿过袍带对着日光细看，又穿在身上，最后才笑着还给他。董承回家翻看许久不见异样，夜里伏案睡着，灯花落下烧破衬里，这才露出血书。他随即联络王子服、种辑、吴子兰、吴硕和西凉马腾在义状上署名，刘备后来也签了名。
《三国志·先主传》记载，董承“辞受帝衣带中密诏”，即自称接到藏在衣带中的密诏，与刘备、种辑、吴子兰、王子服等同谋诛曹。裴松之注说，董承是灵帝之母董太后的侄子，女儿是献帝的贵人，古时没有“丈人”的说法，所以称他为“舅”。建安五年正月事情败露，董承等人被杀。许田射鹿一节则不见于正史。
story: Cao Cao invites Emperor Xian to hunt at Xutian. The emperor shoots three arrows at a great stag and misses; Cao Cao borrows the emperor's own carved bow and gold-tipped arrows and brings it down. Seeing the golden arrow, the courtiers think the emperor has made the kill and cheer 'Long live the emperor!', but Cao Cao rides out in front of the emperor to take the cheers. Guan Yu raises his blade to cut him down, and Liu Bei stops him with a look. Back in the palace the emperor weeps to Empress Fu, and her father Fu Wan names the imperial in-law Dong Cheng as a man to trust.

The emperor bites his finger and writes an edict in blood, which the empress sews into the purple lining of a jade belt. Summoning Dong Cheng to the Hall of Meritorious Ministers, he gives him a brocade robe and the belt and tells him to examine them carefully at home. At the palace gate Dong Cheng runs into Cao Cao, who holds robe and belt up to the light, puts them on, and only at last hands them back with a laugh. At home Dong Cheng searches in vain until, dozing over his desk at night, a spark from the lamp burns through the lining and the bloodstained silk appears. He gathers Wang Zifu, Zhong Ji, Wu Zilan, Wu Shuo and Ma Teng of Xiliang to sign a pledge, and later Liu Bei signs too.

Liu Bei's biography in the Records says Dong Cheng 'claimed to have received a secret edict from the emperor in a belt', and plotted with Liu Bei, Zhong Ji, Wu Zilan, Wang Zifu and others to kill Cao Cao; so even the histories have only Dong Cheng's word for the edict. Pei Songzhi explains that Dong Cheng was a nephew of Emperor Ling's mother, the Empress Dowager Dong, and the father of one of Emperor Xian's consorts; having no word for father-in-law, the ancients called him the emperor's 'uncle'. The plot came out in the first month of 200 and Dong Cheng and the others were executed. The hunt at Xutian is not in the histories.
ch020-belt-edict.why: The belt edict drew Liu Bei into a plot against Cao Cao and set the two men openly against each other.
ch020-belt-edict.why_zh: 衣带诏把刘备卷入反曹密谋，从此他与曹操公开决裂。

quote.zh: 朕闻人伦之大，父子为先；尊卑之殊，君臣为重
quote.en: We have heard that among human bonds, father and son come first; among ranks, lord and subject weigh most.

story_zh: 刘备在衣带诏的义状上签名后，怕曹操起疑，便在后园种菜，装作胸无大志。一天关羽、张飞外出，许褚、张辽来请他去丞相府。曹操一见就笑道：“在家做得好大事！”吓得刘备面如土色，原来曹操说的只是他学种菜。曹操说见枝头梅子青青，想起去年征张绣时望梅止渴的事，便在小亭里摆下一盘青梅、一樽煮酒，与刘备对饮。
酒至半酣，乌云翻滚，曹操借龙的能大能小、能升能隐，谈起当世英雄。刘备列举袁术、袁绍、刘表、孙策、刘璋等人，曹操一一贬斥，说袁术是冢中枯骨，袁绍色厉胆薄、好谋无断。最后他以手指刘备，又指自己：“今天下英雄，惟使君与操耳！”刘备一惊，匙箸落地，恰好雷声大作，他从容拾起，说一震之威竟至于此。曹操笑他大丈夫也怕雷，从此不再疑他。
史实：《三国志·先主传》记载，曹操从容对刘备说：“今天下英雄，唯使君与操耳。本初之徒，不足数也。”刘备正在吃饭，惊得失落匙箸。借雷声掩饰见于东晋常璩的《华阳国志》。裴注引《吴历》还说，刘备在许都闭门种芜菁，曹操派人窥探，他对关羽、张飞说“吾岂种菜者乎”，认定曹操已起疑心，不可久留。青梅煮酒则是小说的点染。
story: Having signed Dong Cheng's pledge, Liu Bei fears Cao Cao's suspicion and takes to growing vegetables in his back garden, to look like a man without ambition. One day, while Guan Yu and Zhang Fei are out, Xu Chu and Zhang Liao fetch him to the chancellor's residence. Cao Cao greets him with a laugh: 'Fine big business you're up to at home!' Liu Bei goes pale, but Cao Cao means only his gardening. The green plums on the branches, Cao Cao says, remind him of last year's march against Zhang Xiu, when he kept his thirsty men going with talk of a plum grove ahead; so he sets out a plate of green plums and a jar of warmed wine in a pavilion and the two drink together.

Halfway through, black clouds boil up, and Cao Cao, comparing heroes to dragons that can grow and shrink, rise and hide, asks who the heroes of the age are. Liu Bei names Yuan Shu, Yuan Shao, Liu Biao, Sun Ce, Liu Zhang and others, and Cao Cao dismisses each in turn: Yuan Shu is a dried bone in a tomb, Yuan Shao fierce in looks but faint of heart, fond of schemes but unable to decide. Then he points at Liu Bei, then at himself: 'The only heroes in the world today are you, my lord, and I.' Liu Bei's spoon and chopsticks fall from his hand. Just then thunder cracks; he calmly picks them up and remarks on the power of a single thunderclap. Cao Cao laughs at a grown man afraid of thunder, and stops suspecting him.

Historically: Liu Bei's biography in the Records says Cao Cao told him casually, 'The only heroes in the world today are you and I; the likes of Benchu are not worth counting', and that Liu Bei, who was eating, dropped his spoon and chopsticks. The thunder as cover comes from Chang Qu's Chronicle of Huayang, written in the Eastern Jin. The Wu li, cited by Pei Songzhi, adds that Liu Bei kept his gate shut in Xu and grew turnips; when Cao Cao had him watched, he said to Guan Yu and Zhang Fei, 'Am I a man who grows vegetables?' and decided that Cao Cao suspected him and he could not stay. The green plums and warm wine are the novel's touch.
ch021-heroes-over-wine.why: The conversation sets Liu Bei up as Cao Cao's equal and rival, and is the novel's sharpest portrait of the two men side by side.
ch021-heroes-over-wine.why_zh: 这场对话把刘备推到了与曹操并立的位置，也是全书刻画曹、刘二人最传神的一幕。

quote.zh: 今天下英雄，惟使君与操耳
quote.en: The only heroes in the world today are you, my lord, and I.

story_zh: 刘备杀了车胄、占据徐州后，自知曹操必来报复，便请大儒郑玄写信给袁绍，求他出兵。袁绍帐下意见不一：田丰、沮授主张稳守，审配、郭图力主出战。袁绍最终决定兴兵讨曹，命书记陈琳起草檄文。陈琳字孔璋，素有文名，提笔一挥而就。
檄文从曹操的祖父中常侍曹腾骂起，说他父亲曹嵩是乞丐携养、花钱买官，骂曹操本人是“赘阉遗丑”，又揭他专设发丘中郎将、摸金校尉盗掘坟墓。檄文传到许都，曹操正犯头风卧床，读罢毛骨悚然，出了一身冷汗，头风不觉好了，一跃而起。得知出自陈琳之手，他笑道：有文才还须有武略相济，陈琳文章虽好，袁绍武略不足又有何用！随即调兵应战。
史实：这篇《为袁绍檄豫州》全文保存在《文选》中。陈琳早年做过何进的主簿，后来投奔袁绍。袁氏败亡后他归降曹操，曹操责问他：骂我本人也就罢了，为何连我的父祖也骂？陈琳谢罪，曹操爱其才，不加追究，让他掌管文书。《典略》说曹操头风发作时读了陈琳起草的文书，翕然而起，说“此愈我病”，那是陈琳归曹以后的事。
story: After killing Che Zhou and taking Xuzhou, Liu Bei knows Cao Cao will come for him, and asks the great scholar Zheng Xuan to write to Yuan Shao for help. Yuan Shao's advisers are split: Tian Feng and Ju Shou counsel patience, Shen Pei and Guo Tu urge war. Yuan Shao decides to march on Cao Cao and orders his secretary Chen Lin, a writer of renown, to draft a proclamation. Chen Lin dashes it off at one sitting.

It starts with Cao Cao's grandfather, the palace eunuch Cao Teng, calls his father Cao Song a beggar's foundling who bought his office, and calls Cao Cao himself 'the vile spawn of a eunuch's line', accusing him of creating posts such as the 'Grave-Opening Commandant' and 'Gold-Groping Colonel' to rob tombs. When it reaches Xudu, Cao Cao is in bed with one of his headaches. As he reads, his hair stands on end and he breaks into a cold sweat, and before he knows it his headache is gone and he leaps out of bed. Told that Chen Lin wrote it, he laughs: skill with words must be backed by skill in arms, and fine as Chen Lin's writing is, Yuan Shao's generalship is not up to it. Then he moves his army.

Historically: the proclamation, 'Denouncing Cao Cao on behalf of Yuan Shao', survives in full in the Wen xuan anthology. Chen Lin had served He Jin as registrar before going over to Yuan Shao. After the Yuans fell he surrendered to Cao Cao, who asked him why, denouncing Cao Cao, he had dragged in his father and grandfather too; Chen Lin apologised, and Cao Cao, valuing his talent, let it go and put him in charge of documents. The Dianlüe's story of Cao Cao, laid up with a headache, sitting up after reading Chen Lin's draft and saying 'This cures my illness' concerns papers Chen Lin wrote for him after that.
ch022-chen-lin.why: The proclamation was the war of words that opened the Guandu campaign, and 'Chen Lin's proclamation cured a headache' became a byword for the power of writing.
ch022-chen-lin.why_zh: 这篇檄文是官渡大战前的舆论宣战，“陈琳檄愈头风”也成了文章威力的著名典故。

quote.zh: 有文事者，必须以武略济之
quote.en: Skill with the pen must be backed by skill in war.

people.name: Chen Lin
people.role: Yuan Shao's secretary, author of the proclamation

story_zh: 董承家奴秦庆童告密，太医吉平下毒不成，受刑而死，衣带诏的密谋彻底败露。曹操将董承、王子服等人连同全家老小七百余口尽数斩杀，又带剑入宫，要杀怀有五个月身孕的董贵妃。献帝苦苦哀求等她分娩后再说，伏皇后也一同求情，曹操不许，命人用白练将她勒死在宫门外。
因刘备也在义状上署了名，曹操亲率大军东征。刘备向袁绍求救，袁绍却因幼子生病无心出兵，谋士田丰以杖击地，痛惜错失良机。张飞献计夜袭曹营，曹操事先察觉，设下伏兵，刘备、张飞大败，兄弟失散。刘备单骑投奔青州袁谭，再到冀州投靠袁绍；张飞逃往芒砀山；关羽保护二位嫂嫂困守下邳，陷入重围。
据《三国志·武帝纪》，建安五年正月董承等人伏诛。诸将担心袁绍袭其后方，曹操坚持东征，说刘备是人杰，今日不打，必为后患，结果一战击破刘备，俘获其妻儿，关羽也投降了。《后汉书》说董承之女为贵人，曹操杀董承后索要她，献帝以她有孕再三求情也未能保全。《先主传》说袁绍亲自出邺城二百里迎接刘备。
story: Betrayed by Dong Cheng's servant Qin Qingtong, and with the physician Ji Ping dead under torture after his failed attempt to poison Cao Cao, the belt-edict plot is laid bare. Cao Cao has Dong Cheng, Wang Zifu and the others executed with their entire households, over seven hundred people, then walks into the palace sword in hand to take Consort Dong, five months pregnant. The emperor begs him to wait until the child is born, Empress Fu pleads too, but Cao Cao refuses, and she is strangled with white silk outside the palace gate.

Since Liu Bei too has signed the pledge, Cao Cao marches east in person. Liu Bei begs Yuan Shao for help, but Yuan Shao, anxious over his youngest son's illness, will not move; his adviser Tian Feng strikes the ground with his staff, grieving at the lost chance. Zhang Fei proposes a night raid on Cao Cao's camp; Cao Cao sees it coming and lays an ambush, and Liu Bei and Zhang Fei are routed and separated. Liu Bei flees alone to Yuan Tan in Qingzhou and on to Yuan Shao in Jizhou; Zhang Fei escapes to the Mang-Dang hills; Guan Yu, guarding Liu Bei's two wives at Xiapi, is surrounded.

The annals of Cao Cao in the Records date the executions of Dong Cheng and his associates to the first month of 200. When his officers feared Yuan Shao would strike their rear, Cao Cao insisted on marching east, calling Liu Bei 'a hero among men' who would be trouble later if not dealt with now. He broke Liu Bei in one battle and captured his wife and children, and Guan Yu surrendered. The Book of the Later Han says Dong Cheng's daughter was a consort whom Cao Cao demanded after killing her father; the emperor pleaded again and again that she was pregnant, in vain. Liu Bei's biography says Yuan Shao came two hundred li out from Ye to meet him.
ch024-liu-bei-flees-to-yuan.why: Liu Bei lost all his territory and the three brothers were scattered, setting off the chain of stories of Guan Yu's stay with Cao Cao and his ride back to Liu Bei.
ch024-liu-bei-flees-to-yuan.why_zh: 刘备丢光了地盘，兄弟三人各自东西，由此引出关羽降曹、千里寻兄的一连串故事。

people.name: Cao Cao
people.role: crushes the plot and Liu Bei

story_zh: 袁绍兴兵南下，派大将颜良进攻白马。颜良连斩宋宪、魏续，徐晃出战二十回合也败下阵来，曹营诸将胆寒。程昱举荐关羽，暗中盘算：关羽杀了袁将，袁绍必杀刘备。曹操请关羽同上土山观阵，指着河北兵马说雄壮，关羽却说不过是土鸡瓦犬；又指麾盖下的颜良，关羽说：“吾观颜良，如插标卖首耳！”
关羽飞身上了赤兔马，倒提青龙刀冲下山去，袁军如波开浪裂。颜良正要开口，关羽已到面前，一刀把他砍于马下，割下首级拴在马颈上飞驰而回。原来刘备曾嘱咐颜良，若遇见红脸长须的关云长，叫他速来相见，所以颜良毫无防备。曹操赞他“真神人也”，关羽说三弟张翼德在百万军中取上将首级，如探囊取物。袁绍听说斩颜良的是红脸长须之人，险些杀了刘备。
《三国志·关羽传》记载：袁绍派颜良在白马围攻东郡太守刘延，曹操以张辽和关羽为先锋，关羽“望见良麾盖，策马刺良于万众之中，斩其首还”，袁军诸将无人能挡，白马之围遂解，曹操随即表封他为汉寿亭侯。史书用的是“刺”字。据《武帝纪》，此战还用了荀攸声东击西之计，先佯攻延津，把袁绍主力引向西边。
story: Yuan Shao marches south and sends his great general Yan Liang against Baima. Yan Liang cuts down Song Xian and Wei Xu and beats off Xu Huang after twenty bouts, and Cao Cao's officers lose heart. Cheng Yu recommends Guan Yu, reckoning privately that if Guan Yu kills one of Yuan Shao's generals, Yuan Shao will kill Liu Bei. Cao Cao takes Guan Yu up a hill to view the enemy. When Cao Cao admires the might of the northern army, Guan Yu calls them clay chickens and earthenware dogs, and of Yan Liang under his parasol he says: 'To me Yan Liang looks like a man who has stuck a price tag on his own head.'

Guan Yu leaps onto Red Hare and charges downhill, his Green Dragon blade trailing, and the enemy ranks part like waves. Before Yan Liang can say a word Guan Yu is upon him; one stroke brings him down, and Guan Yu cuts off the head, ties it to his horse's neck and gallops back. Liu Bei, it turns out, had asked Yan Liang to look out for a red-faced, long-bearded man named Guan Yunchang and tell him to come quickly, so Yan Liang was off his guard. Cao Cao calls Guan Yu superhuman; Guan Yu says his brother Zhang Fei can take a commander's head in an army of a million as easily as picking something out of a bag. When Yuan Shao hears that a red-faced, long-bearded man killed Yan Liang, he very nearly has Liu Bei executed.

Guan Yu's biography in the Records says that Yuan Shao sent Yan Liang to besiege Liu Yan, governor of Dong, at Baima, and that Cao Cao made Zhang Liao and Guan Yu his vanguard. Guan Yu 'saw Yan Liang's parasol, spurred his horse, stabbed Yan Liang in the midst of ten thousand men, cut off his head and returned'; none of Yuan Shao's generals could stop him, the siege was lifted, and Cao Cao at once had him made Marquis of Hanshou. The Records says 'stabbed'. The annals of Cao Cao add that Xun You's feint made it possible: a move toward Yanjin first drew Yuan Shao's main army west.
ch025-yan-liang.why: Killing Yan Liang was the great service with which Guan Yu repaid Cao Cao, and it cleared his way, in honour, to leave him for Liu Bei.
ch025-yan-liang.why_zh: 斩颜良是关羽报答曹操的大功，也为他日后辞曹寻兄扫清了道义上的障碍。

quote.zh: 吾观颜良，如插标卖首耳
quote.en: To my eye, Yan Liang is a man with a price tag on his head, waiting for a buyer.

people.name: Liu Bei
people.role: in Yuan Shao's camp, nearly executed

story_zh: 刘备兵败后，关羽保护甘、糜二夫人守在下邳。曹操爱关羽之才，想收为己用。程昱献计：先派降兵混进城中作内应，再由夏侯惇出阵引关羽出城，截断他的归路。关羽中计，追出二十里后退路被断，只得退上一座土山，眼看着下邳城中火起，四面被曹军团团围住。
天明时张辽上山劝降，说关羽若战死，有三条罪过：违背桃园同生共死之誓，辜负刘备托付二嫂之重，空有本领却不能匡扶汉室。关羽提出三个条件：只降汉帝，不降曹操；二位嫂嫂按皇叔俸禄供养，闲人不得到门；一旦得知刘备下落，不论千里万里都要辞去。曹操说：“吾为汉相，汉即吾也。”前两条一口答应，第三条犹豫，张辽劝他以厚恩结其心，曹操才应允。
史实：《三国志·关羽传》只有一句：“曹公禽羽以归，拜为偏将军，礼之甚厚。”《武帝纪》则说曹操击破刘备，俘获了他的妻儿，又进攻下邳，关羽投降。可见约三事、护嫂入许，以及到许都后关羽秉烛立于门外、直到天明等情节，都是小说和民间传说的创造，用来表现关羽身在曹营而忠义不改。
story: After Liu Bei's defeat Guan Yu holds Xiapi, guarding Ladies Gan and Mi. Cao Cao covets Guan Yu's talents, and Cheng Yu proposes a plan: first slip surrendered soldiers into the city to act from inside, then have Xiahou Dun lure Guan Yu out and cut off his retreat. Guan Yu takes the bait, pursues for twenty li, finds his road back cut, and retreats to an earthen hill, where, surrounded, he watches fires rise in Xiapi.

At dawn Zhang Liao climbs the hill to talk him round: to die now, he says, would be three crimes — breaking the Peach Garden oath to live and die together, failing the trust Liu Bei placed in him to protect his wives, and wasting his gifts instead of helping uphold the Han. Guan Yu names three conditions: he surrenders to the Han emperor, not to Cao Cao; his sisters-in-law are to be kept on an imperial uncle's stipend and no one may come to their door; and the moment he learns where Liu Bei is, he will leave, however far. Cao Cao agrees to the first two at once — 'I am the Han's chancellor; the Han is me' — and balks at the third, until Zhang Liao persuades him that generosity will win Guan Yu's heart.

Historically: Guan Yu's biography in the Records gives it one sentence: 'Lord Cao captured Guan Yu and took him back, made him a lieutenant general and treated him with great courtesy.' The annals of Cao Cao say Cao Cao broke Liu Bei, captured his wife and children, then attacked Xiapi, and Guan Yu surrendered. The three conditions, the escort of the sisters-in-law to Xu, and Guan Yu standing outside their door with a candle until dawn are the inventions of the novel and of popular legend, there to show Guan Yu keeping faith even in Cao Cao's camp.
ch025-three-conditions.why: 'Surrender to the Han, not to Cao Cao' gave Guan Yu's stay with Cao Cao an honourable footing and is a keystone of the novel's portrait of his loyalty.
ch025-three-conditions.why_zh: “降汉不降曹”为关羽暂居曹营定下名分，是小说塑造他忠义形象的关键一笔。

quote.zh: 吾为汉相，汉即吾也
quote.en: I am chancellor of the Han; the Han is me.

story_zh: 颜良被杀，河北名将文丑说“颜良与我如兄弟”，请命为他报仇，刘备也领后军随行。曹操在延津把粮草辎重和马匹丢在路旁诱敌，文丑军果然争相抢夺，阵势大乱，曹军趁势掩杀。文丑回马力战，一箭射中张辽盔上的簪缨，再一箭射中他的马面；徐晃抡斧来战，也被文丑的人马逼退。
正在此时，关羽带着十几名骑兵杀到，大喝一声拦住文丑。两人交手不到三合，文丑心怯，拨马绕河而走；关羽的赤兔马快，从后面赶上，一刀把他斩于马下。曹军乘势大破袁军。刘备在河对岸望见一面大旗，上写“汉寿亭侯关云长”，才知二弟就在曹营，暗暗感谢上天。袁绍闻讯又要斩刘备，刘备答应写信招关羽前来，才得脱身。
史实：据《三国志·武帝纪》，袁绍渡河追击，曹操在延津南坂下扎营，命骑兵解鞍放马，又把从白马撤出的辎重摆在路上作饵。文丑与刘备率五六千骑先后赶到，有人分兵去抢辎重，曹操这才下令上马，以不足六百骑突击，大破袁军，斩了文丑。史书没说是谁斩的，也没提关羽；颜良、文丑如兄弟也是小说的说法。倒是刘备当时确实与文丑同行。
story: With Yan Liang dead, the northern champion Wen Chou, saying 'Yan Liang was like a brother to me', asks to avenge him, and Liu Bei goes along with the rear guard. At Yanjin Cao Cao leaves grain, baggage and horses by the road as bait; Wen Chou's men scramble for them and lose all order, and Cao Cao's troops fall on them. Wen Chou turns and fights hard: one arrow strikes the tassel on Zhang Liao's helmet, another hits his horse in the face, and Xu Huang, swinging his axe, is forced back by Wen Chou's men.

Then Guan Yu arrives with a dozen horsemen and bars Wen Chou's way with a shout. Before three bouts are over Wen Chou loses heart and turns to ride off along the river; Red Hare is faster, and Guan Yu catches him and cuts him down from behind. Cao Cao's army routs Yuan Shao's. From the far bank Liu Bei sees a great banner reading 'Guan Yunchang, Marquis of Hanshou', learns that his brother is in Cao Cao's camp, and secretly thanks heaven. Yuan Shao again wants him executed, and Liu Bei escapes only by promising to write and call Guan Yu over.

Historically: according to the annals of Cao Cao, Yuan Shao crossed the river in pursuit and Cao Cao camped below the southern slope at Yanjin, had his cavalry unsaddle and let their horses loose, and left the baggage withdrawn from Baima on the road as bait. Wen Chou and Liu Bei came up with five or six thousand horse; when some split off to grab the baggage, Cao Cao gave the order to mount and, with fewer than six hundred horsemen, routed them and killed Wen Chou. The Records does not say who killed him and does not mention Guan Yu; the brotherhood of Yan Liang and Wen Chou is also the novel's. Liu Bei, though, really was riding with Wen Chou.
ch026-wen-chou.why: Giving Wen Chou's death to Guan Yu too makes 'Yan Liang and Wen Chou' a double repayment of his debt to Cao Cao, one of the novel's chief additions to his legend.
ch026-wen-chou.why_zh: 把斩文丑也归于关羽，让“斩颜良、诛文丑”成了他报答曹操的双重功劳，是小说为关羽增色的重要一笔。

people.name: Guan Yu
people.role: kills Wen Chou in the novel

story_zh: 斩了颜良、文丑，关羽觉得已报答了曹操。身在袁营的刘备派陈震暗中送来书信，关羽得知兄长下落，立即决意北去。曹操料到他要走，在府门挂起回避牌，关羽几次登门都见不到人，去找张辽，张辽也推病不出。关羽便写下告辞书信，把曹操所赐金银一一封存，将汉寿亭侯印悬在堂上，只带原来的随从，护送二位嫂嫂的车仗出了北门。
曹操读罢书信，蔡阳请求带兵追赶，曹操说：关羽不忘故主，来去明白，真是大丈夫，你们都该效法。程昱劝他除掉后患，曹操说既已答应过他，不能失信。随后曹操亲自赶到灞陵桥送行，赠他一盘黄金，关羽辞而不受；又赠一领锦袍，关羽怕有变故，不肯下马，用刀尖挑起锦袍披在身上，道谢之后拍马而去。
《三国志·关羽传》记载，曹操看出关羽无久留之意，让张辽去探问。关羽说：我深知曹公待我厚，但我受刘将军厚恩，誓同生死，终究不能留下，要立功报答曹公之后再走。斩颜良后，关羽“尽封其所赐，拜书告辞”，曹操左右要追，曹操说：“彼各为其主，勿追也。”裴松之赞叹，若非有王霸之度，曹操做不到这一步。
story: With Yan Liang and Wen Chou dead, Guan Yu feels his debt to Cao Cao is paid. Liu Bei, in Yuan Shao's camp, sends Chen Zhen with a secret letter, and as soon as Guan Yu knows where his brother is, he resolves to go. Cao Cao, guessing as much, hangs a 'no visitors' board at his gate; Guan Yu calls several times in vain, and Zhang Liao too pleads illness. So Guan Yu writes a letter of farewell, seals up every piece of gold and silver Cao Cao has given him, hangs his seal as Marquis of Hanshou in the hall, and with only his original followers escorts his sisters-in-law's carriage out of the north gate.

Cao Cao reads the letter. Cai Yang asks to give chase, and Cao Cao says: he has not forgotten his old lord, he comes and goes in the open — a true man; you should all follow his example. When Cheng Yu warns that he will be trouble later, Cao Cao answers that he gave his word and will not break it. Then he rides out himself to Baling Bridge to see Guan Yu off and offers him a plate of gold, which Guan Yu declines; offered a brocade robe, Guan Yu, wary of a trap, will not dismount, but lifts it on the tip of his blade, throws it over his shoulders, thanks Cao Cao and rides away.

Guan Yu's biography in the Records says Cao Cao saw that Guan Yu had no mind to stay and had Zhang Liao sound him out. Guan Yu replied that he knew how well Cao Cao treated him, but he had received great kindness from General Liu and sworn to die with him; he would not stay, but would repay Cao Cao with a great deed before leaving. After killing Yan Liang he 'sealed up everything he had been given, wrote a letter of farewell' and left. When Cao Cao's attendants wanted to pursue, Cao Cao said, 'Each serves his own master; do not pursue.' Pei Songzhi remarks that only a man with the breadth of a true ruler could have done that.
ch026-seals-the-gifts.why: Sealing the gifts and leaving became a double model of honour: Guan Yu's loyalty to his old lord and Cao Cao's magnanimity in letting him go.
ch026-seals-the-gifts.why_zh: 挂印封金成为忠义与气度的双重典范：关羽不忘旧主，曹操成人之美。

quote.zh: 不忘故主，来去明白，真丈夫也
quote.en: He does not forget his old lord, and he comes and goes in the open: a true man.

story_zh: 关羽护送二位嫂嫂的车仗北上，因没有曹操的通关文凭，一路处处受阻。东岭关守将孔秀要扣下车仗作人质，被关羽一刀斩杀。到了洛阳，太守韩福与牙将孟坦设计：孟坦诈败诱敌，反被赤兔马追上，斩为两段；韩福在门旁放冷箭，射中关羽左臂，关羽用牙咬出箭头，血流不止，仍冲上去把韩福劈死。
汜水关卞喜在镇国寺埋伏刀斧手，寺中老僧普净是关羽同乡，以戒刀示警，关羽斩了卞喜。荥阳太守王植是韩福的亲家，想夜里放火烧死关羽，奉命的胡班偷看关羽灯下读书，惊叹“真天人也”，又因关羽带来了父亲胡华的书信，便来报信。关羽连夜出城，斩了追来的王植。黄河渡口的秦琪不肯给船，也被斩杀。刚过黄河，孙乾赶来说刘备已去汝南，关羽只得掉头南下。
史实：《三国志·关羽传》只说关羽封存赏赐、拜书告辞，投奔袁军中的刘备，没有沿途厮杀，孔秀、韩福、孟坦、卞喜、王植、秦琪六人都不见于史书。据《先主传》，当时袁绍已派刘备到汝南联合刘辟袭扰许都以南，紧接着就写“关羽亡归先主”，根本用不着绕道洛阳。元杂剧已有《关云长千里独行》，小说在说唱和戏曲的基础上铺陈成这段传奇。
story: Escorting his sisters-in-law's carriage north without a pass from Cao Cao, Guan Yu is stopped at every turn. At Dongling Pass the commander Kong Xiu demands the carriage as a hostage and dies at a single stroke. At Luoyang the governor Han Fu and his officer Meng Tan lay a trap: Meng Tan feigns flight to draw Guan Yu on, but Red Hare overtakes him and Guan Yu cuts him in two; Han Fu, shooting from beside the gate, hits Guan Yu in the left arm, and Guan Yu pulls the arrow out with his teeth and, bleeding, rides at Han Fu and cuts him down.

At Sishui Pass Bian Xi hides axemen in the Zhenguo Temple, but the old monk Pu Jing, from Guan Yu's home district, warns him with a gesture at his own knife, and Guan Yu kills Bian Xi. Wang Zhi, governor of Xingyang and Han Fu's kinsman by marriage, plans to burn Guan Yu in his lodging; the officer Hu Ban, sent to do it, peeps in at Guan Yu reading by lamplight and gasps 'Truly a man from heaven!' — and since Guan Yu has brought a letter from his father Hu Hua, he warns him. Guan Yu escapes and kills Wang Zhi in pursuit. At the Yellow River ford Qin Qi refuses him boats and dies too. Across the river Sun Qian brings word that Liu Bei has gone to Runan, and Guan Yu has to turn south again.

Historically: Guan Yu's biography in the Records says only that he sealed up his gifts, wrote his farewell and went to Liu Bei in Yuan Shao's army; there is no fighting on the way, and none of the six — Kong Xiu, Han Fu, Meng Tan, Bian Xi, Wang Zhi, Qin Qi — appears in the histories. Liu Bei's biography says Yuan Shao had sent Liu Bei to Runan to join Liu Pi in raiding the country south of Xu, and right after that says 'Guan Yu escaped and returned to him', so there was no reason to go anywhere near Luoyang. A Yuan-dynasty play was already titled 'Guan Yunchang Rides a Thousand Li Alone'; the novel built the episode out of storytelling and stage traditions.
ch027-five-passes.why: Crossing five passes and killing six generals is the high point of Guan Yu's legend of loyalty and has become a household idiom.
ch027-five-passes.why_zh: 过五关斩六将是关羽忠义形象的巅峰，也成了家喻户晓的成语。

quote.zh: 马骑赤兔行千里，刀偃青龙出五关
quote.en: On Red Hare he rode a thousand li; with Green Dragon lowered he passed five gates.

people.name: Han Fu
people.role: governor of Luoyang, wounds Guan Yu

people.name: Hu Ban
people.role: officer who saves him at Xingyang

story_zh: 徐州兵败后，张飞流落芒砀山，后来夺了古城，招兵买马。关羽护送二嫂来到古城，先让孙乾进城通报。张飞听了一言不发，披挂提矛，领兵出城，见了关羽挺矛便刺，骂他背了兄长、降了曹操、封侯受爵，如今又来哄骗自己。关羽连连闪避，二位嫂嫂出面解释，张飞仍然不信。
正争执间，远处尘头大起，曹将蔡阳领兵追来，要为外甥秦琪报仇。张飞更认定关羽带兵来捉他，说：你若真心，我擂三通鼓，你须斩了来将。关羽拍马迎上，张飞亲自擂鼓，头一通鼓还没擂完，蔡阳的人头已经落地。捉来的旗手供出蔡阳的来意，张飞这才相信，流泪向关羽下拜。不久刘备从袁绍处脱身，赵云、关平、周仓等人也先后来投，众人在古城聚义。
史实：据《三国志·先主传》，袁绍派刘备到汝南，与龚都等人合兵数千，曹操派蔡阳来攻，蔡阳被刘备所杀，与关羽无关。张飞据守古城、猜疑关羽的情节也不见于史书。至于赵云，裴注引《云别传》说他早在刘备投靠袁绍时就在邺城与刘备重逢，暗中替他招募了数百人，随后跟着刘备南下。
story: Scattered at Xuzhou, Zhang Fei has wandered to the Mang-Dang hills and then seized the town of Gucheng and raised troops. When Guan Yu arrives with the two ladies he sends Sun Qian in to announce him. Zhang Fei says nothing, arms himself, rides out and thrusts his spear straight at Guan Yu, shouting that he has betrayed their brother, surrendered to Cao Cao and taken a title, and now comes to trick him. Guan Yu dodges; even the ladies' explanations do not convince him.

Just then dust rises in the distance: Cao Cao's general Cai Yang is coming in pursuit to avenge his nephew Qin Qi. Now Zhang Fei is sure Guan Yu has brought soldiers to seize him: if you are true, he says, kill their commander by the time I have beaten three rolls on the drum. Guan Yu rides out; Zhang Fei beats the drum himself, and before the first roll is finished Cai Yang's head is on the ground. A captured standard-bearer confirms why Cai Yang came, and Zhang Fei, in tears, kneels to Guan Yu. Soon Liu Bei slips away from Yuan Shao, Zhao Yun, Guan Ping and Zhou Cang join them, and all are reunited at Gucheng.

Historically: according to Liu Bei's biography in the Records, Yuan Shao sent Liu Bei to Runan, where he joined Gong Du and others with several thousand men; Cao Cao sent Cai Yang against them and Liu Bei killed him. Guan Yu had nothing to do with it, and Zhang Fei holding Gucheng and doubting Guan Yu is not in the histories either. As for Zhao Yun, the Zhao Yun biezhuan quoted by Pei Songzhi says he had already rejoined Liu Bei at Ye while Liu Bei was with Yuan Shao, secretly raised several hundred men for him, and followed him south.
ch028-cai-yang.why: The reunion at Gucheng brings the scattered brothers back together and lets Liu Bei's band regroup.
ch028-cai-yang.why_zh: 古城相会让离散的刘、关、张重新聚首，刘备集团也在此重整旗鼓。

people.name: Guan Yu
people.role: proves himself by killing Cai Yang

story_zh: 吴郡太守许贡暗中上书曹操，说孙策骁勇与项羽相似，应召到京城加以羁縻，书信被截获，孙策将他绞杀。许贡的三个门客立誓报仇，趁孙策在丹徒西山打猎时设伏，一箭射中他的面颊。孙策伤重，医生嘱咐须静养百日，切不可动怒。偏偏这时传来曹操谋士郭嘉的话，讥讽他轻而无备，日后必死于小人之手，孙策怒不可遏。
一日孙策与诸将在城楼饮宴，众将纷纷下楼拜见路过的道士于吉。孙策见他深得人心，斥为妖人，下令拿下。母亲吴太夫人和张昭等官员都来求情，孙策便叫于吉祈雨：午时前降雨就放人，否则烧死。到了午时，果然雷雨大作，孙策仍将于吉斩首。此后于吉的阴魂屡屡出现，孙策在镜中又见到他的身影，大叫一声，伤口迸裂而死，年仅二十六岁。
史实：《三国志·孙策传》记载，建安五年孙策暗中准备袭击许都，尚未出兵，就在单骑外出时被许贡门客刺伤，当夜身亡。郭嘉确曾预言孙策轻而无备，必死于刺客之手。斩于吉一事出自裴注所引《江表传》和《搜神记》，裴注又引虞喜《志林》指出《江表传》年代不合。按《后汉书》，顺帝时已有人献上于吉所得的神书，若是同一人，到孙策时年纪应已极高。
story: Xu Gong, governor of Wu, writes secretly to Cao Cao that Sun Ce is as fierce as Xiang Yu and should be called to the capital where he can be kept in check; the letter is intercepted and Sun Ce has him strangled. Three of Xu Gong's retainers swear revenge and ambush Sun Ce while he hunts in the western hills at Dantu, hitting him in the cheek with an arrow. Badly wounded, he is told to rest for a hundred days and above all not to lose his temper. Then he hears that Cao Cao's adviser Guo Jia has called him rash and careless, a man bound to die at the hands of nobodies, and he is beside himself.

One day, feasting with his officers on a city tower, Sun Ce sees them hurry down to bow to a passing Taoist, Yu Ji. Angry at the man's hold over them, he calls him a sorcerer and has him seized. His mother, Lady Wu, and Zhang Zhao and other officials plead for him, so Sun Ce sets a test: let him bring rain by noon and go free, or be burned. At noon thunder rolls and rain pours down, yet Sun Ce has him beheaded all the same. Yu Ji's ghost returns again and again; when Sun Ce sees him in a mirror he gives a great cry, his wound bursts open, and he dies, only twenty-six.

Historically: Sun Ce's biography in the Records says that in 200 he was secretly preparing to strike at Xu, but before he could march he was wounded by Xu Gong's retainers while out riding alone, and died that night. Guo Jia really had predicted that Sun Ce, rash and unguarded, would die at an assassin's hand. Yu Ji's execution comes from the Jiangbiao zhuan and the Soushen ji quoted by Pei Songzhi, who also cites Yu Xi's Zhilin to show that the Jiangbiao zhuan's dates do not fit. The Book of the Later Han mentions a sacred book found by a Yu Ji being presented to the throne as early as the reign of Emperor Shun; if it was the same man, he would have been extremely old by Sun Ce's day.
ch029-sun-ce-dies.why: Sun Ce's early death passed Jiangdong to Sun Quan, and the novel uses the Yu Ji story to give the Little Conqueror's end the shape of retribution.
ch029-sun-ce-dies.why_zh: 孙策英年早逝，江东大业转入孙权手中，小说借于吉的故事给“小霸王”的结局添上了因果报应的色彩。

story_zh: 孙策自知伤重不起，召张昭等人到床前，说中原正乱，凭吴越之众、三江之固，大可有所作为，嘱托他们好好辅佐弟弟。随后把印绶交给孙权，说：率江东之众在两军阵前决机、与天下争衡，你不如我；举贤任能、使人各尽其力以保江东，我不如你。又安慰担心孙权年幼的母亲：内事不决可问张昭，外事不决可问周瑜，只恨周瑜不在身边，不能当面嘱托。当夜孙策去世。
孙权哭个不停，张昭劝他：现在不是哭的时候，应先料理军国大事。孙权这才收泪，出来安抚军心。周瑜从巴丘领兵赶回奔丧，表示愿效犬马之劳，又向孙权举荐了鲁肃。鲁肃与孙权同榻夜谈，提出汉室不可复兴、曹操不可骤除，应当鼎足江东、以观天下之变。孙权礼贤下士，江东人心渐渐安定。
《三国志·孙策传》记有孙策这段临终嘱托，原话与小说几乎一样。据《三国志》，张昭见孙权悲痛不已，劝他以大事为重，亲自扶他上马巡视军队。当时孙氏只有会稽、吴郡、丹杨、豫章、庐陵几郡，偏远山区尚未归附，全靠张昭、周瑜等人倾心辅佐。鲁肃这番“榻上策”见于《鲁肃传》，比诸葛亮的隆中对还早几年。
story: Knowing he will not recover, Sun Ce calls Zhang Zhao and the others to his bed: with the men of Wu and Yue and the barrier of the three rivers there is much to be done while the north is in chaos, so look after my brother. Then he hands Sun Quan his seal: at leading the host of Jiangdong to a decision between two armies and contending with the world, you are not my equal; at raising the worthy and using the able, so that every man gives his best to keep Jiangdong safe, I am not yours. To his mother, who fears Sun Quan is too young, he says that for affairs at home Sun Quan can ask Zhang Zhao and for affairs abroad Zhou Yu, and regrets that Zhou Yu is not there to hear it from him. That night he dies.

Sun Quan cannot stop weeping until Zhang Zhao tells him this is no time for tears; there is an army and a state to see to. Sun Quan dries his eyes and goes out to steady the troops. Zhou Yu hurries back from Baqiu with his army, pledges his service, and recommends Lu Su. Talking with Sun Quan late into the night on a shared couch, Lu Su lays out his plan: the Han cannot be restored and Cao Cao cannot be removed quickly, so Sun Quan should make Jiangdong one leg of a tripod and wait for the world to change. Sun Quan treats able men with courtesy, and Jiangdong settles down.

Sun Ce's dying words to his brother are in his biography in the Records, almost exactly as the novel has them. According to the Records, Zhang Zhao, finding Sun Quan lost in grief, told him to put the great affairs first and helped him onto his horse himself to review the troops. At the time the Suns held only Kuaiji, Wu, Danyang, Yuzhang and Luling, with the remote hill country still unsubdued; everything depended on Zhang Zhao, Zhou Yu and others giving him their loyalty. Lu Su's 'plan from the couch' is in his biography, several years before Zhuge Liang's Longzhong plan.
ch029-sun-quan-succeeds.why: Sun Quan's smooth succession, backed by Zhang Zhao, Zhou Yu and Lu Su, kept the Jiangdong regime alive and gave Wu its shape.
ch029-sun-quan-succeeds.why_zh: 孙权顺利接班，又得到张昭、周瑜、鲁肃辅佐，江东政权得以延续，三国中的东吴由此成形。

quote.zh: 内事不决，可问张昭；外事不决，可问周瑜
quote.en: If affairs at home perplex you, ask Zhang Zhao; if affairs abroad perplex you, ask Zhou Yu.

story_zh: 袁绍灭了公孙瓒，据有河北四州，大举南下。田丰在狱中上书劝他不可轻进，袁绍大怒，说等破了曹操再治他的罪；沮授劝他持久消耗，也被关押起来。两军在官渡对峙。袁军堆起土山，在高处架设弩手往曹营射箭，曹兵只得顶盾而行。曹操采纳刘晔之计造发石车，把土山上的箭楼砸毁，袁军称之为“霹雳车”。袁绍又挖地道偷袭，曹操便绕营掘出长沟，地道白挖。
相持日久，曹军粮草将尽，士卒疲乏，曹操写信给留守许都的荀彧，商量是否退兵。荀彧回信说：袁绍倾巢而出，要与明公决一胜负，明公以至弱当至强，若不能制服对方，必被对方所乘，这正是天下大势所系的关头，务必坚持，等待出奇制胜的时机。曹操于是坚守不退。不久徐晃截烧了袁军的运粮车，接着许攸来投，局面一夕逆转。
据《三国志》记载，建安五年袁绍挑选精兵十万、战马万匹进攻许都，土山、箭楼、地道和霹雳车的攻防都与小说所写相合，荀彧劝曹操坚守的书信也保存在《荀彧传》里。《武帝纪》说曹军“兵不满万，伤者十二三”，裴松之已怀疑这个数字偏小。官渡一战之后，袁氏一蹶不振，北方归于曹操。
story: Having destroyed Gongsun Zan and taken the four provinces north of the Yellow River, Yuan Shao marches south in force. From prison Tian Feng writes urging him not to advance rashly; Yuan Shao says he will deal with him once Cao Cao is beaten, and Ju Shou, who advises a long war of attrition, is locked up too. The armies face each other at Guandu. Yuan Shao's men pile up earth mounds and shoot down into Cao Cao's camp, so that his soldiers can move only under shields; on Liu Ye's advice Cao Cao builds stone-throwers that smash the archers' towers, and Yuan's men call them 'thunderbolt carts'. Yuan Shao tries tunnels; Cao Cao digs a long trench round his camp, and the tunnels come to nothing.

The standoff drags on. Cao Cao's grain runs low and his men are worn out, and he writes to Xun Yu, holding Xudu, asking whether to withdraw. Xun Yu replies that Yuan Shao has thrown everything into this to settle it with him; Cao Cao, the weakest, is facing the strongest, and if he cannot master him he will be swallowed. The fate of the empire turns on this moment: hold on, and wait for the chance to strike by surprise. Cao Cao holds. Soon Xu Huang ambushes and burns a Yuan grain convoy, then Xu You comes over, and everything turns overnight.

According to the Records, in 200 Yuan Shao picked a hundred thousand of his best foot and ten thousand horse to attack Xu, and the fighting over mounds, towers, tunnels and thunderbolt carts matches what the novel describes; Xun Yu's letter urging Cao Cao to hold is preserved in his biography. The annals of Cao Cao say his army numbered 'fewer than ten thousand, of whom two or three in ten were wounded', a figure Pei Songzhi already thought too small. After Guandu the Yuans never recovered, and the north passed to Cao Cao.
ch030-guandu.why: Guandu, won by the weaker side, decided who would hold the north and was the turning point in Cao Cao's unification of it.
ch030-guandu.why_zh: 官渡之战以少胜多，决定了北方的归属，是曹操统一北方的转折点。

story_zh: 袁绍谋士许攸截获曹操向许都催粮的信使，劝袁绍分兵偷袭许都，袁绍不听。恰好审配来信，说许攸在冀州时纵容子侄贪污，已将他们下狱，袁绍便当众斥退许攸。许攸羞愤欲死，被左右劝住，连夜投奔老友曹操。曹操正要歇息，闻讯光着脚跑出去迎接。许攸问军粮还剩多少，曹操先说一年，又说半年、三个月，最后才承认只够一个月，许攸笑着拆穿：粮早已吃完了。
许攸献计：袁军粮草都囤在乌巢，守将淳于琼嗜酒无备，若轻兵夜袭，不出三日袁军必乱。曹操亲选五千步骑，打着袁军旗号，人衔枚、马勒口，冒称奉命去乌巢护粮，骗过沿途哨卡，到乌巢后四面放火。淳于琼醉卧被擒，被割去耳鼻放回袁营。袁绍听信郭图，派张郃、高览去攻曹营而不全力救粮，二将兵败后投降曹操，袁军全线崩溃，袁绍只带少数骑兵渡河逃回。
《三国志·武帝纪》记载，许攸贪财，袁绍不能满足，便来投曹，劝曹操袭击淳于琼。曹操留曹洪守营，亲率步骑五千夜行，天亮时赶到，大破淳于琼并将其斩首。光脚出迎、追问存粮、冒用袁军旗号等细节，见于裴注引《曹瞒传》。曹操从缴获的文书中查出许都和军中有人私通袁绍，下令一概烧掉，事见裴注引《魏氏春秋》，小说也照写了。
story: Yuan Shao's adviser Xu You intercepts a messenger carrying Cao Cao's urgent request for grain from Xudu and urges Yuan Shao to send a force to raid Xudu; Yuan Shao refuses. Just then a letter arrives from Shen Pei saying Xu You's sons and nephews have been jailed for corruption, and Yuan Shao dismisses him in front of everyone. Xu You, ashamed, is talked out of killing himself and slips away by night to his old friend Cao Cao. Cao Cao, about to undress for bed, runs out barefoot to greet him. Asked how much grain he has, Cao Cao says a year, then half a year, then three months, and at last admits one month; Xu You laughs: your grain is already gone.

Xu You tells him that Yuan Shao's grain is all stored at Wuchao under Chunyu Qiong, a drunkard who keeps no guard; strike it by night with light troops and Yuan Shao's army will fall apart within three days. Cao Cao picks five thousand foot and horse, flies Yuan banners, gags men and horses, and, claiming orders to reinforce Wuchao, bluffs his way past the outposts and sets the depot ablaze on every side. Chunyu Qiong is taken in a drunken sleep, his ears and nose are cut off, and he is sent back to Yuan Shao. Listening to Guo Tu, Yuan Shao sends Zhang He and Gao Lan to attack Cao Cao's camp instead of saving the grain; they fail and go over to Cao Cao, Yuan Shao's army collapses, and he flees across the river with a few horsemen.

The annals of Cao Cao in the Records say that Xu You, greedy and never satisfied by Yuan Shao, came over and urged Cao Cao to attack Chunyu Qiong. Leaving Cao Hong to hold the camp, Cao Cao led five thousand foot and horse by night, arrived at dawn, crushed Chunyu Qiong and beheaded him. The barefoot welcome, the haggling over grain and the borrowed banners come from the Cao Man zhuan quoted by Pei Songzhi. Among the captured papers Cao Cao found letters to Yuan Shao from people in Xu and in his own army and had them all burned, a story from the Weishi chunqiu that the novel retells.
ch030-wuchao.why: The fire at Wuchao destroyed the lifeline of Yuan Shao's army and decided the battle of Guandu.
ch030-wuchao.why_zh: 乌巢一把火烧断了袁军的命脉，官渡之战由此分出胜负。

quote.zh: 当绍之强，孤亦不能自保，况他人乎
quote.en: When Yuan Shao was at his strongest, even I could not be sure of my own safety; how much less anyone else?

people.name: Yuan Shao
people.role: loses his grain and his army

story_zh: 官渡、仓亭两战之后，袁绍忧愤成疾，吐血而死。他生前偏爱幼子袁尚，审配、逢纪拥立袁尚继位，长子袁谭不服，兄弟反目。曹操听从郭嘉的意见暂且退兵，任由二袁自相残杀。袁谭被袁尚围攻，竟派辛毗向曹操求救，曹操趁机北上，包围了袁尚的根本邺城，审配据城坚守。
邺城久攻不下，许攸献计决漳河之水淹城。曹操命人绕城挖掘壕沟，长四十里，起初挖得很浅，审配在城上望见，笑曹军无能。不料曹操一夜之间把壕沟挖到深宽二丈，引漳河水灌城。城中断粮，饿死大半。袁尚回兵救援被击败，审配的侄子审荣夜开城门，曹军入城。审配被擒，宁死不降，面向北方受刑。曹操亲到袁绍墓前祭奠，痛哭流涕。
据《三国志》，建安九年（204年）曹操趁袁尚出兵攻打袁谭，进围邺城，掘堑围城，引漳水灌之，从五月到八月，城中饿死过半。审荣夜开东门放曹军入城，审配被擒斩首。曹操祭奠袁绍墓，慰劳袁家家属，随后兼领冀州牧，以邺城为大本营，后来他的魏国也定都于此。史书并没有说灌城之计出自许攸。
story: After his defeats at Guandu and Cangting, Yuan Shao falls ill with grief and rage and dies vomiting blood. He had favoured his youngest son Yuan Shang, and Shen Pei and Pang Ji put Yuan Shang in his place; the eldest, Yuan Tan, will not accept it, and the brothers turn on each other. On Guo Jia's advice Cao Cao pulls back and lets them fight. When Yuan Shang besieges Yuan Tan, Yuan Tan actually sends Xin Pi to ask Cao Cao for help, and Cao Cao seizes the chance to march north and surround Ye, Yuan Shang's base, held by Shen Pei.

Ye holds out until Xu You proposes flooding it from the Zhang River. Cao Cao has a trench forty li long dug round the city, but only shallow at first; Shen Pei looks down from the walls and laughs at it. Then in a single night Cao Cao's men dig it two zhang deep and wide and turn the Zhang into it. Ye runs out of food and more than half its people starve. Yuan Shang's relief army is beaten, Shen Pei's nephew Shen Rong opens a gate by night, and Cao Cao's men pour in. Captured, Shen Pei refuses to surrender and dies facing north. Cao Cao goes to Yuan Shao's grave and weeps.

According to the Records, in 204 Cao Cao took advantage of Yuan Shang's absence attacking Yuan Tan to besiege Ye, dug a trench round it and turned the Zhang River in; from the fifth month to the eighth, half the city starved. Shen Rong opened the east gate by night, and Shen Pei was captured and beheaded. Cao Cao sacrificed at Yuan Shao's tomb and comforted his family, then took the governorship of Ji province and made Ye his headquarters, later the capital of his state of Wei. The histories do not credit Xu You with the flooding plan.
ch032-ye-taken.why: Taking Ye gave Cao Cao the heartland of the north, and Ye became the political centre of his Wei.
ch032-ye-taken.why_zh: 攻取邺城使曹操夺得河北根本之地，邺城从此成为曹魏的政治中心。

people.name: Xu You
people.role: proposes the flood in the novel

story_zh: 袁谭兵败被杀，袁尚、袁熙逃往塞外投奔乌桓。曹操决意北征，众将担心刘表、刘备乘虚袭击许都，郭嘉却力主远征。大军辎重多，行进迟缓，郭嘉说“兵贵神速”，劝曹操丢下辎重，轻兵兼程，出其不意。郭嘉因水土不服病倒，留在易州养病。曹操请熟悉地形的田畴带路，从卢龙塞故道出塞，一路荒凉。
在白狼山，曹军与袁熙、袁尚和乌桓首领蹋顿的骑兵遭遇。曹操登高望见敌军阵势不整，下令进攻，张辽奋勇冲杀，斩了蹋顿，乌桓大败，二袁又逃往辽东投奔公孙康。回师时天寒地旱，杀马为粮，掘地数十丈才见水。到易州时郭嘉已病逝，年仅三十八岁，曹操放声痛哭。郭嘉留下遗书，劝他不必进兵辽东。曹操按兵不动，不久公孙康果然送来了二袁的首级。
《三国志·武帝纪》记载，建安十二年曹操出卢龙塞，以张辽为先锋，在白狼山斩了蹋顿。《郭嘉传》记下了“兵贵神速”的建议，并说郭嘉从柳城回师途中病重去世。不过不打辽东、坐等公孙康斩送二袁首级的判断，在《武帝纪》里出自曹操本人之口：公孙康一向畏惧袁尚兄弟，逼得急了他们会联手，放缓了就会自相图谋。
story: Yuan Tan is killed, and Yuan Shang and Yuan Xi flee beyond the frontier to the Wuhuan. Cao Cao resolves to go after them; his generals fear Liu Biao and Liu Bei will strike Xu while he is away, but Guo Jia argues for the expedition. When the army, weighed down with baggage, moves too slowly, Guo Jia tells Cao Cao that in war speed is everything: leave the baggage, go light and fast, and take the enemy unawares. Guo Jia himself falls sick from the climate and stays behind at Yizhou. Guided by Tian Chou, who knows the country, Cao Cao leaves the frontier by the old road through Lulong, across a desolate land.

At White Wolf Mountain Cao Cao meets the Yuan brothers and the Wuhuan chief Tadun with their horsemen. From high ground he sees their ranks in disorder and orders the attack; Zhang Liao charges in and kills Tadun, the Wuhuan are crushed, and the Yuan brothers flee again, to Gongsun Kang in Liaodong. On the way back the land is cold and dry; the army kills horses for food and digs dozens of zhang down for water. At Yizhou Cao Cao finds Guo Jia already dead, at thirty-eight, and weeps aloud. Guo Jia has left a letter urging him not to attack Liaodong. Cao Cao waits, and before long Gongsun Kang sends him the heads of Yuan Shang and Yuan Xi.

The annals of Cao Cao in the Records say that in 207 he went out through the Lulong pass with Zhang Liao as vanguard and killed Tadun at White Wolf Mountain. Guo Jia's biography records his 'speed is everything' advice, and says he fell gravely ill on the way back from Liucheng and died. But the reasoning about leaving Liaodong alone and waiting for Gongsun Kang to send the heads is, in the annals, Cao Cao's own: Gongsun Kang had long feared the Yuan brothers, and if pressed they would unite, but if left alone they would turn on each other.
ch033-white-wolf-mountain.why: The Wuhuan campaign wiped out the last of the Yuans and completed Cao Cao's conquest of the north, at the cost of his most trusted strategist.
ch033-white-wolf-mountain.why_zh: 北征乌桓扫清了袁氏残余，曹操至此平定北方，却也痛失了最得力的谋士郭嘉。

quote.zh: 兵贵神速
quote.en: In war, speed is what counts.

story_zh: 刘备投靠刘表，屯驻新野。一次陪刘表饮酒，他起身如厕，见自己大腿上长满了肉，想到久不骑马、功业未成，不禁落泪。刘表问起立嗣之事，刘备劝他不要废长立幼，被屏风后的蔡夫人听了去。此前刘备得了的卢马，伊籍曾提醒他此马眼下有泪槽、额边生白点，骑了会妨害主人，刘备却说生死有命，岂是一匹马能妨的。
蔡夫人与弟弟蔡瑁设计害刘备。刘表病中请刘备代为主持襄阳之会，蔡瑁在东、南、北三门布下伏兵，只因西门外有檀溪阻隔，没有派人把守。席间伊籍示意刘备借口更衣，告诉他有埋伏。刘备上马独自冲出西门，奔到檀溪边，马陷入水中。他加鞭大叫：“的卢，的卢！今日妨吾！”的卢猛然从水中跃起，一跃三丈，飞上西岸。蔡瑁追到溪边，只能望着他远去。
史实：此事出自裴注引《世语》：刘备屯驻樊城时，刘表请他赴宴，蒯越、蔡瑁想借机除掉他，刘备察觉，假装如厕溜走；的卢马陷入襄阳城西的檀溪，刘备急呼“的卢，今日厄矣，可努力”，马一跃三丈过溪。孙盛认为刘备寄人篱下，若真有此变，岂能在刘表在世时一直相安无事，斥为世俗妄说。“髀肉复生”之叹倒是见于裴注引《九州春秋》。
story: Liu Bei is now a guest of Liu Biao, stationed at Xinye. Once, drinking with Liu Biao, he goes to the privy and sees how fat his thighs have grown; thinking of the years out of the saddle with nothing achieved, he weeps. When Liu Biao asks his advice on the succession, Liu Bei warns him against passing over the elder son for the younger, and Lady Cai hears it all from behind a screen. Earlier, when Liu Bei acquired the horse Dilu, Yi Ji had warned him that its tear-trough under the eye and white blaze meant it would bring its rider to ruin; Liu Bei answered that life and death are fated, and no horse can decide them.

Lady Cai and her brother Cai Mao plot to kill him. Liu Biao, ill, asks Liu Bei to host the gathering at Xiangyang in his place. Cai Mao posts men at the east, south and north gates, leaving the west unguarded because the Tan Stream bars the way. During the feast Yi Ji signals Liu Bei to step out and tells him of the ambush. Liu Bei mounts and gallops out of the west gate alone, down to the Tan Stream, where Dilu sinks into the water. Lashing it, he cries: 'Dilu, Dilu! Today you will be my ruin!' The horse surges up out of the water and in one leap of three zhang lands on the far bank. Cai Mao, reaching the stream, can only watch him go.

Historically: the story comes from the Shiyu quoted by Pei Songzhi. When Liu Bei was stationed at Fancheng, Liu Biao invited him to a banquet where Kuai Yue and Cai Mao meant to seize him; sensing it, he pretended to go to the privy and slipped away. Dilu floundered in the Tan Stream west of Xiangyang, Liu Bei cried, 'Dilu, today is our peril — do your best!', and the horse leapt three zhang across. Sun Sheng dismissed it as a popular fabrication: Liu Bei was only a guest, and had such a thing happened he could never have lived on peaceably under Liu Biao for the rest of Liu Biao's life. The lament over his fattened thighs, on the other hand, is in the Jiuzhou chunqiu quoted by Pei.
ch034-tan-stream.why: The leap over the Tan Stream sums up Liu Bei's precarious years as a guest in Jingzhou, and his flight leads him to Sima Hui and the first word of the Sleeping Dragon and the Young Phoenix.
ch034-tan-stream.why_zh: 马跃檀溪是刘备寄人篱下、险遭不测的写照，也引出他逃亡途中遇见司马徽、得闻“卧龙、凤雏”的奇遇。

quote.zh: 的卢，的卢！今日妨吾
quote.en: Dilu, Dilu! Today you will be my ruin!

people.name: Lady Cai
people.role: Liu Biao's wife, Cai Mao's sister

story_zh: 徐庶化名单福辅佐刘备，大破曹仁的八门金锁阵，又袭取樊城，令曹操大惊。程昱告诉曹操，单福就是颍川徐庶，此人极孝，只要把他母亲接到许都，便能把他招来。徐母到了许都，不但不肯写信，反而痛骂曹操，抓起石砚就打。程昱假称与徐庶结为兄弟，常去问候徐母，骗得她的笔迹，伪造了一封家书。
徐庶读信泪如泉涌，说出真名，向刘备辞行。孙乾劝刘备扣住徐庶，好让曹操杀了徐母，刘备不肯：害其母而用其子是不仁，扣人断其母子之道是不义。次日刘备送了一程又一程，徐庶的身影被树林遮住，他竟要把树砍光。忽见徐庶拍马回来，说心乱忘了一事：隆中有位奇士诸葛孔明，自己与他相比，好比驽马比麒麟、寒鸦比鸾凤。后来徐母得知受骗，愤而自缢。
史实：《三国志·诸葛亮传》记载，徐庶在新野向刘备推荐诸葛亮，说此人只能登门去见，不可召来，刘备这才三顾茅庐，当时徐庶并未离开。直到建安十三年曹军南下，刘备在长坂兵败，徐母被俘，徐庶才指着胸口说方寸已乱，辞别刘备投奔曹操。裴注引《魏略》说徐庶本名福，出身“单家”，即寒门，“单福”之名便由此而来；他后来在魏国官至御史中丞。
story: Under the false name Shan Fu, Xu Shu serves Liu Bei, breaks Cao Ren's 'eight gates golden lock' formation and takes Fancheng by surprise, to Cao Cao's alarm. Cheng Yu tells Cao Cao that Shan Fu is Xu Shu of Yingchuan, a devoted son: bring his mother to Xudu and he will come. Once there, Xu Shu's mother refuses to write to him, curses Cao Cao and hurls an inkstone at him. Cheng Yu, claiming to be Xu Shu's sworn brother, visits her often, collects samples of her handwriting, and forges a letter from her.

Reading it, Xu Shu weeps, tells Liu Bei his real name and asks leave to go. Sun Qian urges Liu Bei to keep him so that Cao Cao will kill the mother, and Liu Bei refuses: to have a mother killed in order to use her son is inhumane, to keep mother and son apart is unrighteous. Next day he rides with Xu Shu farther and farther, and when trees hide him from view he wants to cut them all down. Then Xu Shu gallops back: in his distress he forgot to tell him of a remarkable man at Longzhong, Zhuge Kongming, beside whom he himself is a nag beside a qilin, a winter crow beside a phoenix. In Xudu his mother, learning she has been used, hangs herself.

Historically: according to Zhuge Liang's biography in the Records, Xu Shu recommended Zhuge Liang to Liu Bei at Xinye, saying such a man must be visited and could not be summoned, which is why Liu Bei went to him three times; Xu Shu did not leave then. Only in 208, when Cao Cao marched south, Liu Bei was routed at Changban and Xu Shu's mother was captured, did he point to his heart, say it was in turmoil, and leave Liu Bei for Cao Cao. The Weilüe, cited by Pei Songzhi, says his original name was Fu and he came from a humble family (danjia), which is where the novel's 'Shan Fu' comes from; he later rose to be palace assistant censor in Wei.
ch036-xu-shu-recommends.why: Xu Shu's parting recommendation leads straight to the three visits, and to the adviser who would change Liu Bei's fortunes.
ch036-xu-shu-recommends.why_zh: 徐庶走马荐诸葛，直接引出三顾茅庐，刘备从此得到改变命运的谋士。

quote.zh: 譬犹驽马并麒麟、寒鸦配鸾凤耳
quote.en: It is like setting a nag beside a qilin, or a winter crow beside a phoenix.

story_zh: 刘备带着关羽、张飞第一次来到隆中，向童子报上“汉左将军宜城亭侯领豫州牧皇叔刘备”一长串名号，童子说记不得这许多名字，又说先生一早出门，归期不定，刘备只得怏怏而回。第二次正值隆冬，朔风凛冽，大雪纷飞，张飞抱怨天寒地冻何必去见无用之人，刘备执意前往，却只见到其弟诸葛均，只好留书而回，归途又遇孔明的岳父黄承彦骑驴过桥吟诗。
转过新春，刘备选定吉日，斋戒沐浴后第三次前往。关羽说孔明徒有虚名，张飞说一条麻绳就能把他捆来，都被刘备斥责。到了庄前，童子说先生在草堂午睡未醒，刘备不让通报，拱立阶下等候。过了许久，诸葛亮翻身朝里又睡，张飞气得要去屋后放火。又过了一个时辰，诸葛亮才醒来吟诗，随后更衣出迎，与刘备纵论天下大势。
诸葛亮在《出师表》中亲笔写道：“先帝不以臣卑鄙，猥自枉屈，三顾臣于草庐之中，咨臣以当世之事。”《三国志·诸葛亮传》也说刘备“凡三往，乃见”。裴注引《魏略》《九州春秋》另有诸葛亮先到樊城求见刘备的说法，裴松之根据《出师表》断定并非如此。至于风雪路途和阶下久候，则是小说的渲染。
story: Liu Bei rides to Longzhong with Guan Yu and Zhang Fei and announces himself to the boy at the gate with his whole string of titles — General of the Left of the Han, Marquis of Yicheng, Governor of Yuzhou, Imperial Uncle Liu Bei. The boy says he can't remember all that; anyway, the master went out early and no one knows when he will be back. The second visit is in deep winter, in a biting north wind and heavy snow. Zhang Fei grumbles at trudging through the cold to see a useless man, but Liu Bei presses on, finds only Zhuge Liang's younger brother Zhuge Jun, and leaves a letter; on the way home he meets Zhuge Liang's father-in-law Huang Chengyan crossing a bridge on a donkey, reciting a poem.

When spring comes Liu Bei picks an auspicious day, fasts and bathes, and goes a third time. Guan Yu says Kongming has more name than substance, Zhang Fei offers to bring him back tied up with a rope, and Liu Bei rebukes them both. At the cottage the boy says the master is taking a nap in the hall. Liu Bei will not let him be woken and stands with folded hands below the steps. After a long while Zhuge Liang turns over to face the wall and sleeps on; Zhang Fei wants to set fire to the back of the house. Another hour passes before Zhuge Liang wakes, reciting a poem, then changes his clothes and comes out to talk with Liu Bei about the state of the world.

Zhuge Liang wrote in his own memorial on setting out to war that 'the late emperor, not thinking me base, lowered himself to visit me three times in my thatched cottage and consulted me on the affairs of the day'. His biography in the Records likewise says Liu Bei 'went three times before he saw him'. The Weilüe and Jiuzhou chunqiu, quoted by Pei Songzhi, say instead that Zhuge Liang went to see Liu Bei first, at Fancheng; Pei, citing the memorial, rejected that. The snowy road and the long wait below the steps are the novel's colouring.
ch037-three-visits.why: The three visits won Liu Bei his great strategist and became the classic image of a ruler humbling himself to seek talent.
ch037-three-visits.why_zh: 三顾茅庐让刘备得到了诸葛亮，也成为礼贤下士的千古典范。

quote.zh: 大梦谁先觉？平生我自知。草堂春睡足，窗外日迟迟。
quote.en: Who wakes first from the great dream? I have always known myself. Spring sleep in the thatched hall is sweet; outside the window the sun moves slow.

story: On Liu Bei's third visit to Longzhong, Zhuge Liang is taking an afternoon nap in his thatched cottage. Liu Bei forbids the boy to wake him and stands waiting at the foot of the steps, while Zhang Fei threatens to set fire to the back of the house to see whether that gets him up. At last Zhuge Liang turns over, recites a verse about waking from a great dream, changes his clothes and comes out to receive his guest.

When Liu Bei begs for guidance, Zhuge Liang has a map of the fifty-four districts of Xichuan hung up. Cao Cao holds the emperor and commands the lords in his name, he says, so he cannot yet be fought; Sun Quan's family has held the east for three generations, so he can be an ally but not a target. The masters of Jingzhou and Yizhou cannot keep what they have: take Jingzhou as a home, then build a base in Xichuan, stand as the third leg of a tripod, and only then turn to the central plain. Liu Bei bows in thanks, and Zhuge Liang agrees to leave, telling his brother Zhuge Jun to tend the fields until he comes home with his work done.

The exchange comes almost directly from Zhuge Liang's biography in the Records of the Three Kingdoms and dates to 207, when Liu Bei was Liu Biao's guest, garrisoned at Xinye. The three visits are confirmed by Zhuge Liang's own memorial ('three times he called on me in my thatched hut'); a note by Pei Songzhi quotes the Weilue saying that Zhuge Liang went to Liu Bei first, which Pei rejects for that reason. From the Red Cliffs to the conquest of Shu, events followed the plan closely, until the loss of Jingzhou in 219 ended the hope of a two-pronged march north.
story_zh: 刘备第三次来到隆中，正赶上诸葛亮在草堂午睡。刘备不许童子通报，拱手立在阶下等候；张飞性急，扬言要到屋后放一把火，看他起不起来。良久，诸葛亮翻身吟道：“大梦谁先觉？平生我自知。草堂春睡足，窗外日迟迟。”这才更衣出迎。
刘备恳请指教，诸葛亮命童子挂出西川五十四州地图，说：曹操挟天子以令诸侯，不可与争锋；孙权据有江东已历三世，可为外援而不可图。荆、益二州的主人都守不住基业，将军应先取荆州为家，再取西川建基业，成鼎足之势，然后可图中原。刘备顿首拜谢，诸葛亮这才答应出山，嘱咐弟弟诸葛均好生耕种，待功成之日再回来归隐。
这番对答基本出自《三国志·诸葛亮传》，时在建安十二年（207年），刘备正寄身刘表，屯驻新野。“三顾”有诸葛亮《出师表》“三顾臣于草庐之中”为证；裴注引《魏略》另有诸葛亮主动求见刘备之说，裴松之认为与《出师表》不合。此后从赤壁到入蜀，形势大体照此展开，直到219年荆州失守，两路北伐的设想才落空。
ch038-longzhong-plan.why: It gave Liu Bei his grand strategy, ally with Wu and hold Jingzhou and Yizhou, and it is the blueprint for the three-way division that shapes the rest of the novel.
ch038-longzhong-plan.why_zh: 隆中对为刘备集团定下了联吴抗曹、跨有荆益的总方略，也是全书三分天下格局的蓝图。

quote.zh: 北让曹操占天时，南让孙权占地利
quote.en: Let Cao Cao in the north have the timing of Heaven, and Sun Quan in the south the advantage of the land.

people.name: Zhuge Liang
people.role: Recluse of Longzhong who lays out the plan

people.name: Liu Bei
people.role: Visits three times to seek his counsel

story: Liu Bei treats his new adviser as a teacher, and when Guan Yu and Zhang Fei grumble he tells them that having Kongming is like a fish finding water. Soon Cao Cao sends Xiahou Dun with a hundred thousand men against Xinye, and Zhang Fei sneers: why not send the 'water' to meet them? Fearing the generals will not obey him, Zhuge Liang borrows Liu Bei's sword and seal of command before he gives his orders.

Guan Yu is to hide at Yushan, let the enemy van pass and burn its supplies when he sees fire to the south; Zhang Fei waits in the valley behind Anlin; Guan Ping and Liu Feng lie ready with tinder on both sides behind the slope of Bowang; Zhao Yun leads the van with orders to lose, not win. Zhuge Liang himself will stay in Xinye, which Zhang Fei mocks as a comfortable job. Xiahou Dun laughs at the small force facing him and chases Zhao Yun into a narrow, reed-choked valley; Li Dian and Yu Jin sense the danger, but their warning comes too late. At nightfall the reeds go up on both sides and Cao's army is routed. From then on Guan Yu and Zhang Fei bow to the strategist.

Historically: there was an ambush at Bowang, but it is usually dated to 202, years before Zhuge Liang joined Liu Bei. According to Liu Bei's biography, Liu Biao sent him north to resist Xiahou Dun and Yu Jin; Liu Bei burned his own camp, feigned a retreat, and caught the pursuers in an ambush. Li Dian's biography says Li Dian warned that an enemy who retreats for no reason must have laid a trap, and that he had to come to the rescue afterwards. The novel moves the battle to 208 and gives the credit to Zhuge Liang.
story_zh: 诸葛亮出山后，刘备待之如师，关羽、张飞很不服气，刘备说：“吾得孔明，犹鱼之得水也。”不久曹操派夏侯惇领兵十万杀奔新野，张飞冷笑说何不叫“水”去迎敌。诸葛亮怕众将不听调遣，先向刘备借来剑印，然后升帐点将。
他令关羽伏兵豫山，放过敌军前锋，见南面火起便烧其粮草；张飞伏于安林背后山谷；关平、刘封备好引火之物，在博望坡后两边等候；赵云为前部，只许输不许赢；自己坐守新野，张飞讥笑他在家坐地好自在。夏侯惇见赵云兵少，大笑轻进，追入芦苇丛生的狭谷，李典、于禁察觉不妙，赶来提醒时已经迟了。入夜两边火起，曹军大败。关、张从此心服。
史实：博望之战确有其事，但一般系于建安七年（202年），比诸葛亮出山早了好几年。据《三国志·先主传》，刘表派刘备北拒夏侯惇、于禁，刘备一日烧掉自己营寨假装撤走，夏侯惇追击，中了伏兵。《李典传》说李典曾劝阻：“贼无故退，疑必有伏”，夏侯惇不听，战败后靠李典救援才得脱身。小说把此战移到208年，功劳也记到了诸葛亮名下。
ch039-bowang.why: Zhuge Liang's first battle wins over Guan Yu and Zhang Fei and establishes his authority as Liu Bei's strategist.
ch039-bowang.why_zh: 诸葛亮初次用兵便以火攻大胜，折服了关、张，确立了军师的威信。

quote.zh: 初出茅庐第一功
quote.en: The first triumph of the man fresh from his thatched hut.

story: Liu Biao's elder son Liu Qi is in danger: his stepmother Lady Cai favours her own son Liu Cong and schemes against him with Cai Mao. Liu Qi weeps to Liu Bei, who sends him to Zhuge Liang, but Zhuge Liang refuses to meddle in another family's affairs. So Liu Bei sets up a meeting: the next day he pleads a stomach ache and sends Zhuge Liang to return Liu Qi's call in his place.

Over wine Liu Qi says he has an old book to show his guest and leads him up into a small tower, then has the ladder taken away. Now, he weeps, there is no Heaven above and no earth below: the words will leave your mouth and enter only my ears. When Zhuge Liang still demurs, Liu Qi draws a sword to kill himself. At that Zhuge Liang reminds him of the two princes of Jin: Shensheng stayed at home and was destroyed, Chonger went abroad and survived. Huang Zu has just been killed and Jiangxia has no one to guard it, so why not ask to command it? The next day Liu Qi makes the request.

The scene is in Zhuge Liang's biography, down to the line about Heaven and earth and the two princes, though there Liu Qi simply takes Zhuge Liang for a walk in the garden and up a tower, with no help from Liu Bei. The posting to Jiangxia proved to be Liu Bei's lifeline: after Changban it was Liu Qi who brought more than ten thousand men to meet him at the Han ford. 'Climb the roof and remove the ladder' later became one of the classic stratagems.
story_zh: 刘表长子刘琦处境危险：继母蔡夫人偏爱亲生的刘琮，与蔡瑁等人处处算计他。刘琦向刘备哭诉，刘备让他去问诸葛亮，诸葛亮却推说这是人家骨肉之事，不肯开口。刘备暗中教了刘琦一个办法，第二天推说腹痛，叫诸葛亮代他去刘琦府上回拜。
刘琦设酒款待，借口请先生看一部古书，把诸葛亮引上小楼，随即命人撤去楼梯，哭道：如今上不至天，下不至地，话出先生之口，入我之耳，总可以赐教了。见诸葛亮仍推辞，便要拔剑自刎。诸葛亮这才讲起晋国旧事：申生留在国内而遇害，重耳出亡在外而得安。如今黄祖新亡，江夏缺人镇守，公子何不请求出屯江夏？刘琦次日便向刘表请命。
此事见于《三国志·诸葛亮传》，连“上不至天，下不至地”的话和申生、重耳之喻都与小说相同，只是本传里刘琦是邀诸葛亮游后园、登高楼，并没有刘备暗中安排。出镇江夏后来成了刘备的退路：长坂兵败后，正是刘琦带着万余人马在汉津接应。“上屋抽梯”后来也成了兵家常说的计谋。
ch039-upstairs.why: The advice sent Liu Qi to Jiangxia, and the troops he kept there saved Liu Bei after Changban.
ch039-upstairs.why_zh: 这条计策让刘琦出镇江夏，为刘备日后兵败长坂留下了一条退路。

story: Liu Biao dies; Lady Cai and Cai Mao forge his will to put Liu Cong in his place, and Liu Cong promptly surrenders Jingzhou to Cao Cao. Cao Cao sends Cao Ren and Cao Hong with a hundred thousand men towards Xinye, with Xu Chu's three thousand armoured horsemen clearing the road. On Zhuge Liang's advice Liu Bei invites the people of Xinye to follow him to Fancheng, and the town is left empty.

Zhuge Liang has Zhao Yun hide sulphur and saltpetre on the roofs and shoot fire arrows into the town when the wind rises after dusk; Guan Yu dams the White River upstream with sandbags, to be released when he hears men and horses below; Zhang Fei lies in wait at the Boling ford. Cao Ren arrives late, finds the town deserted and lets his men bed down there. That night a gale blows and the whole town burns. The survivors flee through the east gate to the river, and as they crowd in to drink the flood comes down on them and Zhang Fei attacks; Cao Ren and Cao Hong barely escape.

Historically: no source mentions a fire at Xinye or a flood on the White River. Liu Bei's biography says he was stationed at Fancheng and knew nothing of Cao Cao's approach until the enemy reached Wan; he then led his followers south. Zhuge Liang urged him to attack Liu Cong and take Jingzhou, and Liu Bei answered that he could not bear to. As he passed Xiangyang, many of Liu Cong's followers and the people of Jingzhou went with him.
story_zh: 刘表病死，蔡夫人与蔡瑁伪造遗嘱，立刘琮为荆州之主，刘琮随即献州降曹。曹操命曹仁、曹洪领兵十万为前队，许褚率三千铁甲军开路，杀奔新野。诸葛亮让刘备出榜晓谕百姓，愿随者即日同往樊城暂避，新野就此成了一座空城。
诸葛亮命赵云在城中屋顶暗藏硫黄焰硝，次日黄昏起风后用火箭射入城中；关羽在白河上游用布袋装沙堵住河水，听到下游人喊马嘶便放水；张飞埋伏在博陵渡口。曹仁天晚到来，见城中无人，便令军士入城歇宿。当夜狂风大作，满城火起，曹军从东门逃到白河边争着饮水，上游大水冲下，张飞又杀出，曹仁、曹洪仅得逃脱。
史实：史书并无火烧新野、白河放水的记载。据《三国志·先主传》，刘备当时屯驻樊城，并不知道曹军突然到来，直到曹操兵至宛城才得到消息，只得率众南撤。诸葛亮劝他攻打刘琮、夺取荆州，刘备说“吾不忍也”；路过襄阳时，刘琮左右和荆州士民有很多人随他南下。
ch040-xinye-fire.why: The novel's second fire gives Liu Bei's hasty retreat a victory and deepens the picture of Zhuge Liang as a master planner; history records only a flight.
ch040-xinye-fire.why_zh: 小说用这“第二把火”为刘备的仓皇南撤添上一场胜仗，进一步塑造诸葛亮神机妙算的形象。

people.name: Guan Yu
people.role: Dams and releases the White River

story: Cao Cao's five thousand iron cavalry catch Liu Bei's column at Changban in Dangyang. Soldiers and civilians scatter, and Lady Gan, Lady Mi and the infant A Dou are lost in the rout. Zhao Yun, charged with guarding the family, blames himself and rides back into the enemy to find them. Someone tells Liu Bei that Zhao Yun has gone over to Cao Cao; Liu Bei refuses to believe it. Zhao Yun rescues Lady Gan and sends her to the bridge, then kills Cao Cao's sword-bearer Xiahou En and takes the precious Qinggang sword.

At last he finds Lady Mi, badly wounded, holding A Dou beside a broken wall and a dry well. Refusing to take his horse and slow him down, she hands him the child and throws herself into the well. Zhao Yun pushes the wall over to cover it, loosens his armour, tucks A Dou inside against his chest and fights his way out. Watching from a hill, Cao Cao asks who this is, and the answer rings out: 'I am Zhao Zilong of Changshan!' Wanting him alive, Cao Cao forbids his men to shoot, and Zhao Yun cuts his way through, killing more than fifty of Cao's named officers.

Historically: Zhao Yun's biography says only that when Liu Bei abandoned his family and fled, Zhao Yun carried the infant, the future emperor, and protected his mother Lady Gan, so that both escaped; he was promoted for it. A note quoting Zhao Yun's separate biography adds that when someone said Zhao Yun had gone north, Liu Bei threw a hand halberd at the man and said: Zilong would never desert me. Lady Mi's death in the well and the fifty officers are the novel's; Cao Chun's biography records that Liu Bei's two daughters were captured in this battle.
story_zh: 曹操亲率五千铁骑追到当阳长坂，刘备军民大溃，甘、糜二夫人和幼子阿斗都在乱军中失散。赵云奉命保护家小，自责失职，回马杀入敌阵寻找。有人对刘备说赵云投曹去了，刘备不信。赵云先救出甘夫人送往长坂桥，又刺死替曹操背剑的夏侯恩，夺得青釭宝剑。
他终于在断墙边、枯井旁找到抱着阿斗的糜夫人。夫人身负重伤，不肯上马拖累他，把孩子托付给赵云后投井而死。赵云推倒土墙掩住井口，解开勒甲绦，把阿斗揣在怀中，提枪杀出。曹操在景山上望见，问是何将，赵云高声答道：“吾乃常山赵子龙也！”曹操爱其勇，传令只许活捉，不许放冷箭。赵云左冲右突，斩曹营名将五十余员，终于杀出重围。
史实：《三国志·赵云传》只说刘备在长坂弃妻子南逃时，赵云“身抱弱子，即后主也，保护甘夫人，即后主母也，皆得免难”，事后升为牙门将军。裴注引《赵云别传》说，当时有人说赵云已经北去，刘备用手戟掷他，说“子龙不弃我走也”。糜夫人投井、斩将五十余员都是小说的渲染；据《曹纯传》，刘备的两个女儿在此战中被曹军俘获。
ch041-zhao-yun-changban.why: Zhao Yun's most famous exploit, and the reason Liu Bei's only heir survived.
ch041-zhao-yun-changban.why_zh: 这是赵云一生最著名的战绩，刘备唯一的继承人也因此得以保全。

quote.zh: 吾乃常山赵子龙也！
quote.en: I am Zhao Zilong of Changshan!

people.name: Zhao Yun
people.role: Liu Bei's general who rescues the heir

people.name: Lady Mi
people.role: Liu Bei's wife, who entrusts the child to him

people.name: Cao Cao
people.role: Watches from Jingshan and orders him taken alive

story: With Cao Cao's army closing in on Fancheng, Liu Bei cannot bring himself to abandon the people, so Zhuge Liang has him announce that anyone who wishes may come. The people of Xinye and Fancheng cry out that they will follow him even to death, and cross the river with their old and young, weeping. Watching from his boat, Liu Bei cries that he has brought this disaster on them all and tries to throw himself into the river; his men hold him back.

At Xiangyang Liu Cong will not open the gates; inside, Wei Yan tries to let Liu Bei in and fights Wen Pin, and Liu Bei, fearing for the people, turns towards Jiangling. By now more than a hundred thousand people follow him, with thousands of carts, moving barely ten li a day. His officers urge him to leave them and hurry ahead to hold Jiangling, but he weeps: whoever would do great things must make the people his root; they have come to me, so how can I abandon them?

The passage follows Liu Bei's biography closely: at Dangyang his following numbered over a hundred thousand, with several thousand carts, covering ten-odd li a day, and when urged to save himself he replied that great undertakings must be rooted in people. Fearing that Liu Bei would seize the stores at Jiangling, Cao Cao left his baggage behind and rode with five thousand light cavalry, covering more than three hundred li in a day and a night, to catch him at Changban. The Eastern Jin historian Xi Zuochi wrote that a man who kept faith even in such straits deserved his final success.
story_zh: 曹军压境，刘备在樊城不忍抛下百姓，诸葛亮便让他传令：愿随者同行，不愿者留下。新野、樊城两县百姓齐声说：“我等虽死，亦愿随使君！”扶老携幼，哭着渡江。刘备在船上望见，大哭道：为我一人，让百姓遭此大难，我还活着做什么！说着就要投江，左右急忙抱住。
到了襄阳，刘琮不敢开门，城中魏延要开门接应，与文聘厮杀起来，刘备怕百姓受害，转身往江陵去。一路随行百姓已有十余万，车辆数千，每天只走十余里。众将劝他暂弃百姓，先去据守江陵，刘备哭道：“举大事者必以人为本。今人归我，奈何弃之？”百姓闻言，无不感动。
这一段几乎全依《三国志·先主传》：到当阳时“众十余万，辎重数千两，日行十余里”，有人劝刘备速保江陵，他答以“夫济大事必以人为本”。曹操怕江陵的军资被刘备占去，丢下辎重，亲率五千轻骑一日一夜追了三百余里，在长坂追上。东晋习凿齿评论说，刘备颠沛之中信义愈明，最终成就大业并非偶然。
ch041-crossing-with-the-people.why: The scene fixes Liu Bei's image as the benevolent lord, and it is also why Cao Cao's cavalry caught him at Changban.
ch041-crossing-with-the-people.why_zh: 这一幕奠定了刘备仁德之主的形象，也直接导致他在长坂被曹军追上。

quote.zh: 举大事者必以人为本
quote.en: Whoever would do great things must make the people his root.

people.name: Liu Cong
people.role: New lord of Jingzhou who bars the gates

story: Covering Liu Bei's flight with only twenty-odd riders, Zhang Fei reaches Changban Bridge and devises a trick: his men tie branches to their horses' tails and ride back and forth in the woods east of the bridge to raise dust, as if an army were hidden there, while he sits his horse on the bridge, spear levelled. Zhao Yun dashes across with A Dou. Then Cao's generals arrive, see Zhang Fei glaring and the dust behind him, and, suspecting another of Zhuge Liang's traps, dare not advance.

Cao Cao rides up, remembering Guan Yu's words that Zhang Fei could take a general's head amid a million men as easily as picking something out of a bag. Zhang Fei's eyes blaze and he roars like thunder: 'I am Zhang Yide of Yan! Who dares fight me to the death?' Three times he roars. Xiahou Jie, at Cao Cao's side, falls dead from his horse in terror, and Cao's army flees, trampling itself. Zhang Fei then tears down the bridge and rides back to report, but Liu Bei says this has given the game away; sure enough, Cao Cao realises there is no ambush and throws pontoon bridges across to resume the chase.

Historically: Zhang Fei's biography says Liu Bei left him with twenty riders to hold the rear. Zhang Fei 'held the river and broke the bridge, glared and levelled his spear', shouting: 'I am Zhang Yide! Come and fight to the death!' No one dared come near, and Liu Bei escaped. So the stand is real, but in the record breaking the bridge was part of the defence from the start, not a blunder, and the dust trick and the officer frightened to death are the novel's. The histories also write his courtesy name Yide with a different character.
story_zh: 刘备败逃，张飞只带二十余骑断后，来到长坂桥。他心生一计，叫部下砍下树枝拴在马尾上，在桥东树林里往来驰骋，扬起尘土，好像藏有伏兵；自己横矛立马站在桥上。赵云抱着阿斗冲过桥去，随后曹仁、夏侯惇、张辽、许褚等曹将追到，见张飞怒目而立，林后尘头大起，疑是诸葛亮之计，都不敢上前。
曹操赶来，想起关羽说过张飞在百万军中取上将之首如探囊取物，心中先怯了几分。张飞睁圆环眼，厉声大喝：“我乃燕人张翼德也！谁敢与我决一死战？”声如巨雷，接连喝了三声。曹操身边的夏侯杰吓得肝胆碎裂，坠马而死，曹军人马争逃，自相践踏。张飞随即拆断桥梁回去报信，刘备却说拆桥露了底；曹操果然看出并无伏兵，搭起浮桥再追。
史实：《三国志·张飞传》记载，刘备弃妻子逃走，派张飞率二十骑断后。张飞“据水断桥，瞋目横矛”，大喝“身是张益德也，可来共决死！”曹军无人敢近，刘备因此脱险。可见据桥一喝确有其事，只是史书中拆桥本是倚河据守的一部分，小说反把它写成失策；马尾扬尘和吓死夏侯杰都是小说添加的。张飞的字，史书作“益德”，小说作“翼德”。
ch042-changban-bridge.why: One of the most famous single feats of the age, and largely true.
ch042-changban-bridge.why_zh: 一声断喝退曹兵，是张飞最著名的事迹，而且大体有史可据。

quote.zh: 我乃燕人张翼德也！谁敢与我决一死战？
quote.en: I am Zhang Yide of Yan! Who dares fight me to the death?

people.name: Zhang Fei
people.role: Holds the rear at the bridge

story: Zhao Yun breaks out and reaches Changban Bridge, where Zhang Fei lets him through. He finds Liu Bei resting under a tree and kneels in tears: Lady Mi was badly wounded, refused his horse and threw herself into a well; he pulled down a wall to cover it and carried the young master out through the enemy. The child was crying in his arms a while ago, he says, but has not stirred since, and he fears the worst. He opens his armour: A Dou is fast asleep.

Zhao Yun hands the child over with both hands. Liu Bei takes him and throws him to the ground: 'For your sake, little brat, I nearly lost one of my great generals!' Zhao Yun snatches A Dou up and bows weeping: even if his brains were dashed out on the ground, he could never repay such a lord. A verse in the novel remarks that, having no other way to console a loyal servant, Liu Bei threw his own son down before the horse. Years later Zhao Yun would rescue A Dou again, stopping Lady Sun from carrying him off to Wu.

Historically: no source records Liu Bei throwing down his son; Zhao Yun's biography says only that he saved the boy and his mother and was promoted. The scene was written to show Liu Bei's gift for winning hearts and Zhao Yun's gratitude, and it gave rise to the popular saying 'Liu Bei throws down his child: buying people's hearts'. A Dou was Liu Shan, the future second emperor of Shu-Han, born in 207 and not yet two years old.
story_zh: 赵云杀出重围，来到长坂桥，张飞放他过去。他在树下找到刘备，跪地哭诉：糜夫人身受重伤，不肯上马，投井而死，自己推倒土墙掩了井，怀抱公子杀出重围；方才公子还在怀中啼哭，这一会儿不见动静，只怕保不住了。说罢解开甲胄一看，阿斗正睡得香甜。
赵云双手递上阿斗，刘备接过孩子，掷在地上，说：“为汝这孺子，几损我一员大将！”赵云慌忙抱起阿斗，哭拜道：“云虽肝脑涂地，不能报也！”书中有诗道：“无由抚慰忠臣意，故把亲儿掷马前。”多年以后，赵云又在江上截回被孙夫人带走的阿斗。
史实：史书中没有刘备摔子的记载，《三国志·赵云传》只说赵云保全了后主母子，事后升为牙门将军。这一情节是小说为表现刘备笼络人心、赵云感恩图报而设计的，民间由此生出“刘备摔孩子——收买人心”的歇后语。阿斗即后来的蜀汉后主刘禅，生于207年，此时还不满两岁。
ch042-throws-the-child.why: A small invented gesture that became proverbial for winning loyalty with a show of feeling.
ch042-throws-the-child.why_zh: 这个虚构的小动作后来家喻户晓，成了“收买人心”的代名词。

quote.zh: 为汝这孺子，几损我一员大将！
quote.en: For your sake, little brat, I nearly lost one of my great generals!

people.name: Zhao Yun
people.role: Brings the child back from the battle

story: Seeing through the broken bridge, Cao Cao builds new ones and resumes the chase. Liu Bei flees towards the Han River and is about to be overtaken when drums sound behind a hill and a body of troops charges out, led by Guan Yu. He had been sent to Jiangxia to borrow ten thousand men from Liu Qi, and hearing of the battle at Changban he came this way to cut in. At the sight of him Cao Cao exclaims that he has fallen for another of Zhuge Liang's tricks, and orders a retreat.

Guan Yu escorts Liu Bei to the Han ford, where boats are waiting.
