Asking after his two sisters-in-law and hearing what happened at Dangyang, he sighs that if Liu Bei had let him kill Cao Cao at the Xutian hunt, none of this would have happened; Liu Bei answers that at the time he could not strike the rat for fear of breaking the vase. Then Liu Qi arrives with warships, and Zhuge Liang comes by boat as well. They agree that Liu Qi will go back to Jiangxia to ready his fleet while Liu Bei holds Xiakou, the two supporting each other against Cao Cao.

The histories largely agree. Liu Bei's biography says he 'cut across to the Han ford, where he happened to meet Guan Yu's boats', crossed the Mian, and met Liu Qi with more than ten thousand men, and together they reached Xiakou; Guan Yu had gone ahead with several hundred boats to meet him at Jiangling. The Xutian exchange comes from the Shu ji quoted by Pei Songzhi, who found Liu Bei's recorded reply, that he had spared Cao Cao for the sake of the state, implausible. It was also at Changban that Lu Su met Liu Bei and urged him to ally with Sun Quan.
story_zh: 张飞拆桥之后，曹操识破虚实，搭桥追赶。刘备逃向汉水，眼看就要被追上，忽然山坡后鼓声大作，一彪军马杀出，为首的正是关羽。原来他奉命往江夏向刘琦借得一万人马，探知长坂大战，特地从这条路截出。曹操一见关羽，以为又中了诸葛亮之计，急令退兵。
关羽护送刘备来到汉津，早有船只等候。关羽问起二位嫂嫂，听刘备诉说当阳之事，叹道：当初许田打围时若依我的意思杀了曹操，就没有今日之患。刘备说那时投鼠忌器。正说着，刘琦率战船赶来接应，诸葛亮也乘船到来。众人商定刘琦回江夏整顿战船，刘备屯驻夏口，两处互为掎角，共拒曹操。
史书的记载与此大体相合。《三国志·先主传》说刘备“斜趋汉津，适与羽船会”，渡过沔水，又遇上刘琦的万余人马，一同到了夏口；关羽原是率数百艘船先行，准备在江陵会合的。许田旧话见裴注引《蜀记》，刘备答以当时是为国家爱惜曹操，裴松之认为这说法不合情理。也正是在长坂，鲁肃见到刘备，劝他与孙权联合。
ch042-hanjin.why: The meeting with Guan Yu's fleet kept the rout at Changban from becoming annihilation and let Liu Bei hold Xiakou until the alliance with Wu.
ch042-hanjin.why_zh: 与关羽水军的会合使长坂溃败没有变成覆灭，刘备得以退保夏口，等来与东吴联合的机会。

people.name: Liu Qi
people.role_zh: 率战船来援的江夏太守

people.name: Zhuge Liang
people.role: Arranges the next move to Xiakou

story: Lu Su brings Zhuge Liang to Chaisang and first presents him to the officials of Wu, Zhang Zhao and some twenty others in tall hats and broad sashes. Zhang Zhao opens the attack: you compare yourself to Guan Zhong and Yue Yi, yet since Liu Bei got you he has lost Xinye, fled Fancheng and been beaten at Dangyang. Zhuge Liang answers with a doctor's analogy: a gravely ill man must be nursed with gruel and mild medicine before strong drugs can cure him. With fewer than a thousand men Liu Bei still burned Cao's armies at Bowang and Xinye; he lost at Dangyang only because he would not abandon the people; and the founder of Han lost many times to Xiang Yu before one victory at Gaixia won everything.

Then Yu Fan, Bu Zhi, Xue Zong, Lu Ji, Yan Jun and Cheng Bing take turns: one praises Cao Cao's numbers, one sneers that he plays the wandering persuader like Su Qin and Zhang Yi, one says Cao Cao already holds two thirds of the realm, and Lu Ji mocks Liu Bei as a seller of mats and sandals. Zhuge Liang refutes each in turn, reminds Lu Ji of the oranges he hid in his sleeve as a boy at Yuan Shu's table, and dismisses Yan Jun's kind as pedants who hunt for phrases. The hall falls silent until Huang Gai comes in, rebukes them for bickering with a guest while the enemy is at the gate, and leads Zhuge Liang to Sun Quan.

Historically: Zhuge Liang's biography confirms that he went to Chaisang and worked on Sun Quan by provocation: if Wu can resist, break with Cao Cao now; if not, lay down arms and serve him. When Sun Quan asked why Liu Bei did not surrender, he replied that if Tian Heng, a mere strongman of Qi, would not submit to disgrace, how could a scion of the imperial house? He added that Cao's army was exhausted, 'an arrow at the end of its flight', and that northerners were no sailors. Many of Sun Quan's officials did favour surrender, but the debate with the scholars is not in any history.
story_zh: 鲁肃引诸葛亮到柴桑，先让他会见东吴文武。张昭等二十余人峨冠博带，坐满一堂。张昭首先发难：先生自比管、乐，可刘豫州得了先生，反而弃新野、走樊城、败当阳。诸葛亮以治病作比：重病之人要先用粥饭和缓药调理，才能用猛药根治；刘备兵不满千，仍在博望、新野两用火攻，当阳之败是不忍抛弃百姓，汉高祖屡败于项羽，最终垓下一战成功。
虞翻、步骘、薛综、陆绩、严畯、程秉等人轮番诘难：有人夸曹操兵多，有人讥他效仿苏秦、张仪，有人说曹操已得天下三分之二，陆绩笑刘备是织席贩屦之徒。诸葛亮一一驳回，还揭出陆绩幼时在袁术席上怀橘的旧事，斥严畯之流是寻章摘句的腐儒。众人尽皆失色，最后黄盖进来喝止，说大敌当前，以唇舌刁难客人不是待客之礼，引他去见孙权。
史实：《三国志·诸葛亮传》记载诸葛亮确曾到柴桑，用激将之法游说孙权：能抗衡就早与曹操绝交，不能就北面称臣。孙权反问刘备为何不降，他答田横不过是齐国壮士，尚且守义不辱，何况刘豫州是王室之后。他又指出曹军远来疲惫，是“强弩之末”，北方人不习水战。东吴群臣确实多主张迎降，但舌战群儒一场不见于任何史书。
ch043-debating-the-scholars.why: The novel's showcase of Zhuge Liang's eloquence, setting up the alliance that made the Red Cliffs possible.
ch043-debating-the-scholars.why_zh: 这是小说展示诸葛亮辩才的名场面，也为孙刘联盟和赤壁之战作了铺垫。

quote.zh: 寻章摘句，世之腐儒也
quote.en: Hunting for phrases and plucking out sentences: that is what pedants do.

story: After taking Jingzhou, Cao Cao writes to Sun Quan that, with a million men and a thousand generals, he proposes to 'go hunting' with him at Jiangxia. Sun Quan calls his council. Zhang Zhao argues that Cao Cao acts in the emperor's name and now has the Jingzhou fleet, so the Yangzi is no longer Wu's alone to defend; surrender is the only safe course. The other advisers agree. Sun Quan says nothing and rises to change his clothes.

Lu Su follows him into the corridor, and Sun Quan takes his hand and asks what he thinks. If someone like me surrenders, says Lu Su, I will be sent home to my district, keep an office and in time rise to govern a province; if you surrender, you will be a marquis at most, with one carriage and a handful of attendants. How could you ever sit facing south as a ruler again? Sun Quan sighs that his ministers have bitterly disappointed him, but Lu Su's words match his own thoughts: 'Heaven has given you to me!' Lu Su then recommends that he meet Zhuge Liang.

The conversation appears almost verbatim in Lu Su's biography: Sun Quan rose to change, Lu Su followed him under the eaves and said that he, Lu Su, could surrender, but his lord could not; he himself would still ride an ox-cart with clerks behind him and mix with the gentry, but where would Sun Quan go? Sun Quan answered that Heaven had given Lu Su to him. Zhou Yu was then away at Poyang, and it was Lu Su who urged Sun Quan to recall him. At their first meeting, around 200, Lu Su had already advised Sun Quan to hold the east as one leg of a tripod, a plan that mirrors Zhuge Liang's at Longzhong.
story_zh: 曹操得了荆州，致书孙权，声称统雄兵百万、上将千员，要与将军“会猎于江夏”。孙权召集文武商议，张昭认为曹操挟天子之名，又得了荆州水军，长江之险已与我共有，不如迎降为万安之策。众谋士纷纷附和，孙权沉吟不语，起身更衣。
鲁肃追到廊下，孙权拉着他的手问他有何主张。鲁肃说：像我这样的人投降曹操，仍可还乡做官，慢慢升到州郡；将军投降，最多封个侯，车不过一乘，从者不过数人，还能南面称孤吗？孙权叹道：众人的议论大失我望，子敬所言正合我意，“此天以子敬赐我也！”鲁肃随即推荐孙权接见诸葛亮。
这段对话几乎原样见于《三国志·鲁肃传》：孙权起身更衣，鲁肃追到屋檐下，说“今肃可迎操耳，如将军，不可也”，自己降了照样“乘犊车，从吏卒，交游士林”，将军降了又将安所归？孙权答以“此天以卿赐我也”。当时周瑜奉命在鄱阳，也是鲁肃劝孙权把他召回。早在约200年初见孙权时，鲁肃就提出过“鼎足江东”的方略，与隆中对遥相呼应。
ch043-lu-su-alone.why: Lu Su was the first to tell Sun Quan plainly what surrender would mean for him personally, the turning point of Wu's debate.
ch043-lu-su-alone.why_zh: 鲁肃一席话点破了投降对孙权本人的后果，是东吴由降转战的关键。

quote.zh: 众人皆可降曹操，惟将军不可降曹操
quote.en: Everyone else may surrender to Cao Cao; you alone, my lord, may not.

people.name: Lu Su
people.role: Sun Quan's adviser who opposes surrender

story: Zhou Yu hurries back from Poyang. When Lu Su brings Zhuge Liang to him, Zhou Yu pretends that he too favours surrender. Zhuge Liang says there is no need for an army at all: just send Cao Cao two women. Cao Cao has built the Bronze Sparrow Terrace and sworn to install the two Qiao sisters of the east there, and Zhuge Liang recites Cao Zhi's rhapsody on the terrace, with its line about 'embracing the two Qiao of the southeast'. Zhou Yu flies into a rage and points north: 'The old traitor and I cannot live under the same sky!' The elder Qiao was Sun Ce's widow; the younger was Zhou Yu's own wife.

Next day before the court Zhou Yu lists Cao Cao's four fatal weaknesses: the north is not secure, with Ma Teng and Han Sui at his back; his northerners must give up horses for boats; it is deep winter and there is no fodder; and his men, far from home in an unfamiliar climate, are falling sick. Sun Quan draws his sword and hacks a corner off the desk before him: 'Any officer who speaks again of surrendering to Cao Cao will end like this desk!' He hands Zhou Yu the sword and makes him commander-in-chief, with Cheng Pu as deputy and Lu Su on his staff. That night Zhou Yu calls on Sun Quan again and puts his last doubts to rest with an account of Cao Cao's real numbers.

Most of this is in the histories. Zhou Yu's biography gives his list of Cao Cao's weaknesses and his request for some tens of thousands of picked troops to advance to Xiakou; the cutting of the desk comes from the Jiangbiao zhuan quoted by Pei Songzhi, where Sun Quan says any officer who again proposes welcoming Cao Cao will be like this desk. The same source has Zhou Yu reckoning that night that Cao Cao's northern troops numbered no more than 150,000 to 160,000 and were worn out, and Liu Biao's former soldiers at most 70,000 to 80,000 and of doubtful loyalty. The Bronze Sparrow provocation is the novel's: the terrace was built only in 210, and Cao Zhi's rhapsody later still.
story_zh: 周瑜从鄱阳赶回，鲁肃引诸葛亮来见，周瑜故意说要降曹。诸葛亮说不必兴师动众，只须把两个人送给曹操：曹操新造铜雀台，发誓要得江东二乔置于台上。他背出曹植《铜雀台赋》，内有“揽二乔于东南兮，乐朝夕之与共”的句子。周瑜勃然大怒，指北骂道：“吾与老贼誓不两立！”原来大乔是孙策之妻，小乔正是周瑜之妻。
次日孙权升堂，周瑜当众剖析曹军四忌：北方未平，马腾、韩遂为其后患；北兵舍鞍马、仗舟楫，与东吴争衡；时值隆冬，马无草料；中原士卒远涉江湖，水土不服，多生疾病。孙权拔剑砍下面前奏案一角：“诸官将有再言降操者，与此案同！”随即赐剑给周瑜，封他为大都督，程普为副，鲁肃为赞军校尉。当夜周瑜又入见孙权，算清曹军实数，孙权疑虑尽消。
这一段大都出自史书。《三国志·周瑜传》载周瑜力陈曹军数患，请精兵数万进驻夏口；砍案之事出自裴注引《江表传》，孙权原话是“诸将吏敢复有言当迎操者，与此案同”。《江表传》还记周瑜夜见孙权，估算曹军中原士卒不过十五六万，且已疲惫，所得刘表部众至多七八万，尚怀狐疑。至于以铜雀台激周瑜，则是小说的创造：铜雀台建于210年，曹植作赋更在其后。
ch044-sun-quan-decides.why: The moment Wu committed to war, which made the Red Cliffs campaign possible.
ch044-sun-quan-decides.why_zh: 孙权砍案定计，东吴正式决意抗曹，赤壁之战由此展开。

quote.zh: 诸官将有再言降操者，与此案同！
quote.en: Any officer who speaks again of surrendering to Cao Cao will end like this desk!

story: Cao Cao has made the surrendered Jingzhou commanders Cai Mao and Zhang Yun admirals of his fleet, and Zhou Yu, spying on their water camp, is alarmed at how well it is drilled. Jiang Gan, one of Cao Cao's staff, claims Zhou Yu as an old schoolfriend and offers to cross the river and talk him into surrendering. He arrives in a small boat with a single page. Zhou Yu greets him laughing, asking whether he has come as Cao Cao's persuader, and throws a great feast of Wu's heroes, setting Taishi Ci with a drawn sword to keep order: anyone who mentions Cao Cao or the war will lose his head.

Pretending to be very drunk, Zhou Yu takes Jiang Gan to share his bed. Unable to sleep, Jiang Gan finds among the papers on the desk a letter sealed by Cai Mao and Zhang Yun, promising to deliver Cao Cao's head. Zhou Yu mutters in his sleep that within days he will show Jiang Gan the traitor's head; before dawn a man comes in and whispers that the two admirals have not yet found their chance. Jiang Gan slips away with the letter. Cao Cao, enraged, has Cai Mao and Zhang Yun beheaded at once, realises his mistake only when their heads are brought in, and, unwilling to admit it, appoints Mao Jie and Yu Jin in their place.

Historically: the Jiangbiao zhuan, quoted by Pei Songzhi, says that Jiang Gan of Jiujiang, known for his looks and eloquence, was indeed sent by Cao Cao to win Zhou Yu over. Zhou Yu showed him his camps, storehouses and treasures and said that, having found a lord who understood him, not even Su Qin or Zhang Yi could talk him round. Jiang Gan only smiled, and on his return praised Zhou Yu's magnanimity as beyond the reach of words. There was no stolen letter. The Xiangyang qijiu ji says Cai Mao had known Cao Cao since youth and after surrendering became a colonel and a marquis; nothing is recorded of Zhang Yun's end.
story_zh: 曹操以降将蔡瑁、张允为水军都督，日夜操练，周瑜偷看曹军水寨，暗暗心惊。曹营谋士蒋干自称与周瑜同窗交好，愿过江劝降，只带一个小童，驾一叶扁舟来到吴营。周瑜笑问他是否来作说客，随即大会文武，号为“群英会”，命太史慈佩剑监酒，席间只叙旧情，有谁提起曹操与军事的立斩。
周瑜佯装大醉，拉蒋干同榻而眠。蒋干半夜睡不着，在桌上翻出一封蔡瑁、张允的密信，约定献上曹操首级。周瑜又在梦中说：数日之内教你看曹贼之首；四更时有人进帐低声报说，蔡、张二都督急切不得下手。蒋干信以为真，偷了书信溜回江北。曹操大怒，立斩蔡瑁、张允，等首级献上才醒悟中计，却不肯认错，改派毛玠、于禁为水军都督。
史实：据《三国志·周瑜传》裴注引《江表传》，蒋干是九江人，以仪容和辩才著称，曹操确曾派他去游说周瑜。周瑜带他参观营寨、仓库和器用珍玩，说自己遇上知己之主，即使苏秦、张仪复生也说不动。蒋干只是笑，无言以对，回去称赞周瑜“雅量高致，非言辞所间”。并无盗书之事；据《襄阳耆旧记》，蔡瑁与曹操少年相识，降曹后官至长水校尉，封亭侯；张允结局史书无载。
ch045-jiang-gan.why: The novel's most famous ruse of disinformation, which strips Cao Cao of his two experienced naval commanders before the battle.
ch045-jiang-gan.why_zh: 这是小说中最著名的反间计，使曹操在决战前自断水军臂膀。

people.name: Jiang Gan
people.role: Cao Cao's envoy, Zhou Yu's old schoolmate

people.name: Zhou Yu
people.role: Wu commander who sets the trap

story: Wary of Zhuge Liang, Zhou Yu asks him in council which weapon matters most in a river battle. Bows and arrows, he replies. Then, says Zhou Yu, please supervise the making of a hundred thousand arrows within ten days. Zhuge Liang says Cao's army may arrive any day and ten days is too long: he needs only three, and signs a pledge on his life. Zhou Yu secretly tells the craftsmen to drag their feet. Zhuge Liang merely borrows twenty boats from Lu Su, each with thirty soldiers, screened with blue cloth and lined on both sides with over a thousand bundles of straw.

For two days he does nothing. Before dawn on the third he invites Lu Su aboard to 'fetch the arrows'. The twenty boats, linked by long ropes, slip through a thick fog up to Cao Cao's water camp, line up, and beat drums and shout. Fearing an ambush in the fog, Cao Cao will not come out and orders his archers to shoot. Zhuge Liang and Lu Su sit drinking in the cabin; when one side bristles with arrows, the boats turn to take them on the other. As the fog lifts, the soldiers shout 'Thank you for the arrows, Chancellor!' and sail home with more than a hundred thousand. Zhou Yu sighs that he is no match for the man.

Historically: it never happened. The nearest real story comes from Ruxu in 213: the Weilue, quoted by Pei Songzhi, says Sun Quan sailed out in a large ship to look at Cao Cao's lines; Cao Cao's archers shot so many arrows into one side that the ship began to list, so Sun Quan turned it to take arrows on the other side, and once it was level he went home. In the Yuan-dynasty Sanguozhi pinghua the trick belongs to Zhou Yu; the novel gave it to Zhuge Liang.
story_zh: 周瑜忌惮诸葛亮，议事时问他水上交兵以何种兵器为先，诸葛亮答以弓箭。周瑜便请他十日内督造十万支箭。诸葛亮说曹军即日将至，十日必误大事，只要三天，当场立下军令状。周瑜暗中吩咐工匠故意拖延。诸葛亮却只向鲁肃借了二十只船，每船军士三十人，用青布为幔，两边各束草把千余个。
头两天诸葛亮毫无动静。第三天四更，他请鲁肃上船，说是去取箭。二十只船用长索相连，趁着漫天大雾驶近曹军水寨，一字摆开，擂鼓呐喊。曹操怕雾中有埋伏，不敢出战，只令弓弩手乱箭齐射。诸葛亮与鲁肃在舱中饮酒，船一侧插满了箭，又掉过船头用另一侧受箭。日出雾散，军士齐声高叫“谢丞相箭！”满载而归，得箭十余万支。周瑜得知，长叹自愧不如。
史实：草船借箭并无其事。最接近的记载是213年的濡须之战：裴注引《魏略》说，孙权乘大船来观察曹军营垒，曹操下令弓弩乱射，船一侧中箭太多，眼看要倾覆，孙权命掉转船身，让另一侧受箭，等船身平衡后才从容退回。元代《三国志平话》把借箭的事安在周瑜身上，《三国演义》才把它改成诸葛亮的妙计。
ch046-borrowing-arrows.why: One of the best-loved stories of Zhuge Liang's foresight, though entirely invented.
ch046-borrowing-arrows.why_zh: 这是最脍炙人口的诸葛亮故事之一，把他神机妙算的形象推向顶点，却完全出自虚构。

quote.zh: 谢丞相箭！
quote.en: Thank you for the arrows, Chancellor!

people.name: Lu Su
people.role: Lends the boats and rides along

people.name: Cao Cao
people.role: Orders his archers to shoot into the fog

story: Cao Cao sends Cai Mao's cousins Cai Zhong and Cai He to Wu as false defectors; Zhou Yu sees through them and keeps them to carry false reports back. That night the old general Huang Gai comes to him secretly, proposes a fire attack and offers to make a false surrender himself. Zhou Yu warns that Cao Cao will believe it only if he suffers in the flesh first. Huang Gai answers that he owes the Sun family so much that he would not regret it even if it cost his life, and Zhou Yu bows to him in thanks.

Next day in council Zhou Yu orders the officers to draw three months' supplies for the campaign. Huang Gai retorts that thirty months' would not help; they might as well surrender, as Zhang Zhao advised. Zhou Yu orders him beheaded; the officers plead, and the sentence is cut to a hundred strokes on the back. At fifty they plead again and he is spared, his flesh torn open, fainting again and again. When Lu Su asks why he did not intercede, Zhuge Liang laughs: without this ruse of self-injury, how could they fool Cao Cao? Kan Ze then carries Huang Gai's letter of surrender to Cao Cao, the Cai cousins report the beating, and Cao Cao believes it.

Historically: Zhou Yu's biography confirms that the fire attack was Huang Gai's idea, because Cao's ships were moored 'bow to stern' and could be burned, and that he sent Cao Cao a false letter of surrender beforehand. The Jiangbiao zhuan, quoted by Pei Songzhi, gives its text: the men of the six eastern commanderies cannot stand against a million, as all the world can see, and only Zhou Yu and Lu Su are too foolish to understand. Cao Cao questioned the messenger in person, saying he only feared a trick, and in the end believed it. The beating and Kan Ze's mission are not in the histories.
story_zh: 曹操派蔡瑁的族弟蔡中、蔡和到吴营诈降，周瑜看穿，将计就计留下他们传递假消息。当夜老将黄盖秘密来见，主张火攻，并愿意亲自诈降。周瑜说诈降必须先吃些皮肉之苦，才能让曹操相信。黄盖表示自己受孙氏厚恩，即使肝脑涂地也毫无怨悔，周瑜下拜称谢。
次日升帐，周瑜命诸将各领三个月粮草准备破敌。黄盖当众顶撞：就是领三十个月的粮也没用，不如依张昭之言投降。周瑜大怒，喝令斩首，众将苦苦求情，改为脊杖一百；打到五十，众官又再三哀求，才饶了他。黄盖被打得皮开肉绽，几次昏死。鲁肃怪诸葛亮不劝，诸葛亮笑说不用苦肉计，怎能瞒过曹操？随后阚泽替黄盖送去降书，蔡中、蔡和也密报此事，曹操信以为真。
史实：据《三国志·周瑜传》，火攻之策确是黄盖提出的，理由是曹军船舰“首尾相接，可烧而走也”，他还预先写信向曹操诈降。裴注引《江表传》载有降书原文，说以江东六郡对抗百万之众，众寡不敌，海内共见，只有周瑜、鲁肃执迷不悟。曹操曾亲自盘问送信人，说只怕其中有诈，最终还是信了。苦肉计和阚泽献书都不见于史书。
ch046-huang-gai-beaten.why: The ruse makes Huang Gai's false surrender believable and so makes the fire attack possible; 'Zhou Yu beating Huang Gai' became a byword for a willing victim.
ch046-huang-gai-beaten.why_zh: 苦肉计让黄盖的诈降取信于曹操，是火烧赤壁的关键一环，“周瑜打黄盖”也成了俗语。

people.name: Huang Gai
people.role: Veteran Wu general and false defector

story: Jiang Gan crosses the river a second time. Zhou Yu pretends to be angry about the stolen letter and packs him off to a hermitage in the western hills. Strolling at night, Jiang Gan hears someone reading a military classic in a thatched hut: it is Pang Tong, the 'Fledgling Phoenix'. Delighted, Jiang Gan persuades him to join Cao Cao and takes him across that night. Cao Cao welcomes him and shows him the camps; Pang Tong praises his dispositions but points out that the northern soldiers, unused to water, are falling sick from the pitching of the boats.

His remedy: group the ships, large and small, in rows of thirty or fifty, chain them bow to stern with iron rings and lay broad planks across, so that men and even horses can cross them and no wave can trouble them. Cao Cao is delighted and has his smiths forge chains through the night. As Pang Tong leaves, Xu Shu grabs him by the river and says his scheme is meant to burn Cao's army to the last man; Pang Tong tells him to spread a rumour that Ma Teng and Han Sui are attacking Xudu, so that he can leave the camp with troops. When Cheng Yu later warns of fire, Cao Cao laughs that in deep winter only a northwest wind blows, so fire would burn the attackers themselves.

Historically: Cao Cao's ships really were joined together. Zhou Yu's biography has Huang Gai observing that they were moored 'bow to stern' and could be burned, which is where the fire attack came from; it does not say whose idea the mooring was, and Pang Tong had nothing to do with it. Pang Tong was then an officer of Nan commandery; he later served under Zhou Yu and, when Zhou Yu died, escorted his coffin to Wu. Xu Shu stayed in Cao Wei service and rose to high office, with no record of his leaving the camp on a pretext.
story_zh: 蒋干第二次过江，周瑜假装恼他盗书，把他打发到西山庵中暂住。蒋干夜里信步闲走，听见草屋中有人诵读兵书，原来是号称“凤雏”的庞统。蒋干大喜，劝他投奔曹操，连夜带他过江。曹操亲自迎接，请他观看营寨，庞统称赞曹操用兵有法，又指出北方士兵不习水性，在船上颠簸生病。
庞统献策：把大小船只三十或五十只编为一排，首尾用铁环连锁，上铺阔板，不但人可渡，马也能走，任凭风浪也不怕。曹操大喜，命铁匠连夜打造连环大钉。庞统辞行时，在江边被徐庶一把揪住，说他献连环计是要把曹军烧个干净。庞统教徐庶散布马腾、韩遂袭取许都的流言，借机领兵离开曹营。后来程昱提醒防备火攻，曹操笑说隆冬只有西北风，若用火攻是自烧其兵。
史实：曹军战船相连确有其事。《三国志·周瑜传》记黄盖说曹军船舰“首尾相接，可烧而走也”，火攻之计正由此而来，但并没有说连船是谁出的主意，更与庞统无关。庞统当时是南郡功曹，后来在周瑜手下任职，周瑜病逝时还护送灵柩到东吴。徐庶留在曹魏，官至御史中丞，也没有借故离营的记载。
ch047-chained-ships.why: The chained fleet is the last link in the novel's chain of stratagems, the forged letter, the beating and the chains, that prepares the fire.
ch047-chained-ships.why_zh: 连环计让曹军战船锁成一体，与反间计、苦肉计环环相扣，为火烧赤壁备下最后一步。

people.name: Pang Tong
people.role: The Fledgling Phoenix who offers the plan

people.name: Jiang Gan
people.role: Brings Pang Tong to Cao Cao

story: Everything is ready. Watching Cao's camp from a hilltop, Zhou Yu feels a gust flick the corner of a banner across his face and suddenly remembers that in deep winter only the northwest wind blows: a fire would turn back on his own fleet. He cries out, coughs blood and takes to his bed. Lu Su brings Zhuge Liang to see him. Claiming he can cure the commander's real illness, Zhuge Liang sends the attendants away and writes sixteen characters: 'To break Cao Cao, use fire; all is ready, but the east wind is lacking.' Zhou Yu is astounded.

Zhuge Liang says a remarkable man once taught him the secret arts of calling up wind and rain. He asks for an altar on Nanping Hill, the Seven Stars Altar, nine feet high in three tiers and guarded by a hundred and twenty flag-bearers, and promises three days and nights of southeast wind. On the appointed day he bathes, fasts and climbs the altar barefoot, hair unbound, in a Taoist robe. Near the third watch of the night the banners swing round and the southeast wind rises. Zhou Yu, as frightened as he is amazed, decides the man is a mortal danger to Wu and sends Ding Feng and Xu Sheng to kill him, but Zhuge Liang has already left the altar and sails off in the boat Zhao Yun has brought to fetch him.

Historically: the wind blew, but nobody summoned it. The Jiangbiao zhuan, quoted in the notes to Zhou Yu's biography, says only that when Huang Gai set out 'the southeast wind was blowing hard', and that the fire ships raised sail in mid-river and ran before it. Winter winds on the middle Yangzi are mostly northerly, but brief southeasterlies do occur. The Tang poet Du Mu still credited Zhou Yu's luck: had the east wind not favoured him, spring would have found the two Qiao locked in the Bronze Sparrow. Making the wind Zhuge Liang's magic was the work of later storytellers and the novel.
story_zh: 万事齐备，周瑜在山顶眺望曹营，忽然一阵风过，旗角拂过脸颊，他猛然想起隆冬只有西北风，火攻反会烧着自己，大叫一声，口吐鲜血，卧病不起。鲁肃请诸葛亮来探病。诸葛亮说能医都督的心病，屏退左右，提笔写下十六个字：“欲破曹公，宜用火攻；万事俱备，只欠东风。”周瑜大惊。
诸葛亮自称曾遇异人传授奇门遁甲之术，可以呼风唤雨，请在南屏山筑七星坛，高九尺，分三层，用一百二十人执旗守护，他上坛作法，借三日三夜东南大风。到了日子，他沐浴斋戒，身披道衣，跣足散发登坛。当夜将近三更，旗幡转动，东南风大起。周瑜又惊又惧，认定此人是东吴祸根，急派丁奉、徐盛去杀他，诸葛亮却早已下坛，乘赵云接应的船扬长而去。
史实：东南风确实吹过，但并无祭风之事。《三国志·周瑜传》裴注引《江表传》只说黄盖出发之时“东南风急”，火船到江心举帆，借风直冲曹营。冬季长江中游虽以北风为主，偶尔也会刮起短暂的东南风。唐代杜牧《赤壁》诗“东风不与周郎便，铜雀春深锁二乔”，说的还是周瑜幸得天时；把这阵风写成诸葛亮作法借来，是后世说书和小说的发挥。
ch049-east-wind.why: The saying 'all is ready but the east wind' comes from here, and the scene hands the credit for the victory to Zhuge Liang.
ch049-east-wind.why_zh: “万事俱备，只欠东风”出自此处，小说借祭风把赤壁的胜利归到诸葛亮名下。

quote.zh: 欲破曹公，宜用火攻；万事俱备，只欠东风。
quote.en: To break Cao Cao, use fire; all is ready, but the east wind is lacking.

people.name: Lu Su
people.role: Brings Zhuge Liang to Zhou Yu

story: With the southeast wind blowing, Huang Gai readies twenty fire ships loaded with dry reeds and firewood soaked in fish oil and sprinkled with sulphur and saltpetre, covered with oiled cloth and flying blue dragon banners, as if bringing grain to surrender. Cao Cao, watching from his water camp, is delighted that Huang Gai has kept his word. But Cheng Yu sees what is wrong: grain boats would sit low in the water, and these ride high and light. Cao Cao realises the trick too late; Wen Pin is sent out to stop them and is hit by an arrow.

Two li from the camp Huang Gai waves his sword, and the leading ships burst into flame and race before the wind into the fleet. Chained together, Cao's ships cannot scatter; the river becomes a sea of fire, which spreads to the camps on shore. Gan Ning, who has had Cai Zhong guide him into Cao's camp, cuts him down and sets fires as a signal, and the Wu columns attack together. Pursuing Cao Cao, Huang Gai is shot into the river by Zhang Liao and pulled out by Han Dang. Cao Cao escapes ashore under Zhang Liao's protection.

The battle is real and decisive. Zhou Yu's biography says Huang Gai took several dozen warships, filled them with brushwood soaked in oil, sent word that he was surrendering and set them alight as they closed in; 'smoke and flame filled the sky, and men and horses burned or drowned in great numbers'. The Wu shu, quoted by Pei Songzhi, adds that Huang Gai, hit by a stray arrow, fell into the cold river and was picked up by Wu soldiers who did not recognise him, until he managed to call out to Han Dang. Cao Cao's side told it differently: his annals speak only of a setback and of plague in the army, and in a letter to Sun Quan he claimed he had burned his own ships and let Zhou Yu win an undeserved name.
story_zh: 东南风起，黄盖备好二十只火船，船上装满芦苇干柴，灌以鱼油，铺上硫黄焰硝，用青布油单遮盖，船头插着青龙牙旗，诈称押粮来降。曹操在水寨中望见，大喜，以为黄盖果然来投。程昱却看出破绽：粮船必定沉重，这些船却轻飘飘浮在水面，必然有诈。曹操这才醒悟，急令文聘出寨拦截，文聘却被一箭射中。
离曹寨二里，黄盖把刀一挥，前船一齐点火，火趁风威，船如箭发，撞入水寨。曹军战船被铁环锁住，无法逃散，江面上一片火海，火势又延烧到岸上营寨。甘宁让蔡中引路混入曹营，斩了蔡中，放火为号，吴军各路一齐杀到。黄盖追赶曹操，被张辽一箭射落江中，幸被韩当救起。曹操在张辽护卫下狼狈逃上岸去。
赤壁之战是真实的决定性战役。《三国志·周瑜传》记黄盖取蒙冲斗舰数十艘，装满柴草、灌以膏油，先送信诈降，临近时一齐放火，“烟炎张天，人马烧溺死者甚众”。裴注引《吴书》说黄盖中流矢落水，被吴兵救起却无人认得，他勉力叫了一声韩当，才得救治。曹操一方说法不同：《武帝纪》只说战事不利，又逢大疫；他致孙权信中还说是自己烧船退兵，让周瑜白得了名声。
ch049-red-cliffs.why: The battle that ended Cao Cao's conquest of the south and made the division of the realm possible.
ch049-red-cliffs.why_zh: 此战终结了曹操一统南方的企图，奠定了三国鼎立的基础。

people.name: Han Dang
people.role: Rescues Huang Gai from the river

story: Before the battle Zhuge Liang posts Zhao Yun in ambush at Wulin and Zhang Fei at Hulukou, but leaves Guan Yu out: he owes Cao Cao too much and would let him go. Guan Yu protests and signs a pledge on his life, and is sent to hold the Huarong road, with orders to light smoky fires on the heights to draw Cao Cao in. In his flight Cao Cao three times throws back his head and laughs at Zhou Yu and Zhuge Liang for failing to set ambushes in the obvious places; the first laugh brings out Zhao Yun, the second Zhang Fei.

At the Huarong path Cao Cao sees smoke and, sure it is a bluff, takes that road. It is deep in mud; he makes the weaker soldiers carry straw to fill it, and many are trampled to death. Just past the worst of it he laughs again, and Guan Yu bars the way with five hundred swordsmen. Cao's men are spent, and Cheng Yu advises appealing to Guan Yu's sense of obligation. Cao Cao reminds him of the five passes and of the old tale of the archer who would not kill his teacher's teacher. Guan Yu, for whom honour weighs like a mountain, turns his horse aside and lets them through. Back in camp Zhuge Liang orders his execution under the pledge, and only Liu Bei's plea saves him.

Historically: the Shanyang gong zaiji, quoted by Pei Songzhi, says that after Liu Bei burned his ships, Cao Cao retreated on foot by the Huarong road. It was so muddy and windy that the weak soldiers had to carry grass to fill it so the cavalry could pass, and many were trampled into the mud. Once clear, Cao Cao was delighted: Liu Bei is my equal, he said, but slow; had he set his fire sooner, we would all have been finished. Liu Bei did set fire to the reeds, too late. Cao Cao's laughter may echo that moment; Guan Yu's ambush and his mercy are invented.
story_zh: 赤壁战前，诸葛亮分派赵云伏于乌林、张飞伏于葫芦口，唯独不用关羽，说他受过曹操厚恩，必定放走曹操。关羽不服，立下军令状，领命去守华容道，诸葛亮还教他在高处堆柴放烟，引曹操前来。曹操败逃途中三次仰面大笑，笑周瑜、诸葛亮不懂在险要处埋伏，第一次笑出了赵云，第二次笑出了张飞。
到了华容小路，曹操见山边有烟，认定是虚张声势，偏走此路。道路泥泞，他命老弱士兵背草填路，被践踏而死者不计其数。刚出险处，曹操又大笑，话音未落，关羽率五百校刀手拦住去路。曹军人困马乏，程昱劝他以旧恩打动关羽。曹操提起当年过五关斩将之事，又讲庾公之斯不追子濯孺子的故事。关羽义重如山，终于勒马让路。回营后诸葛亮要依军令斩他，刘备求情才罢。
史实：裴注引《山阳公载记》说，曹操战船被刘备烧毁后，引军从华容道步行撤退，道路泥泞，又遇大风，只得让老弱兵背草填路，骑兵才得通过，老弱多被践踏陷死泥中。出险之后曹操大喜，说刘备与我是同一流人物，只是计谋来得稍晚，若早放火，我们就全完了。刘备随后放火，已来不及。三次大笑或许由此“大喜”而来，关羽截路、义释曹操则是虚构。
ch050-huarong.why: It pushes Guan Yu's loyalty to its limit and, in the novel, explains how Cao Cao survived the Red Cliffs.
ch050-huarong.why_zh: 这个情节把关羽的“义”推向极致，也在小说里解释了曹操为何能从赤壁生还。

quote.zh: 只为当初恩义重，放开金锁走蛟龙
quote.en: For the weight of a kindness long ago, he opened the golden lock and let the dragon go.

people.name: Guan Yu
people.role: Holds the Huarong road and lets Cao Cao go

people.name: Cheng Yu
people.role: Advises appealing to Guan Yu's honour

story: After the Red Cliffs Zhou Yu advances on Nanjun, and Liu Bei moves his troops to Youjiangkou, much to Zhou Yu's annoyance. They agree that if Wu fails to take Nanjun, Liu Bei may try. Cao Ren holds Jiangling with sealed instructions left by Cao Cao. Following them, he abandons the city as if in flight; Zhou Yu rushes in first, hidden troops rise, and a poisoned arrow strikes him in the side and knocks him from his horse.

Zhou Yu turns this to account by letting it be known that he has died of the wound. Cao Ren falls for it, raids his camp, is crushed and gives up Jiangling. But when Zhou Yu reaches the city its walls are already covered in banners, and Zhao Yun calls down that he has taken it on the strategist's orders. Zhuge Liang had seized Nanjun while the two armies fought, and used a captured tally to lure the garrisons of Jingzhou and Xiangyang out, so that Zhang Fei and Guan Yu took both cities. Zhou Yu gives a great cry, his wound bursts and he collapses; coming to, he swears he will kill the bumpkin Zhuge Liang.

Historically: the arrow is real. Zhou Yu's biography says that while facing Cao Ren he rode out to direct the fighting himself and was badly wounded by a stray arrow in the right side; when Cao Ren heard he was bedridden and came out to fight, Zhou Yu got up, toured the camps and rallied his men, and Cao Ren withdrew. After more than a year Cao Ren abandoned the city and Zhou Yu became governor of Nanjun. Liu Bei did send Guan Yu to cut the road north of Jiangling, but he did not seize the city; he obtained Nanjun the next year by 'borrowing' it from Sun Quan.
story_zh: 赤壁战后，周瑜进兵南郡，刘备也移兵油江口，周瑜十分不快，与刘备约定：东吴若取不下南郡，再任凭刘备去取。曹操留曹仁守江陵，临走留下密计。周瑜攻城时，曹仁依计弃城佯走，周瑜抢先入城，城中伏兵四起，他中了一支毒箭，翻身落马。
周瑜将计就计，诈称箭疮发作身亡，引曹仁前来劫营，大败曹军，曹仁弃城而走。周瑜赶到南郡城下，只见城上遍插旗帜，赵云高叫：我奉军师将令，已取了城池。原来诸葛亮趁两家厮杀袭取南郡，又用缴获的兵符诈调荆州、襄阳守军出城，让张飞、关羽轻取二城。周瑜大叫一声，箭疮迸裂，醒后恨道：“不杀诸葛村夫，怎息我心中怨气！”
史实：周瑜中箭确有其事。《三国志·周瑜传》载，周瑜与曹仁对峙，亲自骑马督阵，被流矢射中右胁，伤势很重；曹仁听说他卧床不起，便出兵挑战，周瑜带伤巡视军营，激励将士，曹仁只好退回。双方相持一年有余，曹仁才弃城北撤，周瑜领南郡太守。其间刘备曾派关羽截断江陵北道，但并未趁机夺城；刘备得南郡，是次年向孙权“借”来的。
ch051-first-anger.why: The first of the 'three angers', the device that turns Zhou Yu into Zhuge Liang's foil.
ch051-first-anger.why_zh: 这是“三气周瑜”的第一气，小说借此把周瑜塑造成衬托诸葛亮的对手。

quote.zh: 不杀诸葛村夫，怎息我心中怨气！
quote.en: Unless I kill that bumpkin Zhuge, how can I ever ease my rage?

people.name: Zhuge Liang
people.role: Takes the cities from under him

story: Liu Bei is taking the four commanderies south of the Yangzi. Zhang Fei and Zhao Yun have each won one, and Guan Yu volunteers to take Changsha with only five hundred swordsmen. Its governor Han Xuan is violent and quick-tempered, but he has a veteran general, Huang Zhong, nearly sixty yet a match for ten thousand men, whose arrows never miss. Guan Yu and Huang Zhong fight more than a hundred bouts without result. The next day Huang Zhong's horse stumbles and throws him; Guan Yu, instead of striking, raises his blade and tells him to go and change his horse.

Huang Zhong is moved by the mercy. On the third day Han Xuan orders him to shoot Guan Yu; he twangs his bowstring twice without an arrow, and with the third shot hits only the base of the tassel on Guan Yu's helmet, a debt repaid. Han Xuan sees that he held back, accuses him of treason and orders him beheaded. Wei Yan, long resentful of Han Xuan, rescues Huang Zhong, kills the governor and surrenders the city. Liu Bei has to call on Huang Zhong in person before he will come out. Zhuge Liang wants Wei Yan executed, saying he has a rebel's bone at the back of his skull, but Liu Bei talks him out of it.

Historically: Liu Bei's biography says the governors of all four commanderies, Han Xuan of Changsha among them, surrendered; none was killed by his own officers. Huang Zhong's biography says only that he had served Liu Biao, was placed under Han Xuan after Cao Cao took Jingzhou, and joined Liu Bei when the southern commanderies fell, following him into Shu. Wei Yan joined Liu Bei as a personal retainer, with no recorded link to Changsha. The histories give no birth year for Huang Zhong; 'old Huang Zhong' is largely the novel's creation.
story_zh: 刘备南征荆南四郡，张飞、赵云各取一郡，关羽也主动请命，只带五百校刀手去取长沙。长沙太守韩玄性情暴躁，手下老将黄忠年近六旬，有万夫不当之勇，箭法百发百中。关羽与黄忠交锋一百多回合，不分胜负。次日再战，黄忠战马失蹄，把他掀翻在地，关羽却不趁机下手，举刀喝令他快换马再来厮杀。
黄忠感念不杀之恩。第三天韩玄命他用箭射关羽，他先虚拽弓弦两次，第三箭才真的射出，正中关羽盔缨根上，以此报恩。韩玄看出他手下留情，认定他私通敌军，下令推出斩首。部将魏延早就不满韩玄，挺身救下黄忠，杀了韩玄献城投降。刘备亲自登门，才请得黄忠出来相见。诸葛亮说魏延脑后有反骨，日后必反，要斩他，刘备劝阻才罢。
史实：《三国志·先主传》说刘备南征四郡，长沙太守韩玄与武陵、桂阳、零陵三郡太守一样都是投降的，并没有被部下杀死。《黄忠传》只说他原是刘表部将，曹操得荆州后归长沙太守韩玄统属，刘备南定诸郡时归附，随刘备入蜀。魏延则是以部曲身份追随刘备，与长沙无关。史书也没有记下黄忠的生年，“老黄忠”的形象主要来自小说。
ch053-huang-zhong.why: It brings two of Shu's future generals, Huang Zhong and Wei Yan, into the story, and adds another tale of Guan Yu's chivalry.
ch053-huang-zhong.why_zh: 此回引出了黄忠、魏延两员日后的蜀汉名将，也是关羽之“义”的又一则故事。

people.name: Wei Yan
people.role: Kills Han Xuan and opens the gates

story: Liu Bei's wife Lady Gan has died, and Zhou Yu proposes a trap: Sun Quan will offer his sister in marriage, lure Liu Bei to Nanxu, and hold him hostage until Jingzhou is handed back. Zhuge Liang sees through it and plays along, sending Zhao Yun as escort with three silk pouches of instructions. Following the first, Liu Bei calls on Lord Qiao as soon as he arrives, and has his men, dressed in festive red, buy wedding goods all over the town, until everyone knows the Imperial Uncle has come to be married.

Lord Qiao goes to congratulate the Dowager Wu, whom Sun Quan honours as his mother, and so she learns that her son has used her daughter as bait. She berates Sun Quan and Zhou Yu and insists on seeing the groom herself. At a banquet in Ganlu Temple, Sun Quan hides swordsmen in the side galleries, ready to act if she disapproves. But she is charmed by Liu Bei's bearing, and Lord Qiao sings his praises. When Zhao Yun spots the hidden men and warns Liu Bei, he kneels weeping before the old lady and offers his life; furious, she orders the swordsmen away and confirms the match. The sham has become real.

Historically: Sun Quan did give his sister to Liu Bei. Liu Bei's biography says that as Liu Bei's power grew, Sun Quan grew wary and sent his sister to strengthen their ties. Fa Zheng's biography describes her as quick and fierce like her brothers, attended by over a hundred maids who all stood guard with swords, so that Liu Bei went in to her with a chill in his heart. Zhou Yu did urge Sun Quan to keep Liu Bei in Wu and soften him with palaces and beauties, but that was when Liu Bei later visited Jingkou, and Sun Quan refused. Sun Quan's mother had died in 202, the novel's Dowager Wu is not in the histories, and the scene at Ganlu Temple is fiction.
story_zh: 刘备的甘夫人去世，周瑜向孙权献计：假称要把孙权之妹嫁给刘备，骗他到南徐成亲，再扣作人质，逼刘备交还荆州。诸葛亮看破却将计就计，派赵云护送刘备过江，交给赵云三个锦囊。依第一个锦囊，刘备一到南徐就去拜见乔国老，又让随行军士披红挂彩，满城购买婚礼用品，弄得人人都知道刘皇叔来招亲。
乔国老入府向吴国太道喜，吴国太这才知道儿子拿女儿做诱饵，痛骂孙权与周瑜，执意要亲自相看。次日在甘露寺设宴，孙权暗中在两廊埋伏刀斧手，只等国太不中意就动手。国太见刘备仪表不凡，十分欢喜，乔国老也在旁称赞。赵云察觉廊下伏兵，告知刘备，刘备跪在国太席前哭诉请死，国太大怒，喝退伏兵，亲口许下婚事，假戏就此成真。
史实：孙权确实把妹妹嫁给了刘备，《三国志·先主传》说刘备势力渐大，孙权有所畏惧，便“进妹固好”。《法正传》说孙夫人刚猛有诸兄之风，侍婢百余人都执刀侍立，刘备每次入内都心存戒惧。周瑜也确曾上疏主张把刘备留在吴地，用宫室美女消磨其志，但那是刘备后来亲到京口时的事，孙权没有采纳。孙权之母吴夫人已于202年去世，小说中的吴国太不见于史书，甘露寺相亲是虚构的。
ch054-ganlu-temple.why: A comic episode in which Zhou Yu's trap backfires; behind it lies a real political marriage meant to bind the alliance.
ch054-ganlu-temple.why_zh: 周瑜的美人计弄假成真，是小说中最富喜剧色彩的段落之一，背后则是一桩真实的政治联姻。

quote.zh: 周郎妙计安天下，陪了夫人又折兵
quote.en: Master Zhou's brilliant plan to settle the realm: he gave away a bride and lost his troops besides.

people.name: Dowager Wu
people.role: Sun Quan's mother in the novel, approves the match
people.role_zh: 小说中孙权之母，相中女婿

story: Liu Bei escapes back to Jingzhou with Lady Sun; Zhou Yu pursues, runs into an ambush and hears the soldiers on the bank chanting that his brilliant plan has cost him a bride and his troops besides. His wound bursts open: the second anger. Lu Su keeps coming to ask for Jingzhou, and Liu Bei, coached by Zhuge Liang, only weeps and promises to return it once he has taken Xichuan. So Zhou Yu devises a plan: Wu will conquer Xichuan on Liu Bei's behalf, and when the army passes Jingzhou and Liu Bei comes out with provisions, it will seize the city.

Zhuge Liang recognises the old ruse of 'borrowing a road to destroy Guo' and pretends to agree. When Zhou Yu reaches Jingzhou the walls bristle with banners and Zhao Yun demands to know his real purpose; scouts report four armies under Guan Yu, Zhang Fei, Huang Zhong and Wei Yan closing in, all shouting to take Zhou Yu alive. Zhou Yu cries out, his wound opens again and he falls from his horse. At Baqiu a letter of advice arrives from Zhuge Liang. Knowing he is dying, Zhou Yu writes to Sun Quan recommending Lu Su, then looks up to Heaven: 'Since you made Zhou Yu, why make Zhuge Liang too!' He cries it several times and dies, aged thirty-six.

Historically: Zhou Yu did die at Baqiu at thirty-six, but while preparing a real Wu campaign against Yizhou. His biography says he went to Jingkou to propose that he and Sun Yu take Shu and ally with Ma Chao, and died on the road while returning to Jiangling to prepare; on his deathbed he recommended Lu Su. Sun Quan put on mourning and went to Wuhu to meet the coffin. The Records calls him broad-minded and well liked, and Cheng Pu said that knowing him was like drinking fine wine: you grew drunk without noticing. The three angers and the dying cry are the novel's.
story_zh: 刘备携孙夫人逃回荆州，周瑜追赶中伏，岸上军士齐喊“周郎妙计安天下，陪了夫人又折兵”，气得他箭疮迸裂，这是第二气。此后鲁肃屡次来讨荆州，刘备依诸葛亮的安排只是痛哭，答应取了西川便还。周瑜于是定计：东吴以替刘备攻取西川为名，大军路过荆州时向刘备索要钱粮，趁他出城劳军，一举夺下荆州。
诸葛亮一眼看破这是“假途灭虢”之计，假意应承。周瑜率军来到荆州城下，城上遍插旗帜，赵云质问他此行究竟为何；探马接连来报，关羽、张飞、黄忠、魏延四路兵马杀来，都喊要活捉周瑜。周瑜大叫一声，箭疮复裂，坠于马下。退到巴丘，诸葛亮又送来书信。周瑜自知不起，写信向孙权举荐鲁肃，仰天长叹：“既生瑜，何生亮！”连叫数声而亡，年仅三十六岁。
史实：周瑜确实病死于巴丘，年三十六岁，但当时他正为东吴真的西取益州做准备。据《三国志·周瑜传》，他到京口向孙权提议与孙瑜一同取蜀，再结援马超，回江陵整装途中病逝，临终举荐鲁肃。孙权身穿素服举哀，亲到芜湖迎接灵柩。史书说他“性度恢廓，大率为得人”，程普曾说与他交往“若饮醇醪，不觉自醉”。三气和临终长叹都是小说的安排。
ch056-zhou-yu-dies.why: Zhou Yu's death ends the novel's great rivalry and hands Wu's direction to Lu Su; his dying cry became proverbial.
ch056-zhou-yu-dies.why_zh: 周瑜之死结束了小说中最著名的一段斗智，“既生瑜，何生亮”也成了千古名句。

quote.zh: 既生瑜，何生亮！
quote.en: Since you made Zhou Yu, why make Zhuge Liang too!

people.name: Zhou Yu
people.role: Wu commander who dies at Baqiu

people.name: Zhuge Liang
people.role: His rival who foils the plan

story: In Jingzhou Zhuge Liang watches the night sky, sees a general's star fall and laughs: Zhou Yu is dead. He decides to go and mourn him in person. Liu Bei fears Wu will kill him, but Zhuge Liang says he was not afraid of Zhou Yu alive, still less now, and sets off for Chaisang with Zhao Yun, five hundred men and offerings. Wu's generals, who blame him for their commander's death, want to kill him, but with Zhao Yun at his side, hand on sword, nobody dares.

Before the coffin Zhuge Liang lays out the offerings, pours the libation himself and kneels to read a eulogy that begins 'Alas, Gongjin, taken so young!' and recounts Zhou Yu's achievements. Then he throws himself down weeping, tears gushing like a spring. Wu's generals tell each other that everyone said the two men were enemies, but such grief proves it was all gossip, and Lu Su decides Zhou Yu brought his death on himself by his narrowness. At the river someone grabs Zhuge Liang and laughs: you drove Zhou Yu to his death and now come to mourn him; do you think Wu has no one with eyes? It is Pang Tong. Zhuge Liang leaves him a letter inviting him to serve Liu Bei.

Historically: there is no record of Zhuge Liang mourning Zhou Yu, and the Records hardly shows the two men dealing with each other at all. The man from Jingzhou who really took Zhou Yu's coffin to Wu was Pang Tong: his biography says he escorted the body, the people of Wu knew his name, and when he left, Lu Ji, Gu Shao and Quan Cong all came to see him off. Pang Tong later joined Liu Bei; Lu Su wrote that he was 'no talent for a hundred-li county', and Zhuge Liang recommended him too.
story_zh: 诸葛亮在荆州夜观天象，见将星坠地，笑说周瑜死了。他决定亲往江东吊丧，刘备怕东吴加害，诸葛亮说周瑜在世时尚且不怕，如今更无所惧，便带赵云和五百军士，备好祭礼来到柴桑。东吴诸将都恨他气死了都督，想要杀他，见赵云按剑相随，才不敢动手。
诸葛亮在周瑜灵前设下祭品，亲自奠酒，跪地读祭文，历数周瑜一生功业，读罢伏地大哭，泪如泉涌，哀恸不已。东吴众将议论说：人人都说公瑾与孔明不和，看他祭奠时的真情，原来都是虚言。鲁肃也觉得是周瑜气量狭窄，自取其死。祭毕回到江边，诸葛亮被一人揪住，笑他气死周郎又来吊孝，欺东吴无人，原来是庞统。诸葛亮留下书信，邀他日后到荆州共扶刘备。
史实：史书中没有诸葛亮吊丧的记载，《三国志》里也几乎看不到诸葛亮与周瑜直接往来的记录。真正护送周瑜灵柩回吴的倒是庞统：《庞统传》说周瑜死后，庞统送丧至吴，吴人多闻其名，临别时陆绩、顾劭、全琮等都来送行。庞统后来归附刘备，鲁肃写信说他“非百里才也”，诸葛亮也向刘备举荐他。
ch057-mourning-zhou-yu.why: The mourning shows Zhuge Liang's political finesse in keeping the alliance alive, and it brings Pang Tong over to Liu Bei.
ch057-mourning-zhou-yu.why_zh: 卧龙吊丧显示了诸葛亮维系孙刘联盟的政治手腕，也顺势引出庞统投奔刘备。

quote.zh: 呜呼公瑾，不幸夭亡！
quote.en: Alas, Gongjin, taken so young!

story: Ma Chao and Han Sui have taken Tong Pass, and Cao Cao comes in person to fight them. Ma Chao, in white robe and silver armour, beats several of Cao's officers and charges straight at the centre, throwing Cao's army into confusion. The Xiliang troops shout: 'The one in the red robe is Cao Cao!' Cao Cao tears off his red robe. Then: 'The one with the long beard is Cao Cao!' He hacks off his beard with his sword. Then: 'The one with the short beard is Cao Cao!' He wraps a corner of a banner round his chin and flees. Ma Chao's spear thrust lodges in a tree, and Cao Hong arrives in time to save him.

Later Cao Cao sends his army across the river while he sits on the south bank as rearguard, and Ma Chao swoops down with arrows falling like rain. Xu Chu bundles Cao Cao into a ferry; when the boatman is shot dead, Xu Chu holds up a saddle in his left hand to shield Cao Cao and poles the boat across the current with his right. On the hills, Ding Fei, the magistrate of Weinan, turns loose his cattle and horses, and the Xiliang troops stop to grab them instead of pursuing, so Cao Cao gets away.

Historically: the narrow escape at the crossing is real. Xu Chu's biography says that as the army crossed north, Cao Cao stayed on the south bank as rearguard with Xu Chu and a hundred-odd guards; Ma Chao came on with over ten thousand foot and horse, and arrows fell like rain. Xu Chu helped him into the boat, cut down men clinging to its sides, held up a saddle in his left hand to protect him, and when the boatman was killed, poled the boat with his right. The Cao Man zhuan, quoted by Pei Songzhi, adds that Ding Fei released cattle and horses as bait, and that once safe Cao Cao laughed that the little rebel had nearly trapped him. The robe and the beard are the novel's.
story_zh: 马超、韩遂攻下潼关，曹操亲率大军来战。阵前马超白袍银铠，连败曹军数将，挺枪直冲中军，曹军大乱。西凉兵齐声大喊：“穿红袍的是曹操！”曹操慌忙脱下红袍；又听得喊“长髯者是曹操！”他急忙拔剑割去胡须；又有人喊“短髯者是曹操！”他只得扯下旗角包住下巴逃命。马超一枪刺去，扎在树上，曹操才得逃脱，幸好曹洪赶来救驾。
后来曹操分兵渡河，自己坐在南岸断后，马超率兵杀到，箭如雨下。许褚扶曹操跳上渡船，船工中箭身亡，许褚左手举马鞍为曹操遮挡箭矢，右手撑篙，在激流中把船撑向对岸。渭南县令丁斐在山上望见，把寨中牛马尽数放出，西凉兵争抢牛马，无心追赶，曹操这才脱身。
史实：渡河遇险确有其事。《三国志·许褚传》记载，曹操渡河时只与许褚和虎士百余人留在南岸断后，马超率步骑万余赶来，矢下如雨；许褚扶曹操上船，砍杀攀船者，左手举马鞍为他挡箭，船工中箭而死，许褚又用右手撑船，才得渡河。裴注引《曹瞒传》还说丁斐放牛马诱敌，曹操脱险后大笑：“今日几为小贼所困乎！”割须弃袍则是小说的渲染。
ch058-cuts-his-beard.why: One of Cao Cao's narrowest escapes, and the scene that shows off both Ma Chao's ferocity and Xu Chu's devotion.
ch058-cuts-his-beard.why_zh: 这是曹操一生最狼狈的时刻之一，也展现了马超的勇猛和许褚的忠勇。

quote.zh: 穿红袍的是曹操！
quote.en: The one in the red robe is Cao Cao!

story: Planning a campaign against Sun Quan but fearing Ma Teng in the northwest, Cao Cao summons him to the capital by imperial decree, supposedly to join the war in the south. Ma Teng comes to Xudu with his sons Ma Xiu and Ma Tie and his nephew Ma Dai, and plots with the court official Huang Kui to kill Cao Cao, but the plot leaks from Huang Kui's household. Ma Teng and his two sons are executed; only Ma Dai escapes.

In Xiliang Ma Chao dreams he is lying in the snow while tigers attack him; as he puzzles over it, Ma Dai arrives with the news, and Ma Chao collapses weeping. Cao Cao writes to Han Sui offering him a marquisate if he will seize Ma Chao, but Han Sui hands the letter to Ma Chao and joins him instead. With two hundred thousand Xiliang troops they march on Chang'an, take it by a ruse and press on to Tong Pass. Cao Cao sends Cao Hong and Xu Huang to hold the pass for ten days, but Cao Hong cannot bear the Xiliang soldiers' insults, sallies out and loses it, and Cao Cao must march west himself.

Historically: cause and effect run the other way. Ma Teng had answered a summons to court back in 208, becoming Commandant of the Guards, and his family moved to Ye, while Ma Chao kept command of his troops. In 211, when Cao Cao sent Zhong Yao against Zhang Lu in Hanzhong, the Guanzhong warlords suspected they were the real target, and Ma Chao, Han Sui and others rose together. The Weilue, quoted by Pei Songzhi, has Ma Chao telling Han Sui that he now abandoned his father and took Han Sui as his father: he knew what he was risking. In the fifth month of 212 Cao Cao executed Ma Teng and his whole clan.
story_zh: 曹操想南征孙权，又怕西凉马腾袭其后方，便以天子诏命召马腾入京，假称让他征讨东吴。马腾带着儿子马休、马铁和侄子马岱来到许都，与侍郎黄奎密谋除掉曹操，却因黄奎家中走漏消息而事败。马腾父子三人被杀，只有马岱逃脱。
马超在西凉梦见自己卧在雪地，群虎来咬，正在疑虑，马岱逃回报信，马超哭倒在地。曹操又写信给韩遂，许他若擒马超便封西凉侯，韩遂却把信交给马超，与他一同起兵。马超、韩遂领西凉兵二十万杀奔长安，用计夺城，又直取潼关。曹操派曹洪、徐晃守关十日，曹洪受不住西凉兵辱骂，出关厮杀，潼关失守，曹操只得亲率大军西征。
史实：因果正好相反。马腾早在208年就应召入朝任卫尉，家属迁居邺城，西凉兵马由马超统领。211年曹操派钟繇讨伐汉中张鲁，关中诸将疑心是冲着自己来的，马超便与韩遂等人联合起兵。据裴注引《魏略》，马超曾对韩遂说“今超弃父，以将军为父”，可见他明知父亲在曹操手中。次年五月，曹操诛杀马腾，夷灭三族。
ch058-ma-chao-rises.why: Ma Chao's rising opens Cao Cao's war for Guanzhong; the novel reverses cause and effect to make him a filial avenger.
ch058-ma-chao-rises.why_zh: 马超起兵揭开了曹操平定关中之战，小说颠倒因果，把他写成为父报仇的孝子。

people.name: Ma Chao
people.role: Xiliang commander who rises in revolt

people.name: Ma Teng
people.role: His father, killed by Cao Cao

people.name: Han Sui
people.role: Ma Teng's sworn brother and Ma Chao's ally
people.role_zh: 马腾结义兄弟，马超盟友

people.name: Cao Cao
people.role: Kills Ma Teng and marches west

story: Beaten again and again along the Wei, Cao Cao had only just got across the river and built a fortified camp, and Xu Chu had fought Ma Chao stripped to the waist. Even so, Ma Chao and Han Sui sued for peace, offering land in return for a truce. Jia Xu advised pretending to agree and then setting the two allies against each other. So Cao Cao asked Han Sui to meet him between the lines. With their horses' heads side by side, Cao Cao talked only of their old days in the capital, clapping his hands and laughing, and never said a word about the war.

When Ma Chao asked what had been said, Han Sui answered that it was nothing but old times, and Ma Chao grew suspicious. Next Cao Cao sent Han Sui a letter blotted and altered at all the key points. Ma Chao demanded to see it and decided that Han Sui had changed it himself to hide something. Han Sui offered to lure Cao Cao out the next day so Ma Chao could kill him, but Cao Cao sent Cao Hong instead, who called out a vague message of thanks for 'what the general said last night' and rode off. Furious, Ma Chao turned on Han Sui; when Han Sui secretly planned to go over to Cao Cao, Ma Chao burst into his tent and cut off his left hand. With the allies at each other's throats, Cao Cao routed them, and Ma Chao fled back to Longxi with Pang De, Ma Dai and a handful of riders.

The core of the story is in the Annals of Emperor Wu in the Records: Cao Cao had been nominated for office in the same year as Han Sui's father, and the two men talked on horseback for a long while about old friends in the capital, never touching on the war. Afterwards Cao Cao sent a letter 'with many crossings-out, as if Han Sui had corrected it', and Ma Chao's suspicions deepened. Jia Xu's biography credits him with the advice to split the allies. The severed hand is the novel's: in fact Han Sui fled back to Liangzhou, and in 215 local commanders sent his head to Cao Cao.
story_zh: 曹操在渭水一带屡战屡败，好不容易才渡过渭水、筑起营寨，又有许褚赤膊大战马超。马超、韩遂仍想议和，愿割地罢兵。贾诩献计：假意应允，再用反间之计，让韩、马二人互相猜疑。曹操便约韩遂阵前相见，两人马头相交，曹操只谈当年同在京城的旧事，说到高兴处抚掌大笑，对军情却一字不提。
马超问韩遂谈了什么，韩遂说只叙旧事，马超已然起疑。曹操又送去一封书信，故意在要紧处涂抹改动，马超看后认定是韩遂心中有鬼、自己改过。韩遂约曹操次日出阵，想让马超当场刺杀，曹操却只派曹洪出来含糊道谢一句便回。马超大怒，与韩遂翻脸；韩遂暗中谋划降曹，马超闯入帐中砍下他的左手。联军内讧，曹操趁势大破西凉兵，马超只带庞德、马岱等数十骑逃回陇西。
故事的主干见于《三国志·武帝纪》：曹操与韩遂之父是同年举孝廉，与韩遂也是同辈旧识，两人交马长谈，只说京都旧事，不及军事；之后曹操又给韩遂写信，“多所点窜，如遂改定者”，马超等人愈加怀疑。《贾诩传》说离间之策出自贾诩。砍手一节是小说添的，韩遂其实随马超退回凉州，215年才被当地诸将斩首送给曹操。
ch059-blotted-letter.why: One friendly chat and one smudged letter broke the northwestern alliance and gave Cao Cao the Guanzhong region, a textbook case of divide and rule.
ch059-blotted-letter.why_zh: 一次叙旧、一封涂改的书信便瓦解了西凉联军，曹操由此平定关中，是反间计的经典范例。

people.name: Han Sui
people.role: Ma Chao's ally and Cao Cao's old acquaintance

story: Afraid of Zhang Lu, Liu Zhang sent his aide Zhang Song to the capital to ask Cao Cao to strike Hanzhong, and Zhang Song secretly took along a map of the west. He was an ugly little man, and Cao Cao, proud after beating Ma Chao, received him coldly. Yang Xiu showed him Cao Cao's new book on war; Zhang Song recited it after a single reading and claimed it was an old anonymous text every child in Shu knew, so Cao Cao burned it. When Cao Cao paraded his troops to impress him, Zhang Song listed his defeats to his face and was beaten out of the camp.

Zhang Song went home by way of Jingzhou. Zhao Yun met him at the border, Guan Yu feasted him at the post house, and Liu Bei came out with Zhuge Liang and Pang Tong to welcome him. For three days they entertained him without a word about Shu. When Liu Bei saw him off at the ten-li pavilion, Zhang Song was moved: he urged Liu Bei to take Yizhou, drew the map from his sleeve and named his friends Fa Zheng and Meng Da as allies inside. Back in Chengdu, he talked Liu Zhang into inviting Liu Bei, and Fa Zheng was sent as envoy.

Historically: Liu Zhang's biography says Zhang Song went to Cao Cao in 208, just after Cao Cao took Jingzhou, and was ignored; resentful, he came home, ran Cao Cao down and urged Liu Zhang to turn to Liu Bei instead. The envoy who went to Liu Bei, twice, was Fa Zheng. A note from a Shu local history says Yang Xiu admired Zhang Song and showed him Cao Cao's book on war, which he memorised over wine at one reading; the novel grows its scene from that. The handing over of the map is not recorded, though the Wu shu cited in the notes says that Zhang Song and Fa Zheng told Liu Bei all about Shu and drew him its mountains and rivers.
story_zh: 刘璋惧怕张鲁，别驾张松自请出使许都，请曹操出兵攻打汉中，暗中带上西川地图。张松相貌丑陋，曹操刚破马超，骄气正盛，对他十分冷淡。杨修拿曹操所著兵书给他看，张松看一遍就背了出来，还说这是蜀中小儿都会背的古书，曹操气得把书烧了。曹操阅兵示威，张松当面历数他的败仗，被乱棒打了出去。
张松转道荆州。赵云在边界迎接，关羽在驿馆设宴，刘备带着诸葛亮、庞统亲自出迎，一连款待三日，只叙交情，绝口不提西川。临别时刘备送到十里长亭，张松大为感动，劝刘备取蜀，从袖中取出地图献上，又推荐好友法正、孟达为内应。回到成都，他便力劝刘璋请刘备入川，派法正前往联络。
史实：据《三国志·刘璋传》，张松是在208年曹操刚取荆州时出使的，曹操未加礼遇，张松怀恨，回去后劝刘璋改结刘备；前后奉命去见刘备的是法正。裴注引《益部耆旧杂记》说杨修赏识张松，拿曹操兵书给他看，他宴饮间看一遍便能暗诵，小说即由此生发。献图一事正史无载，只有裴注引《吴书》说张松、法正曾向刘备详述蜀中虚实，并画出山川地形。
ch060-zhang-song-map.why: The map opens the road west: from here Liu Bei's move on Yizhou, the second half of the Longzhong plan, begins.
ch060-zhang-song-map.why_zh: 西川图一献，刘备取益州的门户就此打开，隆中对的后半篇开始落地。

quote.zh: 割须弃袍于潼关，夺船避箭于渭水
quote.en: You cut off your beard and threw away your robe at Tong Pass, and grabbed a boat to dodge arrows on the Wei.

people.name: Fa Zheng
people.role: Zhang Song's friend, envoy to Liu Bei

story: Once Liu Zhang decided to invite Liu Bei in against Zhang Lu, his officers fought it hard. Huang Quan clung to his robe with his teeth until two of them were torn out; Wang Lei hung himself upside down from the city gate to protest and, when that failed, cut the rope and fell to his death. Liu Bei hesitated too: Cao Cao was harsh, brutal and devious, he said, so he must be generous, humane and honest, and he would not break faith for a small gain. Only when Pang Tong argued that a state seized by force can still be ruled justly did he set out, leaving Zhuge Liang to hold Jingzhou.

Liu Zhang came in person to Fu to meet him, and the two kinsmen got on warmly. Pang Tong and Fa Zheng urged Liu Bei to seize Liu Zhang at the banquet; he refused, saying he had only just arrived and had won no one's trust. Pang Tong then had Wei Yan perform a sword dance as cover for an attack, but Liu Zhang's general Zhang Ren saw through it and drew his sword to dance opposite, and officers on both sides leapt up. Liu Bei drew his own sword and shouted them down: this was a reunion of brothers, not the Feast at Hongmen. Afterwards Liu Zhang gave him more troops and sent him north to Jiameng to guard against Zhang Lu.

The Records says Liu Zhang came to Fu with over thirty thousand horse and foot, his carriages and tents glittering in the sun, and the two feasted for more than a hundred days. Zhang Song, through Fa Zheng, and Pang Tong both urged Liu Bei to seize Liu Zhang at the meeting; he replied that it was too great a matter to rush. At Jiameng he did not move against Zhang Lu but spent his time winning local loyalty. His 'Cao Cao is harsh, I am generous' speech comes from the Jiuzhou chunqiu cited in the notes.
story_zh: 刘璋决意请刘备入川抵御张鲁，部下纷纷苦谏：黄权咬住刘璋衣襟不放，被扯落两颗门牙；王累把自己倒吊在城门上进谏，见劝不住，割断绳索摔死。刘备也犹豫，说曹操以急、以暴、以谲，自己以宽、以仁、以忠，处处与曹操相反才能成事，不忍为小利失信于天下。庞统以“逆取顺守”相劝，他才留诸葛亮守荆州，领兵西进。
刘璋亲到涪城迎接，两人相见甚欢。庞统、法正劝刘备在席间擒杀刘璋，刘备说初入蜀中、恩信未立，坚决不许。庞统便让魏延借舞剑助兴、伺机下手，蜀将张任看出端倪，也拔剑对舞，双方将领纷纷起身。刘备拔剑喝止，说兄弟相逢痛饮，又不是鸿门宴，何必舞剑，一场危机才化解。此后刘璋增拨兵马，请刘备北上葭萌关防备张鲁。
据《三国志·先主传》，刘璋率步骑三万余人到涪城相会，车乘帐幔光彩耀日，两人欢饮百余日。张松让法正转告，庞统也进言，都劝刘备在会上袭取刘璋，刘备答：“此大事也，不可仓卒。”他北到葭萌后并不急于讨伐张鲁，而是广施恩德、收揽人心。“操以急，吾以宽”那番话出自裴注所引《九州春秋》。
ch060-liu-bei-enters-shu.why: Liu Bei enters Yizhou as an invited guest, the first step toward the state that would become Shu Han.
ch060-liu-bei-enters-shu.why_zh: 刘备以客军身份进入益州，迈出了建立蜀汉基业的第一步。

quote.zh: 操以急，吾以宽；操以暴，吾以仁；操以谲，吾以忠
quote.en: Cao Cao is harsh, so I am lenient; he is cruel, so I am kind; he is crafty, so I am true.

people.name: Wei Yan
people.role: Dances with the sword at the feast

story: With Liu Bei far away in Shu, Sun Quan and Zhang Zhao laid a plan. Zhou Shan and five hundred men, disguised as merchants, carried a letter to Lady Sun saying her mother was dying and she must come home at once, bringing the boy A Dou, who could then be traded for Jingzhou. Lady Sun believed it, took the child aboard without telling anyone and set sail downriver.

Zhao Yun, back from patrol, heard the news and rode along the bank with a few horsemen, seized a fishing boat, caught up with the ship and leapt aboard with his spear. He forced his way into the cabin and told Lady Sun that she might go if she wished, but the young master stayed; then he took A Dou from her arms. As they faced each other, Zhang Fei came up with a flotilla and blocked the river, cut Zhou Shan down and threw his head at Lady Sun's feet. The two generals let her sail on to Wu and carried A Dou home.

The episode is in the Zhao Yun biezhuan cited in the notes: when Liu Bei went into Yizhou he put Zhao Yun in charge of his household, because Lady Sun, proud of being Sun Quan's sister, kept many Wu officers and soldiers who did as they pleased. When Sun Quan sent ships to fetch her, she tried to take the heir with her, and Zhao Yun and Zhang Fei blocked the river and got him back. Zhou Shan and the false letter are the novel's; Sun Quan's mother had in fact died years before. The histories never show Lady Sun at Liu Bei's side again.
story_zh: 刘备入川后，孙权见荆州空虚，便与张昭定计：派周善带五百人扮作商人，持书去见孙夫人，谎称吴国太病危，要她速归，并把阿斗一起带回，好拿来换荆州。孙夫人信以为真，瞒着众人抱着阿斗登船，扬帆东下。
赵云巡哨回来得知消息，带着几名骑兵沿江追赶，夺了一只渔船追上大船，提枪跃上船头。他闯进舱中，对孙夫人说主母要走可以，小主人却必须留下，一把从她怀中夺过阿斗。正相持间，张飞率船队赶到截住江面，一剑斩了周善，把首级掷在孙夫人面前。二人放孙夫人回吴，抱着阿斗回到荆州。
此事见于裴注引《赵云别传》：刘备入益州，让赵云掌管内事，因为孙夫人仗着是孙权之妹，骄横不法，带来的东吴吏兵也多横行。孙权派船来接妹妹，夫人想带后主回吴，赵云与张飞勒兵截江，才把后主夺回。周善和国太病危的假信是小说添的，孙权之母其实早已去世。此后史书再未见孙夫人回到刘备身边。
ch061-river-rescue.why: It saves Liu Bei's only son and heir, and in effect ends the marriage that had sealed the Sun-Liu alliance.
ch061-river-rescue.why_zh: 这一截保住了刘备唯一的子嗣，也让维系孙刘联盟的这桩婚姻实际上走到了尽头。

people.name: Lady Sun
people.role: Liu Bei's wife, Sun Quan's sister

people.name: Zhang Fei
people.role: Blocks the river with his boats

story: After Liu Bei broke with Liu Zhang, his army closed on Luo. Zhuge Liang sent a letter from Jingzhou: he had watched the stars, Venus stood over the region of Luo, and the omens were bad for the commanders, so Liu Bei should take care. Pang Tong took it as jealousy, Zhuge Liang trying to keep him from winning Shu alone, and insisted on advancing. Liu Bei then dreamed that a spirit struck his right arm with an iron club, but Pang Tong would not wait.

As they set out, Pang Tong's horse stumbled and threw him, so Liu Bei gave him his own white horse. They split up, Liu Bei on the main road and Pang Tong on the narrow one. In a cramped, overgrown pass Pang Tong asked the name of the place: Fallen Phoenix Slope. His own sobriquet was 'Young Phoenix', and he ordered an immediate retreat, but arrows were already pouring down. Zhang Ren had told his archers that the rider on the white horse was Liu Bei. Pang Tong died under the arrows at thirty-six.

Historically: Pang Tong's biography says only that while Liu Bei besieged Luo, Pang Tong led an assault on the walls and was killed by a stray arrow, aged thirty-six. Liu Bei wept whenever he spoke of him and gave him a posthumous marquisate. The siege of Luo dragged on for nearly a year, and Zhuge Liang came upriver into Shu with Zhang Fei and Zhao Yun. The borrowed horse, the dream and the ill-omened name are the novel's. A shrine and tomb of Pang Tong stand at Baima Pass in Luojiang today.
story_zh: 刘备与刘璋翻脸后，大军进逼雒城。诸葛亮从荆州来信，说夜观天象，太白临于雒城分野，主将帅多凶少吉，劝刘备谨慎。庞统以为诸葛亮怕他独占取川之功，故意阻拦，执意进兵。刘备又梦见神人用铁棒击他右臂，心中不安，庞统仍不肯停。
临行时庞统的坐骑失蹄把他掀下马来，刘备便把自己的白马换给他。两人分兵，刘备走大路，庞统走小路。行至一处山势逼仄、林木丛杂的地方，庞统问地名，军士答是落凤坡。庞统道号凤雏，大惊之下急令后退，话音未落，箭如雨下。原来张任早有吩咐：骑白马的就是刘备，只管放箭。庞统死于乱箭之中，年仅三十六岁。
史实：《三国志·庞统传》只载刘备围攻雒县，庞统率众攻城，被流矢射中而死，年三十六。刘备痛惜不已，一说起他就流泪，追赐关内侯，谥靖侯。雒城被围近一年才攻下，其间诸葛亮与张飞、赵云溯江入蜀。换马、梦兆和落凤坡之名都出自小说；今德阳罗江白马关有庞统祠墓。
ch063-pang-tong-dies.why: Liu Bei loses the 'Young Phoenix', and Zhuge Liang has to leave Jingzhou for the west, leaving Guan Yu to hold it alone.
ch063-pang-tong-dies.why_zh: 刘备失去了与卧龙齐名的“凤雏”，诸葛亮只得离开荆州入川，荆州重担从此落在关羽一人肩上。

quote.zh: 吾道号凤雏，此处名落凤坡，不利于吾
quote.en: They call me the Young Phoenix, and this place is called Fallen Phoenix Slope. It bodes ill for me.

people.name: Zhang Ren
people.role: Liu Zhang's general who lays the ambush

story: After Pang Tong's death, Zhuge Liang left Guan Yu in Jingzhou and led Zhang Fei and Zhao Yun into Shu by separate roads. He warned Zhang Fei that Shu had many able men, that he must not underrate them, must keep his troops from plundering and must stop flogging his soldiers. At Ba the old general Yan Yan shut his gates and would not come out however much Zhang Fei's men cursed him, and an arrow from the walls even struck Zhang Fei's helmet.

So Zhang Fei used a trick. He let Yan Yan's spies overhear that he would slip past Ba by a back road at night. Yan Yan laid an ambush there and fell on the baggage train, but the 'Zhang Fei' leading it was a double, and the real one came up behind and took him alive. Brought before Zhang Fei, Yan Yan refused to kneel and said Shu had generals who lose their heads, not generals who surrender. Ordered to execution, he only said: cut, then, why the temper? Zhang Fei's anger turned to admiration; he untied him himself, put a robe on him, seated him in the place of honour and bowed. Won over, Yan Yan persuaded the commanders of every pass ahead to give way, and Zhang Fei reached Luo almost without a fight.

The exchange is in Zhang Fei's biography in the Records: Zhang Fei defeated and captured Yan Yan, the governor of Ba, at Jiangzhou, and asked why he had resisted. Yan Yan said Liu Bei's men had invaded his province without cause, and that his province had generals who lost their heads but none who surrendered. Unmoved when led off to be beheaded, he asked why Zhang Fei was so angry; Zhang Fei, impressed, freed him and treated him as an honoured guest. The Huayang guozhi adds that when Liu Zhang invited Liu Bei in, Yan Yan beat his breast and called it letting a tiger loose to guard oneself. The ruse and the surrendering passes are the novel's.
story_zh: 庞统死后，诸葛亮留关羽守荆州，与张飞、赵云分路入川。临行前他叮嘱张飞：西川豪杰甚多，不可轻敌；沿途要约束三军，不许掳掠百姓，也不可再鞭打士卒。到了巴郡，老将严颜据城坚守，任凭张飞部下百般辱骂，就是不肯出战，城上一箭还射中了张飞的头盔。
张飞改用计谋，故意让严颜的探子听到他要趁夜从小路绕过巴郡。严颜在小路设伏劫粮，不料押车的“张飞”是假扮的，真张飞从背后杀到，将他生擒。严颜挺立不跪，说“但有断头将军，无降将军”，张飞喝令斩首，他面不改色，只说砍头便砍，何必发怒。张飞转怒为喜，亲自为他解缚，请上座下拜。严颜感其义气归降，沿途招降各处关隘，张飞几乎兵不血刃直抵雒城。
这段对答见于《三国志·张飞传》：张飞在江州生擒巴郡太守严颜，呵问为何不降，严颜答“我州但有断头将军，无有降将军也”；张飞令左右拉出斩首，严颜面不改色，说“斫头便斫头，何为怒邪”，张飞敬其壮烈，释放了他，引为宾客。《华阳国志》还载，刘璋迎刘备时，严颜曾拍胸叹息，说这是“独坐穷山，放虎自卫”。诱敌之计与沿途招降则是小说的铺陈。
ch063-yan-yan.why: Zhang Fei shows he can win men as well as battles, and a defiant enemy becomes his guide into Shu.
ch063-yan-yan.why_zh: 张飞粗中有细、以义服人，一位宁死不降的老将从此成了入川的向导。

quote.zh: 但有断头将军，无降将军！
quote.en: Here there are generals who lose their heads, but no generals who surrender!

people.name: Zhang Fei
people.role: Liu Bei's general advancing into Shu

story: Once Ma Chao had come over, Liu Bei sent him to the walls of Chengdu. Ma Chao called up to Liu Zhang that Zhang Lu had listened to slander and tried to kill him, that he now served Liu Bei, and that Liu Zhang should surrender rather than let the people suffer. At the sight of him Liu Zhang went grey and collapsed on the wall. When he came round he sighed that he and his father had ruled Shu for over twenty years without doing the people any good, and that three years of fighting had left their flesh and blood in the fields; it was all his fault, and he would surrender to give them peace.

Dong He and others protested that the city still had troops and supplies enough to hold out. Liu Zhang would not listen, and the next day he came out carrying his seals. Liu Bei met him, took his hands and wept, saying he did not lack humanity; circumstances had left him no choice. Liu Bei entered the city, calmed the people and made himself governor of Yizhou. He sent Liu Zhang, with his family and property, to live at Gong'an in Jingzhou, and handed out offices: Zhuge Liang as military adviser, Fa Zheng as governor of Shu commandery, and posts for Liu Zhang's former officers such as Huang Quan and Liu Ba.

Liu Zhang's biography in the Records says that after Liu Bei had besieged Chengdu for some tens of days, the city still held thirty thousand picked troops and grain and cloth for a year, and its officers and people wanted to fight to the death. But Liu Zhang said that in twenty years he and his father had done the people no kindness, and that three years of war had been fought on his account; how could he be at peace? He opened the gates, and his men all wept. Liu Bei feasted his army, gave Liu Zhang's old officials real posts and made Zhuge Liang his right hand. It was 214, and the Longzhong plan to hold both Jing and Yi provinces had taken shape.
story_zh: 马超归顺后，刘备派他到成都城下喊话。马超说张鲁听信谗言要害他，他已归降刘皇叔，劝刘璋纳土投降，免得生灵受苦。刘璋在城头望见马超，吓得面如土色，当场昏倒。醒来后他叹息说，自家父子在蜀二十多年，没有恩德给百姓，三年攻战，百姓血肉抛洒荒野，都是自己的罪过，不如投降以安百姓。
董和等人劝阻，说城中尚有兵马钱粮，足可坚守。刘璋不听，次日亲自捧着印绶出城投降。刘备握着他的手流泪说，并非自己不行仁义，实在是形势所迫。刘备入城安抚百姓，自领益州牧，把刘璋连同家眷财物送往荆州公安安置，又大封群臣：诸葛亮为军师，法正为蜀郡太守，刘璋旧部黄权、刘巴等人也一一得到任用。
据《三国志·刘璋传》，刘备围成都数十日，城中尚有精兵三万、粮帛可支一年，吏民都愿死战，刘璋却说：“父子在州二十余年，无恩德以加百姓。百姓攻战三年，肌膏草野者，以璋故也，何心能安！”遂开城出降，群下无不流涕。刘备入城后犒赏将士，重用旧臣，以诸葛亮为股肱。这一年是214年，隆中对“跨有荆、益”的设想就此成形。
ch065-governor-of-yizhou.why: Liu Bei at last has a territory of his own, and the three-way division of the realm takes shape.
ch065-governor-of-yizhou.why_zh: 刘备终于拥有了自己的根据地，天下三分之势由此成形。

people.name: Ma Chao
people.role: Calls on the city to yield

story: After his defeats in the northwest, Ma Chao had taken refuge with Zhang Lu in Hanzhong. Hard pressed by Liu Bei, Liu Zhang begged Zhang Lu for help and promised him land; Ma Chao volunteered to lead the attack on Jiameng Pass. Zhuge Liang provoked Zhang Fei by saying only Guan Yu, far away in Jingzhou, could match Ma Chao, until Zhang Fei swore to win or forfeit his head, and Liu Bei went to the pass himself.

Zhang Fei and Ma Chao fought over a hundred bouts without a result, while Liu Bei, watching from the pass, said Ma Chao deserved his fame. When Zhang Fei shouted his name, Ma Chao sneered that his family had been lords for generations and did not know village louts. They changed horses and fought on; night fell, and Zhang Fei had torches lit and fought on by their light until Ma Chao feigned flight and hurled a copper hammer, which Zhang Fei dodged. Liu Bei called a halt. Zhuge Liang then had Zhang Lu's greedy adviser Yang Song bribed to spread word that Ma Chao meant to take Shu for himself; Zhang Lu set him impossible tasks and cut off his retreat, and Li Hui talked the trapped Ma Chao into joining Liu Bei.

Historically: Ma Chao's biography says that in Hanzhong he found Zhang Lu unworthy to plan with and was miserable, and when he heard Liu Bei was besieging Chengdu he wrote secretly to offer his allegiance. Li Hui's biography says Liu Bei sent Li Hui to Hanzhong to win him over. The Dianlüe cited in the notes has Liu Bei exclaim 'I have Yizhou!' and quietly supply him with troops; Ma Chao camped north of Chengdu, and within ten days the city gave in. The battle at Jiameng and the torch-lit duel are the novel's; the pass was actually held by Huo Jun.
story_zh: 马超兵败陇西后，投奔汉中张鲁。刘璋被刘备围困，向张鲁求救，许以割地为谢，马超自请出兵攻打葭萌关。诸葛亮故意说只有远在荆州的关羽才能抵挡马超，激得张飞立下军令状出战，刘备也亲自赶到关上督阵。
张飞与马超大战一百余合不分胜负，刘备在关上赞叹马超名不虚传。张飞报名叫阵，马超却说自家世代公侯，不识村野匹夫。两人换马再战，入夜后张飞点起火把挑灯夜战，马超诈败抛出铜锤，被张飞闪过，刘备才鸣金收兵。诸葛亮派人重金贿赂张鲁谋士杨松，散布马超要自立的谣言；张鲁逼马超限期立功，又断他归路，进退无路的马超被李恢说动，归降刘备。
史实：《三国志·马超传》载，马超在汉中觉得张鲁不足与共事，心中郁闷，听说刘备围成都，便写密信请降；《李恢传》说刘备曾派李恢去汉中结好马超。裴注引《典略》称刘备得讯大喜，说“我得益州矣”，暗中拨兵给马超，让他屯于城北，不到十天成都就降了。葭萌关大战与挑灯夜战都出自小说，当时据守葭萌的是霍峻。
ch065-ma-chao-joins.why: Ma Chao's arrival breaks Chengdu's will to resist and gives Liu Bei one of his most famous generals.
ch065-ma-chao-joins.why_zh: 马超归附令成都守军丧胆，也为刘备增添了一员名震西凉的猛将。

quote.zh: 吾家屡世公侯，岂识村野匹夫！
quote.en: My family have been lords for generations. Why would I know some village lout?

people.name: Ma Chao
people.role: Zhang Lu's general, then Liu Bei's
people.role_zh: 投靠张鲁、后归刘备的猛将

people.name: Li Hui
people.role: Persuades Ma Chao to come over

story: Now that Liu Bei held Shu, Sun Quan sent Zhuge Jin to ask for Jingzhou back. Liu Bei put him off with a letter returning three commanderies, but Guan Yu flatly refused, saying a general in the field need not obey every order from his lord. Lu Su then laid a plan: invite Guan Yu across the river to a feast, demand Jingzhou there, and if he refused, have hidden swordsmen kill him. Guan Ping and Ma Liang begged Guan Yu not to go, but he said he had ridden alone through ten thousand spears as if through an empty field, and was not afraid of the rats of Jiangdong.

He crossed in a small boat with only Zhou Cang carrying his blade and a few attendants, leaving Guan Ping waiting on the river with fast boats. When Lu Su raised the question of Jingzhou, Guan Yu said affairs of state were not for the banquet table. Zhou Cang shouted from below the steps that land belongs to whoever has virtue, not to Wu alone. Guan Yu rose, took the blade from him and sent him off, and Zhou Cang ran to the bank to signal Guan Ping. Then, feigning drunkenness, Guan Yu held his blade in one hand and Lu Su's hand in the other and walked him down to the river, saying they should talk of old friendship, not Jingzhou. Lu Su was frozen with fear, the hidden soldiers dared not move for fear of hurting him, and Guan Yu boarded his boat and left.

Historically: the roles were the other way round. Lu Su's biography says that when he and Guan Yu faced each other at Yiyang, Lu Su invited Guan Yu to meet, each side leaving its troops a hundred paces off, with only the commanders present, each carrying a single sword. Lu Su rebuked Guan Yu for refusing to return the land; when someone in Guan Yu's party said land belonged to the virtuous, Lu Su shouted him down, and Guan Yu took up his sword, said this was a matter of state the man knew nothing of, and sent him away. The Wu shu adds that Guan Yu had no answer. The novel gives the remark to Zhou Cang and makes Guan Yu the master of the scene. Soon after, Liu Bei made peace and split Jingzhou with Sun Quan along the Xiang River.
story_zh: 刘备得了西川，孙权派诸葛瑾索还荆州。刘备写信答应先还三郡，关羽却以“将在外，君命有所不受”为由一口回绝。鲁肃于是定计：请关羽过江赴宴，席间索要荆州；若他不肯，就让埋伏的刀斧手当场杀之。关平、马良都劝关羽别去，关羽却说自己在千军万马中往来冲杀如入无人之境，岂惧江东鼠辈。
关羽只带周仓捧刀和几名随从，乘小舟赴会，命关平带快船在江上接应。席间鲁肃提起荆州，关羽说这是国家之事，筵间不必谈论。周仓在阶下厉声道：天下土地，惟有德者居之，岂独东吴该有！关羽起身夺过大刀，叱退周仓，周仓会意，到岸边招来关平。关羽借着酒意，一手提刀、一手挽住鲁肃，一路走到江边。鲁肃魂不附体，伏兵投鼠忌器，不敢动手，关羽从容登船而去。
史实：主客恰好相反。《三国志·鲁肃传》载，两军在益阳对峙，鲁肃邀关羽相见，双方兵马留在百步之外，将领各带单刀赴会。鲁肃当面责备关羽借地不还，座中有人插话说土地只归有德者，鲁肃厉声呵斥，关羽持刀起身说“此自国家事，是人何知”；裴注引《吴书》说关羽无言以对。小说把插话交给周仓，又让主客易位。不久孙刘议和，以湘水为界平分荆州。
ch066-single-sword.why: One of Guan Yu's most celebrated scenes, and the clearest case of the novel turning a Wu diplomatic success into a showcase for Guan Yu's nerve.
ch066-single-sword.why_zh: 这是关羽最著名的场面之一，也最能看出小说如何把东吴的外交胜利改写成关羽的胆略。

quote.zh: 天下土地，惟有德者居之
quote.en: The land under heaven belongs to whoever has virtue.

people.name: Lu Su
people.role_zh: 设宴索荆州的东吴都督

story: With Cao Cao far off in Hanzhong, Sun Quan led a hundred thousand men north, took Wan and laid siege to Hefei. Before leaving, Cao Cao had left the garrison a sealed box, to be opened only when the enemy came. Inside were his orders: Zhang Liao and Li Dian were to go out and fight, Yue Jin to hold the city. Li Dian, long at odds with Zhang Liao, said nothing at first, but when he saw Zhang Liao was set on fighting to the death, he declared he would not let a private grudge spoil the public cause.

Zhang Liao hid troops north of Xiaoyao Ford, and the planks of the Xiaoshi bridge behind were pulled up. When Sun Quan pushed forward lightly escorted, signal guns went off and Zhang Liao and Li Dian closed in from both sides. Ling Tong, with barely three hundred riders, fought desperately to cover his lord. Sun Quan galloped onto the bridge, only to find more than a zhang of it gone; his officer Gu Li told him to rein back, then charge, and the horse cleared the gap in one leap. Ling Tong's men all died, and he himself, badly wounded, barely got away. Zhang Liao's name now terrified the south; it was said that children there stopped crying at night when they heard it.

Zhang Liao's biography in the Records says the garrison had only about seven thousand men, and that Cao Cao's sealed orders did tell Zhang Liao and Li Dian to fight while Yue Jin held the walls. That night Zhang Liao picked eight hundred volunteers and feasted them on beef; at dawn he led them in armour, halberd in hand, straight to Sun Quan's banner, and Sun Quan fled up a mound to defend himself with a long halberd. Twice Zhang Liao cut back into the encircling enemy to rescue his men. Wu lost heart, gave up the siege after some ten days, and Zhang Liao's pursuit nearly caught Sun Quan again. Gu Li's help at the bridge is in the Jiangbiao zhuan cited in the notes.
story_zh: 曹操远征汉中，孙权趁机亲率十万大军北上，先夺皖城，再围合肥。曹操临行前给合肥守军留下一个木匣，嘱咐敌军来了才能打开，里面写着：张辽、李典出战，乐进守城。李典与张辽素来不和，起初默不作声，见张辽决意死战，便慨然表示不能因私怨而误公事，愿听调遣。
张辽在逍遥津北设下伏兵，又拆去了小师桥的桥板。孙权轻兵冒进，忽听炮响，张辽、李典两路杀出。凌统只带三百余骑拼死护主，孙权纵马奔上小师桥，桥南已断了一丈多，牙将谷利叫他把马勒退几步，再加鞭冲刺，那马一跃飞过断桥。凌统部下全部战死，他本人身负重伤才得脱险。张辽从此威震江南，据说小儿听到他的名字，夜里都不敢啼哭。
据《三国志·张辽传》，合肥守军只有七千余人，曹操留下的教令确是张、李出战，乐进守城。张辽连夜招募敢死之士八百人，杀牛犒赏，天亮后披甲持戟当先冲阵，直杀到孙权麾下，孙权慌忙登上高冢、持长戟自守。张辽两度突入重围救出部下，吴军夺气，围城十余日后撤退，张辽追击，几乎再次擒获孙权。谷利助孙权跃马过桥一节，见于裴注引《江表传》。
ch067-xiaoyao-ford.why: Hefei, held here against all odds, never fell to Wu, and Sun Quan's road north stayed shut.
ch067-xiaoyao-ford.why_zh: 合肥以少胜多守住了，此后东吴始终未能攻破合肥，孙权北上之路就此被堵死。

people.name: Sun Quan
people.role: Ruler of Wu, leading the siege

story: Cao Cao marched west on Hanzhong. Zhang Lu's brother Zhang Wei, with Yang Ang and Yang Ren, held Yangping Pass, and Cao Cao's assaults failed with heavy losses. He pretended to withdraw; Yang Ang left his camp to pursue, and Xiahou Yuan and Zhang He, who had lost their way, blundered into his half-empty camp and took it, and soon the pass fell. Zhang Lu's fierce general Pang De then came out to fight; Cao Cao, admiring his courage, bribed Zhang Lu's adviser Yang Song to slander him, and Pang De was captured and came over to Cao Cao.

Zhang Lu fled to Bazhong. His followers wanted to burn the storehouses, but he said he had always meant to submit to the court and the treasure belonged to the state, and had them sealed instead. Cao Cao was moved when he found them intact. Zhang Lu soon surrendered and was made General Who Guards the South, while Yang Song, who had sold his master, was beheaded in the market. Sima Yi urged Cao Cao to strike Shu at once, while Liu Bei's hold on it was new; Cao Cao sighed that men never know when they have enough, and having got Long, why want Shu as well, and stayed put.

Zhang Lu's biography in the Records gives his words on sealing the storehouses: he had meant to submit but had not yet been able to; he was fleeing only to avoid the army's edge, with no ill intent, and the treasure belonged to the state. Cao Cao praised him, made him a general and marquis of Langzhong, and enfeoffed his five sons. The Jin shu names Sima Yi as the man who urged an invasion of Shu, and Liu Ye's biography says Liu Ye did; 'having got Long, why want Shu' was originally a saying of the Han emperor Guangwu. Cao Cao's restraint gave Liu Bei breathing space, and he quickly made peace with Sun Quan over Jingzhou.
story_zh: 曹操亲率大军西征汉中，张鲁之弟张卫与杨昂、杨任据守阳平关，曹军屡攻不下，折损不少。曹操佯装退兵，杨昂出寨追赶，夏侯渊、张郃两军迷了路，误打误撞闯到杨昂营前，夺了营寨，阳平关随之失守。张鲁部将庞德出战，曹操爱其骁勇，重金贿赂张鲁谋士杨松进谗，庞德被擒后归降曹操。
张鲁逃往巴中，左右要烧掉府库，张鲁说自己本想归顺朝廷，府库是国家之物，下令封存而去。曹操见府库完好，十分感慨。不久张鲁出降，被封为镇南将军，卖主求荣的杨松则被斩首示众。司马懿劝曹操趁刘备新得益州、人心未附，速取西川；曹操叹道人苦不知足，既得陇又望蜀，按兵不动。
据《三国志·张鲁传》，张鲁封存府库时说：“本欲归命国家，而意未达。今之走，避锐锋，非有恶意。宝货仓库，国家之有。”曹操甚为嘉许，拜他为镇南将军，封阆中侯，五个儿子也都封侯。劝曹操取蜀的，《晋书·宣帝纪》说是司马懿，《三国志·刘晔传》说是刘晔；“得陇望蜀”本是东汉光武帝的话。曹操按兵不进，刘备得以喘息，随即与孙权议和、平分荆州。
ch067-hanzhong-taken.why: Cao Cao's decision not to press on into Shu gave Liu Bei time to secure Yizhou and made Hanzhong the next battleground.
ch067-hanzhong-taken.why_zh: 曹操得陇而不望蜀，给了刘备稳住益州的时间，汉中也从此成为魏蜀必争之地。

people.name: Pang De
people.role: Zhang Lu's general, won over by Cao Cao

story: After Xiaoyao Ford, Cao Cao came south in force to Ruxu to settle things with Sun Quan. Ling Tong went out first and fought Zhang Liao to a standstill. Not to be outdone, Gan Ning boasted before Sun Quan that he would raid Cao Cao's camp that night with only a hundred men, and if he lost a single man or horse he would claim no credit. Sun Quan admired his spirit and sent wine and mutton for his men.

Gan Ning gathered his hundred in his tent, poured wine into a silver bowl and drank two bowls himself, then told them each to drink one. When they hesitated, he drew his sword: he, their general, did not value his life, so why did they hold back? They bowed and drank. At the second watch, white goose feathers in their helmets to know each other, they broke into Cao Cao's camp, tore aside the barricades and cut their way back and forth while the enemy, not knowing how many they were, fell into confusion. All hundred returned without a loss. Delighted, Sun Quan said Cao Cao had Zhang Liao and he had Gan Ning, a match for him, and rewarded him with a thousand bolts of silk and a hundred swords.

The story comes almost straight from the histories. Gan Ning's biography in the Records says that when Cao Cao came to Ruxu, Gan Ning led the vanguard and was ordered to raid the enemy's forward camp; Sun Quan sent rice wine and food, and Gan Ning drank two silver bowls himself before pouring for his officers. When they balked he laid his blade across his knees and asked whether they stood higher in their lord's favour than he did; if he was not afraid to die, why were they? They drank, and at the second watch they went out with gags in their mouths. The Jiangbiao zhuan cited in the notes adds that he took a hundred-odd men and killed dozens, and gives Sun Quan's line about Zhang Liao.
story_zh: 张辽威震逍遥津后，曹操又亲率大军南下濡须，要与孙权决战。东吴凌统先出阵，与张辽大战不分胜负。甘宁不甘落后，当着孙权夸口：今夜只带一百人去劫曹营，若折了一人一骑，便不算功劳。孙权壮其言，赐酒肉犒劳将士。
甘宁把百人召入帐中，先用银碗斟酒，自己连饮两碗，再让众人各饮一碗。众人面面相觑，甘宁拔剑喝道：我身为上将尚且不惜性命，你们为何迟疑？众人这才拜受而饮。二更时分，百人头插白鹅翎为记，冲入曹营，拔开鹿角往来砍杀，曹军不知虚实，自相惊扰。百人全数而还，孙权大喜，说孟德有张辽，孤有甘兴霸，足以相敌，赏他绢千匹、刀百口。
这段故事几乎全出自史书。《三国志·甘宁传》载，曹操出兵濡须，甘宁为前部督，奉命夜袭敌营，孙权特赐米酒菜肴；甘宁先用银碗自饮两碗，再斟给部下都督，都督伏地不肯接，甘宁把刀横在膝上喝问：“卿见知于至尊，孰与甘宁？甘宁尚不惜死，卿何以独惜死乎？”众人这才饮酒，二更衔枚出击。裴注引《江表传》说他带百余人斩首数十级，孙权论张辽之语也出自此处。
ch068-gan-ning-raid.why: A daring small raid that lifted Wu's morale and made Gan Ning, in Sun Quan's eyes, the equal of Zhang Liao.
ch068-gan-ning-raid.why_zh: 一次以少胜多的夜袭大振东吴士气，甘宁从此成了孙权眼中足以与张辽匹敌的猛将。

people.name: Gan Ning
people.role: Wu general who leads the raid

story: After Ruxu, Sun Quan asked for peace and Cao Cao went home. His officials proposed making him King of Wei. Xun You objected that as Duke of Wei, honoured with the Nine Bestowments, Cao Cao already stood as high as a subject could, and to go further would be improper. Cao Cao exclaimed that the man meant to copy Xun Yu, and Xun You fell ill with grief and anger and soon died. Another old minister, Cui Yan, was thrown into prison for opposing it and beaten to death there.

In the summer of 216 the officials petitioned jointly, and Emperor Xian had no choice but to have Zhong Yao draft the decree. Cao Cao declined three times for form's sake, then accepted: a crown with twelve strings of beads, a gold-rooted carriage drawn by six horses, the emperor's own carriages, robes and regalia, and the streets cleared wherever he went. He built a palace for the King of Wei at Ye. Then, unsure which son should succeed him, he asked Jia Xu, who said he was thinking of Yuan Shao and Liu Biao and their sons. Cao Cao laughed and named his eldest, Cao Pi, heir.

The Annals of Emperor Wu in the Records say Cao Cao was made King of Wei in the fifth month of 216; only the next year was he allowed the emperor's banners and cleared streets, and later the twelve-string crown and the six-horse carriage, when Cao Pi was also named heir. The novel folds these together. Xun You had in fact died in 214 on campaign against Wu, nothing to do with the kingship; Cui Yan, however, really was forced to die in 216, over a remark in a letter. From Duke to King, Cao Cao was one step from the throne, and he left that step to his son.
story_zh: 濡须之战后，孙权遣使求和，曹操班师回朝。群臣商议尊曹操为魏王，荀攸出来反对，说丞相已是魏公、荣加九锡，位极人臣，再进王位于理不合。曹操大怒，说此人要学荀彧，荀攸听说后忧愤成疾，不久病死。老臣崔琰也因反对此事被下狱，在狱中被杖杀。
216年夏，群臣联名上表，汉献帝只得命钟繇草诏，册立曹操为魏王。曹操假意推辞三次后受封：头戴十二旒冠冕，乘金根车，驾六马，用天子车服仪仗，出入警跸，又在邺郡修建魏王宫。随后他为立嗣犹豫，问计于贾诩，贾诩只说正在想袁绍、刘表父子的事，曹操大笑，遂立长子曹丕为王世子。
据《三国志·武帝纪》，曹操于216年五月进爵魏王；次年才获准设天子旌旗、出入称警跸，后来又获冕十二旒、乘金根车、驾六马，同时立曹丕为太子，小说把这些合在一处写。荀攸其实在214年随军征吴途中病逝，与反对称王无关；崔琰则确在216年因书信中一句话获罪赐死。从魏公到魏王，曹操离帝位只差一步，这一步留给了儿子曹丕。
ch068-king-of-wei.why: Cao Cao climbs to one step below the throne, preparing the way for his son to end the Han.
ch068-king-of-wei.why_zh: 曹操距帝位只剩一步，为儿子曹丕代汉铺平了道路。

people.name: Cao Cao
people.role: Raised from Duke to King of Wei

story: Having taken Mount Tiandang, Huang Zhong and Fa Zheng pressed on to Mount Dingjun, held by Cao Cao's commander Xiahou Yuan. Earlier, the diviner Guan Lu had cast a cryptic oracle for Cao Cao that foretold the loss of a great general south of Dingjun. Fa Zheng told Huang Zhong to 'turn guest into host': advance camp by camp and draw Xiahou Yuan out. At an exchange of prisoners, Huang Zhong shot Xiahou Yuan's nephew Xiahou Shang in the back as he ran home, and Xiahou Yuan was beside himself with rage.

Fa Zheng then had Huang Zhong seize a high peak west of Dingjun that looked straight down into Xiahou Yuan's camp. Fa Zheng stood on the summit with flags: while the white flag flew, Huang Zhong would sit tight; when the red flag went up, he would charge. Xiahou Yuan's men cursed at the foot of the hill all morning, but Huang Zhong did not stir. By afternoon they were weary and had dismounted to rest; up went the red flag, drums and horns sounded, and Huang Zhong came down the slope like a landslide. Xiahou Yuan had no time to react; Huang Zhong reached his banner and cut him down with a single stroke. When the news came, Cao Cao wept aloud and set out himself to fight for Hanzhong.

The histories tell much the same story. Fa Zheng's biography says Liu Bei crossed the Mian and advanced along the hills to camp at Dingjun; when Xiahou Yuan came to contest it, Fa Zheng said 'Now we can strike', and Liu Bei sent Huang Zhong to attack from the heights with drums and shouts, crushing Xiahou Yuan's army. Huang Zhong's biography says the drums shook the sky and the cheers echoed through the valleys, and he killed Xiahou Yuan in one battle.
