Cao Cao later said he had known Liu Bei could not think of such a plan himself: someone had taught him. He had long warned Xiahou Yuan that a general must sometimes be cautious and not rely on courage alone.
story_zh: 黄忠与法正夺下天荡山后，乘势进兵定军山，那里由曹军主帅夏侯渊镇守。管辂早先曾为曹操卜卦，隐语预言定军山之南将折损大将。法正教黄忠“反客为主”，步步扎营向前推进，引夏侯渊出战。双方交换俘虏时，黄忠趁夏侯渊之侄夏侯尚奔回本阵，一箭射中他的后心，夏侯渊气得暴跳如雷。
法正又让黄忠夺下定军山西面一座高山，居高临下俯瞰夏侯渊营寨。法正在山顶执旗：举白旗按兵不动，举红旗便杀下山去。夏侯渊在山下叫骂半日，黄忠只是不出。到了午后，曹军人困马乏，纷纷下马歇息，法正把红旗一举，鼓角齐鸣，黄忠一马当先冲下山来，势如天崩地塌。夏侯渊措手不及，被黄忠冲到麾盖之下一刀斩杀。曹操闻讯放声大哭，亲率大军来争汉中。
史书所载与小说大体相同。《三国志·法正传》说刘备南渡沔水，沿山前进，在定军山扎营，夏侯渊来争，法正说“可击矣”，刘备便命黄忠乘高鼓噪攻之，大破其军。《黄忠传》称当时“金鼓振天，欢声动谷，一战斩渊”。曹操事后说，早知刘备想不出这样的计策，必是有人教他。他也曾告诫夏侯渊，为将当有怯弱之时，不可只恃勇力，此时终于应验。
ch071-dingjun-mountain.why: The death of Cao Cao's western commander decided the war for Hanzhong in Liu Bei's favour.
ch071-dingjun-mountain.why_zh: 斩杀曹军西线主帅，汉中之战的胜负由此定局。

quote.zh: 三八纵横，黄猪遇虎；定军之南，伤折一股
quote.en: Three eights crosswise, the yellow pig meets the tiger; south of Dingjun, a limb is broken off.

people.name: Xiahou Yuan
people.role: Cao Cao's commander in the west

story: After Xiahou Yuan's death, Cao Cao came to Hanzhong himself, but Zhuge Liang's decoy troops kept his camp awake with drums night after night, and he lost one fight after another by the Han River. Camped at the mouth of the Xie Valley, he could not win by advancing and feared ridicule if he withdrew. One evening his cook brought chicken soup; Cao Cao was brooding over a rib in his bowl when Xiahou Dun came in to ask for the night's password, and he said absently: 'Chicken rib, chicken rib.'

When the registrar Yang Xiu heard the password, he told his attendants to pack. Asked why, he explained that a chicken rib has no meat on it, yet you hate to throw it away; the king could not win by going on and feared mockery if he left, so there was no point staying, and he would soon order a withdrawal. Xiahou Dun began packing too. That night Cao Cao, unable to sleep, walked the camp with a steel axe in hand and found everyone packing. Learning why, he had Yang Xiu beheaded for spreading rumours that shook the army, and hung his head at the camp gate. The novel then looks back on Yang Xiu's cleverness, from guessing Cao Cao's riddles to coaching Cao Zhi with ready answers, which Cao Cao had long resented.

Historically: the 'chicken rib' story is in the Jiuzhou chunqiu cited in the notes. Cao Cao, wanting to withdraw, gave the order 'chicken rib'; no one understood except Yang Xiu, who packed, explaining that a chicken rib is a pity to throw away but yields nothing to eat, just like Hanzhong. It does not say he was killed for it. According to the Dianlüe, also cited in the notes, Cao Cao had Yang Xiu arrested and killed in the autumn of 219, after the withdrawal, for leaking his instructions and conspiring with a prince; the real reasons were his part in the succession struggle between Cao Pi and Cao Zhi, and the fact that he was Yuan Shu's nephew. Before he died Yang Xiu told a friend he had always thought he would die too late. The riddle stories come from the Shishuo xinyu.
story_zh: 夏侯渊死后，曹操亲征汉中，却被诸葛亮的疑兵夜夜鼓噪搅得不得安宁，又在汉水边接连失利，退到斜谷口屯驻，进不能胜，退又怕被人耻笑。一天晚饭厨师送上鸡汤，曹操看着碗中的鸡肋正自沉吟，夏侯惇入帐请示夜间口令，他随口说道：“鸡肋！鸡肋！”
行军主簿杨修听到口令，便叫随从收拾行装。他解释说，鸡肋吃着没肉，扔了又可惜，如今进不能胜、退恐人笑，留在这里无益，魏王不日就要班师。夏侯惇也跟着收拾起来。当夜曹操心乱难眠，手提钢斧绕营巡视，见军士都在打点行装，问明原委，便以造言惑乱军心之罪斩了杨修，首级挂在辕门外。小说接着追述杨修猜破曹操字谜、替曹植预备答教等往事，曹操早已忌恨在心。
史实：“鸡肋”见于裴注引《九州春秋》：曹操想退兵，出令“鸡肋”，属官不解，只有杨修收拾行装，说鸡肋弃之可惜、食之无所得，正好比汉中，并未说杨修因此被杀。据《典略》，219年秋撤军后，曹操才以“漏泄言教，交关诸侯”的罪名收杀杨修，实因他卷入曹丕、曹植之争，又是袁术外甥。杨修临死说：“我固自以死之晚也。”猜谜轶事出自《世说新语》。
ch072-chicken-rib.why: A famous parable of the clever man who reads his master too well, and the origin of 'chicken rib' for something worthless yet hard to give up.
ch072-chicken-rib.why_zh: 这是聪明反被聪明误的著名故事，“鸡肋”也从此成为食之无味、弃之可惜的代称。

quote.zh: 鸡肋者，食之无肉，弃之有味
quote.en: A chicken rib: nothing to eat on it, yet it tastes too good to throw away.

people.name: Cao Cao
people.role: King of Wei, stalled in Hanzhong

story: The day after Yang Xiu's death, Cao Cao led his army out against the Shu forces. Wei Yan came out to meet him and fell back as if beaten, and as Cao Cao's men pursued, Ma Chao struck at his half-empty camp and threw the army into confusion. Cao Cao, sword in hand, was shouting at his officers to stand firm when Wei Yan suddenly charged in and loosed an arrow that struck him full in the face, knocking out two front teeth, and he fell from his horse. Only Pang De's desperate fight drove Wei Yan off and got him back to camp.

Back in camp with his wound, Cao Cao at last remembered Yang Xiu's words. He had Yang Xiu's body gathered up and buried properly, then ordered the retreat, and lying wounded in a covered carriage amid his guards he led the army north through the Xie Valley. With Cao Cao gone, Liu Bei held all of Hanzhong, and sent Liu Feng, Meng Da and others to take the Shangyong commanderies, laying the ground for his own kingship.

Historically: the Annals of Emperor Wu in the Records say that in the third month of 219 Cao Cao came out of the Xie Valley from Chang'an to Yangping, where Liu Bei held the passes against him. Liu Bei's biography says he had predicted that Cao Cao could do nothing and Hanzhong would be his; he gathered his troops in strong positions and never gave battle, and after months without success Cao Cao's deserters grew in number. In the fifth month Cao Cao withdrew to Chang'an, and Liu Bei had Hanzhong. Wei Yan's arrow and the lost teeth appear in no history; they are the novel's flourish on a humiliating retreat.
story_zh: 杀了杨修的第二天，曹操亲自出兵与蜀军交战。魏延迎战，诈败而走，曹军追赶之际，马超乘虚袭击曹营，曹军大乱。曹操拔剑在手，喝令众将不许后退，魏延忽然杀到，一箭正中曹操面门，射落两颗门牙，曹操翻身落马。幸得庞德奋力杀退魏延，才把他救回营中。
曹操带伤回寨，这才想起杨修的话，命人收殓杨修尸首厚葬，随即下令班师，自己卧在车中，由亲兵护卫着经斜谷北撤。曹操一走，刘备尽得汉中，又派刘封、孟达等人夺取上庸诸郡，为进位汉中王打下了基础。
史实：《三国志·武帝纪》载，219年三月曹操从长安出斜谷，进军阳平，刘备凭险拒守。《先主传》说刘备早已料定“曹公虽来，无能为也，我必有汉川矣”，他收拢兵马、扼守险要，始终不与曹操交锋；曹军积月不能取胜，逃亡日多，五月曹操只得退回长安，刘备遂有汉中。魏延射落曹操门牙一事史书毫无记载，是小说为这次狼狈撤退添的一笔。
ch072-xie-valley-retreat.why: Cao Cao's withdrawal handed Hanzhong to Liu Bei, the high point of Shu's fortunes.
ch072-xie-valley-retreat.why_zh: 曹操这一退，汉中归了刘备，蜀汉的事业由此达到顶峰。

people.name: Wei Yan
people.role: Liu Bei's general who shoots him

story: With Hanzhong won, Zhuge Liang and the officials urged Liu Bei to take the imperial title. He flatly refused: though of the Han royal house, he was still a subject, and that would be rebellion. Zhuge Liang proposed instead that he become King of Hanzhong; Liu Bei objected that without an imperial decree that too would be usurpation. Zhang Fei burst out that men of other surnames all wanted to be rulers, and his brother was of the Han blood itself: why not King of Hanzhong, why not emperor? Only when Zhuge Liang argued that the times called for flexibility did Liu Bei agree.

In the seventh month of 219 an altar nine li around was built at Mianyang, with banners and guards in array and the officials in their ranks. Liu Bei received crown and seal and sat facing south as King of Hanzhong. Liu Shan was made heir; Xu Jing became grand tutor, Fa Zheng director of the secretariat, and Zhuge Liang chief strategist in charge of all affairs; Guan Yu, Zhang Fei, Zhao Yun, Ma Chao and Huang Zhong were named the Five Tiger Generals, and Wei Yan governor of Hanzhong. Liu Bei sent a memorial to the court, and Cao Cao, reading it, raged at the mat-weaver's brat and vowed to destroy him.

Liu Bei's biography in the Records says his officials jointly petitioned the Han emperor to make him King of Hanzhong; an altar was set up at Mianyang, troops paraded and the royal cap placed on his head. Over four centuries earlier, Liu Bang had risen from Hanzhong as King of Han, so the title carried a clear message. Guan Yu, Zhang Fei, Ma Chao and Huang Zhong were made generals of the front, right, left and rear; Zhao Yun's rank was lower. The 'Five Tigers' are the novel's, perhaps inspired by the Records putting all five in one biography chapter. Guan Yu was furious at ranking alongside Huang Zhong, saying a real man would never stand in line with an old soldier.
story_zh: 刘备夺得汉中，诸葛亮率众官劝他即皇帝位，刘备坚决不肯，说自己虽是汉室宗亲，终究是臣子，这样做就是反汉。诸葛亮退一步，请他先称汉中王，刘备仍说没有天子诏命便是僭越。张飞在旁嚷道：异姓之人都想当皇帝，何况哥哥是汉朝宗派，莫说汉中王，就称皇帝又有何不可！诸葛亮劝他从权行事，刘备这才答应。
219年秋七月，刘备在沔阳筑坛，方圆九里，旌旗仪仗分列，群臣依次排班。刘备受了冠冕玺绶，面南而坐，进位汉中王；立刘禅为王世子，许靖为太傅，法正为尚书令，诸葛亮为军师、总理军国重事，封关羽、张飞、赵云、马超、黄忠为五虎大将，魏延为汉中太守。刘备上表许都，曹操见表大怒，骂他织席小儿，誓要灭之。
据《三国志·先主传》，群臣联名上表，推刘备为汉中王，在沔阳设坛陈兵，为他戴上王冠。四百多年前，刘邦正是以汉王身份从汉中起家，这个封号意味深长。刘备拜关羽为前将军、张飞为右将军、马超为左将军、黄忠为后将军，赵云职位略低；“五虎上将”是小说的说法，大约源于《三国志》将五人合为一传。关羽还因与黄忠同列而大怒，说“大丈夫终不与老兵同列”。
ch073-king-of-hanzhong.why: Liu Bei's kingship is the peak of his career and sets him openly against the King of Wei as an equal.
ch073-king-of-hanzhong.why_zh: 进位汉中王是刘备一生事业的巅峰，从此与魏王曹操分庭抗礼。

people.name: Zhuge Liang
people.role: Leads the officials in urging the title

people.name: Zhang Fei
people.role: Urges him loudly to be emperor

people.name: Guan Yu
people.role: First of the Five Tiger Generals

story: Liu Bei's new title enraged Cao Cao, and Sima Yi advised him to offer Sun Quan land in the south if he would attack Jingzhou from behind. Sun Quan sent Zhuge Jin to Jingzhou to ask for Guan Yu's daughter as a bride for his son, partly to test Guan Yu's mood. Guan Yu exploded: how could a tiger's daughter marry a dog's son? He sent Zhuge Jin packing, and Sun Quan set his mind on taking Jingzhou.

Fei Shi arrived with Guan Yu's appointment; Guan Yu at first refused it rather than rank with Huang Zhong, until Fei Shi talked him round. Ordered north against Fancheng, he made Liao Hua and Guan Ping his vanguard and left Mi Fang at Nanjun and Fu Shiren at Gong'an, two men he had just had flogged forty strokes each for letting a fire break out in camp, and who now nursed a grudge. Outside Xiangyang Guan Yu routed Cao Ren, who fell back into Fancheng, and took Xiangyang. On Wang Fu's advice he also built beacon towers every twenty or thirty li along the river against a Wu surprise attack.

Guan Yu's biography in the Records says that when Liu Bei became King of Hanzhong in 219 he made Guan Yu General of the Front with the insignia of command, and that same year Guan Yu attacked Cao Ren at Fancheng and sent another commander to besiege Lü Chang at Xiangyang. Earlier, Sun Quan had asked for Guan Yu's daughter for his son, and Guan Yu had cursed and insulted the envoy and refused, infuriating Sun Quan. Mi Fang and Shi Ren felt Guan Yu slighted them, were slack in sending supplies, and were frightened when he said he would deal with them on his return. Xiangyang, despite the chapter title, never actually fell to Guan Yu.
story_zh: 刘备进位汉中王，曹操大怒，司马懿献计：许孙权以江南之地，让他从背后袭取荆州。孙权派诸葛瑾到荆州，替儿子向关羽之女求亲，顺便试探关羽心意。关羽勃然大怒，说虎女怎肯嫁给犬子，把诸葛瑾赶了回去，孙权由此决意图谋荆州。
费诗奉命带着诰命到荆州封赏关羽，关羽不愿与黄忠并列，起初不肯受拜，经费诗劝解才接受。随即他奉命北取樊城，以廖化、关平为先锋，留糜芳守南郡、傅士仁守公安，二人刚因营中失火各挨了四十军棍，从此怀恨在心。关羽在襄阳城外大败曹仁，曹仁退守樊城，关羽夺了襄阳；又听王甫之言，沿江每隔二三十里筑烽火台，防备东吴偷袭。
据《三国志·关羽传》，219年刘备称汉中王，拜关羽为前将军、假节钺，同年关羽率军攻曹仁于樊城，另遣别将围吕常于襄阳。此前孙权遣使为儿子求娶关羽之女，关羽辱骂来使、不许婚事，孙权大怒。糜芳、士仁平日就嫌关羽轻视自己，出兵时供应军资不力，关羽扬言回来再治他们，二人惶恐不安。至于回目所说“攻拔襄阳”，史实上襄阳并未被关羽攻下。
ch073-guan-yu-north.why: Guan Yu's northern offensive sets off the chain of events that will cost Liu Bei Jingzhou and Guan Yu his life.
ch073-guan-yu-north.why_zh: 关羽北伐引出一连串变故，最终让刘备失去荆州，也让关羽丢了性命。

quote.zh: 吾虎女安肯嫁犬子乎！
quote.en: Would my tiger of a daughter marry a dog's whelp?

story: Cao Cao sent Yu Jin with seven armies to relieve Fancheng, and Pang De volunteered to lead the van. When some said he could not be trusted, since his old master Ma Chao and his own brother were in Shu, Pang De knocked his head on the ground until it bled, and he marched out with a coffin carried before him: if he did not kill Guan Yu, Guan Yu would kill him, and if not, he would kill himself. He fought Guan Yu over a hundred bouts without result, then feigned flight and turned to shoot Guan Yu in the left arm, but Yu Jin, afraid Pang De would win the glory, sounded the gongs and called him back.

Yu Jin then moved his seven armies into a valley north of Fancheng called Zengkou, the mouth of the fishnet. Guan Yu surveyed it from high ground, asked the name and was delighted: a fish (yu, like Yu Jin's name) in the mouth of the net could not last long. It was the eighth month and the autumn rains went on for days; Guan Yu readied boats and rafts, had the outlets of the river blocked, and when the Han was in flood broke the banks one night and drowned the seven armies. Yu Jin, with no boat, knelt and begged for his life. Pang De fought on from a small boat until Zhou Cang overturned it and took him. He refused to kneel, cursed Guan Yu and died under the sword, and Guan Yu, moved by his loyalty, had him buried.

Historically: Guan Yu's biography says that 'in autumn there were great rains, the Han overflowed, and the seven armies under Yu Jin were all drowned'; Guan Yu attacked in big boats, Yu Jin surrendered and Pang De was beheaded. The flood was the work of the rains, not of a broken dam. Pang De's biography says he had personally shot Guan Yu in the forehead, and that when surrounded he fought from a dyke until his arrows ran out and died unbowed; Cao Cao wept for him and lamented that he had known Yu Jin for thirty years, yet in the crisis Yu Jin had fallen short of Pang De. Afterwards bandit bands far to the north took Guan Yu's seals, his fame 'shook the central lands', and Cao Cao even discussed moving the capital.
story_zh: 曹操派于禁率七军救援樊城，庞德自请为先锋。有人说他的旧主马超和哥哥都在西蜀，不可信任，庞德叩头流血以表忠心，又抬着一口棺材出征，说此去不杀关羽，便死于关羽之手，即便不死，也当自尽。他与关羽大战百余合不分胜负，后来诈败回身，一箭射中关羽左臂，于禁却怕庞德立了头功，鸣金把他召回。
于禁把七军移到樊城以北的罾口川山谷中扎营。关羽登高察看，问明地名后大喜，说“鱼”入“罾口”，岂能长久？时值八月，秋雨连绵，关羽预备船筏，派人堵住各处水口，等襄江水涨，一夜掘堤放水，七军尽被淹没。于禁无船可乘，跪地乞降；庞德在小船上力战，被周仓翻船生擒，宁死不跪，大骂而死。关羽怜其忠义，将他安葬。
史实：《三国志·关羽传》载“秋，大霖雨，汉水泛溢，禁所督七军皆没”，关羽乘大船进攻，于禁投降，庞德被斩；水是天降大雨所致，并非关羽掘堤。《庞德传》说庞德曾亲自射中关羽前额，被围后在堤上力战到箭尽，不屈而死，曹操为之流泪，叹息认识于禁三十年，临危反不如庞德。此战后各地群盗遥受关羽印号，关羽“威震华夏”，曹操甚至商议迁都以避其锋。
ch074-seven-armies.why: The high-water mark of Guan Yu's career: his fame shook the central lands and Cao Cao even considered moving the capital.
ch074-seven-armies.why_zh: 这是关羽一生功业的顶点，威震华夏，连曹操都一度商议迁都避其锋芒。

quote.zh: 鱼入罾口，岂能久乎？
quote.en: When a fish swims into the mouth of the net, how long can it last?

story: Guan Yu attacked the north gate of Fancheng, and Cao Ren had five hundred archers shoot at once; a poisoned arrow struck Guan Yu's right arm and he fell from his horse. The aconite poison had soaked into the bone, and the arm swelled and turned blue until he could not move it. His officers urged him to go back to Jingzhou for treatment, but he refused angrily: Fancheng would soon fall, and he would not give up a great cause for a small wound. Just then a physician arrived by boat from the east, saying he came from Qiao in the state of Pei and had heard the general was wounded. It was Hua Tuo.

Hua Tuo proposed to set up a post with an iron ring, tie the arm through it and cover the patient's head before cutting the flesh and scraping the poison from the bone. Guan Yu laughed that it was easy enough without post or ring, called for wine, drank a few cups and stretched out his arm while playing chess with Ma Liang. When Hua Tuo opened the flesh the bone was already blue, and he scraped it with his knife until the rasping was audible; everyone watching turned pale and hid their faces, while Guan Yu ate, drank, talked, laughed and played on without a sign of pain. When the wound was dressed and sewn, Guan Yu stood and laughed that his arm moved as before. Hua Tuo said he had never seen anything like it in a lifetime of medicine, refused a reward of gold and left.

Historically: Guan Yu's biography in the Records says he was once hit by a stray arrow that went through his left arm. The wound healed, but in wet weather the bone always ached; a doctor said the arrowhead had been poisoned and the bone must be opened and scraped. Guan Yu stretched out his arm then and there; he happened to be feasting his officers, and while the blood filled the dishes he went on carving meat, drinking, talking and laughing. The doctor is not named, there is no chess, and the time is simply 'once', some earlier occasion. Hua Tuo had been put to death by Cao Cao before 208 and could not have been at Fancheng.
story_zh: 关羽攻打樊城北门，曹仁命五百弓弩手一齐放箭，关羽右臂中了毒箭，翻身落马。箭上的乌头之毒直透入骨，右臂青肿，不能动弹。众将劝他暂回荆州调治，关羽大怒，说樊城早晚可破，岂能因小伤误了大事。正在此时，一位自称沛国谯郡人的医者驾小舟从江东而来，说听闻将军中箭，特来医治，此人正是华佗。
华佗说要立柱钉环，把手臂穿进环中系牢，再蒙住头，然后割开皮肉、刮去骨毒。关羽笑道何用柱环，命人设酒，饮了几杯，一边与马良下棋，一边伸臂让华佗动刀。骨头已经发青，华佗用刀刮骨，悉悉有声，见者无不掩面失色，关羽却饮酒吃肉、谈笑弈棋，全无痛苦之色。缝合之后，关羽起身大笑，说手臂伸舒如故；华佗叹服不已，不收酬金而去。
史实：《三国志·关羽传》载，关羽曾被流矢射穿左臂，伤口虽愈，每逢阴雨骨头仍疼，医生说箭头有毒、毒已入骨，须破臂刮骨去毒。关羽当即伸臂让医生动刀，当时他正请诸将饮宴，臂血流满盘器，他却割肉饮酒，言笑自若。史书没有留下医生的姓名，也没有下棋的细节，时间只说是“尝”，即此前某时；华佗早在208年以前就被曹操所杀，不可能来到樊城。
ch075-scraping-the-bone.why: The scene became the defining image of Guan Yu's superhuman fortitude.
ch075-scraping-the-bone.why_zh: 刮骨疗毒成为关羽神勇坚毅最具代表性的画面。

quote.zh: 某为医一生，未尝见此。君侯真天神也！
quote.en: In a whole life of healing I have never seen the like. My lord, you are a god!

story: Guan Yu's beacon towers along the river left the Wu commander Lü Meng no opening, so he pleaded illness and went home. The young Lu Xun saw through it and proposed a plan: Lü Meng should resign, an unknown such as Lu Xun should replace him, and humble letters flattering Guan Yu would persuade him to move his Jingzhou troops north to Fancheng. Guan Yu read Lu Xun's letter, laughed that Sun Quan was short-sighted to put a boy in command, and pulled many of his garrison troops north. Seeing his chance, Sun Quan ordered Lü Meng to strike.

Lü Meng chose some eighty fast boats, put oarsmen in white, merchant's dress, and hid his best troops below decks; travelling day and night, they reached the north bank. When the beacon guards challenged them, they said they were merchants sheltering from the wind. At the second watch the hidden troops burst out and seized every post. Using the captured guards to trick the gates open, Lü Meng took Jingzhou without a fight, then sent Yu Fan to talk Fu Shiren into surrendering Gong'an, and Fu Shiren in turn won over Mi Fang at Nanjun. Lü Meng forbade his men to trouble the people; when a soldier from his own home town took a farmer's bamboo hat to keep the rain off his armour, Lü Meng wept, but had him beheaded.

Both the white-robed crossing and the bamboo hat come from Lü Meng's biography in the Records: he hid his best troops in the holds of his ships, dressed his men in white as merchants to row, travelled day and night and seized all of Guan Yu's riverside posts, so Guan Yu heard nothing. At Nanjun, Shi Ren and Mi Fang surrendered. The soldier from Runan who took a hat to cover government armour was beheaded in tears, because Lü Meng would not bend the law for a fellow townsman, and after that nothing was picked up from the roads. He also cared for the families of Guan Yu's soldiers, a weapon deadlier than any sword. Lu Xun's flattering letters and Guan Yu's seizure of the Xiang Pass rice are recorded too; the novel's Fu Shiren is simply Shi Ren in the Records.
story_zh: 关羽沿江筑起烽火台，东吴大将吕蒙无从下手，只得托病回去。年轻的陆逊看破其意，献计：让吕蒙辞职，由名声不显的陆逊接任，再写信卑辞恭维关羽，使他放心把荆州兵马调往樊城。关羽读信大笑，说孙权见识短浅，竟用孺子为将，果然抽调守军北上。孙权见时机已到，命吕蒙起兵袭取荆州。
吕蒙挑选八十余只快船，让士卒身穿白衣扮作商人摇橹，精兵藏在船舱之中，昼夜兼行直抵北岸。烽火台守军盘问，他们只说是避风的客商。二更时分，精兵一拥而出，把各台守兵尽数擒获。吕蒙再让降兵骗开城门，兵不血刃取了荆州，又派虞翻说降公安的傅士仁，傅士仁再劝降南郡糜芳。吕蒙严令不许扰民，有个同乡士兵拿了百姓一顶斗笠遮盖铠甲，吕蒙垂泪将他斩首。
白衣渡江和“取一笠”都出自《三国志·吕蒙传》：吕蒙把精兵藏在船中，士兵白衣摇橹扮作商贾，昼夜兼行，尽擒关羽沿江哨所守兵，关羽毫不知情；到了南郡，士仁、麋芳皆降。一名汝南籍部下取民家斗笠盖官铠，吕蒙不肯因同乡而废法，垂泪斩之，军中从此道不拾遗。他还善待关羽将士家属，比刀兵更致命。陆逊写信、关羽擅取湘关米亦有记载；小说的傅士仁，史书作士仁。
ch075-white-robes.why: Wu's surprise attack took Jingzhou at a stroke, sealed Guan Yu's fate and tore up the Sun-Liu alliance.
ch075-white-robes.why_zh: 东吴一举袭取荆州，决定了关羽的命运，也彻底撕破了孙刘联盟。

story: Defeated at Fancheng, Guan Yu then learned that Jingzhou had fallen; in his fury the half-healed wound burst open and he collapsed. He sent Ma Liang and Yi Ji to Chengdu for help and marched to retake Jingzhou. But Lü Meng had treated his soldiers' families kindly and had let Guan Yu's messenger go from house to house in the city; when the news reached the army, the homesick men slipped away. Then Wu ambushes struck, and from the hills Jingzhou men called to their kin by name, sons to fathers, brothers to brothers, until the army melted away and Guan Yu was left with about three hundred men.

He fell back into the small town of Maicheng, short of men and food. Liao Hua cut his way out and rode to Shangyong to ask Liu Feng and Meng Da for help, but Meng Da reminded Liu Feng that Guan Yu had once opposed making him Liu Bei's heir, and Liu Feng sent no troops. Sun Quan sent Zhuge Jin into the town to urge surrender; Guan Yu answered that jade can be smashed but not robbed of its whiteness, bamboo can be burned but not robbed of its joints, and though he might die, his name would live on in the records. Zhuge Jin left with nothing.

Sun Quan's biography in the Records says Guan Yu retreated to Dangyang and then west to hold Maicheng; when Sun Quan tried to lure him into surrender, he pretended to agree, set up banners and dummy figures on the walls, and slipped away, while his troops scattered until only a dozen or so riders remained. Liu Feng's biography says that during the siege of Fancheng Guan Yu repeatedly called on Liu Feng and Meng Da for troops, and they refused, saying the hill commanderies had only just submitted and could not be stirred. Liu Bei never forgave Liu Feng, and in the end ordered him to take his own life.
story_zh: 樊城兵败后，关羽又得知荆州失守，怒气冲天，箭伤迸裂，昏倒在地。他派马良、伊籍赶往成都求救，自己领兵回夺荆州。吕蒙早已厚待关羽将士的家属，又让关羽派来的使者在城中挨家探视，消息传回军中，士卒思家，纷纷逃散。途中又遇东吴伏兵，山上荆州乡人呼唤亲人的名字，子唤父、弟唤兄，军心彻底瓦解，关羽身边只剩三百余人。
关羽退入麦城这座小城，兵少粮缺。廖化杀出重围，赶到上庸向刘封、孟达求援，孟达却提醒刘封，关羽当年曾反对立他为嗣，刘封竟按兵不动。孙权派诸葛瑾入城劝降，关羽正色答道：玉可碎而不可改其白，竹可焚而不可毁其节，身虽死，名可垂于竹帛。诸葛瑾无功而返。
据《三国志·吴主传》，关羽退回当阳，西保麦城，孙权派人诱降，关羽假装答应，在城头竖起旗帜、扎上人像，自己趁机逃走，部下随即溃散，身边只剩十余骑。《刘封传》说关羽围樊城时屡次催刘封、孟达发兵，二人以山郡初附、不可动摇为由不肯奉命，刘备因此深恨刘封，后来终于将他赐死。
ch076-maicheng.why: 'Retreating to Maicheng' became a byword for a proud man's final defeat.
ch076-maicheng.why_zh: “败走麦城”从此成为骄傲者终遭惨败的代名词。

quote.zh: 玉可碎而不可改其白，竹可焚而不可毁其节
quote.en: Jade may be shattered, but its whiteness cannot be changed; bamboo may be burned, but its joints cannot be broken.

story: After Yu Jin's disaster, Cao Cao sent Xu Huang to relieve Fancheng. Xu Huang tricked Guan Ping out of Yancheng and broke through his camps one after another. Guan Yu rode out himself and met Xu Huang, an old friend, between the lines. Xu Huang first spoke warmly of old times and of how white Guan Yu's beard had grown; then he suddenly turned and shouted that whoever took Guan Yu's head would get a thousand in gold. Startled, Guan Yu asked what he meant. Xu Huang answered that today was the state's business, and he would not let private feeling override public duty.

They fought some eighty bouts; Guan Yu's arm had not healed, his strength began to fail, and Guan Ping hurriedly sounded the retreat. Seeing relief arrive, Cao Ren sallied out of Fancheng, and caught between the two, Guan Yu's army broke and he fell back along the Xiang River. Cao Cao came out in person to welcome Xu Huang and, seeing his troops standing in perfect order, said he truly had the bearing of the great Han general Zhou Yafu, and that in more than thirty years of war he himself had never dared drive straight into an enemy's siege lines.

Xu Huang's biography in the Records says Guan Yu had camps at Weitou and Sizhong; Xu Huang announced he would attack Weitou but secretly struck Sizhong. Guan Yu came out with five thousand foot and horse and was driven back, and Xu Huang chased him right into the siege lines and broke them, many of the enemy drowning in the Mian. Cao Cao's order of commendation said the siege works were ten rows deep, and that in thirty-odd years of war he had never known or heard of anyone driving straight into an enemy's siege like this. The friendly talk and the bounty on Guan Yu's head come from the Shu ji cited in the notes, in which Guan Yu cries 'Elder brother, what are you saying?' and Xu Huang answers only that it is the state's affair.
story_zh: 于禁兵败后，曹操派徐晃救援樊城。徐晃用计夺下关平驻守的偃城，又接连攻破营寨。关羽亲自出马，与老相识徐晃阵前相见。徐晃先叙旧情，说别来多年，没想到君侯须发已白；叙罢忽然回头大喝：谁能取得云长首级，重赏千金！关羽大惊，问他何出此言，徐晃答：今日乃国家之事，不敢以私废公。
两人交马战了八十余合，关羽右臂箭伤未愈，渐渐力不能支，关平急忙鸣金收兵。樊城中的曹仁见援军已到，也开城杀出，内外夹攻，荆州兵大乱，关羽只得沿襄江退走。曹操亲自出营迎接徐晃，见他的军马队伍严整，赞叹徐将军真有周亚夫之风，又说自己用兵三十余年，也不敢长驱直入敌人重围。
《三国志·徐晃传》载，关羽在围头、四冢分别屯兵，徐晃扬言要攻围头，暗中却攻四冢；关羽亲率步骑五千出战，被徐晃击退，徐晃乘势追入围中，大破其军，不少人投沔水而死。曹操下令表彰，说贼围堑鹿角十重，自己用兵三十余年，从未听说有人长驱直入敌围。阵前叙旧、悬赏首级一幕见于裴注引《蜀记》，关羽惊问“大兄，是何言邪”，徐晃只答“此国之事耳”。
ch076-xu-huang.why: Xu Huang's breakthrough turned the tide at Fancheng and, with Lü Meng's attack from behind, trapped Guan Yu.
ch076-xu-huang.why_zh: 徐晃解围扭转了樊城战局，与吕蒙的偷袭前后夹击，把关羽逼入绝境。

story: With no relief coming and food running out, Guan Yu decided to abandon Maicheng and break out north by a small road toward the west. Wang Fu warned him of ambushes; he would not listen, left Wang Fu and Zhou Cang to hold the town with a hundred-odd men, and set out by night with Guan Ping, Zhao Lei and two hundred more. Zhu Ran and Pan Zhang struck at them one after another and Zhao Lei was killed. At Jueshi, in a narrow pass, ropes hidden across the path brought down Guan Yu's horse, and Pan Zhang's officer Ma Zhong took him; Guan Ping was captured too.

Sun Quan urged him to surrender, but Guan Yu cursed him as a green-eyed boy and a purple-bearded rat, and said that he and Liu Bei had sworn brotherhood in the peach garden to uphold the Han; how could he join traitors? Sun Quan was half inclined to spare him, but an adviser reminded him that Cao Cao had showered Guan Yu with favours and still could not keep him. So father and son were beheaded; Guan Yu was fifty-eight. Red Hare, given to Ma Zhong, refused to eat and died; Wang Fu leapt from the wall and Zhou Cang cut his own throat. The novel goes on to tell of Guan Yu's spirit crying 'Give me back my head!' on Mount Yuquan, of Lü Meng dying possessed and bleeding at a victory feast, and of Cao Cao, shown the head by Sun Quan's envoys, burying it with a body carved of fragrant wood outside Luoyang.

Sun Quan's biography in the Records says that in the twelfth month of 219 Pan Zhang's major Ma Zhong captured Guan Yu, his son Guan Ping and the officer Zhao Lei at Zhangxiang; Guan Yu's biography says father and son were beheaded at Linju. The Shu ji cited in the notes claims Sun Quan wanted to keep Guan Yu alive to use against Liu Bei and Cao Cao, but Pei Songzhi rejects it: according to the Wu shu Guan Yu was killed as soon as he was caught, and Linju was too far from Jiangling to debate his fate. Sun Quan sent the head to Cao Cao, and it was buried with a lord's honours. The ghost and the possession are the novel's; Lü Meng in fact died of illness soon afterwards.
story_zh: 麦城援兵无望、粮草将尽，关羽决定弃城，从城北小路突围奔向西川。王甫劝他小路恐有埋伏，关羽不听，留王甫、周仓带一百余人守城，自己与关平、赵累带二百余人夜里出发。一路连遭朱然、潘璋截杀，赵累战死。行至决石，山路狭窄，伏兵用绊马索拽倒关羽坐骑，潘璋部将马忠将他擒获，关平也被俘。
孙权劝降，关羽大骂碧眼小儿、紫髯鼠辈，说自己与刘皇叔桃园结义，誓扶汉室，岂与叛汉之贼为伍。孙权本有爱才之意，左右提醒他曹操当年厚待关羽也没能留住，孙权便斩了关羽父子，关羽时年五十八岁。赤兔马绝食而死，王甫跳城、周仓自刎。小说接着写关羽英魂在玉泉山大呼“还我头来”，吕蒙被附体而死，曹操以沉香木雕成身躯，配上首级葬于洛阳城外。
据《三国志·吴主传》，219年十二月，潘璋司马马忠在章乡擒获关羽、关平和都督赵累；《关羽传》说关羽父子被斩于临沮。裴注引《蜀记》称孙权本想留关羽对抗刘、曹，被左右劝止；裴松之驳斥说，据《吴书》关羽被擒后当即斩杀，临沮距江陵二三百里，根本来不及商议。孙权将首级送给曹操，以诸侯之礼安葬。显灵、附体都是小说之言，吕蒙其实不久后病逝。
ch077-guan-yu-dies.why: Guan Yu's death drives Liu Bei to the war of revenge that ends at Yiling, and begins Guan Yu's long afterlife as the god Guandi.
ch077-guan-yu-dies.why_zh: 关羽之死引出刘备伐吴、兵败夷陵，关羽本人也从此走上被奉为“关帝”的神坛。

quote.zh: 还我头来！
quote.en: Give me back my head!

people.name: Guan Ping
people.role: Guan Yu's son, dies with him

people.name: Sun Quan
people.role_zh: 下令斩关羽的东吴之主

people.name: Ma Zhong
people.role: Pan Zhang's officer who captures him

story: After Guan Yu's death, Cao Cao saw him in his dreams night after night. Planning a new hall at Luoyang, he had a towering pear tree by the Zhuolong shrine cut down, and blood spurted where the axe struck; that night the tree spirit came to rebuke him in a dream, and his headaches became unbearable. After Hua Tuo's death he grew worse still, and in a haze he saw the vengeful ghosts of Empress Fu, Consort Dong, the two princes, Fu Wan, Dong Cheng and others standing in dark clouds demanding his life. He knew he would not rise again.

He called Cao Hong, Chen Qun, Jia Xu and Sima Yi to his bedside to hand over his affairs, naming his eldest son Cao Pi, sincere and dutiful, as heir. He divided his store of fine incense among his concubines and told them to learn needlework and make silk shoes to sell for a living. He ordered seventy-two decoy tombs built outside the Jiangwu fort in Zhangde, so that no one would know where he really lay and rob his grave. Then he sighed, wept, and died, at sixty-five, or sixty-six by Chinese reckoning.

The Annals of Emperor Wu in the Records say Cao Cao died at Luoyang in the first month of 220. His will said the realm was not yet at peace and the old rites need not be followed: mourning was to end after the burial, garrison troops were not to leave their posts, he was to be dressed in ordinary clothes, and no gold, jade or treasure was to go into the tomb. The incense and silk shoes come from his testament as quoted by the Jin poet Lu Ji. The seventy-two decoy tombs are later legend; he was buried at the Gao Mausoleum west of Ye, identified with a great tomb excavated at Xigaoxue near Anyang in 2009. Before the year was out, Cao Pi had ended the Han.
story_zh: 关羽死后，曹操夜夜梦见关公。他要在洛阳新建宫殿，命人砍伐濯龙祠旁一株高大的梨树，斧砍之处鲜血迸溅，当夜梨树之神入梦斥责，曹操头风大作。华佗被杀后病势更重，他又恍惚看见伏皇后、董贵人、二皇子以及伏完、董承等人的冤魂立于阴云之中索命，自知不起。
临终前，曹操召曹洪、陈群、贾诩、司马懿等人到榻前托付后事，说长子曹丕笃厚恭谨，可继大业。他把平日所藏名香分给众姬妾，嘱咐她们日后勤习女工、多做丝履卖钱度日；又遗命在彰德府讲武城外设疑冢七十二座，不让后人知道真正的葬处，以防盗掘。说罢长叹一声，泪如雨下，气绝而亡，终年六十六岁。
据《三国志·武帝纪》，220年正月曹操崩于洛阳，年六十六。遗令说天下尚未安定，不必遵循古制，下葬后即除丧服，屯戍将士不得离开驻地，入殓只穿平时衣服，不藏金玉珍宝。“分香卖履”出自西晋陆机《吊魏武帝文》所引的遗令。疑冢七十二是后世传说，曹操实葬于邺城以西的高陵，2009年河南安阳西高穴发掘的大墓被认定为曹操高陵。同年冬，曹丕代汉称帝。
ch078-cao-cao-dies.why: The death of the age's dominant figure clears the way for Cao Pi to end the Han within the year.
ch078-cao-cao-dies.why_zh: 一代枭雄谢幕，曹丕当年便代汉称帝，三国时代正式开始。

story: Cao Cao's headaches had become agonising, and no doctor could help. Hua Xin recommended the divine physician Hua Tuo, who could put patients to sleep with a drug and then open the belly and wash the bowels, and who had scraped the poison from Guan Yu's bone. Cao Cao sent for him at once. Hua Tuo took his pulse and said the pain came from wind lodged in the brain, where no medicine could reach it; the only cure was to drink an anaesthetic first, then open the skull with a sharp axe and draw out the wind.

Cao Cao flew into a rage and accused him of trying to kill him. Hua Tuo replied that Guan Yu had not flinched when he scraped his bone, so why should the king be so suspicious over a small illness? That made it worse: an arm could be scraped, Cao Cao said, but how could a skull be split? Hua Tuo must be a friend of Guan Yu's out for revenge. He had him thrown into prison and tortured. A jailer named Wu treated him with respect and fed him well, and Hua Tuo gave him his life's work, the 'Book of the Black Bag'. After Hua Tuo died in prison, Wu went home to practise from it, only to find his wife burning it; she saved just a page or two, saying that even if he became as skilled as Hua Tuo he would only die in a cell too.

Historically: Hua Tuo's biography in the Records says he did attend Cao Cao and treated his headaches with acupuncture, which gave relief at once. Later he went home on leave, claimed his wife was ill and kept overstaying; when Cao Cao found it was untrue he had him taken to the prison at Xu and interrogated. Xun Yu pleaded that such skill held men's lives in its hands, but Cao Cao had him tortured to death. Before dying Hua Tuo offered a book to the jailer, who was afraid to take it, so Hua Tuo called for fire and burned it. When Cao Cao's beloved son Cao Chong died in 208, he regretted the killing. There is no record of any skull operation.
story_zh: 曹操头风发作，疼痛难忍，遍请良医都治不好。华歆举荐神医华佗，说他能用麻药让病人昏睡，再剖腹洗肠，又曾为关羽刮骨疗毒。曹操连夜派人请来华佗。华佗诊脉后说，大王头痛是风邪所致，病根在脑袋中，吃药无用；须先饮麻药，再用利斧砍开头颅，取出风涎，才能根除。
曹操大怒，说你这是要杀我。华佗说当年关公刮骨疗毒毫无惧色，大王小病何必多疑。曹操更怒：臂痛可刮，脑袋怎能砍开？你必是与关羽交好，想趁机替他报仇！当即把华佗下狱拷问。狱卒吴押狱敬重华佗，每日酒食供养，华佗便把《青囊书》传给了他。华佗死后，吴押狱回家想照书行医，却见妻子正在烧书，抢出来只剩一两页；妻子说就算学得和华佗一样，也不过死在牢中。
史实：《三国志·华佗传》载，华佗确曾在曹操身边，用针刺为他治头风，随手见效。后来他告假回乡，推说妻子生病，屡次逾期不归，曹操查实是假，便把他押入许县狱中拷问。荀彧求情说华佗医术精妙、关系人命，曹操不听，将他拷死。华佗临死拿出一卷书交给狱吏，狱吏不敢收，华佗便索火烧了。208年爱子曹冲病死，曹操才后悔杀了华佗。开颅之说史书并无记载。
ch078-hua-tuo.why: The novel's darkest portrait of Cao Cao's suspicion, and a tragic end for the age's greatest physician.
ch078-hua-tuo.why_zh: 小说借此写尽曹操的多疑，也为一代神医画上了悲剧的句号。

quote.zh: 臂痛可刮，脑袋安可砍开？
quote.en: An aching arm may be scraped, but how can anyone split open a head?

story: After Cao Cao's death Cao Pi succeeds him as King of Wei. His brother Cao Zhang marches in from Chang'an with troops but, challenged by Jia Kui, gives them up; another brother, Cao Xiong, hangs himself in fear. Cao Zhi does not even come to the funeral: he sits drinking in Linzi with his partisans the Ding brothers and insults Cao Pi's envoy. Cao Pi sends Xu Chu with three thousand guards to bring him to Ye, and the Ding brothers are put to death.

Hua Xin suggests putting Cao Zhi's famous talent to the test. Pointing to a painting of two oxen fighting by a wall, one of which falls into a well, Cao Pi orders a poem on it within seven paces, without naming the scene outright, and Cao Zhi has it done in seven steps. Then Cao Pi demands an instant poem on brothers without the word “brother”, and Cao Zhi at once chants the four lines of the beans boiled over a fire of their own stalks. Cao Pi bursts into tears, their mother Lady Bian comes out from behind the hall to ask why he presses his brother so hard, and Cao Zhi escapes with demotion to Marquis of Anxiang.

Historically: on becoming king, Cao Pi did kill the Ding brothers and the men of their families, and kept his own brothers under close watch. In 221 a court supervisor reported Cao Zhi for drunken insolence and threatening an envoy, and he was demoted to Marquis of Anxiang; he was moved from fief to fief, never trusted with office, and died frustrated in 232 at forty-one. The seven-step poem first appears in Liu Yiqing's Shishuo xinyu of the fifth century, in a six-line version; the familiar four lines are a later trimming, and the poem is not in Cao Zhi's collected works.
story_zh: 曹操死后，曹丕继位为魏王。弟弟曹彰从长安领兵前来，被贾逵一番质问，交出了兵权；曹熊畏罪自缢；曹植却不来奔丧，在临淄与丁仪、丁廙终日饮酒，还辱骂了曹丕派去的使者。曹丕大怒，派许褚率三千虎卫军把曹植押到邺城，丁氏兄弟也被处死。
华歆献计，以才学相试。曹丕指着壁上二牛相斗、一牛坠井的画，令曹植七步之内作诗，不许直说画中情景，曹植七步而成。曹丕又令他以兄弟为题当场作诗，不许用“兄弟”二字，曹植应声吟出“煮豆燃豆萁”四句。曹丕听了潸然泪下，母亲卞氏也从殿后出来责问“兄何逼弟之甚耶”，曹植这才保住性命，被贬为安乡侯。
史实：曹丕即王位后确实诛杀了丁仪、丁廙及其家中男子，对诸弟严加防范。黄初二年（221年），监国谒者灌均奏曹植醉酒悖慢、劫胁使者，曹植被贬为安乡侯，此后屡次改换封地，始终不得重用，232年郁郁而终，年仅四十一岁。七步诗最早见于南朝刘义庆的《世说新语》，原为六句，通行的四句本是后人删改，曹植本集也不载此诗。
ch079-seven-steps.why: The poem made Cao Zhi the emblem of brothers turned against each other, and its last line became the proverb for strife within a family.
ch079-seven-steps.why_zh: 这首诗让骨肉相残的悲剧深入人心，“相煎何太急”至今仍用来形容自家人互相倾轧。

quote.zh: 本是同根生，相煎何太急
quote.en: We grew from the same root; why such haste to scorch me?

story: Soon after Cao Pi becomes King of Wei, reports of good omens pour in: phoenixes, a qilin, a yellow dragon. Hua Xin, Wang Lang and other ministers take the hint and go into the palace to press Emperor Xian to abdicate. The emperor weeps and refuses; Cao Hong and Cao Xiu stride into the hall wearing swords; and Zu Bi, keeper of the imperial seals, who loudly refuses to hand over the seal, is dragged out and beheaded. The emperor has no choice but to issue the edict.

When the edict arrives Cao Pi wants to accept at once, but Sima Yi advises him to decline first, to silence the world's criticism. After the refusals Hua Xin has an abdication terrace built at Fanyang, and on the chosen day Emperor Xian himself carries the seal up to present it. Cao Pi takes the throne, names the dynasty Great Wei, changes the era to Huangchu, honours his father as Emperor Wu, and makes Emperor Xian Duke of Shanyang, sent away that same day. The novel adds a gale that blows up as the ceremony ends, knocks Cao Pi down on the terrace, and leaves him ill for days.

The Records dates the abdication to the tenth month of 220; Cao Pi received the throne at Fanyang and renamed the place Fanchang. Pei Songzhi's notes quote the Weishi chunqiu: after the ceremony Cao Pi told his ministers, “Now I know what happened with Shun and Yu.” The Hou Hanshu adds that Emperor Xian's empress, Cao Cao's daughter Cao Jie, refused to give up the seal, then flung it down weeping, “Heaven will not bless you!” The deposed emperor lived on as Duke of Shanyang until 234.
story_zh: 曹丕做了魏王不久，各地纷纷奏报凤凰、麒麟、黄龙出现等祥瑞。华歆、王朗等大臣心领神会，入宫逼汉献帝让位。献帝痛哭不从，曹洪、曹休带剑上殿，掌管玉玺的符宝郎祖弼厉声拒交玉玺，被推出斩首。献帝无可奈何，只得下诏禅位于魏王。
诏书送到，曹丕想立即接受，司马懿劝他先上表推辞，以堵天下人之口。几番辞让之后，华歆请在繁阳筑起受禅台。到了吉日，献帝亲自捧玺登台，曹丕受禅即位，国号大魏，改元黄初，追尊曹操为武皇帝，降献帝为山阳公，令他即日离京。小说还写典礼刚毕便狂风大作，曹丕惊倒台上，回宫后病了多日。
据《三国志·文帝纪》，延康元年（220年）十月，曹丕在繁阳受禅，并将其地改名繁昌。裴注引《魏氏春秋》说，曹丕礼毕后对群臣说：“舜、禹之事，吾知之矣。”《后汉书》记载，献帝的皇后曹节是曹操之女，起初不肯交出玉玺，最后把玉玺掷到轩下，哭道：“天不祚尔！”退位的献帝作为山阳公一直活到234年。
ch080-cao-pi-emperor.why: The abdication formally ended the four-hundred-year Han dynasty and turned the Cao family's long regency into the Wei empire.
ch080-cao-pi-emperor.why_zh: 这次禅让正式终结了延续四百年的汉朝，把曹氏多年的实际掌权变成了名正言顺的魏朝。

people.name: Cao Pi
people.role: King of Wei, takes the throne

people.name: Emperor Xian
people.role: last Han emperor, forced to abdicate
people.role_zh: 被迫禅位的汉朝末代皇帝

story: News reaches Chengdu that Cao Pi has usurped the Han, together with a rumour that Emperor Xian has been murdered. Liu Bei weeps all day, puts the court into mourning, gives the emperor the posthumous title Xiaomin, and falls ill with grief. Zhuge Liang, Xu Jing, Qiao Zhou and the other officials say the state cannot be without a ruler, cite auspicious signs, and urge him to take the throne and carry on the Han line. Liu Bei angrily asks whether they mean to make him disloyal and unrighteous.

So Zhuge Liang takes to his bed. When Liu Bei comes to visit, Zhuge Liang tells him that his officers have risked their lives in hope of great deeds; if he keeps refusing, they will drift away, and Wei and Wu will take the two Chuan. Liu Bei gives way, saying it can wait until the strategist is well. At that Zhuge Liang leaps up from his couch and strikes the screen, and the whole court files in and bows. In the fourth month of 221 Liu Bei ascends the altar south of Wudan in Chengdu, names the era Zhangwu, and makes Liu Shan crown prince and Zhuge Liang chancellor.

The Records confirms that “it was rumoured the Han emperor had been killed”, and that Liu Bei put on mourning and gave him the title Xiaomin; in fact Emperor Xian lived on as Duke of Shanyang until 234. Liu Bei kept Han as the name of his state. Fei Shi, who argued that proclaiming himself before the great enemy was beaten would sow doubt, was demoted for it. Chen Shou, a Jin official, called the state Shu; later ages say Shu Han.
story_zh: 曹丕篡汉的消息传到成都，又误传汉献帝已经遇害。刘备痛哭终日，下令百官挂孝，遥祭献帝，追谥为孝愍皇帝，自己也因忧伤成病。诸葛亮与许靖、谯周等群臣认为国不可一日无君，列举祥瑞天象，劝刘备即皇帝位，延续汉朝正统。刘备发怒说：你们是要陷我于不忠不义吗？
诸葛亮于是称病不出。刘备亲到府中探望，诸葛亮说众文武舍命追随，都盼着建功立业，陛下若坚持不肯，人心离散，魏、吴来攻，两川就难保了。刘备只好说，等军师病好了再办不迟。话音刚落，诸葛亮从榻上一跃而起，拍击屏风，文武百官一齐拥入拜倒。221年四月，刘备在成都武担之南登坛即位，改元章武，立刘禅为太子，以诸葛亮为丞相。
《三国志·先主传》记载，当时“或传闻汉帝见害”，刘备于是发丧制服，追谥孝愍皇帝；其实献帝作为山阳公一直活到234年。刘备即位后国号仍为汉。费诗曾上疏，认为大敌未灭便先自立，恐怕人心疑惑，因此被贬官。陈寿身为晋臣，修史时称之为“蜀”，后世又称“蜀汉”。
ch080-liu-bei-emperor.why: By keeping the Han name, Liu Bei made his state the claimed heir of the dynasty, the basis of the novel's view that Shu was the legitimate line.
ch080-liu-bei-emperor.why_zh: 刘备沿用汉的国号，自居汉朝正统的继承者，这正是小说“尊刘贬曹”立场的根基。

story: After Guan Yu's death Zhang Fei weeps day and night in Langzhong, drowns his grief in wine, and flogs his men when drunk. Once Liu Bei, now emperor, decides on war with Wu, Zhang Fei hurries to Chengdu to urge him on, then returns to Langzhong to make ready. Liu Bei warns him at parting: you flog your soldiers when drunk and still keep them at your side; that is the road to disaster, so be more lenient. Zhang Fei pays no heed.

Back in camp he orders white banners and white armour for the whole army within three days, so that they can march against Wu in mourning. When his officers Fan Jiang and Zhang Da ask for more time, he has them tied to a tree and given fifty lashes each, and says they will lose their heads if the work is late. Desperate, they decide to strike first. That night Zhang Fei lies drunk in his tent; they creep in, find his eyes wide open and hesitate, until his thunderous snoring tells them he is asleep, then stab him in the belly and carry his head down the river to Wu. Told that a report has come from Zhang Fei's camp, Liu Bei knows at once that his brother is dead.

The episode follows the Records closely. Zhang Fei, it says, respected gentlemen but had no care for common soldiers, and Liu Bei warned him that harsh punishments and daily floggings, with the flogged men kept close about him, were the way to ruin. In 221 he was to bring ten thousand men from Langzhong to join the army at Jiangzhou, but before he set out his officers Zhang Da and Fan Qiang (Fan Jiang in the novel) killed him and took his head down the river to Sun Quan. Hearing that Zhang Fei's camp commander had sent a report, Liu Bei said: “Alas, Fei is dead.” The white armour and the three-day deadline are the novel's.
story_zh: 关羽死后，张飞在阆中日夜哭泣，借酒浇愁，醉后动辄鞭打士卒。刘备称帝后决意伐吴，张飞赶到成都力劝出兵，随即回阆中整顿人马。临别时刘备告诫他：你常常酒后鞭打健儿，又把他们留在身边，这是取祸之道，今后务必宽容。张飞并未放在心上。
回营后，张飞下令三日之内备齐白旗白甲，全军挂孝伐吴。部将范疆、张达请求宽限，张飞大怒，把二人绑在树上各打五十鞭，限期不完便要斩首。二人走投无路，决定先下手。当夜张飞大醉卧帐中，二人潜入，见他双眼圆睁，起初不敢动手，听到鼾声如雷，才用短刀刺入腹中，提着首级顺江投奔东吴。刘备得知张飞营中有表送来，便知三弟已死。
这段故事大体本于《三国志·张飞传》：张飞“爱敬君子而不恤小人”，刘备曾告诫他刑杀过度、鞭挞健儿而令在左右，是取祸之道。221年刘备伐吴，张飞应率一万人从阆中到江州会师，临行前被帐下将张达、范强（小说作范疆）所杀，二人持首顺流投奔孙权。刘备听说张飞营都督有表奏来，便说：“噫！飞死矣。”白旗白甲和三日限期是小说添写的。
ch081-zhang-fei-killed.why: Losing his second sworn brother before the war even began made Liu Bei all the more set on revenge, and the campaign that followed broke Shu's strength.
ch081-zhang-fei-killed.why_zh: 出师之前又失去一位结义兄弟，刘备复仇之心更加坚决，随后的东征让蜀汉元气大伤。

people.name: Zhang Fei
people.role: Shu general, murdered in his sleep

people.name: Fan Jiang
people.role: officer, the other assassin (Fan Qiang in the Records)
people.role_zh: 部将，刺杀者之一（史书作范强）

story: Liu Bei's first act as emperor is to raise the whole country's forces against Wu to avenge Guan Yu. Zhao Yun objects: the traitor to the state is Cao Cao, not Sun Quan; with Cao Pi on a usurped throne, the army should strike at the Guanzhong first; the enemy of the Han is a public cause, a brother's death a private one. Liu Bei answers that if he cannot avenge his brother, an empire of ten thousand li is worth nothing to him. The scholar Qin Mi pleads too, is nearly executed and ends up in prison; Zhuge Liang sends a memorial, and Liu Bei throws it to the ground.

The news of Zhang Fei's murder only deepens his grief and fury. Sun Quan hastily sends Zhuge Jin to sue for peace, offering to send back Lady Sun and return Jingzhou, and is refused. Leaving Zhuge Liang to help the crown prince hold Chengdu, Liu Bei leads the army down the Yangzi. Zhang Fei's son Zhang Bao and Guan Yu's son Guan Xing vie for the lead, the Wu general Sun Huan and others fall back again and again, and the Shu army sweeps on to Zigui.

Zhao Yun's protest comes from the Zhao Yun biezhuan quoted in Pei's notes, and Qin Mi's imprisonment for opposing the war is in his biography in the Records. In the seventh month of 221 Liu Bei marched; Sun Quan asked for peace and was refused. The Shu generals Wu Ban and Feng Xi broke the Wu commanders Li Yi and Liu A at Wu county and the army advanced to Zigui, while the Wuxi tribes of Wuling sent envoys to join the cause. After the defeat Zhuge Liang sighed that if Fa Zheng had lived, he could have kept the emperor from going east.
story_zh: 刘备即位后的头一件事，就是要起倾国之兵伐吴，为关羽报仇。赵云进谏：国贼乃曹操，非孙权也；如今曹丕篡汉，应先图关中，汉贼之仇是公，兄弟之仇是私，愿以天下为重。刘备答道：朕不为弟报仇，纵有万里江山，又有何贵？学士秦宓苦谏，险些被斩，终被下狱；诸葛亮上表劝阻，刘备看罢掷于地上。
张飞遇害的噩耗传来，刘备更是悲愤难平。孙权急派诸葛瑾前来求和，许诺送还孙夫人、交还荆州，也被刘备拒绝。刘备留诸葛亮辅佐太子镇守成都，亲率大军顺江东下。张飞之子张苞、关羽之子关兴随军争先，吴将孙桓等节节败退，蜀军势如破竹，直抵秭归一带。
赵云的谏言见于裴注引《赵云别传》，秦宓因谏阻伐吴下狱，见《三国志·秦宓传》。221年七月刘备东征，孙权遣使求和，刘备不许。蜀将吴班、冯习在巫县击破吴将李异、刘阿，进军秭归，武陵五溪蛮也遣使响应。后来兵败，诸葛亮叹息说：法孝直（法正）若在，必能劝阻主上，不让他东行。
ch081-liu-bei-marches.why: Choosing private vengeance over the war on Wei, Liu Bei committed Shu to the campaign that would end in its worst defeat.
ch081-liu-bei-marches.why_zh: 刘备舍弃讨魏大义而为兄弟复仇，把蜀汉推向了一场惨败。

quote.zh: 国贼乃曹操，非孙权也
quote.en: The traitor to the state is Cao Cao, not Sun Quan.

story: With Shu winning battle after battle, Gan Ning killed by an arrow and the Wu army beaten again and again, Sun Quan is at a loss. Kan Ze tells him that after Zhou Yu, Lu Su and Lü Meng, Wu still has a pillar to hold up the sky, Lu Xun, and stakes his whole family on him. Zhang Zhao says Lu Xun is a mere scholar and no match for Liu Bei; Gu Yong that he is too young to command respect; Bu Zhi that he is fit to run a commandery and no more. Kan Ze cries that without Lu Xun, Wu is finished.

Sun Quan overrules them, builds an altar and makes Lu Xun grand commander, giving him a sword and seal. At the front old generals such as Han Dang and Zhou Tai look on this pale scholar with contempt. Lu Xun orders every post to hold its pass and not fight; when Sun Huan, besieged at Yiling, begs for help, he will not send it, and with his hand on his sword declares that anyone who disobeys will die. Shu troops jeer at the gates day after day, and Wu stays inside. It is high summer, and Liu Bei moves his camps into the forests beside the streams, strung out over seven hundred li.

The Records bears this out. Sun Quan made Lu Xun grand commander over Zhu Ran, Pan Zhang, Han Dang, Xu Sheng, Sun Huan and others, fifty thousand men. The generals, old officers of Sun Ce or kinsmen of the ruling house, would not take his orders, and Lu Xun, hand on sword, told them: “I may be a scholar, but I hold my orders from our lord.” When Sun Huan was besieged at Yidao, Lu Xun judged that he had his men's loyalty and a strong, well-stocked town, and sent no help. In fact Lu Xun was nearly forty and had helped plan the seizure of Jingzhou three years before; Kan Ze's pledge of his family is the novel's.
story_zh: 蜀军连战连胜，甘宁中箭身亡，吴军屡败，孙权惊惶无措。阚泽进言：周瑜、鲁肃、吕蒙之后，东吴还有擎天之柱陆逊，并愿以全家性命担保。张昭说陆逊不过一介书生，不是刘备的对手；顾雍嫌他年幼望轻；步骘说他只是治郡之才。阚泽大呼：若不用陆伯言，东吴就完了！
孙权力排众议，筑坛拜陆逊为大都督，赐剑授印。陆逊到了军中，韩当、周泰等老将见是个白面书生，都不服气。陆逊下令各处坚守关隘，不许出战；孙桓在夷陵被困求救，他也不肯发兵，又按剑申明军令，违者必斩。蜀兵天天在关前辱骂挑战，吴军始终闭营不出。时值盛夏，刘备把营寨移入山林溪涧之间避暑，连营七百余里。
《三国志·陆逊传》载，孙权以陆逊为大都督，统率朱然、潘璋、韩当、徐盛、孙桓等五万人抵御蜀军。诸将或是孙策旧将，或是公室贵戚，各不相服，陆逊按剑说：“仆虽书生，受命主上。”孙桓在夷道被围，陆逊认为他深得士心、城坚粮足，不肯分兵相救。其实陆逊当时已近四十岁，三年前还参与谋划袭取荆州；阚泽以全家担保一事是小说添写。
ch083-lu-xun-commander.why: Lu Xun's refusal to fight, taken for timidity, wore down Liu Bei's army in the summer heat and set up the fire that destroyed it.
ch083-lu-xun-commander.why_zh: 陆逊被讥为怯懦的坚守不战，拖垮了盛夏中的蜀军，为火烧连营埋下伏笔。

people.name: Kan Ze
people.role: vouches for Lu Xun with his family

story: After Huang Zhong dies of an arrow wound, Liu Bei leads the attack at Xiaoting himself. In the confusion Guan Xing chases Pan Zhang, loses his way after dark, and asks for shelter at a farmhouse in the hills, where a portrait of Guan Yu hangs in the hall. Pan Zhang happens to come to the same house; seeing Guan Yu's ghost appear, he turns to run, and Guan Xing cuts him down, offers his blood before his father's picture, and takes back his father's Green Dragon blade.

Mi Fang and Fu Shiren, whose surrender of their cities doomed Guan Yu, now fear the Shu army; they kill Ma Zhong, the man who captured Guan Yu, and bring his head to Liu Bei, who has them put to death before Guan Yu's spirit tablet. Zhang Bao weeps to avenge his own father. Sun Quan in alarm sends back Zhang Fei's murderers, Fan Jiang and Zhang Da, in a cage together with Zhang Fei's head, and offers to return Lady Sun and Jingzhou. Liu Bei has the two killed before Zhang Fei's tablet, but still refuses peace: he means to destroy Wu.

Historically: all this settling of scores is invented. Pan Zhang in fact fought at Yiling, where his men killed the Shu general Feng Xi, and lived until 234. Mi Fang lived on in Wu, where Yu Fan once mocked him to his face; Fu Shiren, called Shi Ren in the Records, simply drops out of the record; and Ma Zhong, the officer under Pan Zhang who took Guan Yu, has no recorded end. Nor is there any record of Wu handing Zhang Fei's killers back to Shu.
story_zh: 黄忠中箭身亡后，刘备亲率大军进攻猇亭。关兴在乱军中追赶潘璋，天黑迷路，投宿到山中一户人家，只见堂上供着关公画像。不料潘璋也来到这家投宿，忽见关公显圣，转身要逃，被关兴追上斩杀。关兴在父亲像前沥血祭奠，又夺回了父亲的青龙偃月刀。
当年献城降吴、害死关羽的糜芳、傅士仁，见蜀军势大，便杀了擒获关羽的马忠，提着首级来降。刘备大怒，在关羽灵前将二人处死。张苞也哭求为父报仇。孙权惊恐，把杀害张飞的范疆、张达装进囚车，连同张飞首级送还，又许诺送回孙夫人、交还荆州，以求罢兵。刘备在张飞灵前处死二人，却仍不许和，誓要灭吴。
史实：这些快意恩仇的情节都是虚构。潘璋其实参加了夷陵之战，部下还斩了蜀将冯习，他直到234年才去世。糜芳降吴后一直生活在东吴，曾被虞翻当面讥讽；傅士仁在史书中作“士仁”，此后下落不明；擒获关羽的马忠是潘璋部下的司马，结局也不见记载。史书更没有东吴交还杀害张飞凶手的记载。
ch083-enemies-delivered.why: The novel grants readers the revenge history denied them, paying off Guan Yu's and Zhang Fei's deaths just before Liu Bei's own ruin.
ch083-enemies-delivered.why_zh: 小说让读者在刘备败亡之前先出了一口恶气，替关羽、张飞报了史书上没能报的仇。

people.name: Guan Xing
people.role: Guan Yu's son, kills Pan Zhang

people.name: Pan Zhang
people.role: Wu general whose man took Guan Yu

story: As the Shu camps move into the forest, Ma Liang draws a map of them and takes it to Zhuge Liang. Zhuge Liang strikes the table: camping along hills, woods and broken ground is what the art of war forbids; who advised the emperor to do this? Told it was Liu Bei's own idea, he sighs that the Han's fortune is running out, and tells Ma Liang to hurry back: if disaster comes, the emperor should fall back to Baidi. Cao Pi too, hearing that Liu Bei's camps stretch for seven hundred li, laughs that he knows nothing of war and says news of a Wu victory will soon arrive.

Lu Xun first sends Chunyu Dan against a single camp; the attack fails, but it shows him how to win. When the wind is right he has every soldier carry a bundle of reeds stuffed with sulphur and saltpetre, and at night sets the camps alight, with Zhu Ran coming by river and Han Dang and Zhou Tai on the flanks. The flames leap from camp to camp and more than forty go up; Fu Tong dies fighting, and Feng Xi, Zhang Nan and Shamoke are killed. Liu Bei flees to Ma'an Hill and is surrounded, saved only by the desperate fighting of Guan Xing and Zhang Bao and by Zhao Yun arriving from Jiangzhou, and escapes by night to Baidi.

Lu Xun's biography in the Records tells much the same story: after one failed attack he “had each man carry a bundle of reeds and took the camps by fire”, killed Zhang Nan, Feng Xi and the tribal king Shamoke, and broke more than forty camps. Liu Bei, surrounded on Ma'an Hill, lost tens of thousands and got away only because post-station men burned armour to block the road behind him; his boats and stores were almost all lost. “To be humiliated by Lu Xun, is this not Heaven's will?” he said. Huang Quan, cut off north of the river, had to surrender to Wei. Cao Pi's remark comes from the Wei shu quoted in Pei's notes.
story_zh: 蜀军移营山林，马良把各营布置画成图本，送去给诸葛亮过目。诸葛亮看后拍案叫苦，说依傍山林险阻结营是兵家大忌，问是谁教主上这样下寨。得知是刘备自己的主张，他叹道汉朝气数要尽了，嘱咐马良速回：万一有失，请天子退守白帝城。曹丕听说刘备连营七百余里，也笑他不懂用兵，断定东吴的捷报不日就到。
陆逊先派淳于丹试攻一营，失利而回，却由此看出了破敌之法。他看准风势，令士兵各带茅草一把，内藏硫黄焰硝，夜里顺风放火，朱然从水路、韩当和周泰从两翼一齐杀出。蜀营接连起火，四十余营化为灰烬，傅彤力战而死，冯习、张南、沙摩柯等阵亡。刘备逃上马鞍山，又被团团围住，幸有关兴、张苞死战，赵云从江州赶来接应，才连夜逃入白帝城。
据《三国志·陆逊传》，陆逊先攻一营不利，随即“敕各持一把茅，以火攻拔之”，斩张南、冯习及胡王沙摩柯，破蜀军四十余营。刘备退上马鞍山，四面受敌，死者以万计，靠驿站人员焚烧铠甲堵塞道路才得脱身，舟船器械几乎丧尽。他羞愤地说：“吾乃为逊所折辱，岂非天邪！”江北的黄权退路被断，只得降魏。曹丕的评语见于裴注引《魏书》。
ch084-yiling.why: Yiling destroyed the last great army Liu Bei could raise, settled the fate of Jingzhou for good, and made Lu Xun the guardian of Wu's west.
ch084-yiling.why_zh: 夷陵之战葬送了刘备最后一支大军，荆州归属从此尘埃落定，陆逊也由此成为东吴的西线柱石。

people.name: Lu Xun
people.role_zh: 火攻破蜀的东吴大都督

people.name: Cao Pi
people.role: Wei emperor who foresees the defeat

story: Pursuing Liu Bei toward Kuiguan, Lu Xun sees a murderous aura rising into the sky from the riverbank. His scouts find no soldiers at all, only eighty or ninety piles of stones. Local people tell him that Zhuge Liang laid them out here when he entered Sichuan. Lu Xun rides in with a few dozen horsemen to look, and laughs that it is a trick to bewilder people and good for nothing else.

When he tries to leave, a gale rises, sand flies and stones roll, rocks loom like swords and the river roars like an army's drums, and he cannot find the way out. An old man appears before his horse: Huang Chengyan, Zhuge Liang's father-in-law, who leads him out of the stones. This is the Eight Formations, he explains, with eight gates that change without end, worth a hundred thousand picked troops; Zhuge Liang foresaw that a Wu general would be lost here and told him not to help, but he could not bear to watch the man die. Back in camp Lu Xun sighs that Kongming truly is the Sleeping Dragon, and withdraws, lest Cao Pi strike Wu from behind.

Historically: the Records says Zhuge Liang “worked out the art of war and made the Eight Formations diagram”, and the stone ridges on the river at Yufu said to be his were already described in Li Daoyuan's Commentary on the Water Classic; Du Fu wrote of them, “The river flows on, the stones do not turn; the regret is the failure to swallow Wu.” But Lu Xun never pursued so far. When Liu Bei reached Baidi, Xu Sheng, Pan Zhang and others pressed to attack again, but Lu Xun, with Zhu Ran and Luo Tong, judged that Cao Pi was about to invade and pulled back. Soon Wei did attack Wu on three fronts.
story_zh: 陆逊乘胜追赶刘备，来到夔关附近，只见江边一阵杀气冲天而起。派人探看，回报说并无一兵一卒，只有乱石八九十堆。询问当地人，才知是诸葛亮当年入川时在此用石头排成的阵势。陆逊带着几十名骑兵上前观看，笑道：这不过是迷惑人的把戏，有什么用处！
等他要退出时，忽然狂风大作，飞沙走石，怪石嵯峨如剑，江声浪涌如千军擂鼓，找不到出路。一位老人来到马前，自称诸葛亮的岳父黄承彦，将他引出石阵。老人说这就是八阵图，分为八门，变化无穷，可比十万精兵；诸葛亮料定日后有东吴大将迷于阵中，嘱咐不可引他出来，自己不忍见他陷没。陆逊回营感叹孔明真是卧龙，随即班师，以防曹丕乘虚袭吴。
史实：《三国志·诸葛亮传》说他“推演兵法，作八阵图”，鱼腹浦江边相传为他所布的石垒遗迹，北魏郦道元的《水经注》已有记载，杜甫也有“江流石不转，遗恨失吞吴”之句。但陆逊并没有追到这里：刘备退入白帝城后，徐盛、潘璋等人争相上表请求再攻，陆逊与朱然、骆统却判断曹丕必乘机南下，主动收兵。不久魏军果然三路伐吴。
ch084-stone-sentinel-maze.why: The maze lets Zhuge Liang, far away in Chengdu, still shield his defeated lord, and it gave a real riverside monument its legend.
ch084-stone-sentinel-maze.why_zh: 远在成都的诸葛亮借一座石阵护住了败退的刘备，江边的石垒遗迹也因此有了传奇。

quote.zh: 孔明真卧龙也！吾不能及！
quote.en: Kongming truly is the Sleeping Dragon! I can never match him.

people.name: Lu Xun
people.role: Wu commander lost in the maze
people.role_zh: 误入石阵的东吴大都督

people.name: Huang Chengyan
people.role: Zhuge Liang's father-in-law, leads him out
people.role_zh: 诸葛亮岳父，引陆逊出阵

story: Ashamed after Yiling, Liu Bei will not go back to Chengdu; he stays at Baidi and renames his lodging the Palace of Yong'an, Lasting Peace. Grief and anger make him ill, and when he dreams that Guan Yu and Zhang Fei have come for him, he knows the end is near and sends for Zhuge Liang, who hurries there with the princes Liu Yong and Liu Li, leaving the crown prince Liu Shan to hold Chengdu.

Liu Bei first asks what Zhuge Liang thinks of Ma Su, and warns him that Ma Su's words outrun his ability and he must not be given great charges. Then, holding his hand, he says: your talent is ten times Cao Pi's; you will surely secure the state and finish the great work; if my son can be helped, help him; if he has no talent, you may make yourself master of Chengdu. Drenched in sweat, Zhuge Liang falls weeping to the ground and knocks his head until it bleeds, swearing to serve with all his strength until death. Liu Bei tells his sons to treat the chancellor as a father, asks Zhao Yun to watch over them, leaves a last edict for Liu Shan, and dies at sixty-three.

The scene is in the histories almost as told. The Records gives Liu Bei's charge and Zhuge Liang's answer that he would give all his strength and loyalty “and follow it with death”; Pei's notes quote the last edict: “Do not do a wrong because it is small, nor leave a good deed undone because it is small; only worth and virtue win men over.” Li Yan also received the dying charge and stayed to guard Yong'an. Chen Shou called it the height of trust between ruler and minister; the Eastern Jin historian Sun Sheng condemned the words “take it yourself” as a reckless command, and some later readers have seen a test in them.
story_zh: 夷陵惨败后，刘备羞于回成都，便留在白帝城，把馆驿改名为永安宫。他忧愤成疾，病势日重，又梦见关羽、张飞来迎，自知不久于人世，派人到成都请诸葛亮。丞相带着鲁王刘永、梁王刘理星夜赶来，留太子刘禅守成都。
刘备先问诸葛亮对马谡的看法，告诫他马谡言过其实，不可大用。随后握着诸葛亮的手说：君才十倍曹丕，必能安邦定国，终定大事；若嗣子可辅则辅之，如其不才，君可自为成都之主。诸葛亮汗流遍体，泣拜于地，叩头流血，誓言竭尽股肱之力，继之以死。刘备又命两个儿子以父礼事丞相，托赵云照看幼子，留遗诏告诫刘禅，随即去世，年六十三岁。
这一幕在史书中几乎原样可见。《三国志·先主传》载有刘备托孤之语和诸葛亮“臣敢竭股肱之力，效忠贞之节，继之以死”的回答；裴注引《诸葛亮集》载其遗诏：“勿以恶小而为之，勿以善小而不为。惟贤惟德，能服于人。”尚书令李严同受遗诏，留镇永安。陈寿赞之为“君臣之至公”；东晋孙盛却批评“君可自取”是乱命，后人也有视之为试探的。
ch085-baidi.why: The deathbed charge sealed the bond between ruler and minister that defines Zhuge Liang for the rest of the novel: everything he does afterwards keeps this promise.
ch085-baidi.why_zh: 白帝托孤奠定了诸葛亮此后的一生：他后来的一切作为，都是在兑现这一诺言。

quote.zh: 勿以恶小而为之，勿以善小而不为
quote.en: Never do a wrong because it is small; never neglect a good deed because it is small.

story: Soon after Liu Bei's death the southern king Meng Huo raids the border, and the governors Yong Kai of Jianning, Zhu Bao of Zangke and Gao Ding of Yuexi rise with him. Zhuge Liang decides to go south himself. Wang Lian protests that the south is barren, plague-ridden country, and that the chancellor, on whom the whole state depends, should not risk himself there. Zhuge Liang answers that the southerners will never be subdued unless he goes in person, settles the affairs of the court, and marches.

As the army sets out, the emperor sends Ma Su with wine and silk for the troops. Asked for advice, Ma Su says the southerners trust in their distance and their mountains; beat them today and they will rebel tomorrow. In war, winning hearts comes first and winning cities second; battle of minds is better than battle of arms; let the chancellor simply win their hearts. “Youchang knows my very heart,” says Zhuge Liang, and takes him along as adviser. At Yuexi he sows discord so that Gao Ding's side does away with Yong Kai and Zhu Bao, then turns to face Meng Huo.

The Records says that in the spring of 225 Zhuge Liang led the army south and by autumn the whole region was pacified, its products afterwards enriching Shu's war chest. Wang Lian's protest is in his biography; Ma Su's advice comes from the Xiangyang ji quoted in Pei's notes, given as Ma Su saw him off for some tens of li. The real advance went three ways: Zhuge Liang by Yuexi, Li Hui toward Jianning, Ma Zhong against Zangke; and Yong Kai had already been killed by Gao Ding's men before the army arrived.
story_zh: 刘备死后不久，南蛮王孟获起兵侵扰边境，建宁太守雍闿、牂牁太守朱褒、越嶲太守高定也相继反叛。诸葛亮决定亲自南征。王连劝阻说，南方是不毛之地、瘴疫之乡，丞相身系一国之望，不宜亲身冒险。诸葛亮认为南人难以驯服，非亲往不能平定，安排好朝中事务后率大军出发。
大军启程时，后主派马谡带着酒帛前来犒军。诸葛亮向他求计，马谡说：南蛮恃其地远山险，久不臣服，今日打败，明日又反；用兵之道，攻心为上，攻城为下，心战为上，兵战为下，愿丞相只求收服其心。诸葛亮叹道：幼常真懂我的心思！遂命马谡为参军随行。到了越嶲，他用离间计使高定一方除掉雍闿、朱褒，随即与孟获交锋。
据《三国志·诸葛亮传》，建兴三年（225年）春，诸葛亮率众南征，当年秋天全部平定，从此南中的物产充实了蜀汉军资。王连谏阻见于《王连传》；马谡“攻心为上”之策出自裴注引《襄阳记》，是马谡送行数十里时所献。实际进军分为三路：诸葛亮自越嶲进入，李恢趋建宁，马忠攻牂牁；雍闿在大军到来之前已被高定部下所杀。
ch087-southern-campaign.why: The southern campaign secured Shu's rear and resources before the northern wars, and “win their hearts” became the novel's model for ruling the frontier.
ch087-southern-campaign.why_zh: 南征稳定了蜀汉的后方和财源，为北伐铺平道路，“攻心为上”也成了小说中治理边地的典范。

quote.zh: 攻心为上，攻城为下
quote.en: Winning hearts comes first; winning cities comes second.

people.name: Wang Lian
people.role: minister who begs him not to go

story: The first time Meng Huo is caught in an ambush he will not submit: he was tricked on narrow mountain paths, he says, so Zhuge Liang lets him go to raise a new army. After that he loses again and again. Once his own chieftains tie him up and hand him over; once his brother Meng You feigns surrender, and Meng Huo's night raid finds an empty camp; once, chasing Zhuge Liang, he tumbles into a pit. He calls in allies, King Duosi behind his poisoned springs and King Mulu with his tigers and leopards, and his wife Lady Zhurong rides into battle herself; Zhuge Liang undoes them all.

Each time Meng Huo still will not submit, and each time Zhuge Liang gives him food and wine and sends him home. At last he brings in the rattan-armoured army of Wuge, sees it burned in Panshe Valley, and is taken for the seventh time. When Zhuge Liang offers to free him yet again, Meng Huo weeps: seven captures and seven releases have never happened before; though he lives beyond the pale he knows right from wrong, and cannot be so shameless. Kneeling with his clan, he swears: “Your heavenly might, Chancellor! The southerners will never rebel again.” Zhuge Liang leaves him to rule the south, with no Han officials and no garrison, and marches home.

Historically: Chen Shou's Records says only that the south was “all pacified by autumn” and never mentions Meng Huo. The seven captures come from the Han-Jin chunqiu quoted in Pei's notes: Meng Huo was respected by southerners and Han settlers alike; once caught, he was shown round the camp, freed and caught “seven times”, and finally said, “You are Heaven's might, my lord; the southerners will not rebel again,” after which the army reached Dianchi. Many historians doubt the number. The Huayang guozhi says Meng Huo later became a deputy censor-in-chief at the Shu court. And the south rose again soon after the army left; Li Hui, Ma Zhong and Zhang Ni spent years putting down revolts.
story_zh: 孟获第一次中伏被擒，不服，说是山路狭窄误中奸计，诸葛亮便放他回去重整兵马。此后他屡战屡败：有一次被手下洞主绑了献来，有一次让弟弟孟优诈降，夜里劫营却扑了个空，又有一次追赶诸葛亮掉进陷坑。他还先后请来凭毒泉据守的朵思大王、驱使虎豹出阵的木鹿大王，妻子祝融夫人也亲自上阵，都被诸葛亮一一破解。
每次被擒，孟获都不服，诸葛亮便赐以酒食，放他回去。最后他借来乌戈国的藤甲兵，又在盘蛇谷全军覆没，第七次成了俘虏。诸葛亮仍要放他，孟获却垂泪说：七擒七纵，自古未有，我虽是化外之人，也懂礼义，怎能如此不知羞耻？于是率宗族跪地谢罪，誓言“丞相天威，南人不复反矣”。诸葛亮让他继续统领南中，不留汉官、不驻兵马，班师回朝。
史实：《三国志》正文只说南中“其秋悉平”，没有提到孟获。七擒七纵见于裴注引《汉晋春秋》：孟获为夷汉所服，诸葛亮擒获他后让他参观营阵，“七纵七禽”，孟获说“公，天威也，南人不复反矣”，随后进至滇池。史家多怀疑七次之数。据《华阳国志》，孟获后来官至蜀汉御史中丞。而南中在大军撤回后不久又起叛乱，李恢、马忠、张嶷等平叛多年。
ch090-seven-captures.why: The seven captures became the novel's showpiece of conquest by magnanimity, and made Meng Huo the best-known southern figure in Chinese storytelling.
ch090-seven-captures.why_zh: 七擒七纵是小说中以德服人的经典，孟获也因此成为中国说部里最著名的南中人物。

quote.zh: 丞相天威，南人不复反矣
quote.en: Your heavenly might, Chancellor! The southerners will never rebel again.

people.name: Lady Zhurong
people.role: Meng Huo's wife, fights in battle

story: Freed for the sixth time, Meng Huo takes advice and goes to the kingdom of Wuge. Its king, Wutugu, stands twelve feet tall, eats no grain but live snakes and wild beasts, and has scales on his body that no blade can cut. His thirty thousand soldiers wear armour of rattan cut from mountain gullies, soaked in oil for half a year, dried in the sun and soaked again more than ten times over: it floats across rivers, and neither swords nor arrows can pierce it. In the first clash the Shu crossbow bolts simply drop to the ground, and the Shu army is beaten.

Zhuge Liang surveys the land and picks Panshe Valley. He has Ma Dai hide carts packed with gunpowder, and mines, in the valley, and has Wei Yan feign defeat again and again, losing fifteen fights and abandoning seven camps. Sure the Shu army is beaten, Wutugu chases it into the valley. Rocks and logs seal the mouth, the carts are lit, the mines burst, and Wutugu and all thirty thousand burn. Watching from the hill, Zhuge Liang weeps: he has served the state, but this will surely cost him years of his life.

Historically: no kingdom of Wuge, no Wutugu and no battle of Panshe Valley appear in any history; it is a climax the novel invented to round out the seven captures. The gunpowder and mines are anachronisms besides: gunpowder appears only around the Tang dynasty, and its use in war belongs mainly to the Song. The histories say little about the fighting in the south, only that Zhuge Liang crossed the Lu River in the fifth month, went deep into the south and had it pacified by autumn; no great burning or slaughter is recorded.
story_zh: 孟获第六次被放回后，听人建议投奔乌戈国。国王兀突骨身长丈二，不食五谷，以生蛇恶兽为食，身上生着鳞甲，刀箭不能伤。他手下三万藤甲兵，藤甲用山涧中的藤条在油中浸泡半年，晒干再浸，反复十余遍制成，渡江不沉，刀箭不入。两军初战，蜀军的弩箭射在藤甲上纷纷落地，大败而回。
诸葛亮察看地形，选定盘蛇谷，令马岱在谷中预先埋下装满火药的车辆和地雷，又命魏延一再诈败，接连输了十五阵，弃了七座营寨。兀突骨以为蜀军不堪一击，率藤甲兵追入谷中。谷口随即被乱石巨木截断，火车点燃，地雷迸发，兀突骨和三万藤甲兵全部葬身火海。诸葛亮在山上望见，垂泪叹道：我虽有功于社稷，必定要折损阳寿了！
史实：乌戈国、兀突骨和盘蛇谷之战都不见于任何史书，是小说为凑足七擒而虚构的高潮。小说里的火药和地雷更是时代错置：火药大约到唐代才出现，用于战争主要是宋代的事。史书对南征的战况记载很少，只知道诸葛亮五月渡过泸水，深入南中，当年秋天便平定了，并没有大规模火攻屠戮的记载。
ch090-rattan-armour.why: The burning of the rattan army is the novel's darkest victory: Zhuge Liang wins completely and weeps for it, counting the cost of his own cleverness.
ch090-rattan-armour.why_zh: 火烧藤甲兵是小说中最惨烈的一场胜利，诸葛亮大获全胜却垂泪自责，显出他对杀戮的不忍。

story: Back from the south, Zhuge Liang rests his army. Cao Pi dies and Cao Rui succeeds him, sending Sima Yi to command in the north-west, but Ma Su's ruse, proclamations of a Sima Yi rebellion posted far and wide, gets him dismissed. Judging the moment has come, in 227 Zhuge Liang presents his memorial to the young emperor: keep worthy men near and petty men away, be fair in reward and punishment, trust Guo Youzhi, Fei Yi, Dong Yun and Xiang Chong. He recalls ploughing his fields in Nanyang and the late emperor's three visits to his thatched hut, and vows to pacify the north, restore the Han and return to the old capital.

Liu Shan says the chancellor has barely sat down after the hardships of the south and should not exhaust himself with another campaign. The court astrologer Qiao Zhou objects as well: he has watched the sky, and the north's vital energy is at its height. Zhuge Liang replies that the ways of Heaven change and cannot be held to rigidly, leaves Guo Youzhi, Dong Yun and others to run the court, and leads the army north to Hanzhong.

The full text is in Zhuge Liang's biography in the Records, written in 227 as he moved the army north to Hanzhong. It was later included in the anthology Guwen guanzhi, Lu You wrote that this one memorial made Zhuge Liang's name for all ages, and it is still studied in Chinese schools. A second, the Later Memorial, given in chapter 97 of the novel, comes from the Han-Jin chunqiu quoted in Pei's notes; it is not in Zhuge Liang's collected works, and its authenticity has long been disputed.
story_zh: 南征归来，诸葛亮休养兵马。这时曹丕病逝，曹叡继位，派司马懿镇守雍凉；马谡献反间计，四处张贴司马懿谋反的告示，曹叡果然罢免了他。诸葛亮认为北伐时机已到，227年向后主呈上《出师表》，劝他亲贤臣、远小人，严明赏罚，推荐郭攸之、费祎、董允、向宠等人；又追述自己躬耕南阳、先帝三顾草庐的往事，立誓北定中原，兴复汉室。
后主读罢说：相父南征远涉艰难，回来坐席未暖，又要北征，恐怕太劳神思。太史谯周也出班劝阻，说他夜观天象，北方旺气正盛，未可图也。诸葛亮回答说天道变化无常，岂可拘泥，坚持出兵，留郭攸之、董允等人辅佐朝政，自己率大军北上，屯驻汉中。
《出师表》全文载于《三国志·诸葛亮传》，写于建兴五年（227年）诸葛亮率军北驻汉中之时。这篇表文后来被收入《古文观止》，陆游有“出师一表真名世”之句，至今仍是中学语文课文。小说第97回另有一篇《后出师表》，出自裴注引《汉晋春秋》，不见于诸葛亮文集，真伪历来有争议。
ch091-memorial.why: The memorial is Zhuge Liang's own statement of what he lived for, and it turned a campaign proposal into one of the best-loved prose pieces in Chinese.
ch091-memorial.why_zh: 《出师表》是诸葛亮一生志向的自白，一篇出兵奏章由此成为传诵千古的名文。

quote.zh: 臣本布衣，躬耕于南阳
quote.en: I was a commoner, tilling my own fields in Nanyang.

story: Assigning commands for the northern campaign, Zhuge Liang leaves out Zhao Yun. Zhao Yun protests: since he followed the late emperor he has never retreated in battle and has always been first to meet the enemy; to die on the field is a man's good fortune; he wants the vanguard. Zhuge Liang pleads his age, but Zhao Yun says he will dash his head against the steps if refused, and Zhuge Liang gives him the vanguard together with Deng Zhi. Cao Rui sends the imperial son-in-law Xiahou Mao as grand commander to meet them.

The Xiliang general Han De rides out with his four sons, Han Ying, Han Yao, Han Qiong and Han Qi. Zhao Yun spurs forward and within a few bouts kills all four, and Han De flees back to his lines; when Han De comes out again, Zhao Yun spears him too, five generals in all, and the Wei troops scatter. Later Zhao Yun is trapped on a hill by Xiahou Mao's ambush and sighs that, refusing to admit his age, he will die here, until Guan Xing and Zhang Bao fight their way through to rescue him.

Historically: the Records says that in 228 Zhuge Liang gave out that he would come by the Xie Valley and sent Zhao Yun and Deng Zhi with a decoy force to hold Ji Valley and pin down Cao Zhen's main army, while he himself struck at Qishan. Outnumbered, Zhao Yun was beaten at Ji Valley, but gathered his men and held firm, avoiding a rout. Han De and his sons are not in the histories, and no general is recorded as falling to Zhao Yun; his birth year is unknown, so “over seventy” is the novel's. Xiahou Mao was real and held Chang'an, but the man facing Zhao Yun was Cao Zhen.
story_zh: 诸葛亮分派北伐将领，唯独没有赵云。赵云厉声说：我自从跟随先帝以来，临阵不退，遇敌则先，大丈夫能死在疆场是幸事，我愿做先锋！诸葛亮以他年事已高再三劝阻，赵云说若不用他为先锋，便撞死在阶下。诸葛亮只得让他与邓芝同为先锋。魏主曹叡则派驸马夏侯楙为大都督前来迎战。
西凉大将韩德带着四个儿子韩瑛、韩瑶、韩琼、韩琪出阵。赵云挺枪跃马，几个回合之间把韩德的四个儿子尽数刺杀，韩德吓得逃回阵中；后来韩德再来交战，也被赵云一枪刺死，前后力斩五将，魏兵望风而逃。不久赵云中了夏侯楙的埋伏，被困山上，叹道：我不服老，竟要死在这里了！幸好关兴、张苞杀到，才把他救了出来。
史实：《三国志·赵云传》记载，228年诸葛亮扬言由斜谷进兵，令赵云、邓芝率疑兵据守箕谷，牵制曹真主力，自己则攻祁山。赵云兵弱敌强，在箕谷失利，但收拢部众固守，没有大败。韩德父子不见于史书，也没有赵云斩将的记载；赵云生年不详，“年过七旬”是小说的说法。夏侯楙确曾镇守长安，但与赵云对阵的是曹真。
ch092-zhao-yun-old.why: The novel gives the last of the old heroes one more great day, a farewell to Liu Bei's generation before younger men take over.
ch092-zhao-yun-old.why_zh: 小说让最后一位开国老将再显一次神威，为刘备那一代英雄作别，此后便是后辈登场。

people.name: Han De
people.role: Wei general killed with his sons

story: After Xiahou Mao's defeat Cao Rui makes Cao Zhen grand commander, with the seventy-six-year-old minister Wang Lang as his military adviser. Wang Lang boasts that a few words before the lines will make Zhuge Liang surrender. At Qishan he rides out and lectures on the Mandate of Heaven: Cao Cao swept the realm clean, and Cao Pi received the throne as Shun did from Yao; let Zhuge Liang lay down his arms and come over with honour, and he will still be made a marquis.

Zhuge Liang laughs in his carriage, then rounds on him: Wang Lang began his career as a Han nominee and should have upheld his sovereign, yet he helped the usurpers, a crime heaven and earth will not tolerate. “White-headed wretch! Grey-bearded old traitor!” Soon he will go down to the Yellow Springs; how will he face the twenty-four emperors of Han? Choking with rage, Wang Lang gives a great cry and falls dead from his horse. That night Zhuge Liang foresees Cao Zhen's raid on his camp and routs it from ambush.

Historically: Wang Lang was a leading Confucian scholar who wrote commentaries on the Changes, the Spring and Autumn Annals, the Classic of Filial Piety and the Rites of Zhou; he rose to minister over the masses under Wei and died of illness in 228, never having gone to the front. The scene may have grown from something else: Pei's notes quote the Zhuge Liang collection, which says that after Liu Bei's death Hua Xin, Wang Lang, Chen Qun and other Wei ministers each wrote urging Zhuge Liang to submit, and he answered not with a letter but with an essay, the Zhengyi, refuting them. Wang Lang's granddaughter married Sima Zhao and bore the Jin founder Sima Yan.
story_zh: 夏侯楙兵败后，魏主曹叡改派曹真为大都督，七十六岁的司徒王朗随军任军师。王朗夸口说，只要到两军阵前，凭他一席话就能让诸葛亮拱手而降。两军在祁山前列阵，王朗出马，大谈天命所归，说曹操扫清四海、曹丕受禅如同尧舜之事，劝诸葛亮倒戈卸甲，以礼来降，仍不失封侯之位。
诸葛亮在车上大笑，随即历数王朗所为：他以孝廉入仕，本该匡君辅国，却助曹篡逆，罪恶深重，天地不容。接着骂道：“皓首匹夫！苍髯老贼！”你不日就要归于九泉之下，有什么脸面去见汉朝二十四代皇帝？王朗听罢，气满胸膛，大叫一声，撞死于马下。当夜诸葛亮又料定曹真会来劫营，设下埋伏大败魏军。
史实：王朗是汉魏之际的名儒，曾为《易》《春秋》《孝经》《周官》作传，在魏官至司徒，228年病逝，从未到过前线。这段故事或许另有来由：据裴注引《诸葛亮集》，刘备死后，华歆、王朗、陈群等魏国重臣曾分别写信给诸葛亮，陈说天命人事，劝他举国称藩；诸葛亮不予回信，作《正议》加以驳斥。王朗的孙女后来嫁给司马昭，生下晋武帝司马炎。
ch093-wang-lang.why: A battle won by words alone, it is the novel's purest celebration of Zhuge Liang as the voice of Han legitimacy.
ch093-wang-lang.why_zh: 不费一兵一卒、仅凭口舌取胜，这一幕把诸葛亮塑造成汉室正统最雄辩的代言人。

quote.zh: 皓首匹夫！苍髯老贼！
quote.en: White-headed wretch! Grey-bearded old traitor!

story: Having taken Nan'an and Anding, Zhuge Liang forges a call for help from Xiahou Mao to lure the Tianshui governor Ma Zun out of his city. But the young Tianshui officer Jiang Wei sees through the trick and lays an ambush, and Zhao Yun, caught in it, crosses spears with him and marvels that such a man should be found here. Zhuge Liang learns that Jiang Wei is a native of Ji, devoted to his mother, skilled in letters and arms alike, and resolves to win him over.

He sends Wei Yan to feint at Ji, and Jiang Wei, whose mother lives there, rushes to defend it; then he has a man disguised as Jiang Wei attack Tianshui by night, so that Ma Zun believes Jiang Wei has gone over. When Jiang Wei breaks out of Ji and calls at the gate of Tianshui, arrows rain down on him; at Shanggui Liang Qian will not open either. With nowhere left to go, he meets Zhuge Liang coming in a small carriage, who tells him that ever since leaving his thatched hut he has sought a worthy man to pass his learning to, without success; now that he has met Boyue, his wish is fulfilled. Jiang Wei dismounts and submits.

Jiang Wei's biography in the Records is plainer. When Zhuge Liang came out at Qishan in 228, the Tianshui governor, away on tour, heard that the Shu army was near and the counties were going over, suspected Jiang Wei and his colleagues, and fled by night to Shanggui; when they followed, the gates were shut, and Ji would not take them in either, so together with Liang Xu, Yin Shang and Liang Qian they went over to Zhuge Liang. Zhuge Liang called him “the best man of Liang province” and “very quick in military matters”. When the army soon withdrew, Jiang Wei was parted from his mother for good.
story_zh: 诸葛亮连取南安、安定，又伪造夏侯楙求救的文书，想诱天水太守马遵出城。不料天水的年轻将领姜维识破计谋，设下埋伏，赵云中伏后与姜维交手，惊叹此地竟有这样的人物。诸葛亮得知姜维是冀县人，事母至孝，文武双全，智勇足备，便一心想要收服他。
诸葛亮先派魏延佯攻冀县，姜维因母亲住在冀城，急忙回救；又派人假扮姜维，夜里攻打天水，让马遵以为姜维已经降蜀。姜维从冀城突围，到天水叫门，城上乱箭射下；转投上邽，守将梁虔也不肯开门。走投无路之际，诸葛亮乘小车迎来，对他说：我自出茅庐以来，遍求贤者，想传授平生所学，恨未得其人，今遇伯约，吾愿足矣。姜维于是下马拜降。
《三国志·姜维传》的记载简单得多：建兴六年（228年）诸葛亮出祁山，天水太守正在外巡视，听说蜀军将到、各县响应，怀疑姜维等人有异心，连夜逃往上邽；姜维追去时城门已闭，回冀县也不被接纳，只好与梁绪、尹赏、梁虔等一同投奔诸葛亮。诸葛亮称他为“凉州上士”，“甚敏于军事”。不久蜀军撤退，姜维从此与母亲失散。
ch093-jiang-wei.why: Zhuge Liang found his heir in Jiang Wei, who would carry the northern wars on for three decades after his death.
ch093-jiang-wei.why_zh: 诸葛亮由此得到了衣钵传人，姜维在他死后又把北伐坚持了近三十年。

quote.zh: 今遇伯约，吾愿足矣
quote.en: Now that I have met Boyue, my wish is fulfilled.

story: Restored to command, Sima Yi crushes Meng Da with lightning speed, then heads straight for Jieting with Zhang He. Zhuge Liang knows Jieting is the throat of Hanzhong: if it falls, the army must retreat. Ma Su volunteers and signs a pledge staking his whole family. Zhuge Liang gives him the careful Wang Ping as deputy, tells them to camp across the road so that no Wei force can slip past, and asks for a plan of the camp.

At Jieting Ma Su laughs that the chancellor worries too much: what Wei army would dare come to such a remote spot? The road is no place to camp, he says; the lone wooded hill beside it is a stronghold sent by Heaven, and he quotes the art of war: strike down from the heights like splitting bamboo. Wang Ping warns that if Wei cuts off their water the men will fall apart without a fight; Ma Su will not listen, and gives him only a detachment to camp ten li to the west. Zhang He cuts the road to the water and surrounds the hill. Parched, the Shu army falls into chaos, Ma Su breaks out and flees, and Jieting is lost.

The histories largely agree. Ma Su's biography says veterans such as Wei Yan and Wu Yi were the obvious choices to lead the van, but Zhuge Liang promoted Ma Su over them; Wang Ping's biography says Ma Su left the water and went up the hill, his orders confused, ignoring Wang Ping's repeated warnings, and that after the rout only Wang Ping's thousand men held together, beating their drums, so that Zhang He, suspecting an ambush, dared not close in. The difference is that Sima Yi was far away in Jingzhou at the time; the man who beat Ma Su was Zhang He.
story_zh: 魏主重新起用司马懿，他先以神速平定了孟达，随即与张郃领兵直扑街亭。诸葛亮深知街亭是汉中的咽喉，一旦失守，大军就得撤退。马谡自告奋勇，立下军令状，以全家性命担保。诸葛亮派谨慎的王平做他的副将，叮嘱二人务必当道扎营，使魏军无法偷过，并要把营寨布置画图送来。
到了街亭，马谡笑丞相多虑：这样的山僻之处，魏兵怎么敢来？他说路口不是扎营之地，旁边孤山树木茂盛，正是天赐险要，执意屯兵山上，还搬出兵法说凭高视下，势如劈竹。王平苦劝，说魏兵一旦断了汲水之道，军士不战自乱，马谡不听，只分给他少量人马在山西十里扎营。张郃领兵截断水道，围住山头，蜀兵无水，军心大乱，马谡突围而走，街亭失守。
史书记载与小说大致相同。《三国志·马谡传》说，当时宿将魏延、吴壹等人众望所归，诸葛亮却破格提拔马谡统率前军；《王平传》说马谡舍水上山，举措烦扰，王平屡次劝谏不听，大败之后只有王平所领的一千人鸣鼓自守，张郃疑有伏兵，不敢逼近。不同的是，司马懿当时远在荆州，打败马谡的是张郃。
ch095-jieting.why: One general's disobedience threw away Zhuge Liang's best chance of the whole war, when three Wei commanderies had already come over to him.
ch095-jieting.why_zh: 一员将领违令失守，断送了诸葛亮北伐中最好的一次机会，当时魏国已有三郡归降蜀汉。

quote.zh: 马谡无知，坑陷吾军矣！
quote.en: Ma Su, you fool, you have led my army into a pit!

people.name: Zhang He
people.role: Wei general who cuts the water

story: Word of Jieting's fall reaches Zhuge Liang at Xicheng, where he is moving grain. No generals are with him, only civil officials, and half of his five thousand men have gone off with the grain, leaving two thousand five hundred in the town. Then comes news that Sima Yi is approaching with a hundred and fifty thousand men, and the officials turn pale. Zhuge Liang orders every banner hidden and every man to keep silently to his post, has all four gates thrown open, and sets twenty soldiers dressed as townsfolk at each gate to sweep the road.

In a crane-feather cloak and silk cap, with two boys carrying his zither, Zhuge Liang sits at the parapet of the gate tower, lights incense and plays. Sima Yi rides up to see for himself: Zhuge Liang smiling, one boy holding a sword, the other a fly-whisk, and at the gate a score of townsfolk sweeping with heads down as if no one were there. Deeply suspicious, he retreats at once. When his son Sima Zhao asks why, he says: Zhuge Liang has always been careful and never takes a gamble; open gates mean an ambush. Zhuge Liang claps his hands and laughs, saying he took no gamble by choice; he simply had no other way.

Historically: the story comes from Guo Chong's anecdotes about Zhuge Liang quoted in Pei's notes, which set it at Yangping: with only ten thousand men in the town, Zhuge Liang lowered his banners, silenced his drums and opened all four gates, and Sima Yi with two hundred thousand suspected an ambush and withdrew. Pei Songzhi refuted it at once: Sima Yi was then commander in Jingzhou, stationed at Wan, and only faced Zhuge Liang after Cao Zhen's death. The real empty camp was Zhao Yun's on the Han River in 219: he opened his gates and stilled his drums, Cao Cao's army feared an ambush and pulled back, and Liu Bei said Zilong was all courage.
story_zh: 街亭失守的消息传来时，诸葛亮正在西城搬运粮草，身边没有大将，只有一班文官，所带五千兵马已有一半运粮去了，城中只剩两千五百人。忽报司马懿率十五万大军杀来，众官尽皆失色。诸葛亮传令把旌旗全部隐藏，军士各守城铺，不许出入喧哗；大开四门，每门派二十名士兵扮成百姓洒扫街道。
诸葛亮披上鹤氅，戴着纶巾，带两个小童携琴，在城楼上凭栏焚香操琴。司马懿亲自来看，只见他笑容可掬，左边童子捧剑，右边童子执麈尾，城门内外二十多个百姓低头洒扫，旁若无人。他心中大疑，立即退兵。次子司马昭问为何退兵，司马懿说：诸葛亮平生谨慎，不曾弄险，今大开城门，必有埋伏。诸葛亮抚掌而笑，说自己并非行险，实是不得已而用之。
史实：空城计出自裴注引郭冲所述的轶事，说诸葛亮驻军阳平，城中只有万人，司马懿率二十万大军来攻，诸葛亮偃旗息鼓、大开四门，司马懿疑有伏兵而退。裴松之已驳斥：当时司马懿任荆州都督，镇守宛城，直到曹真死后才与诸葛亮对阵。真正以空营退敌的是赵云：219年汉水之战，他大开营门、偃旗息鼓，曹军疑有伏而退，刘备赞他“一身都是胆”。
ch095-empty-fort.why: The empty fort is the novel's most famous stratagem, a bluff that works only because of Zhuge Liang's reputation for never bluffing.
ch095-empty-fort.why_zh: 空城计是小说中最著名的计策，它之所以奏效，恰恰因为诸葛亮一生从不冒险的名声。

quote.zh: 亮平生谨慎，不曾弄险
quote.en: Zhuge Liang has been cautious all his life; he never takes a gamble.

people.name: Sima Zhao
people.role: Sima Yi's son, doubts the retreat
people.role_zh: 质疑退兵的司马懿次子

story: Back at Hanzhong Zhuge Liang counts his forces: Wang Ping, Wei Yan and Gao Xiang come in, and Zhao Yun and Deng Zhi bring their men back intact; Zhuge Liang rewards Zhao Yun, who declines. Then Ma Su, bound, kneels before the tent. His face hardening, Zhuge Liang rebukes him: you have read the books of war since boyhood; I told you again and again that Jieting was our root; you staked your family on it, then ignored Wang Ping and lost the army and the ground. If the law is not upheld, how can I command anyone?

Ma Su weeps: the chancellor has treated him as a son and he has looked on the chancellor as a father; he asks only that his son be cared for. In tears, Zhuge Liang orders him executed. Jiang Wan, just arrived from Chengdu, pleads that killing a man of such wits while the realm is unsettled is a pity; Zhuge Liang answers that Sun Wu conquered because his laws were clear, and with the realm divided, to set aside the law would leave no means to fight the rebels. When Ma Su's head is brought in he weeps without end: not for Ma Su, he says, but because the late emperor warned him that Ma Su's words outran his ability, and he hates his own blindness. He then asks to be demoted three grades.
