The Records says only that Ma Su “died in prison” and that Zhuge Liang wept for him; he was thirty-nine. Xiang Lang's biography adds that Ma Su fled after the defeat, and that Xiang Lang, who knew and said nothing, was dismissed. Ma Su's last letter, Jiang Wan's plea and Zhuge Liang's answer about Sun Wu all come from the Xiangyang ji quoted in Pei's notes, which says the whole army of a hundred thousand wept for him. Zhuge Liang demoted himself to General of the Right, acting as chancellor; the generals Zhang Xiu and Li Sheng were executed too, while Wang Ping was promoted.
story_zh: 诸葛亮退回汉中，清点诸军：王平、魏延、高翔先后归来，赵云、邓芝的人马也完整退回，诸葛亮重赏赵云，赵云却辞谢不受。随后马谡自缚跪于帐前。诸葛亮变色责问：你自幼熟读兵书，我再三叮嘱街亭是根本，你以全家性命立下军令状，却不听王平之言，以致兵败地失，若不明正军法，何以服众？
马谡哭道：丞相待我如子，我视丞相如父，只求照看我的儿子。诸葛亮挥泪下令推出斩首。蒋琬从成都赶来，说天下未定却杀智谋之臣，岂不可惜？诸葛亮说孙武能制胜天下，在于用法严明，如今四方分争，若废法度，何以讨贼？马谡首级献上，诸葛亮大哭不止，说并非为马谡而哭，而是想起先帝曾说马谡言过其实、不可大用，恨自己不明。随后上表自贬三等。
《三国志·马谡传》只说马谡“下狱物故”，诸葛亮为之流涕，时年三十九岁；《向朗传》还提到马谡兵败后曾经逃亡，向朗知情不报而被免官。马谡临终致书、蒋琬劝谏和诸葛亮以孙武用法为答，都出自裴注引《襄阳记》，据说当时十万之众为之垂泪。诸葛亮自贬为右将军，行丞相事；一同被诛的还有将军张休、李盛，王平则因功升迁。
ch096-ma-su-executed.why: Executing a favourite he had promoted against advice, and taking the blame publicly, Zhuge Liang showed the rule of law and accountability that the novel holds up as his greatness.
ch096-ma-su-executed.why_zh: 诸葛亮斩杀自己力排众议提拔的爱将，又公开引咎自贬，体现了小说所推崇的执法严明、勇于担责。

quote.zh: 吾非为马谡而哭
quote.en: It is not for Ma Su that I weep.

people.name: Wang Ping
people.role: promoted for his conduct at Jieting

story: When Wu crushes Cao Xiu at Shiting, Zhuge Liang sees a chance to march out again while Wei is reeling. One day, as he feasts with his generals, a sudden gale snaps the pine tree in front of the hall. He casts a divination and says the wind foretells the loss of a great general; nobody believes him. Then Zhao Yun's sons, Zhao Tong and Zhao Guang, ask to see him, and Zhuge Liang, aghast, cries that Zilong is gone. Indeed they have come to report that their father died of illness the night before.

Zhuge Liang stamps and weeps: “With Zilong gone, the state has lost a pillar, and I have lost an arm!” All the generals weep. He sends the sons to Chengdu to report, and Liu Shan weeps aloud: when he was a child, but for Zilong he would have died amid the fighting. Zhao Yun is honoured as grand general with the posthumous title Marquis Shunping, buried east of Chengdu at Jinping Hill, and a temple is raised to him. Zhuge Liang then submits his Later Memorial, vowing to serve until death, and marches north again.

Historically: the Records dates Zhao Yun's death to 229, a year later than the novel. The novel puts it in 228 because the Later Memorial, said to date from the winter of that year, already mentions “the loss of Zhao Yun, Yang Qun” and others; that contradiction is one of the main reasons scholars suspect the Later Memorial is not genuine. The title Marquis Shunping was conferred only in 261. Zhao Tong rose to command the palace guard, and Zhao Guang fell in battle under Jiang Wei at Tazhong.
story_zh: 东吴在石亭大破曹休，诸葛亮认为魏军新败，正好再出祁山。一天他正与诸将饮宴，忽然一阵大风把庭前松树吹折。诸葛亮占了一卦，说这风主折损一员大将，众将都不相信。正饮酒间，赵云的两个儿子赵统、赵广前来求见，诸葛亮大惊失色，说子龙休矣！二人果然哭报父亲昨夜病重去世。
诸葛亮跌足痛哭：“子龙身故，国家损一栋梁，吾去一臂也！”众将无不落泪。他让赵统、赵广入成都报丧，后主放声大哭，说当年自己年幼，若不是子龙，早已死于乱军之中。后主追赠赵云为大将军，谥顺平侯，葬于成都锦屏山之东，并为他建庙祭祀。诸葛亮随即呈上《后出师表》，表示为国尽忠，死而后已，再次出兵北伐。
史实：《三国志·赵云传》记载赵云卒于建兴七年（229年），比小说晚一年。小说之所以写在228年，是因为《后出师表》中已有“丧赵云、阳群”等语，而此表据说作于228年冬，这一矛盾正是后人怀疑《后出师表》为伪作的重要理由之一。“顺平侯”的谥号直到景耀四年（261年）才追赠。赵统后来官至虎贲中郎督，赵广随姜维在沓中战死。
ch097-zhao-yun-dies.why: With Zhao Yun gone, the last of Liu Bei's founding generals has left the stage, and Zhuge Liang carries the war on almost alone.
ch097-zhao-yun-dies.why_zh: 赵云去世，刘备创业时的老将至此凋零殆尽，诸葛亮几乎只能独力支撑北伐。

quote.zh: 子龙身故，国家损一栋梁，吾去一臂也
quote.en: With Zilong gone, the state has lost a pillar, and I have lost an arm.

people.name: Zhuge Liang
people.role: mourns him as a lost arm

people.name: Liu Shan
people.role: emperor he once saved as a baby
people.role_zh: 当年被赵云救下的后主

story: On his second campaign Zhuge Liang comes out through San Pass to Chencang, only to find that the Wei general Hao Zhao has already built a strong fortress behind deep moats and high walls. Wei Yan's assaults fail. Zhuge Liang sends Jin Xiang, a man from Hao Zhao's home town, to talk him round, and from the tower Hao Zhao flatly refuses: he owes Wei too much and will die before he yields. Zhuge Liang tries scaling ladders, and Hao Zhao burns them with fire arrows; battering rams, and Hao Zhao smashes them with stones swung on ropes; tunnels, and Hao Zhao digs a trench inside the wall to cut them off. Twenty days and nights of assault fail to take the town.

When the Wei general Wang Shuang cuts down Shu officers in the field, Zhuge Liang has to withdraw, arranging for Wei Yan to kill Wang Shuang as he pursues. On the next campaign, the novel goes on, spies report that Hao Zhao is gravely ill. Zhuge Liang orders Wei Yan and Jiang Wei to march on Chencang unseen within three days, but when they arrive Shu flags already fly from the walls: Zhuge Liang himself has slipped in by a back road with Guan Xing and Zhang Bao. Hao Zhao, sick in bed, hears the uproar in the town and dies, and Chencang falls to Shu.

Historically: according to the Wei lüe quoted in Pei's notes, Hao Zhao had just over a thousand men against Zhuge Liang's tens of thousands. When Jin Xiang came to persuade him, he answered from the tower: “You know what kind of man I am... Go back and thank Zhuge, and he may attack.” Zhuge Liang tried ladders, rams, siege towers and tunnels; Hao Zhao met them with fire arrows, stones and cross-trenches, and the siege dragged on for over twenty days. With Wei relief coming and his grain gone, Zhuge Liang withdrew, and Wang Shuang, pursuing, was killed. Hao Zhao was rewarded and died of illness soon after. Chencang never fell to Shu.
story_zh: 第二次北伐，诸葛亮兵出散关，直抵陈仓，不料魏将郝昭早已筑起坚城，深沟高垒。魏延攻城不下，诸葛亮派郝昭的同乡靳祥前去劝降，郝昭在城楼上断然拒绝，说自己深受魏恩，唯有一死。诸葛亮于是用云梯攻城，郝昭用火箭焚烧；又用冲车撞城，郝昭用绳索系着巨石往下砸；再挖地道，郝昭在城内掘堑截断。昼夜攻打二十余日，始终不能破城。
魏将王双又接连斩杀蜀将，诸葛亮只得撤兵，撤退时设计让魏延斩了追来的王双。小说接着写，到了下一次出兵，细作报说郝昭病重，诸葛亮令魏延、姜维暗中进兵，三日内赶到陈仓。二将到了城下，却见城上已遍插蜀军旗号，原来诸葛亮早已亲率关兴、张苞从小路袭入城中。郝昭在病榻上听到城中大乱，就此身亡，陈仓落入蜀军之手。
史实：据裴注引《魏略》，郝昭只有一千余人，而诸葛亮兵力数万。靳祥劝降时，郝昭在城楼上回答：“我之为人，卿所知也……卿还谢诸葛，便可攻也。”诸葛亮先后用云梯、冲车、井阑和地道进攻，郝昭以火箭、石块和城内横堑一一化解，相持二十余日。魏援军将到，诸葛亮粮尽退兵，追击的王双被蜀军斩杀。郝昭因功受赏，不久病逝。陈仓始终未被攻下。
ch098-chencang.why: Chencang showed the limit of Zhuge Liang's war: one well-held fortress on the road north could stop him until his grain ran out.
ch098-chencang.why_zh: 陈仓之战暴露了北伐的根本困境：北上要道上一座坚守的城池，就足以拖到蜀军粮尽。

people.name: Jin Xiang
people.role: Hao Zhao's townsman, sent to persuade him

people.name: Wei Yan
people.role: Shu general who kills Wang Shuang

story: Lu Xun's great victory over Cao Xiu at Shiting raises Wu's standing, and Sun Quan's ministers urge him to take the throne, while reports arrive of a yellow dragon and phoenixes appearing. Sun Quan becomes emperor at Wuchang, names his era Huanglong, Yellow Dragon, honours his father Sun Jian as Emperor Wulie and his brother Sun Ce as Prince Huan of Changsha, and makes his son Sun Deng crown prince.

Wu sends envoys to Shu to announce the new title and propose a joint attack on Wei. Many in Shu argue that Sun Quan is a usurper and the alliance should be broken off, but Zhuge Liang puts the larger cause first and sends Chen Zhen with gifts to congratulate him and to ask Wu to march against Wei. Sun Quan consults Lu Xun, who says this is a plan born of Zhuge Liang's fear of Sima Yi; as allies they must agree, but Wu need only make a show of mobilising, and wait to profit while Shu and Wei wear each other down.

Sun Quan's annals in the Records say that in the fourth month of 229 Xiakou and Wuchang both reported a yellow dragon and phoenixes, and Sun Quan took the throne at the southern altar. Shu sent Chen Zhen to congratulate him, and the two states swore a treaty dividing Wei in advance: Yu, Qing, Xu and You provinces to Wu, Yan, Ji, Bing and Liang to Shu, with the capital province split at the Hangu Pass. Pei's notes quote the Jiangbiao zhuan: on taking the throne Sun Quan said, “But for Zhou Yu I would not be emperor,” and when Zhang Zhao began to praise him, he cut in: “Had we followed your plan, sir, we would be begging for food by now.”
story_zh: 石亭一战，陆逊大破曹休，东吴声威大振。群臣纷纷劝孙权登基，又有人奏报黄龙、凤凰出现的祥瑞。孙权于是在武昌即皇帝位，改元黄龙，追尊父亲孙坚为武烈皇帝、兄长孙策为长沙桓王，立儿子孙登为太子。
吴国遣使入川，通报称帝之事，相约共同伐魏。蜀中议论纷纷，有人认为孙权僭号称帝，应当断绝盟好。诸葛亮却以大局为重，派陈震带着礼物前往东吴道贺，并请吴国出兵伐魏。孙权与陆逊商议，陆逊认为这是诸葛亮忌惮司马懿而定的计策，既是盟友，不得不应，不妨虚张声势，遥作呼应，等蜀魏相争时再坐收其利。
据《三国志·吴主传》，黄龙元年（229年）夏四月，夏口、武昌都奏报黄龙、凤凰出现，孙权在南郊即皇帝位。蜀汉派卫尉陈震前往祝贺，两国盟约预先瓜分魏地：豫、青、徐、幽归吴，兖、冀、并、凉归蜀，司州以函谷关为界。裴注引《江表传》说，孙权称帝时说“孤非周公瑾，不帝矣”；张昭刚要歌功颂德，孙权说：“如张公之计，今已乞食矣。”
ch098-sun-quan-emperor.why: With Sun Quan's enthronement there were three emperors at once, and the alliance against Wei survived only because Zhuge Liang swallowed the affront.
ch098-sun-quan-emperor.why_zh: 孙权称帝后天下同时出现三位皇帝，蜀吴联盟之所以得以维系，全靠诸葛亮顾全大局、隐忍不发。

people.name: Lu Xun
people.role: advises a mere show of support
people.role_zh: 建议虚张声势的东吴大将

story: In the novel, after taking Chencang Zhuge Liang turns to Wudu and Yinping, two commanderies west of Hanzhong that command the roads from Longyou into Shu. He sends troops to take them; the Wei inspector of Yong province, Guo Huai, marches to their relief and is driven off by Zhuge Liang, and both commanderies pass into Shu's hands. Wei is shaken, and the next year Cao Zhen and Sima Yi invade Shu in force, only to be caught in the mountains by endless rain that washes out the plank roads, and they march home with nothing to show for it.

The Records says that in 229 Zhuge Liang sent Chen Shi to attack Wudu and Yinping; when Guo Huai moved against Chen Shi, Zhuge Liang came out himself as far as Jianwei, Guo Huai withdrew, and the two commanderies were taken. The emperor then restored Zhuge Liang to the chancellorship he had given up after Jieting. Wudu and Yinping stayed in Shu hands to the end, the one lasting gain of all the northern campaigns; and in 263 it was by the Yinping track that Deng Ai slipped into Shu.
story_zh: 小说写诸葛亮夺下陈仓之后，转而谋取武都、阴平两郡。这两郡位于汉中以西，扼守着从陇右进入蜀地的道路。诸葛亮分兵前往攻取，魏国雍州刺史郭淮领兵来救，被诸葛亮击退，两郡就此归入蜀汉版图。魏国为之震动，次年曹真、司马懿大举伐蜀，却在秦岭山中遇上连绵大雨，栈道断绝，只得无功而返。
据《三国志·诸葛亮传》，建兴七年（229年），诸葛亮派陈式攻打武都、阴平，魏雍州刺史郭淮率众来攻陈式，诸葛亮亲自出兵到建威，郭淮退走，二郡遂平。后主随即下诏，恢复了诸葛亮因街亭之败而自贬的丞相之职。武都、阴平此后一直归属蜀汉，是历次北伐中唯一长期守住的战果；263年邓艾偷渡入蜀，走的正是阴平小道。
ch099-wudu-yinping.why: The two commanderies were the only ground the northern campaigns ever held for good, and Yinping would later be the road by which Deng Ai brought Shu down.
ch099-wudu-yinping.why_zh: 武都、阴平是北伐唯一守住的土地，而三十多年后邓艾正是取道阴平灭亡了蜀汉。

people.name: Zhuge Liang
people.role_zh: 指挥第三次北伐的丞相

people.name: Chen Shi
people.role: Shu general who took the two commanderies (per the Records)
people.role_zh: 据史书攻取二郡的蜀将

people.name: Guo Huai
people.role: Wei inspector of Yong, leads the relief
people.role_zh: 领兵救援的魏雍州刺史

story: On his fourth campaign Zhuge Liang comes out at Qishan and reaps the ripening wheat of Longshang, even dressing men as gods to scare off the Wei troops. Just as things go well, Li Yan, in charge of the grain supply, falls behind and, afraid of blame, falsely reports trouble with Wu and asks the chancellor to come home. Zhuge Liang has to pull back in stages toward Jiange.

Sima Yi suspects an ambush and will not pursue rashly, but Zhang He insists: as vanguard, now is his time to win merit, and a man who gives his life for his country dies without regret. Sima Yi lets him go ahead and sends Wei Ping after him in support. The Shu rearguard fights and falls back, drawing Zhang He into the Mumen road. As dusk falls a signal gun sounds, rocks and logs block the way behind, crossbows loose from both slopes, and Zhang He and his men are shot dead. Zhuge Liang laughs that he went hunting for a horse, ma as in Sima, and hit a roebuck, zhang, instead.

The histories tell it the other way round. According to the Wei lüe quoted in Pei's notes, when the Shu army withdrew Sima Yi ordered Zhang He to pursue; Zhang He objected that by the rules of war a besieged town is left a way out and a retreating army is not chased, but Sima Yi would not listen, and Zhang He went against his will; the Shu troops, waiting on the heights, loosed their bows and crossbows and hit him in the thigh. Zhang He's own biography says an arrow struck his right knee at Mumen and killed him. Chen Shou put him in one biography with Zhang Liao, Yue Jin, Yu Jin and Xu Huang as the finest generals of the age; he had fought for Wei for over thirty years, ever since coming over at Guandu.
story_zh: 第四次北伐，诸葛亮兵出祁山，在陇上抢割新麦，还让人扮作天神吓退魏军。正当战局顺利时，负责督运粮草的李严因粮草不继，怕被问罪，竟谎称东吴有变，请丞相回师。诸葛亮只得下令分批撤军，向剑阁方向退去。
司马懿料定蜀军撤退必有埋伏，不肯轻追；张郃却执意请战，说自己身为先锋，正该立功，大丈夫舍身报国，万死无恨。司马懿只得让他先行，又派魏平随后接应。蜀军且战且退，把张郃引进木门道。天色将晚，山上忽然一声炮响，乱石巨木截断归路，两边万弩齐发，张郃和部下尽被射死。诸葛亮笑说这次围猎本想射一匹“马”，却误中一只“獐”。
史书所记恰好相反。据裴注引《魏略》，蜀军撤退，司马懿命张郃追击，张郃说兵法讲围城必开出路，归军勿追，司马懿不听，张郃不得已而进，蜀军居高设伏，弓弩齐发，射中其大腿。《三国志·张郃传》则说他追到木门，交战时飞箭射中右膝而死。陈寿将他与张辽、乐进、于禁、徐晃合传，称“时之良将，五子为先”；他自官渡之战归曹，转战三十余年。
ch101-zhang-he.why: Zhang He was the most experienced general Wei had on the western front, and his death left Sima Yi alone in command against Zhuge Liang.
ch101-zhang-he.why_zh: 张郃是魏国西线最老练的宿将，他一死，对抗诸葛亮的重任便完全落在司马懿一人身上。

people.name: Zhang He
people.role: Wei veteran killed in the ambush

people.name: Li Yan
people.role: supply officer whose false report forces the retreat
people.role_zh: 谎报军情、迫使退兵的督粮官

story: On his last campaign Zhuge Liang camps south of the Wei River, face to face with Sima Yi. The mountain roads make supply a constant worry, and the chief clerk Yang Yi frets over it. Zhuge Liang says he has long since designed the wooden ox and the gliding horse, which need neither food nor water and can haul grain day and night, and has craftsmen build them to his plans. The novel copies out the instructions, every measurement and part; once built, they carry grain over the mountain roads to the front in an endless stream.

Sima Yi has a few seized in an ambush on the road, has his craftsmen take them apart and copy them, and is soon using his own to bring grain from Longxi. This is just what Zhuge Liang wanted. A Shu detachment disguised as Wei troops falls on the convoy, scatters the escort, and twists the tongues in the mouths of the wooden oxen, after which they will not move. Wei soldiers retake them but cannot budge them; the Shu troops return, twist the tongues back, and drive the oxen off laden with Wei grain. Sima Yi can only sigh.

Historically: the wooden ox and gliding horse were real. Liu Shan's annals in the Records say that in 231, besieging Qishan, Zhuge Liang “first used the wooden ox for transport”, and in 234, coming out by the Xie Valley, “first used the gliding horse”. Pei's notes quote instructions for making them from the Zhuge Liang collection, a wooden ox with “a square belly and a curved head, one leg and four feet”, the source of the novel's description. How they worked has long been lost; later writers have often guessed at some kind of wheelbarrow. The tongue trick and the stolen Wei grain are the novel's invention.
story_zh: 最后一次北伐，诸葛亮大军屯于渭水之南，与司马懿相持。蜀道艰险，粮草难以接济，长史杨仪为此发愁。诸葛亮说他早已设计好木牛流马，不用饮食，可以昼夜转运，随即令工匠依图打造。小说照录了制作之法，从尺寸到部件一一写明。造成之后，木牛流马载着粮米往来山路，源源不断运往前线大营。
司马懿听说后，派兵在半路截住，抢回几头木牛流马，令工匠拆开仿造，很快也用来从陇西搬运粮草。这正中诸葛亮下怀：他派一支人马扮作魏军，混入运粮队伍，杀散押运的魏兵，把木牛流马口中的舌头扭转，它们便再也不能行走。魏军赶来夺回，却怎么也拉不动；蜀军再杀回来，把舌头扭回原处，驱赶着木牛流马满载魏粮而去。司马懿只能叹息。
史实：木牛、流马确有其事。《三国志·后主传》记载，建兴九年（231年）诸葛亮围祁山，“始以木牛运”；建兴十二年（234年）出斜谷，“始以流马运”。裴注引《诸葛亮集》载有制作之法，说木牛“方腹曲头，一脚四足”，小说所录即源于此。它们的具体构造早已失传，后世多推测是某种独轮车。扭转牛舌、劫夺魏粮的计策，则出自小说的虚构。
ch102-wooden-oxen.why: The wooden oxen point to the real problem of Zhuge Liang's northern wars, feeding an army across the Qinling mountains, and to his ingenuity in meeting it.
ch102-wooden-oxen.why_zh: 木牛流马点出了北伐的真正难题：如何翻越秦岭供养大军，也显示了诸葛亮解决难题的巧思。

story_zh: 诸葛亮第五次北伐，屯兵五丈原，司马懿坚守不战。诸葛亮便在上方谷（又名葫芦谷）设下埋伏：谷中搭起草房，堆满干柴，四周山上暗藏火种；又故意让魏军得知蜀军粮草都囤在谷中，再命魏延出战，只许败不许胜，务必把司马懿引进谷来。
司马懿果然中计，一面派兵佯攻祁山大寨，一面亲率司马师、司马昭直扑上方谷。魏延且战且走，把他引入谷中。司马懿见满谷干柴，才知中计，谷口却已被堵死，火箭齐下，烈焰冲天，父子三人抱头痛哭，自分必死。忽然狂风大作，一场倾盆大雨浇灭了大火，司马懿趁机杀出。消息传来，诸葛亮长叹：“谋事在人，成事在天！”
史实：上方谷火攻于史无据。《三国志》和《晋书·宣帝纪》只记建兴十二年（234年）诸葛亮出斜谷，屯五丈原，分兵在渭水边屯田，司马懿坚壁不出，两军相持百余日；见于记载的交锋只有郭淮抢先占据北原、击退来争的蜀军等小战。木牛流马运粮确有其事，火烧司马父子、天降大雨则是小说的创作。
story: On his fifth northern campaign Zhuge Liang camps at the Wuzhang Plains, and Sima Yi refuses to come out and fight. So Zhuge Liang lays a trap in Shangfang Valley, also called Gourd Valley: straw huts stacked with dry firewood inside, incendiaries hidden on the slopes all around. He lets the Wei side learn that his grain is stored there, and sends Wei Yan out with orders to lose, not win, and draw Sima Yi in.

Sima Yi takes the bait. He sends troops in a feint against the Shu camp at Qishan and rides for the valley himself with his sons Sima Shi and Sima Zhao. Wei Yan falls back before them into the valley. Only when he sees the firewood does Sima Yi understand, but the mouth of the valley is already blocked, fire arrows rain down and the valley goes up in flames. Father and sons cling to each other weeping, sure they will die. Then a gale rises, a sudden downpour puts out the fire, and Sima Yi cuts his way free. When the news comes, Zhuge Liang sighs: 'Man proposes, heaven disposes.'

Historically: there is no record of any of this. The Records of the Three Kingdoms and the Book of Jin say only that in 234 Zhuge Liang came out through the Xie valley, camped at Wuzhang, set his soldiers to farm along the Wei River and faced Sima Yi, who would not fight, for over a hundred days; the only clashes recorded are small ones, such as Guo Huai seizing the Northern Plain ahead of the Shu army and beating off its attack. The wooden oxen and gliding horses that carried Zhuge Liang's grain were real; the burning valley and the saving rain are the novel's.
ch103-shangfang-valley.why: It is the closest the novel's Zhuge Liang comes to destroying Sima Yi, and the plainest statement that heaven, not skill, has already decided his northern campaigns.
ch103-shangfang-valley.why_zh: 这是诸葛亮离消灭司马懿最近的一次，小说借一场大雨点明：北伐的成败已由天定，非人力所能挽回。

quote.zh: 谋事在人，成事在天
quote.en: Man makes the plans; heaven decides how they end.

story_zh: 上方谷功败垂成之后，司马懿坚守不出。诸葛亮派人送去女人的头巾衣服羞辱他，他笑着收下，只向来使打听丞相的起居。听说诸葛亮早起晚睡，罚二十军棍以上的事都亲自过问，饭却吃得很少，司马懿断言：“孔明食少事烦，其能久乎？”不久东吴出兵失利的消息传来，诸葛亮急火攻心，一病不起。
夜观天象，诸葛亮见自己的将星昏暗。姜维劝他祈禳，他便在帐中摆下七盏大灯、四十九盏小灯，中间安放本命灯一盏，说七日之内主灯不灭，便可延寿一纪。他披发仗剑，每夜踏罡步斗。第六夜，主灯依然明亮，魏延却闯进帐来报告魏兵来袭，脚步太急，竟把主灯扑灭。诸葛亮弃剑长叹：“死生有命，不可得而禳也！”姜维拔剑要杀魏延，诸葛亮拦住说：这是天命，不怪他。
史实：《三国志·诸葛亮传》只说建兴十二年八月诸葛亮“疾病，卒于军”，祈禳续命、魏延扑灯都没有记载。送巾帼羞辱司马懿、问使者寝食之事倒是真的，见于《晋书·宣帝纪》和裴注引《魏氏春秋》，司马懿听后说：“亮将死矣。”向北斗祈求延寿本是道教法术，小说借此渲染诸葛亮的悲剧，也为魏延的下场埋下伏笔。
story: After the failure at Shangfang Valley, Sima Yi stays behind his walls. Zhuge Liang sends him a woman's headdress and clothes as an insult; Sima Yi accepts them with a smile and asks the envoy only about the chancellor's daily life. Told that Zhuge Liang rises early, goes to bed late, handles every punishment of twenty strokes or more himself and eats very little, Sima Yi concludes that a man who eats so little and works so hard cannot last. Soon news comes that Wu's offensive has failed, and Zhuge Liang collapses and takes to his bed.

Reading the night sky, he sees his own star growing dim. Jiang Wei urges him to pray for more life, and in his tent he sets out seven large lamps and forty-nine small ones around a single lamp for his own life: if it stays lit for seven days, he says, he will gain twelve more years. Night after night, hair loose and sword in hand, he paces out the steps of the Dipper. On the sixth night the main lamp is still burning when Wei Yan rushes in to report a Wei attack and, in his haste, puts it out. Zhuge Liang throws down his sword: 'Life and death are fated; no prayer can change them.' Jiang Wei draws his sword on Wei Yan, but Zhuge Liang stops him: it is heaven's will, not Wei Yan's fault.

Historically: Zhuge Liang's biography says only that in the eighth month of 234 he fell ill and died in camp; there is no prayer for life and no lamp put out by Wei Yan. The woman's headdress and Sima Yi's questions to the envoy are recorded, in the Book of Jin and in the Wei shi chunqiu quoted in Pei Songzhi's notes, where Sima Yi remarks: 'Liang will soon die.' Praying to the Dipper for long life is a Daoist rite; the novel uses it to deepen Zhuge Liang's tragedy and to prepare Wei Yan's end.
ch103-seven-lamps.why: Here the novel's Zhuge Liang accepts that his life, and his cause, are over, and Wei Yan becomes the man who put out the lamp.
ch103-seven-lamps.why_zh: 诸葛亮至此认命，北伐大业也随之无望；魏延扑灭主灯，为他日后的结局埋下伏笔。

quote.zh: 死生有命，不可得而禳也
quote.en: Life and death are fated; no prayer can buy them off.

people.role: Shu general, puts out the lamp

people.role: Wei commander who foresees his death
people.role_zh: 魏军主帅，料定诸葛亮将死

story_zh: 禳星失败后，诸葛亮自知不起，抱病安排后事：把平生所著兵书和连弩之法传给姜维；把一个锦囊交给杨仪，留下对付魏延的计策；又定下退兵方略，命死后秘不发丧，大军徐徐撤退。他让左右扶上小车，出寨巡视各营，秋风扑面，寒彻骨髓，长叹道：“再不能临阵讨贼矣！悠悠苍天，曷此其极！”
后主派尚书李福前来问安。李福问丞相百年之后谁可担当大任，诸葛亮答蒋琬；再问蒋琬之后，答费祎；又问费祎之后，再无回答，众人上前一看，丞相已经去世，时年五十四岁。当夜司马懿仰观天象，见一颗赤色大星光芒有角，自东北流向西南，坠入蜀营，又惊又喜：“孔明死矣！”
据《三国志·诸葛亮传》，诸葛亮常苦于粮运不继，这次便分兵在渭水边屯田，与当地百姓杂居而秋毫无犯，与司马懿相持百余日，当年八月病逝军中。他遗命葬在汉中定军山，依山为坟，以平常衣服入殓；早先还上表后主说，自家在成都有桑八百株、薄田十五顷，子孙衣食有余。蜀军退后，司马懿察看他留下的营垒，赞叹为“天下奇才”。
story: With the lamp out, Zhuge Liang knows he will not recover and settles his affairs from his sickbed. He gives Jiang Wei the books on war he has written and the design of his repeating crossbow; he gives Yang Yi a sealed bag with a plan for dealing with Wei Yan; and he lays down how the army is to withdraw, keeping his death secret and pulling back slowly. Helped into a small carriage, he tours the camps one last time. The autumn wind chills him to the bone, and he sighs that he will never again take the field against the rebels, and asks the distant heavens why it must end like this.

Liu Shan sends the minister Li Fu to ask after him. Li Fu asks who should take charge after him: Jiang Wan, says Zhuge Liang. And after Jiang Wan? Fei Yi. And after Fei Yi? There is no answer; when the officers lean in, the chancellor is dead, at fifty-four. That night Sima Yi, watching the sky, sees a great red star with pointed rays streak from the northeast to the southwest and fall into the Shu camp. 'Kongming is dead!' he cries, startled and overjoyed.

Zhuge Liang's biography in the Records says that, always hampered by supply problems, this time he had his soldiers farm along the Wei River, living among the local people without harming them, and held Sima Yi for over a hundred days before dying in camp in the eighth month. He asked to be buried on Mount Dingjun in Hanzhong, in a grave cut into the hillside and in everyday clothes; earlier he had told Liu Shan that his family owned eight hundred mulberry trees and fifteen qing of poor land in Chengdu, enough for his descendants. After the Shu army left, Sima Yi went over its abandoned camps and called him 'a genius of the age'.
ch104-wuzhang.why: Zhuge Liang's death ends Shu's best hope of restoring the Han, and the novel's heart goes with him.
ch104-wuzhang.why_zh: 诸葛亮之死，意味着蜀汉兴复汉室的最大希望破灭，小说的情感高峰也随之落幕。

quote.zh: 再不能临阵讨贼矣！悠悠苍天，曷此其极！
quote.en: Never again shall I face the traitors in the field! O distant heaven, why must it end so?

story_zh: 诸葛亮临终嘱咐：死后不可发丧，将遗体安坐龛中，口含米七粒，脚下点一盏明灯，军中安静如常；若司马懿追来，就把他的木像安放在车上，推出阵前。蜀军依计拔营撤退。司马懿虽见大星坠落，仍怕有诈，先派夏侯霸探营，得知蜀营已空，这才带着两个儿子急急追赶。
追到山脚，蜀军忽然回旗返鼓，林中飘出一面大旗，上书“汉丞相武乡侯诸葛亮”，数十员上将簇拥着一辆四轮车，车上端坐诸葛亮，纶巾羽扇，鹤氅皂绦。司马懿以为中计，拨马便逃，一口气跑出五十余里，还摸着脑袋问部将自己的头还在不在。两天后听乡民说起，才知车上不过是一尊木像，只能叹道：“吾能料其生，不能料其死也！”
史实：据裴注引《汉晋春秋》，杨仪等整军撤退，百姓奔告司马懿，司马懿随即追赶；姜维令杨仪反旗鸣鼓，作势回击，司马懿便退兵不敢逼近，蜀军结阵而去，入谷后才发丧。百姓编出“死诸葛走生仲达”的谚语，司马懿听说后自嘲：“吾能料生，不便料死。”《晋书·宣帝纪》则说他是因“穷寇”不可逼才没有进击。木像和摸头问头都是小说的创造。
story: Before he died Zhuge Liang left instructions: no mourning; his body to be seated in a shrine with seven grains of rice in his mouth and a lamp at his feet, the camp kept quiet as usual; and if Sima Yi gave chase, his wooden likeness was to be set in his carriage and pushed out in front of the army. The Shu army breaks camp as told. Sima Yi has seen the great star fall but still fears a trick; only when Xiahou Ba, sent to scout, finds the camps empty does he set off in pursuit with his two sons.

At the foot of a hill the Shu army suddenly turns its banners and beats its drums. A great flag reading 'Zhuge Liang, Chancellor of Han, Marquis of Wuxiang' appears from the trees, and out rolls a four-wheeled carriage ringed by generals, with Zhuge Liang seated in it: silk cap, feather fan, crane-down cloak. Sure he has been tricked, Sima Yi turns and flees fifty li, and when he finally stops he feels his head and asks his officers whether it is still there. Two days later villagers tell him the figure was made of wood. 'I could read him while he lived,' he sighs, 'but not once he was dead.'

Historically: the Han-Jin chunqiu, quoted in Pei Songzhi's notes, says that as Yang Yi led the army away, local people ran to tell Sima Yi, who gave chase; Jiang Wei had Yang Yi turn the banners and beat the drums as if to attack, and Sima Yi drew back and dared not close in, so the Shu army marched off in formation and announced the death only once it was in the valleys. People made up the saying 'a dead Zhuge put a living Zhongda to flight', and Sima Yi answered wryly that he could predict the living, not the dead. The Book of Jin says he held back only because a cornered enemy should not be pressed. The statue and the feeling for his head are the novel's.
ch104-wooden-statue.why: One of the novel's best-loved scenes, it lets Zhuge Liang beat Sima Yi even after death, and it grew from a real retreat and a real popular saying.
ch104-wooden-statue.why_zh: 诸葛亮死后仍能吓退司马懿，是小说最脍炙人口的场面之一，其底本是一次真实的撤退和一句流传的民谚。

quote.zh: 吾能料其生，不能料其死也
quote.en: I could foresee him living; I could not foresee him dead.

people.role: Wei commander, flees from the statue

people.name: Zhuge Liang
people.role: routs the enemy with his wooden likeness

story_zh: 魏延当年归降时，诸葛亮就说他脑后有反骨。诸葛亮临终料定他必反，把锦囊交给杨仪，又暗中嘱咐了马岱。退兵时，费祎去告诉魏延由杨仪统领大军、他负责断后，魏延大怒，说丞相虽死，还有他魏延在，岂肯替一个长史断后！他抢先率本部南归，烧断栈道，与杨仪各自上表，互指对方谋反，马岱也假意跟随了他。
两军在南谷口对阵。王平出阵大骂魏延是反贼，魏延的部众纷纷散去。杨仪这时拆开锦囊，对魏延说：你若敢在马上连叫三声“谁敢杀我”，我就把汉中献给你。魏延大笑：孔明在时我还怕他三分，如今天下谁敢敌我？别说三声，三万声也不难！他提刀勒马大叫“谁敢杀我”，一声未了，背后一人厉声应道：“吾敢杀汝！”手起刀落，魏延落马。原来正是马岱。
史实：据《三国志·魏延传》，诸葛亮临终确曾安排魏延断后，若他不从便自行撤军；魏延不服，抢先南归，沿途烧绝阁道，双方互相告发。两军相遇，王平（何平）当先叱责，魏延部众自知理亏而散；魏延带几个儿子逃往汉中，被马岱追斩，杨仪踩着他的首级骂“庸奴”，夷其三族。锦囊和“谁敢杀我”都出于小说。陈寿认为魏延只想除掉杨仪、取代诸葛亮，并无投魏之意。
story: When Wei Yan first came over, Zhuge Liang said the bone at the back of his head showed he would one day rebel. Dying, he expects that rebellion: he leaves Yang Yi a sealed bag and gives Ma Dai secret orders. When Fei Yi tells Wei Yan that Yang Yi will lead the army home and he is to cover the rear, Wei Yan explodes: the chancellor may be dead, but Wei Yan is still here, and he will not guard the rear for a mere chief clerk. He races south ahead of the army with his own men, burning the plank roads behind him, and he and Yang Yi each send memorials accusing the other of rebellion. Ma Dai pretends to join him.

The two forces meet at the mouth of the southern valley. Wang Ping rides out and curses Wei Yan as a traitor, and Wei Yan's men melt away. Now Yang Yi opens the bag and calls out: shout 'Who dares kill me?' three times from your saddle, and Hanzhong is yours. Wei Yan laughs: while Kongming lived he feared him a little, but who in the world can face him now? Three times, or thirty thousand, is nothing. He raises his blade and shouts 'Who dares kill me?' Before the shout is done a voice behind him answers 'I dare!', and a sword cuts him down. It is Ma Dai.

Historically: Wei Yan's biography confirms that the dying Zhuge Liang ordered Wei Yan to cover the retreat, and the army to leave without him if he refused; that Wei Yan rushed south, burning the plank roads; and that each side accused the other of rebellion. When they met, Wang Ping (He Ping) rebuked Wei Yan's men, who knew they were in the wrong and scattered; Wei Yan fled toward Hanzhong with a few of his sons, Ma Dai rode him down, and Yang Yi stamped on his head, called him a slave and wiped out his clan. The sealed bag and the shout are the novel's. Chen Shou believed Wei Yan meant only to remove Yang Yi and take Zhuge Liang's place, not to go over to Wei.
ch105-wei-yan.why: The novel makes Wei Yan's death the last proof of Zhuge Liang's foresight; the historian who recorded it judged Wei Yan far more kindly.
ch105-wei-yan.why_zh: 小说把魏延之死写成诸葛亮神机妙算的最后一例，而记录此事的史家对魏延要宽厚得多。

quote.zh: 谁敢杀我？
quote.en: Who dares to kill me?

story_zh: 辽东公孙氏割据三代。公孙渊先与东吴往来，又斩杀孙权派来的使者向魏国邀功，受封乐浪公；后来自以为辽东偏远，魏军奈何他不得，便自立为燕王，改元绍汉，劝阻的部下都被他杀了。魏明帝曹睿召司马懿征讨，问需要多少时日，司马懿答：去一百天，攻一百天，回一百天，再休整六十天，一年足矣。
司马懿率四万人远征。公孙渊派卑衍、杨祚屯兵辽隧，挖堑二十余里阻挡。司马懿不去硬攻，绕道直取襄平，敌军慌忙回救，被他半路击溃。围城时正逢连月大雨，平地积水数尺，将士请求移营，司马懿下令再言者斩。他说敌众我寡、敌饥我饱，此时急攻只会把敌人吓跑。雨停后，他堆土山、挖地道，昼夜猛攻，城中粮尽，以至人相食。
公孙渊遣使求和，又请送儿子为人质，司马懿答：军事大要有五，能战当战，不能战当守，不能守当走，不能走当降，不能降当死，何必送子！公孙渊突围南逃，在梁水边被斩。据《三国志·公孙度传》和《晋书·宣帝纪》，司马懿入城后杀十五岁以上男子七千余人，筑为京观。割据辽东近五十年的公孙氏至此灭亡，司马懿的声望也如日中天。
story: The Gongsun family had ruled Liaodong for three generations. Gongsun Yuan first dealt with Wu, then killed Sun Quan's envoys to win favour with Wei, which made him Duke of Lelang; later, sure that distance would protect him, he proclaimed himself King of Yan with his own era name and killed the officers who objected. Emperor Cao Rui calls on Sima Yi and asks how long it will take. A hundred days to get there, says Sima Yi, a hundred to attack, a hundred to come back and sixty to rest: a year will do.

Sima Yi marches with forty thousand men. Gongsun Yuan's generals Bei Yan and Yang Zuo hold Liaosui behind twenty li of trenches; Sima Yi ignores them and heads straight for Xiangping, and when they rush back to save it he crushes them on the way. The siege begins in a month of rain; the plain is under several feet of water and his officers beg to move camp, but he orders that anyone who mentions it again be beheaded. The enemy is many and hungry, he explains, his own men few and fed: attack too soon and they will only scatter. When the rain stops he builds earth mounds and digs tunnels and attacks day and night, until the starving city turns to cannibalism.

Gongsun Yuan asks for peace and offers his son as a hostage. Sima Yi replies that war comes down to five things: fight if you can, hold if you cannot fight, flee if you cannot hold, surrender if you cannot flee, and die if you cannot surrender; why send a son? Gongsun Yuan breaks out southward and is killed by the Liang River. The Records' account of the Gongsun family and the Book of Jin say that Sima Yi then killed over seven thousand men aged fifteen and over in the city and piled their bodies into a mound. Nearly fifty years of Gongsun rule were over, and Sima Yi's prestige was at its height.
ch106-liaodong.why: Sima Yi's finest campaign made him indispensable to Wei and laid the ground for his later seizure of power.
ch106-liaodong.why_zh: 此战是司马懿用兵的巅峰之作，此后他成为魏国不可或缺的重臣，为日后专权打下了基础。

people.name: Gongsun Yuan
people.role: Liaodong warlord, self-styled King of Yan
people.role_zh: 辽东割据者，自立为燕王

people.name: Cao Rui
people.role: Wei emperor who sends Sima Yi

story_zh: 魏明帝临终，把年幼的太子曹芳托付给大将军曹爽和太尉司马懿。曹爽是曹真之子，身边聚集着何晏、邓飏、李胜、丁谧、毕轨等一班名士。他采纳何晏的主意，奏请天子尊司马懿为太傅，明升暗降，夺去他的兵权。司马懿从此称病不出，两个儿子司马师、司马昭也都辞官闲居。
李胜被任命为荆州刺史，奉曹爽之命借辞行之机前来探病。司马懿去掉冠帽，披头散发，由两个婢女扶着坐在床上。李胜说要回本州荆州，他偏偏一再听成“并州”，叮嘱并州靠近胡地，要好好防备；李胜反复纠正，他仍旧答非所问。婢女端来汤粥，他低头去喝，汤水顺着嘴角流满衣襟，又哽咽着说自己死在旦夕，把两个儿子托付给李胜照看。
李胜回报曹爽，说太傅形神已离，不足为虑，曹爽从此再无防备。李胜一走，司马懿便起身对两个儿子说：曹爽不会再疑心我了，只等他出城打猎，就可以动手。此事见于《晋书·宣帝纪》和裴注引《魏末传》，李胜原话是“司马公尸居余气，形神已离”。其实司马懿年轻时就曾以患“风痹”为由装病，推辞曹操的征召。
story: On his deathbed Emperor Cao Rui entrusted the boy heir Cao Fang to two regents, the general-in-chief Cao Shuang and the grand commandant Sima Yi. Cao Shuang, son of Cao Zhen, gathered round him a set of fashionable men: He Yan, Deng Yang, Li Sheng, Ding Mi, Bi Gui. On He Yan's advice he had Sima Yi promoted to Grand Tutor, an honour that took away his command of troops. Sima Yi declared himself ill and stayed at home, and his sons Sima Shi and Sima Zhao gave up their posts too.

When Li Sheng is made governor of Jingzhou, Cao Shuang sends him to take his leave of Sima Yi and see how ill he really is. Sima Yi receives him bareheaded, hair loose, propped up in bed by two maids. Li Sheng says he is going home to Jingzhou; Sima Yi keeps hearing 'Bingzhou' and warns him to guard against the northern tribes there, and however often Li Sheng corrects him, he answers beside the point. When a maid brings porridge, it runs from his mouth down his chest. Choking, he says he will not last long and begs Li Sheng to look after his two sons.

Li Sheng tells Cao Shuang that the old man is finished, body and spirit already parted, and Cao Shuang stops worrying about him. As soon as Li Sheng has gone, Sima Yi gets up and tells his sons that Cao Shuang will suspect nothing now: they need only wait until he leaves the city to hunt. The scene is in the Book of Jin and in the Wei mo zhuan quoted by Pei Songzhi, where Li Sheng calls Sima Yi 'a corpse with a breath left in it'. Sima Yi had done it before: as a young man he had feigned paralysis to avoid serving Cao Cao.
ch106-feigned-illness.why: Sima Yi's greatest act of patience lulls Cao Shuang into the carelessness that costs the Cao family the empire.
ch106-feigned-illness.why_zh: 这是司马懿隐忍功夫的极致，曹爽因此放松警惕，曹氏江山也由此旁落。

story_zh: 正始十年正月，曹爽兄弟陪少帝曹芳出城，拜谒魏明帝的高平陵。司马懿立即发难：奏请郭太后下令关闭城门，占据武库，派司徒高柔代领曹爽的军营、太仆王观代领曹羲的军营，自己率兵屯守洛水浮桥，上表历数曹爽罪状。大司农桓范骗开城门，逃去投奔曹爽。司马懿大惊，说曹爽的智囊跑了；蒋济却说，劣马只贪恋槽中豆料，曹爽必定不会用他。
桓范劝曹爽挟天子到许昌，调集四方兵马讨伐司马懿。曹爽犹豫了一整夜。司马懿接连派许允、陈泰来说只免官职，又让曹爽信任的尹大目带去蒋济的书信，指着洛水发誓。天亮时，曹爽扔下佩剑，叹道就算丢了官，也还能做个富家翁。桓范放声大哭，骂道曹真一世英雄，怎么生下这几个蠢如猪牛的儿子！
曹爽交出印绶，回府后就被看管起来。没过几天，宦官张当被迫供出曹爽与何晏等人图谋造反，曹爽兄弟和何晏、邓飏、丁谧、毕轨、李胜、桓范等都被夷灭三族。此事见于《三国志·曹爽传》和《晋书·宣帝纪》。司马懿背弃了洛水之誓，蒋济因担保失信，羞愧发病而死。从此魏国军政大权尽归司马氏。
story: In the first month of 249 Cao Shuang and his brothers take the young emperor Cao Fang out of the city to the Gaoping tomb of Emperor Ming. Sima Yi strikes at once. In the name of the empress dowager he has the gates shut and the arsenal seized, puts Gao Rou and Wang Guan in command of Cao Shuang's and Cao Xi's troops, camps at the floating bridge over the Luo River and sends the emperor a memorial listing Cao Shuang's crimes. The minister Huan Fan talks his way out of a gate and rides to join Cao Shuang. Sima Yi is alarmed that Cao Shuang's brains have escaped him; Jiang Ji reassures him that a nag thinks only of the beans in its stall, and Cao Shuang will never take Huan Fan's advice.

Huan Fan urges Cao Shuang to take the emperor to Xuchang and call up the provinces against Sima Yi. Cao Shuang dithers all night. Sima Yi sends Xu Yun and Chen Tai to promise that he will only lose his offices, then Yin Damu, whom Cao Shuang trusts, with a letter from Jiang Ji and an oath sworn by the Luo River. At dawn Cao Shuang throws down his sword: out of office, he can still live as a rich man. Huan Fan weeps and cries that Cao Zhen was a hero, and his sons are no better than pigs and calves.

Cao Shuang hands over his seals and is put under guard at home. Within days the eunuch Zhang Dang is made to confess that Cao Shuang and He Yan had been plotting rebellion, and Cao Shuang, his brothers, He Yan, Deng Yang, Ding Mi, Bi Gui, Li Sheng and Huan Fan are executed with their clans. The Records' biography of Cao Shuang and the Book of Jin tell the story. Sima Yi broke his oath by the Luo; Jiang Ji, who had vouched for it, fell ill from shame and died. From then on the Sima held Wei's army and government.
ch107-gaopingling.why: The coup put Wei in the hands of the Sima family and began the road to the Jin dynasty.
ch107-gaopingling.why_zh: 高平陵之变使魏国大权落入司马氏之手，是日后晋代魏的起点。

people.name: Cao Shuang
people.role: regent, gives up without a fight

story_zh: 孙权去世，幼主孙亮即位，太傅诸葛恪辅政，在东兴重修大堤，左右依山各筑一城。魏国趁东吴大丧，派胡遵、诸葛诞领兵七万进攻东兴，架起浮桥攻城。诸葛恪亲率四万大军来救，命老将丁奉为先锋——当年赤壁之战，奉周瑜之命去七星坛追杀诸葛亮的，正是这位丁奉。
这天天降大雪，魏将韩综、桓嘉等正在营中置酒高会。丁奉趁着北风扬帆急进，带三千人抢先赶到，命士兵脱去铠甲，不拿长枪大戟，只持短刀。魏兵远远望见，都笑这支小队伍不自量力，毫不防备。丁奉率众冒雪呐喊登岸，直冲敌营，吴军后队相继杀到，魏军大乱，争抢浮桥逃命，浮桥断裂，落水和践踏而死的不计其数，韩综、桓嘉都死于乱军之中。
此战见于《三国志·丁奉传》和《诸葛恪传》。史书说丁奉令士兵“解铠著胄，持短兵”，即脱去铠甲而保留头盔，并对部下说：“取封侯爵赏，正在今日！”魏军败后，执政的司马师把罪责揽在自己身上，只削去任监军的弟弟司马昭的爵位。诸葛恪却因此骄傲轻敌，次年大举围攻合肥新城，损兵折将，回国后被孙峻设计杀死在宴席上。
story: When Sun Quan dies and the boy Sun Liang succeeds him, the regent Zhuge Ke rebuilds the great dyke at Dongxing with a fort on the hills at each end. Wei seizes the moment of mourning: Hu Zun and Zhuge Dan lead seventy thousand men against Dongxing and throw floating bridges across to attack the forts. Zhuge Ke comes to the rescue with forty thousand and sends the veteran Ding Feng ahead: the same Ding Feng whom Zhou Yu once sent, at Red Cliffs, to kill Zhuge Liang at his altar of the seven stars.

It is snowing hard, and the Wei officers Han Zong, Huan Jia and the rest are feasting in their camp. Sailing hard before the north wind, Ding Feng arrives first with three thousand men. He has them take off their armour and leave their spears and halberds, carrying only short blades. The Wei soldiers watching laugh at so small a band and make no preparations. Ding Feng's men charge up the bank through the snow, the rest of the Wu army follows, and the Wei force collapses: men crowd onto the floating bridges, the bridges break, and countless men drown or are trampled. Han Zong and Huan Jia both die in the rout.

The battle is in the Records' biographies of Ding Feng and Zhuge Ke. There Ding Feng's men take off their armour but keep their helmets, and he tells them: 'Titles and rewards are to be won today!' After the defeat Sima Shi, now ruling Wei, took the blame on himself and punished only his brother Sima Zhao, the army's supervisor, by stripping his title. Zhuge Ke, made overconfident by the victory, besieged the new city at Hefei the next year, lost heavily, and on his return was killed at a banquet by Sun Jun.
ch108-dongxing.why: Wu's last great victory over Wei made Zhuge Ke overconfident and led directly to his ruin.
ch108-dongxing.why_zh: 东兴之战是东吴对魏的最后一次大胜，却让诸葛恪骄傲轻敌，直接招致了他的覆灭。

people.name: Ding Feng
people.role: Wu veteran, leads the charge in the snow
people.role_zh: 东吴老将，雪中率先冲锋

story_zh: 淮南毌丘俭、文钦起兵讨伐司马师，司马师亲征平叛，眼疾发作，死在许昌，司马昭接掌大权。姜维认为魏国内乱，正是北伐良机，不顾张翼蜀国地小民疲、不宜轻动的劝阻，与夏侯霸、张翼等率军出狄道，进至洮水。魏雍州刺史王经领兵数万前来迎战。
姜维背靠洮水列阵，自断退路，要全军拼死一战。王经挥军来攻，蜀军先退后战，退到水边已无路可走，人人奋勇回击；夏侯霸、张翼从两翼杀出，魏军大败，被斩杀和挤落洮水淹死的有数万人。王经带着残兵逃进狄道城，闭门死守。
姜维乘胜包围狄道。张翼劝他见好就收，不宜再进，姜维不听。魏征西将军陈泰与邓艾率援军赶到，夜里在城东南的高山上多举烽火、擂响战鼓，姜维见援军已至，只得解围退走。据《三国志·姜维传》，此战王经“众死者数万人”，是姜维历次北伐中最大的胜利。败将王经五年后因没有向司马昭告发魏帝曹髦的讨伐之谋，与母亲一同被杀。
story: In Huainan, Guanqiu Jian and Wen Qin rise against Sima Shi; Sima Shi crushes them, but his diseased eye bursts and he dies at Xuchang, and Sima Zhao takes over. Jiang Wei sees Wei in turmoil and decides to march, brushing aside Zhang Yi's warning that Shu is small and its people exhausted. With Xiahou Ba and Zhang Yi he comes out by Didao and reaches the Tao River, where the Wei governor of Yongzhou, Wang Jing, meets him with tens of thousands of men.

Jiang Wei draws up his army with its back to the Tao, leaving no way out but to fight to the death. When Wang Jing attacks, the Shu troops give ground until they reach the water, then, with nowhere left to go, turn and fight with everything they have, while Xiahou Ba and Zhang Yi charge in from the flanks. The Wei army breaks, and tens of thousands are cut down or driven into the Tao to drown. Wang Jing escapes with what is left into the city of Didao and shuts the gates.

Jiang Wei besieges Didao. Zhang Yi urges him to stop while he is ahead, but he will not listen. Then the Wei generals Chen Tai and Deng Ai arrive with a relief army and light beacon fires and beat drums by night on the hills southeast of the city, and Jiang Wei, seeing that help has come, lifts the siege and withdraws. Jiang Wei's biography says that 'tens of thousands' of Wang Jing's men died: it was the greatest victory of all his northern campaigns. Five years later the beaten Wang Jing was put to death with his mother by Sima Zhao, for failing to betray Emperor Cao Mao's plan to attack him.
ch110-taoxi.why: Jiang Wei's greatest victory shows that Shu could still hurt Wei, and how little even a great victory could change.
ch110-taoxi.why_zh: 洮西之战是姜维北伐中最辉煌的胜利，却也表明蜀国即使大胜，也难以扭转大局。

story_zh: 司马昭专权后，派心腹贾充到淮南试探镇东大将军诸葛诞。贾充说洛阳的贤士都希望魏帝禅位，问他意下如何。诸葛诞厉声喝斥：你不是贾豫州的儿子吗？世受魏国厚恩，怎敢说出这种话！若洛阳有难，我当以死报国。贾充回报司马昭，司马昭便下诏召诸葛诞入朝任司空，想夺去他的兵权。
诸葛诞知道入朝必死，索性杀了扬州刺史乐綝，集结淮南将士十余万据守寿春，并把儿子诸葛靓送到东吴做人质，请求援兵。东吴派文钦、全怿、全端、唐咨等率军来救。司马昭怕自己远征后洛阳生变，干脆奏请魏帝曹髦和郭太后随军亲征，亲统二十六万大军，把寿春围得水泄不通，深沟高垒，坐等城中粮尽。
据《三国志·诸葛诞传》，诸葛诞与诸葛亮同族，在魏国素有盛名，《世说新语》记时人称“蜀得其龙，吴得其虎，魏得其狗”。寿春被围数月，吴国援军屡败，城中粮尽，诸葛诞与文钦失和，杀了文钦，文钦之子文鸯、文虎出城投降。次年城破，诸葛诞被杀，麾下数百人宁死不降，都说“为诸葛公死，不恨”。此后再无人能与司马氏抗衡。
story: Once Sima Zhao holds power, he sends his confidant Jia Chong to sound out Zhuge Dan, the general commanding in the east. The worthies of Luoyang, says Jia Chong, would all like to see the emperor abdicate: what does Zhuge Dan think? Zhuge Dan rounds on him: is he not the son of Jia Kui, governor of Yuzhou? His family has enjoyed Wei's favour for generations, and he dares say such things? If Luoyang is ever in danger, Zhuge Dan will die for it. Jia Chong reports back, and Sima Zhao summons Zhuge Dan to court as Minister of Works, to take his army away from him.

Zhuge Dan knows that going to court means death. He kills the Yangzhou governor Yue Lin, gathers more than a hundred thousand men of Huainan at Shouchun and sends his son Zhuge Jing to Wu as a hostage, asking for help; Wu sends Wen Qin, Quan Yi, Quan Duan, Tang Zi and others. Afraid of what might happen in Luoyang while he is away, Sima Zhao takes the emperor Cao Mao and the empress dowager with him, and with two hundred and sixty thousand men surrounds Shouchun with deep trenches and high walls, waiting for the city to starve.

Zhuge Dan's biography in the Records shows a kinsman of Zhuge Liang with a great name in Wei; the Shishuo xinyu records the saying 'Shu got the dragon, Wu the tiger, Wei the dog'. The siege lasted months; Wu's relief armies were beaten one after another; as food ran out Zhuge Dan quarrelled with Wen Qin and killed him, and Wen Qin's sons Wen Yang and Wen Hu went over the wall to surrender. Early the next year the city fell and Zhuge Dan was killed; several hundred of his men refused to surrender and were beheaded, each saying: 'To die for Lord Zhuge is no regret.' After this no one could stand against the Sima.
ch111-zhuge-dan.why: The last of the three Huainan risings against the Sima; after its failure no one in Wei could resist them.
ch111-zhuge-dan.why_zh: 这是淮南三叛的最后一次，失败之后，魏国再无力量能与司马氏抗衡。

people.name: Zhuge Dan
people.role: Wei general in the east, rises in revolt
people.role_zh: 魏镇东大将军，起兵讨司马昭

people.name: Jia Chong
people.role_zh: 司马昭心腹，试探诸葛诞

story_zh: 司马昭受封晋公，加九锡，权势日盛。有人奏报宁陵井中两次出现黄龙，群臣都说是祥瑞，魏帝曹髦却说：龙是君王的象征，不在天上，也不在田野，却屈居井中，这是被幽困的征兆。他作《潜龙诗》自伤：“伤哉龙受困，不能跃深渊……”司马昭读到这首诗，勃然大怒，带剑上殿，对曹髦出言逼迫。
曹髦忍无可忍，召来侍中王沈、尚书王经、散骑常侍王业，说司马昭的野心连路上的行人都知道，自己不能坐等被废受辱，要亲自出宫讨伐。王经苦苦劝阻，曹髦说主意已定，就是死也不怕。王沈、王业转身就去向司马昭告密。曹髦拔剑登车，率领宫中宿卫和僮仆数百人呐喊而出。
到了南阙，贾充领兵拦截。曹髦挥剑大喊自己是天子，士兵不敢上前。贾充对太子舍人成济说：司马公养你们，正是为了今天！成济挺戈上前，刃从曹髦背后穿出，曹髦死于车下。据裴注引《汉晋春秋》等书，司马昭事后杀成济灭族以塞众口，曹髦下葬极其简陋，百姓围观说：“是前日所杀天子也。”东晋明帝听王导讲到此事，掩面说：“若如公言，祚安得长！”
story: Sima Zhao has been made Duke of Jin with the nine bestowments, and his power grows by the day. When yellow dragons are twice reported in a well at Ningling, the court hails a good omen, but the emperor Cao Mao says a dragon stands for the ruler, and one that is neither in the sky nor in the fields but shut up in a well foretells captivity. He writes a poem, 'The Hidden Dragon', lamenting the trapped dragon that cannot leap into the deep. Sima Zhao reads it, flies into a rage, and comes into the hall wearing his sword to browbeat the emperor.

Cao Mao can bear no more. He calls in Wang Shen, Wang Jing and Wang Ye and tells them that Sima Zhao's ambition is plain to every passer-by in the street: he will not sit and wait to be deposed and humiliated, but will go out and attack him himself. Wang Jing pleads with him; Cao Mao answers that his mind is made up and he does not fear death. Wang Shen and Wang Ye go straight to Sima Zhao. Sword drawn, Cao Mao mounts his carriage and charges out with a few hundred palace guards and servants.

At the southern gate Jia Chong blocks the way with troops. Cao Mao brandishes his sword and shouts that he is the Son of Heaven, and the soldiers shrink back. Jia Chong tells Cheng Ji, an officer of the crown prince's household, that this is what Lord Sima has been feeding them for, and Cheng Ji drives his blade clean through the emperor, who dies beneath his carriage. According to the Han-Jin chunqiu and other sources in Pei Songzhi's notes, Sima Zhao then executed Cheng Ji and his clan to quiet the outcry, and Cao Mao was buried meanly while people watched and said, 'That is the emperor they killed the other day.' Decades later, hearing the story from Wang Dao, Emperor Ming of the Eastern Jin hid his face: 'If it was as you say, how can our dynasty last?'
ch114-cao-mao.why: A reigning emperor killed in the street by his minister's men: the moment the Sima ambition became undeniable, and a stain the Jin never washed out.
ch114-cao-mao.why_zh: 皇帝当街被权臣部下刺死，司马氏篡魏之心昭然若揭，这也成了晋朝始终洗不掉的污点。

quote.zh: 伤哉龙受困，不能跃深渊
quote.en: Alas for the dragon in its trap, unable to leap into the deep.

people.name: Cao Mao
people.role: Wei emperor who attacks his regent

people.name: Jia Chong
people.role: leads the troops at the gate

story_zh: 司马昭见蜀国宦官黄皓专权、姜维避祸沓中屯田，决定大举伐蜀：邓艾自狄道牵制沓中的姜维，诸葛绪截断姜维的归路，钟会统领十余万主力，分路从斜谷、骆谷、子午谷直取汉中。钟会治军极严，先锋许仪修路不力，钟会过桥时马蹄陷进桥面的窟窿，他不顾许仪是功臣许褚之子，下令斩首，全军为之震恐。
姜维早先把汉中的防守改为收缩兵力、固守汉、乐二城。钟会便分兵围住两城，主力直扑阳安关，蜀将傅佥力战而死，蒋舒开关投降，汉中门户大开。小说写钟会途经定军山，得知诸葛亮葬在山中，亲往墓前设祭再拜；当夜诸葛亮显圣，说汉祚已衰，但两川百姓无辜，嘱咐他入川之后切勿妄杀。钟会随即传令全军不得伤害百姓。
据《晋书·文帝纪》，这次伐蜀魏军共约十八万。《三国志·诸葛亮传》载，钟会到汉川，祭拜当年春天刚在沔阳建成的诸葛亮庙，下令士兵不得在诸葛亮墓周围放牧砍柴；显圣之事则是小说的点染。许仪被斩、傅佥战死、蒋舒投降都见于史书。后世史家多认为，姜维收缩汉中防线的部署使魏军得以长驱直入，是蜀亡的重要原因之一。
story: Seeing the eunuch Huang Hao in control of Shu and Jiang Wei keeping out of his way farming at Tazhong, Sima Zhao launches a full invasion: Deng Ai is to pin Jiang Wei down at Tazhong from Didao, Zhuge Xu to cut off his retreat, and Zhong Hui to lead the main army of over a hundred thousand down the Xie, Luo and Ziwu valleys to Hanzhong. Zhong Hui's discipline is fierce: when his vanguard commander Xu Yi leaves a bridge badly repaired and Zhong Hui's horse puts a hoof through it, he has Xu Yi beheaded, though he is the son of the great Xu Chu, and the whole army trembles.

Jiang Wei had earlier pulled Hanzhong's defenders back into the two fortified towns of Han and Le. Zhong Hui leaves troops to surround them and drives straight for the Yang'an Pass, where the Shu officer Fu Qian dies fighting and Jiang Shu opens the gates; the way into Hanzhong lies open. In the novel, Zhong Hui learns on the march that Zhuge Liang is buried on Mount Dingjun and goes to make offerings at the tomb; that night Zhuge Liang appears to him and says that the Han's time is over, but the people of Shu are innocent and must not be slaughtered. Zhong Hui at once orders his army to leave the people unharmed.

The Book of Jin puts the whole invasion force at about a hundred and eighty thousand. Zhuge Liang's biography records that on reaching Hanzhong Zhong Hui sacrificed at Zhuge Liang's shrine, built at Mianyang only that spring, and forbade his men to graze animals or cut wood around the tomb; the ghost is the novel's touch. Xu Yi's execution, Fu Qian's death and Jiang Shu's surrender are all in the histories. Many later historians have blamed Jiang Wei's pulled-back defence of Hanzhong for letting the invaders through, and count it among the causes of Shu's fall.
ch116-zhong-hui.why: The invasion that ends Shu begins, and the novel has Zhuge Liang himself accept it, asking only mercy for the people.
ch116-zhong-hui.why_zh: 灭蜀之战由此展开，小说让诸葛亮显圣，只求保全百姓，等于默认了天命已改。

people.name: Fu Qian
people.role: Shu officer killed at the Yang'an Pass

story_zh: 姜维退守剑阁，凭险挡住钟会大军，钟会久攻不下，粮草不继，已有退兵之意。邓艾献计：从阴平小路翻山越岭，绕到剑阁背后，直取涪城和成都。钟会表面称赞，背地里却笑他自寻死路。邓艾令儿子邓忠率五千精兵，手持斧凿在前开路，遇山凿山、遇涧架桥，自己率大军随后跟进。
大军在荒无人烟的深山中走了七百余里，来到摩天岭，前面是悬崖峭壁，马不能行，众人束手无策。邓艾说，已经走了七百里，过了此岭就是江油，岂能半途而废！他先把兵器扔下山崖，用毛毡裹住全身，第一个滚了下去；有毡的将士照样滚下，没有毡的腰系绳索，攀着树木鱼贯而下。途中他们发现一块石碣，刻着诸葛亮的预言，邓艾看后慌忙下拜，叹服武侯真是神人。
《三国志·邓艾传》载，景元四年冬十月，邓艾自阴平行无人之地七百余里，凿山通道，造作桥阁，山高谷深，粮运将尽，屡濒危境；他以毡自裹，推转而下，将士攀木缘崖，鱼贯而进，先到江油，蜀守将马邈投降。石碣则是小说的创造：“二火”合为“炎”，暗指蜀汉的炎兴年号；“二士”指邓艾（字士载）和钟会（字士季），二人次年都死于非命。
story: Jiang Wei falls back to Jiange and holds Zhong Hui's army at the pass; unable to break through and short of food, Zhong Hui is thinking of retreat. Deng Ai proposes going round by the Yinping track through the mountains, coming out behind Jiange and making straight for Fu and Chengdu. Zhong Hui praises the plan to his face and laughs behind his back that Deng Ai is marching to his death. Deng Ai sends his son Deng Zhong ahead with five thousand men carrying axes and chisels to cut paths through the rock and bridge the gorges, and follows with the main column.

For more than seven hundred li they march through empty mountains until they reach Motian Ridge, where the way ends in a sheer drop that no horse can manage, and no one knows what to do. Deng Ai tells his men that after seven hundred li, with Jiangyou just beyond the ridge, there is no turning back. He throws the weapons down first, wraps himself in a felt blanket and rolls down the slope; those with felt follow him the same way, and those without tie ropes round their waists and climb down by the trees, one behind another. On the way they find a stone tablet carved with a prophecy by Zhuge Liang, and Deng Ai bows before it in awe.

Deng Ai's biography in the Records tells it: in the tenth month of 263 he led his men through seven hundred li of uninhabited country by the Yinping road, cutting through mountains and building bridges and galleries; the peaks were high, the valleys deep, the food nearly gone, and they were often in danger. He wrapped himself in felt and rolled down; his soldiers clambered down the cliffs clinging to trees, in single file. They reached Jiangyou first, and its Shu commander Ma Miao surrendered. The tablet is the novel's: the 'two fires' make the character yan, for Shu's last era name Yanxing, and the 'two shi' are Deng Ai and Zhong Hui, whose courtesy names both contain shi, and who both died violently the next year.
ch117-yinping.why: One of the boldest marches in Chinese military history, it outflanked Jiange and doomed Shu.
ch117-yinping.why_zh: 偷渡阴平是中国军事史上最大胆的奇袭之一，绕过剑阁天险，决定了蜀汉的灭亡。

quote.zh: 二火初兴，有人越此。二士争衡，不久自死。
quote.en: When the two fires first rise, someone will cross here. Two shi will contend, and before long both will die.

people.name: Deng Ai
people.role_zh: 魏征西将军，率偏师偷渡

story_zh: 邓艾越过阴平，江油守将马邈不战而降，成都大震。后主急召诸葛亮之子诸葛瞻领兵抵御。诸葛瞻此前因黄皓弄权而托病不出，此时慨然领命，带着长子诸葛尚率军赶赴绵竹。初战时，他效法父亲，推出一辆四轮车，车上端坐诸葛亮的木像，魏将邓忠、师纂以为孔明复生，吓得大败而回。
邓艾识破木像之计，写信劝降，许诺奏请封诸葛瞻为琅琊王。诸葛瞻撕碎书信，斩了来使，出城决战，却中了埋伏，被魏军重重围住，身中数箭，大呼自己力竭，当以一死报国，拔剑自刎。诸葛尚见父亲战死，叹道父子祖孙世受国恩，自己岂能偷生，策马冲入魏阵，力战而死。
据《三国志·诸葛瞻传》，诸葛瞻督军到涪县停留，前锋失利，退守绵竹；邓艾来信说“若降者必表为琅邪王”，他大怒斩使，战败阵亡，年三十七岁，长子诸葛尚同死。黄权之子黄崇曾流着泪劝他火速抢占险要，他犹豫不决。裴注引《华阳国志》载，诸葛尚临死叹恨没有早斩黄皓。陈寿评价诸葛瞻在蜀人心中“美声溢誉，有过其实”。
story: With Deng Ai through the Yinping wilderness and Ma Miao surrendering Jiangyou without a fight, Chengdu is in panic. Liu Shan calls on Zhuge Liang's son Zhuge Zhan, who had stayed at home pleading illness while Huang Hao ran the court. He accepts at once and marches to Mianzhu with his eldest son Zhuge Shang. In the first clash he borrows his father's trick: out rolls a four-wheeled carriage with Zhuge Liang's wooden likeness seated in it, and the Wei officers Deng Zhong and Shi Zuan, thinking Kongming has come back to life, flee in disorder.

Deng Ai sees through the statue and writes offering to have Zhuge Zhan made Prince of Langya if he surrenders. Zhuge Zhan tears up the letter, beheads the messenger and comes out to fight, but runs into an ambush. Surrounded and struck by several arrows, he cries that his strength is spent and he will repay the state with his life, and cuts his own throat. Seeing his father dead, Zhuge Shang declares that three generations of his family have owed everything to the state and he will not live on; he spurs into the Wei ranks and dies fighting.

Zhuge Zhan's biography in the Records says he halted at Fu, fell back to Mianzhu when his vanguard was beaten, and, when Deng Ai wrote 'if you surrender I will certainly recommend you as Prince of Langya', beheaded the envoy in fury, fought, lost and died in battle at thirty-seven, his eldest son Zhuge Shang with him. Huang Chong, son of Huang Quan, had begged him in tears to seize the passes quickly, but he hesitated. The Huayang guozhi, quoted by Pei Songzhi, has Zhuge Shang lamenting before he died that they had not executed Huang Hao in time. Chen Shou thought Zhuge Zhan's reputation in Shu outran his real ability.
ch117-mianzhu.why: Zhuge Liang's son and grandson die in Shu's last battle, a loyal end that the novel sets against the court's surrender.
ch117-mianzhu.why_zh: 诸葛亮的子孙战死于蜀汉的最后一战，以身殉国，与随后朝廷的投降形成鲜明对照。

people.name: Deng Ai
people.role: Wei general whose offer is refused

people.name: Huang Chong
people.role_zh: 蜀将，劝诸葛瞻速据险要

story_zh: 绵竹失守，邓艾兵临成都。后主刘禅召集群臣商议：有人主张南逃南中，有人主张东投孙吴，光禄大夫谯周却力主降魏。他说魏能吞吴，吴不能吞魏，与其先向吴称臣、日后再受一次亡国之辱，不如一次降魏；南中蛮夷也靠不住。后主听从谯周，准备出城投降。
后主第五子北地王刘谌闻讯大怒，骂谯周是苟且偷生的腐儒，说自古哪有投降的天子！纵然力尽，也该君臣父子背城一战，同死社稷，去见先帝。后主不听，把他赶了出去。刘谌回到家中，妻子崔夫人听说原委，抢先触柱而死。刘谌杀了三个儿子，割下妻子首级，来到昭烈庙中伏地痛哭，眼中流出血来，然后自刎。蜀人无不伤心落泪。
随后，后主反缚双手、抬着棺材，率太子、诸王和群臣出城北投降，邓艾亲手为他松绑，焚烧棺木。刘谌之死见于裴注引《汉晋春秋》，“背城一战，同死社稷，以见先帝”正是其中原话。据裴注引王隐《蜀记》，蜀亡时有户二十八万、口九十四万，带甲将士十万二千。蜀汉自刘备称帝至此，共四十三年。
story: With Mianzhu lost, Deng Ai is at the gates of Chengdu. Liu Shan's ministers argue: some want to flee south to Nanzhong, some east to Wu, but the counsellor Qiao Zhou insists on surrender to Wei. Wei can swallow Wu, he says, and Wu cannot swallow Wei; better to be humiliated once than to bow to Wu now and be conquered a second time later, and the southern tribes cannot be trusted. Liu Shan takes his advice and prepares to surrender.

Liu Shan's fifth son, Liu Chen, Prince of Beidi, is furious. He calls Qiao Zhou a cowardly pedant and asks when an emperor has ever surrendered: if their strength is spent, father and son, lord and minister should fight one last battle before the walls and die with the state, and face the late emperor with honour. Liu Shan has him thrown out. At home his wife, Lady Cui, hears what has happened and dashes herself against a pillar. Liu Chen kills his three sons, takes his wife's head to the temple of Liu Bei and weeps there until his eyes run with blood; then he kills himself. All Shu mourns him.

Then Liu Shan, hands bound behind him and a coffin carried in his train, leads his heir, the princes and the court out of the north of the city to surrender; Deng Ai unties him himself and burns the coffin. Liu Chen's death is in the Han-Jin chunqiu quoted by Pei Songzhi, which already has his call to fight one last battle and die with the state in the words the novel uses. According to Wang Yin's Shu ji, also in Pei's notes, Shu at its fall had 280,000 households, 940,000 people and 102,000 soldiers. Shu Han had lasted forty-three years since Liu Bei took the throne.
ch118-shu-falls.why: Shu Han ends after forty-three years, and Liu Chen's suicide gives Liu Bei's dynasty one last act of defiance.
ch118-shu-falls.why_zh: 蜀汉立国四十三年至此灭亡，刘谌哭庙殉国，为刘备开创的基业留下最后一抹悲壮。

people.name: Liu Chen
people.role: Prince of Beidi, dies in the ancestral temple

story_zh: 邓艾进入成都，承制拜刘禅为骠骑将军，自行任命蜀国官员，颇为得意，对蜀中士大夫说：你们幸亏遇到了我，才有今天；若遇到别的将领，早被杀光了。他上书司马昭，建议暂留大军在蜀，厚待刘禅以招降东吴。司马昭派监军卫瓘传话，凡事须先奏报，邓艾却回信说，大夫出境，只要能安社稷、利国家，便可专断。
钟会早就嫉妒邓艾抢了灭蜀头功，上表诬告邓艾要据蜀谋反。司马昭下令用槛车把邓艾押送洛阳。卫瓘连夜赶到成都，传令邓艾手下诸将，众将纷纷归顺；天刚亮，他闯进邓艾的卧房，把还在床上的邓艾和儿子邓忠拿下，装进槛车。邓艾仰天长叹：自己一片忠心，竟落到这般地步！
此事见于《三国志》邓艾、钟会二传。裴注引《世语》说，钟会善于模仿他人笔迹，在剑阁截下邓艾的章表，改得言辞傲慢，又毁掉司马昭的回信另写一封。邓艾的结局更惨：钟会败死后，邓艾旧部追上槛车想救他回来，卫瓘怕遭报复，派田续在绵竹以西追杀邓艾父子。田续曾在江油因延误险些被邓艾斩首，卫瓘对他说：可以报江油之辱了。
story: In Chengdu, Deng Ai makes Liu Shan a general on the court's authority and appoints Shu officials himself. He tells the gentlemen of Shu that they are lucky it was him: any other general would have wiped them out. He writes to Sima Zhao proposing to keep the army in Shu and treat Liu Shan generously to tempt Wu into surrender. When Sima Zhao sends the army supervisor Wei Guan to say that everything must first be reported, Deng Ai answers that a minister in the field may act on his own whenever it serves the state.

Zhong Hui, long jealous of Deng Ai's glory in taking Shu, reports that Deng Ai means to make himself master of Shu. Sima Zhao orders Deng Ai brought to Luoyang in a cage cart. Wei Guan reaches Chengdu by night and sends orders to Deng Ai's officers, who all submit; at dawn he bursts into Deng Ai's bedroom, seizes him and his son Deng Zhong in their beds and puts them in the cart. Deng Ai looks up to heaven and laments that a loyal servant should come to this.

Both men's biographies in the Records tell the story. The Shiyu, quoted by Pei Songzhi, adds that Zhong Hui, a skilled imitator of handwriting, intercepted Deng Ai's reports at Jiange and rewrote them in arrogant terms, and destroyed Sima Zhao's reply and forged another. Deng Ai's end was worse still: after Zhong Hui fell, Deng Ai's men caught up with the cage cart to bring him back, and Wei Guan, fearing revenge, sent Tian Xu to kill Deng Ai and his son west of Mianzhu. At Jiangyou Deng Ai had nearly beheaded Tian Xu for being slow, and Wei Guan told him: 'Now you can avenge Jiangyou.'
ch118-deng-ai-cage.why: The two conquerors of Shu turn on each other, and within weeks both are dead, as the stone tablet foretold.
ch118-deng-ai-cage.why_zh: 灭蜀的两位功臣相争相残，转眼之间双双身死，应验了阴平石碣上的预言。

story_zh: 后主降魏后，下诏命姜维投降。剑阁将士听说，个个怒不可遏，拔刀砍石。姜维到钟会营中投降，钟会问他为何来得这么迟，姜维正色流泪说：今日来到这里，已经算快了。钟会大为敬重，出则同车，坐则同席，待如兄弟。姜维看出钟会野心勃勃，便拿韩信、文种功成被诛的旧事激他，劝他据蜀自立，心中却另有打算。
邓艾被押走后，司马昭亲率大军进驻长安。钟会心知已被猜疑，决意起兵：事成可得天下，不成也能退保蜀汉，做个刘备。他借郭太后去世之机，召集魏军将领到蜀宫发丧，假称太后遗诏命他讨伐司马昭，把不肯依从的将领都关押起来。姜维暗中写信给刘禅，请他忍受几天屈辱，打算借钟会之手杀尽魏将，再杀钟会，恢复蜀汉。
被关押的胡烈托亲兵传话给儿子胡渊，说钟会要把魏兵全部坑杀。次日魏军哗变，杀入宫中。姜维挥剑连杀数人，忽然心痛难忍，仰天大叫：“吾计不成，乃天命也！”拔剑自刎；钟会也死于乱军之中。乱兵剖开姜维尸体，见他的胆大如鸡卵。据《三国志》钟会、姜维二传，姜维其实是被乱兵所杀，他的妻儿和刘禅的太子刘璿也死于这场变乱。
story: After Liu Shan's surrender, an edict orders Jiang Wei to lay down his arms. His soldiers at Jiange are so angry they hack at the rocks with their swords. When Jiang Wei comes to Zhong Hui's camp, Zhong Hui asks why he has been so slow; Jiang Wei answers gravely, in tears, that coming today is quick enough. Zhong Hui is deeply impressed and treats him as a brother, sharing his carriage and his mat. Seeing how ambitious Zhong Hui is, Jiang Wei reminds him of Han Xin and Wen Zhong, killed by the masters they had served so well, and urges him to make Shu his own, with plans of his own in mind.

Once Deng Ai has been carted away, Sima Zhao marches to Chang'an with a great army, and Zhong Hui knows he is suspected. He decides to rise: if he wins, the empire is his; if he fails, he can still hold Shu and be another Liu Bei. Using the death of the empress dowager Guo as a pretext, he gathers the Wei officers in the Shu palace for mourning, produces a forged edict from her ordering him to overthrow Sima Zhao, and locks up those who will not go along. Jiang Wei secretly writes to Liu Shan asking him to bear a few days' humiliation: he means to have Zhong Hui kill the Wei officers, then kill Zhong Hui and restore Shu.

But Hu Lie, one of the imprisoned officers, gets word to his son Hu Yuan that Zhong Hui plans to slaughter every Wei soldier. The next day the army mutinies and storms the palace. Jiang Wei cuts down several men, then is seized by a pain in his heart; he cries to heaven, 'My plan has failed: it is fate!' and cuts his own throat, and Zhong Hui too dies at the soldiers' hands. When the mutineers cut Jiang Wei open, they find his gall, the seat of courage, as large as an egg. In the Records' biographies of Zhong Hui and Jiang Wei, Jiang Wei is killed by the mutineers; his wife and children and Liu Shan's heir Liu Xuan also die in the chaos.
ch119-zhong-hui-revolt.why: Jiang Wei's last gamble to revive Shu ends with Shu's last general and its conqueror dying together.
ch119-zhong-hui-revolt.why_zh: 这是姜维复兴蜀汉的最后一搏，蜀国最后的大将与灭蜀的魏将同归于尽。

quote.zh: 吾计不成，乃天命也！
quote.en: My plan has failed: this is heaven's will!

people.name: Hu Lie
people.role: imprisoned Wei officer who sparks the mutiny
people.role_zh: 被囚魏将，传信引发兵变

story_zh: 钟会之乱平定后，刘禅举家迁往洛阳。司马昭封他为安乐公，赐给住宅、钱绢和僮仆，随行的樊建、谯周、郤正等旧臣也都封了侯。弄权误国的宦官黄皓，则被司马昭下令处死。刘禅叩头谢恩，从此在洛阳过起了安逸的日子。
一天，司马昭设宴款待刘禅，先演奏魏国乐舞，蜀国旧臣都黯然神伤，刘禅却喜笑自若；又让人表演蜀地乐舞，旧臣无不落泪，刘禅依旧嬉笑如常。司马昭对贾充感叹：人之无情，竟到这个地步！就算诸葛亮在世，也辅佐不了他长久，何况姜维呢？他问刘禅：“颇思蜀否？”刘禅答：“此间乐，不思蜀。”
郤正私下教他：再被问起，就流着泪说先人坟墓远在蜀地，没有一天不思念，然后闭上眼睛。后来司马昭又问，刘禅照样说了，想哭却挤不出眼泪，只好闭眼。司马昭问：“何乃似郤正语耶？”刘禅睁眼惊道：“诚如尊命。”满座大笑。此事见于裴注引《汉晋春秋》。刘禅在洛阳安度余生，泰始七年（271年）去世；后世也有人认为他是装傻保命。
story: After Zhong Hui's revolt is put down, Liu Shan and his family are moved to Luoyang. Sima Zhao makes him Duke of Anle, 'Peace and Joy', with a house, money, silk and servants, and the old ministers who came with him, Fan Jian, Qiao Zhou, Xi Zheng and others, are made marquises. The eunuch Huang Hao, who had ruined Shu, is put to death on Sima Zhao's orders. Liu Shan kowtows his thanks and settles into a comfortable life in the capital.

One day Sima Zhao gives a banquet for him. First Wei music is played, and the former Shu ministers look stricken while Liu Shan smiles; then come Shu songs and dances, and all the old ministers weep while Liu Shan laughs as before. Sima Zhao remarks to Jia Chong that he has never seen a man so heartless: not even Zhuge Liang could have kept such a ruler going for long, let alone Jiang Wei. He asks Liu Shan whether he misses Shu. 'I am happy here,' says Liu Shan. 'I do not miss Shu.'

Afterwards Xi Zheng coaches him: next time, weep and say that the graves of his forefathers are far away in Shu and not a day passes without his longing for them, then close his eyes. When Sima Zhao asks again, Liu Shan recites it, tries to cry, cannot, and shuts his eyes. 'Why does that sound like Xi Zheng?' asks Sima Zhao. Liu Shan opens his eyes in surprise: 'Just as you say, my lord.' The whole hall roars with laughter. The story is in the Han-Jin chunqiu quoted by Pei Songzhi. Liu Shan lived out his days in Luoyang and died in 271; some later readers have wondered whether he was playing the fool to stay alive.
ch119-happy-here.why: Liu Shan's answer gave Chinese an idiom for forgetting one's roots in comfort, and ends Liu Bei's dynasty in comedy rather than tragedy.
ch119-happy-here.why_zh: “乐不思蜀”从此成为成语，刘备开创的蜀汉以一场笑谈收场。

quote.zh: 此间乐，不思蜀
quote.en: It is pleasant here; I do not think of Shu.

people.name: Liu Shan
people.role: former Shu emperor, now Duke of Anle
people.role_zh: 蜀汉后主，降后封安乐公

people.name: Xi Zheng
people.role: former Shu official who coaches him

story_zh: 司马昭进爵晋王后，有意立过继给兄长司马师的次子司马攸为世子。贾充、何曾、裴秀等人劝他立长子司马炎，说司马炎聪明神武，头发垂地，双手过膝，不是做臣子的相貌。司马昭这才立司马炎为世子。咸熙二年八月司马昭病死，司马炎继位为晋王。
司马炎带剑入宫，问魏帝曹奂：魏的天下是靠谁的力量得来的？曹奂答：都是晋王父祖所赐。司马炎说，陛下文不能论道，武不能经邦，何不让位给有才德的人？黄门侍郎张节挺身斥责，被武士活活打死。曹奂跪地哀求，贾充便劝他效法当年汉献帝，筑受禅坛让位。
十二月，受禅坛筑成，曹奂亲捧玉玺让位，司马炎登坛受禅，国号大晋，改元泰始，封曹奂为陈留王，令他出居金墉城。从筑坛到谦让，一切都与四十五年前曹丕代汉如出一辙，所以小说回目称之为“依样画葫芦”。据《晋书·司马孚传》，司马昭的叔父司马孚拉着曹奂的手痛哭，说自己至死都是大魏的纯臣。曹奂在邺城安度余生，到太安元年（302年）才去世。
story: Made King of Jin, Sima Zhao thinks of naming as heir his second son Sima You, whom he had given to his brother Sima Shi as an adopted son. Jia Chong, He Zeng, Pei Xiu and others urge him to choose his eldest, Sima Yan: brilliant and martial, with hair that reaches the ground and arms that hang below his knees, he has no look of a subject. Sima Zhao names Sima Yan his heir, and when Sima Zhao dies in the eighth month of 265, Sima Yan becomes King of Jin.

Sima Yan comes into the palace wearing his sword and asks the emperor Cao Huan by whose strength Wei won the empire. By the gifts of the King of Jin's father and grandfather, says Cao Huan. Then why, asks Sima Yan, does an emperor who can neither discuss the Way nor govern by arms not give way to a worthier man? The court official Zhang Jie protests and is beaten to death by the guards. Cao Huan falls to his knees, and Jia Chong advises him to do as Emperor Xian of Han did: build a terrace and abdicate.

In the twelfth month the terrace is ready. Cao Huan hands over the imperial seal, Sima Yan ascends and receives the throne, names his dynasty Jin and his era Taishi, makes Cao Huan Prince of Chenliu and sends him to live in the Jinyong fortress. From the terrace to the polite refusals, everything copies Cao Pi's seizure of the Han forty-five years before, which is why the chapter title calls it drawing a gourd from the same pattern. The Book of Jin's life of Sima Fu, Sima Zhao's uncle, says he took Cao Huan's hand and wept, declaring that he would die a true subject of Wei. Cao Huan lived out his life quietly at Ye and died in 302.
ch119-jin-founded.why: Jin replaces Wei with the very ritual Wei had used to replace the Han, closing one of the novel's great circles.
ch119-jin-founded.why_zh: 晋用曹魏代汉的同一套仪式取代曹魏，完成了小说中一个首尾呼应的轮回。

quote.zh: 再受禅依样画葫芦
quote.en: A second abdication: the same gourd drawn from the same pattern.

people.name: Sima Yan
people.role: King of Jin, founds the Jin dynasty

people.name: Sima Zhao
people.role_zh: 司马炎之父，奠定代魏之基

story_zh: 吴主孙皓荒淫残暴，动辄挖人眼睛、剥人面皮，又宠信宦官岑昏，忠臣多遭杀戮。晋武帝采纳羊祜、杜预等人的建议，起兵二十余万分六路伐吴：杜预出江陵，王浑出横江，王戎出武昌，胡奋出夏口，司马伷出涂中，王濬、唐彬率水军从益州顺江而下。吴丞相张悌率军渡江迎战，兵败后不肯逃走，战死阵中。
王濬的楼船一路势如破竹，直抵建业城外的石头城。孙皓走投无路，只得依照亡国之礼，反缚双手，抬着棺材，率太子和文武百官到王濬军前投降。王濬亲手为他松绑，焚烧棺木，以礼相待。东吴就此灭亡，自黄巾起事至此九十六年，天下重归一统。
孙皓被送到洛阳，晋武帝对他说：“朕设此座以待卿久矣。”孙皓答：“臣于南方，亦设此座以待陛下。”贾充问他为何挖人眼、剥人皮，孙皓说这是用来惩治弑君和奸佞不忠之人的，贾充默然羞愧——他正是当年指使成济刺死曹髦的人。据裴注引《晋阳秋》，吴亡时有户五十二万、兵二十三万。小说以一首古风作结，末句是：“鼎足三分已成梦，后人凭吊空牢骚。”
story: The Wu emperor Sun Hao is cruel and debauched, gouging out eyes and flaying faces at whim, trusting the eunuch Cen Hun and killing loyal ministers. On the advice of Yang Hu, Du Yu and others, Emperor Wu of Jin sends over two hundred thousand men against Wu in six columns: Du Yu toward Jiangling, Wang Hun to Hengjiang, Wang Rong to Wuchang, Hu Fen to Xiakou, Sima Zhou to Tuzhong, and Wang Jun and Tang Bin with the fleet down the river from Yizhou. The Wu chancellor Zhang Ti crosses the river to meet them, is defeated, refuses to flee, and dies on the field.

Wang Jun's warships sweep all before them to the Stone City outside Jianye. With nowhere left to turn, Sun Hao performs the rite of a fallen ruler: hands bound behind him and a coffin carried behind, he leads his heir and his court to Wang Jun's camp to surrender. Wang Jun unties him with his own hands, burns the coffin and treats him with courtesy. Wu is gone, and ninety-six years after the Yellow Turbans the realm is one again.

Sun Hao is sent to Luoyang. 'I set out this seat for you long ago,' says Emperor Wu. 'In the south I set one out for Your Majesty too,' answers Sun Hao. When Jia Chong asks why he gouged out eyes and flayed faces, Sun Hao says those punishments were for subjects who murder their lords and for the treacherous, and Jia Chong, the man who had ordered Cao Mao's killing, falls silent in shame. The Jin yangqiu, quoted by Pei Songzhi, counts 523,000 households and 230,000 soldiers in Wu at its fall. The novel closes with a long poem whose last line says that the three-legged cauldron is now a dream, and those who come after mourn it in vain.
ch120-wu-falls.why: The fall of Wu ends the Three Kingdoms and the novel: ninety-six years after the Yellow Turbans, the realm is one again.
ch120-wu-falls.why_zh: 吴亡标志着三国时代和整部小说的终结，天下在黄巾起义九十六年后重归一统。

quote.zh: 鼎足三分已成梦，后人凭吊空牢骚
quote.en: The three-legged cauldron is now a dream; those who come after mourn it and grumble in vain.

people.name: Wang Jun
people.role_zh: 晋龙骧将军，率水军攻入建业

people.name: Jia Chong
people.role: Jin minister put to shame by Sun Hao

story_zh: 晋武帝筹划灭吴，命益州刺史王濬在蜀中大造战船。王濬的大楼船方一百二十步，可载两千余人，船上以木为城，建起望楼，四面开门，甲板上可以驰马往来。造船削下的木片顺江漂下，东吴建平太守吾彦捞起来呈给孙皓，警告晋必有攻吴之计，请求增兵建平，孙皓不听。
王濬上表催促出兵，说臣造船七年，船日渐朽坏，臣也年已七十，来日无多。晋武帝终于下诏伐吴，王濬率水军自成都顺江东下。东吴在西陵峡一带的江中暗设一丈多长的铁锥，又在险要处横江拉起铁锁。王濬先放下几十个大木筏，筏上扎着披甲持杖的草人，铁锥都扎在筏上被带走；又做长十余丈的大火炬，灌满麻油，遇到铁锁就点火焚烧，铁锁顷刻熔断。
此后晋军连克西陵、荆门、夷道等地，杜预又写信鼓励王濬直取建业。王濬率兵八万，战船首尾相接上百里，鼓噪东下，孙皓派去迎战的水军望见旌旗便投降了。此事详见《晋书·王濬传》。唐代刘禹锡《西塞山怀古》咏道：“王濬楼船下益州，金陵王气黯然收。千寻铁锁沉江底，一片降幡出石头。”
story: Planning the conquest of Wu, Emperor Wu of Jin has Wang Jun, governor of Yizhou, build a war fleet in Shu. His largest ships are a hundred and twenty paces square and carry over two thousand men, with wooden walls, towers and gates on all four sides, and decks wide enough to gallop a horse across. Wood shavings from the shipyards float down the Yangzi; the Wu governor of Jianping, Wu Yan, fishes some out and sends them to Sun Hao, warning that Jin is preparing an attack and asking for more troops at Jianping. Sun Hao ignores him.

Wang Jun memorialises the throne: he has been building ships for seven years, they are starting to rot, and he himself is seventy and has little time left. The emperor at last orders the attack, and Wang Jun's fleet sails down the river from Chengdu. Around the Xiling Gorge the Wu have planted long iron spikes under the water and stretched iron chains across the narrows. Wang Jun sends dozens of great rafts ahead, manned by straw soldiers in armour, and the spikes catch in them and are carried away; then he makes enormous torches soaked in sesame oil and burns through the chains, which soon melt and part.

The Jin fleet takes Xiling, Jingmen and Yidao, and Du Yu writes urging Wang Jun to go straight for Jianye. With eighty thousand men and ships stretching a hundred li, he comes downriver with drums beating, and the Wu fleet sent to stop him surrenders at the sight of his banners. The Book of Jin's life of Wang Jun tells it in detail. The Tang poet Liu Yuxi wrote of it: 'Wang Jun's towered ships came down from Yizhou, and the royal aura of Jinling faded away; a thousand fathoms of iron chain sank to the river bed, and a flag of surrender came out of the Stone City.'
ch120-wang-jun-fleet.why: Seven years of shipbuilding in Shu decided the war: the Yangzi, Wu's great defence since Red Cliffs, became Jin's road to Jianye.
ch120-wang-jun-fleet.why_zh: 益州七年造船决定了战局：自赤壁以来护卫东吴的长江天险，成了晋军直下建业的通途。

story_zh: 羊祜临终推荐杜预接替自己镇守荆州。杜预字元凯，博学多谋，酷爱《左传》，自称有“《左传》癖”；他不善骑马，射箭也穿不透甲片，却屡任大将。伐吴时他进兵江陵，先派牙将周旨等率八百人乘夜渡江，在乐乡附近的巴山上遍插旗帜、到处举火。吴将孙歆大惊，说北来的晋军简直是飞渡长江。
周旨的伏兵混在孙歆的败兵中进城，一直摸到孙歆帐下，把他活捉回营。杜预随即攻克江陵，斩吴将伍延，长江上游以至沅湘以南的州郡纷纷归降。这时有人主张，吴国是百年之敌，难以一举荡平，眼下夏天将到，江水上涨，疫病将起，不如等到冬天再大举进兵。杜预说：“今兵威已振，譬如破竹，数节之后，皆迎刃而解。”于是传令诸军，直指建业。
此事见于《晋书·杜预传》，“势如破竹”和“迎刃而解”两个成语都出自这番话。吴人知道杜预脖子上长着瘿瘤，曾把瓠瓜系在狗脖子上嘲笑他，又把树上像瘿瘤的疙瘩砍白，写上“杜预颈”；江陵城破后，杜预把这些人全部捕杀。战后他专心著述，所作《春秋左氏经传集解》至今仍是研读《左传》的重要注本。
story: Dying, Yang Hu recommends Du Yu to succeed him in command of Jingzhou. Du Yu is a scholar and a planner, so devoted to the Zuo zhuan that he calls it his addiction; he is no horseman and his arrows will not pierce armour, yet he is repeatedly given high command. Advancing on Jiangling, he sends his officer Zhou Zhi with eight hundred men across the river by night to plant flags and light fires all over the hills near Lexiang. The Wu commander Sun Xin is aghast: the northern armies must have flown across the Yangzi.

Zhou Zhi's men slip into the city among Sun Xin's own beaten soldiers, reach his tent and carry him off alive. Du Yu then takes Jiangling and kills its Wu commander, and the commanderies of the upper Yangzi and south to the Yuan and Xiang rivers submit one after another. Some officers argue that Wu, an enemy for a century, cannot be finished at one stroke: summer is coming, the rivers will rise and sickness will spread, so they should wait for winter. Du Yu answers that the army's might is roused: it is like splitting bamboo, and after the first few joints the rest open at the touch of the blade. He orders all the armies straight on to Jianye.

The episode is in Du Yu's biography in the Book of Jin, and gave Chinese two idioms, 'like splitting bamboo' and 'opening at the touch of the blade'. The men of Wu, knowing Du Yu had a goitre on his neck, had mocked him by tying gourds to dogs' necks and by stripping the bark from knotted trees and labelling them 'Du Yu's neck'; when Jiangling fell, he had them all hunted down and killed. After the war he turned to scholarship, and his commentary on the Zuo zhuan is still a standard work today.
ch120-splitting-bamboo.why: Du Yu's refusal to wait turned a successful campaign into conquest, and gave Chinese two lasting idioms.
ch120-splitting-bamboo.why_zh: 杜预坚持乘胜进兵，使伐吴一举成功，也留下了“势如破竹”“迎刃而解”两个成语。

people.name: Du Yu
people.role_zh: 晋镇南大将军，进攻江陵

people.name: Zhou Zhi
people.role: Du Yu's officer, crosses by night
